```ts
/**
 * The two default trees as data (SP3d spec §2): the defaults of the `json` leaves `density.defs` and `surface.rules`.
 * They live in core because the schema needs them as leaf defaults and core cannot import gen (master §1); they are
 * typed as `JsonValue` and gen narrows them after its own validation (tier 2).
 *
 * Each is built at module load as tier 1's registered, deep-frozen, key-sorted clone (`checkJson`, §1.7), and the load
 * throws on any issue: so `buildSchema` keeps it by identity, `checkJson` returns it as itself, `canonicalJSON` prints
 * it from its cache, and the resolvers' memo (keyed by the frozen source) hits on every context. The literals below are
 * written with `op` / `kind` first for reading; key order is not semantic.
 */
import { checkJson, type JsonFormat, type JsonValue } from './json';
import type { Issue } from './kit';

/** Tier 1's registered clone of a default tree; throws on any issue (a default that fails tier 1 is a bug). */
function registeredTree(tree: JsonValue, leaf: string, format: JsonFormat): JsonValue {
  const issues: Issue[] = [];
  const clone = checkJson(tree, leaf, issues, format);
  if (clone === undefined) throw new Error(`the default ${leaf} tree fails tier 1: ${issues.map((i) => `${i.path} ${i.code}`).join(', ')}`);
  return clone;
}

/**
 * The default density expression `{root, defs}` (SP3d spec §2.1; SP3b spec §3.1): `defaultDensityExpr` with exactly
 * three substitutions, `C(1 / clampSigma)` → `recip(param density.noises.jag.clampSigma)`, `C(detailAmpLo)` →
 * `param density.detailAmpLo` and `C(detailAmpHi − detailAmpLo)` → `add(param density.detailAmpHi, neg(param
 * density.detailAmpLo))` (`hi + (−lo)` is `hi − lo` for every pair of doubles, §1.4). The sums stay left-nested in the
 * written order (IEEE addition is not associative). `SLIDE`, the floor and ceiling terms and `islands` = −1e6 are data.
 */
export const DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE: JsonValue = registeredTree(
  {
    root: { op: 'max',
      a: { op: 'add',
        a: { op: 'tap', name: 'terrain',
          x: { op: 'interpolated',
            x: { op: 'add',
              a: { op: 'add',
                a: { op: 'add',
                  a: { op: 'add',
                    a: { op: 'add',
                      a: { op: 'col', field: 'offset' },
                      b: { op: 'mul',
                        a: { op: 'col', field: 'jag' },
                        b: { op: 'square',
                          x: { op: 'add',
                            a: { op: 'const', v: 1 },
                            b: { op: 'neg',
                              x: { op: 'abs',
                                x: { op: 'mul',
                                  a: { op: 'noise2', id: 'jag' },
                                  b: { op: 'recip', x: { op: 'param', path: 'density.noises.jag.clampSigma' } },
                                },
                              },
                            },
                          },
                        },
                      },
                    },
                    b: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'y' } },
                  },
                  b: { op: 'mul',
                    a: { op: 'col', field: 'sigma' },
                    b: { op: 'slide', x: { op: 'noise', id: 'overhang' }, knots: [[-64, 0], [-40, 1], [240, 1], [320, 0]] },
                  },
                },
                b: { op: 'mul',
                  a: { op: 'const', v: 2 },
                  b: { op: 'max',
                    a: { op: 'const', v: 0 },
                    b: { op: 'add', a: { op: 'const', v: -56 }, b: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'y' } } },
                  },
                },
              },
              b: { op: 'neg',
                x: { op: 'mul',
                  a: { op: 'const', v: 2 },
                  b: { op: 'max', a: { op: 'const', v: 0 }, b: { op: 'add', a: { op: 'y' }, b: { op: 'const', v: -296 } } },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        b: { op: 'mul',
          a: { op: 'noise', id: 'detail' },
          b: { op: 'add',
            a: { op: 'param', path: 'density.detailAmpLo' },
            b: { op: 'mul',
              a: { op: 'add',
                a: { op: 'param', path: 'density.detailAmpHi' },
                b: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'param', path: 'density.detailAmpLo' } },
              },
              b: { op: 'clamp',
                x: { op: 'mul',
                  a: { op: 'add', a: { op: 'col', field: 'E' }, b: { op: 'const', v: 1 } },
                  b: { op: 'const', v: 0.5 },
                },
                lo: 0,
                hi: 1,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      b: { op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: { op: 'const', v: -1000000 } },
    },
    defs: {},
  },
  'density.defs',
  'density',
);

/**
 * The default surface-rule tree (SP3d spec §2.2; SP3c spec §4): `defaultSurfaceRules`' tree, which is
 * `test/fixtures/sp3c-default-rules.json` at the defaults, with its four parameter reads written as refs at the 15
 * places the builder writes them: the patch condition's `min` → `{param: 'surface.patchThreshold'}` (10), the negated
 * patch condition's `max` → `{param: 'surface.patchThreshold', neg: true}` (2, resolved as `0 − v`, never −0),
```

```ts
/**
 * The legacy default-tree builders, kept as fixtures (SP3d spec §2): `defaultDensityExpr`
 * (`src/gen/density/defaults.ts`) and `defaultSurfaceRules` (`src/gen/surface/defaults.ts`) copied unchanged as at
 * 9fababa, renamed `legacyDefaultDensityExpr` and `legacyDefaultSurfaceRules`. The data defaults of
 * `src/core/params/defaultTrees.ts` resolve to exactly these trees (§2.1, §2.2).
 */
import type { DensityParams, SurfaceParams } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import type { SurfaceBiome } from '../../src/gen/biomes/registry';
import type { DensityExpr, Expr, SlideKnot } from '../../src/gen/density/expr';
import type { Condition, Rule } from '../../src/gen/surface/rules';

// ---- density (src/gen/density/defaults.ts) ----

const SLIDE: readonly SlideKnot[] = [[-64, 0], [-40, 1], [240, 1], [320, 0]];

const C = (v: number): Expr => ({ op: 'const', v });
const Y: Expr = { op: 'y' };
const add = (a: Expr, b: Expr): Expr => ({ op: 'add', a, b });
const mul = (a: Expr, b: Expr): Expr => ({ op: 'mul', a, b });
const max = (a: Expr, b: Expr): Expr => ({ op: 'max', a, b });
const neg = (x: Expr): Expr => ({ op: 'neg', x });

/** The default density expression of SP3b spec §3.1 for `p` (= `params.density`). Ids are the `density.noises` keys. */
export function legacyDefaultDensityExpr(p: DensityParams): DensityExpr {
  const J: Expr = { op: 'square', x: add(C(1), neg({ op: 'abs', x: mul({ op: 'noise2', id: 'jag' }, C(1 / p.noises.jag.clampSigma)) })) };
  const N3: Expr = { op: 'noise', id: 'overhang' };
  let inner = add({ op: 'col', field: 'offset' }, mul({ op: 'col', field: 'jag' }, J));
  inner = add(inner, neg(Y));
  inner = add(inner, mul({ op: 'col', field: 'sigma' }, { op: 'slide', x: N3, knots: SLIDE }));
  inner = add(inner, mul(C(2), max(C(0), add(C(-56), neg(Y)))));
  inner = add(inner, neg(mul(C(2), max(C(0), add(Y, C(-296))))));
  const terrain: Expr = { op: 'tap', name: 'terrain', x: { op: 'interpolated', x: inner } };
  const e01: Expr = { op: 'clamp', x: mul(add({ op: 'col', field: 'E' }, C(1)), C(0.5)), lo: 0, hi: 1 };
  const amp = add(C(p.detailAmpLo), mul(C(p.detailAmpHi - p.detailAmpLo), e01));
  const detail = mul({ op: 'noise', id: 'detail' }, amp);
  const islands: Expr = { op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: C(-1e6) };
  return { root: max(add(terrain, detail), islands), defs: {} };
}

// ---- surface rules (src/gen/surface/defaults.ts) ----

/** The bedrock gradient (rule [0]) and the deepslate gradient (rule [2]). */
const BEDROCK_LO = -64;
const BEDROCK_HI = -59;
const DEEPSLATE_LO = 0;
const DEEPSLATE_HI = 8;
/** The patch noise's range limits: the clampSigma maximum of every noise leaf (8), so a one-sided range is total. */
const PATCH_LIMIT = 8;
const PATCH_NOISE = 'surface.noises.patch';

const block = (state: string): Rule => ({ kind: 'block', state });
const seq = (...rules: Rule[]): Rule => ({ kind: 'sequence', rules });
/** `if A ∧ B ∧ … → R`: nested conditions, A outermost. */
const when = (conds: readonly Condition[], then: Rule): Rule =>
  conds.reduceRight<Rule>((r, c) => ({ kind: 'condition', if: c, then: r }), then);
const biome = (...biomes: SurfaceBiome[]): Condition => ({ kind: 'biome', biomes });
const not = (c: Condition): Condition => ({ kind: 'not', if: c });
const floor = (offset: number, addSurfaceDepth: boolean): Condition => ({ kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset, addSurfaceDepth });
const water = (offset: number, runTop: boolean): Condition => ({ kind: 'water', offset, runTop });
const gradient = (trueAtAndBelow: number, falseAtAndAbove: number): Condition => ({ kind: 'verticalGradient', trueAtAndBelow, falseAtAndAbove });

/** The default rule tree of SP3c spec §4 for `p` (= `params.surface`). */
export function legacyDefaultSurfaceRules(p: SurfaceParams): Rule {
  const TOP = floor(0, false);
  const SKIN = floor(0, true);
  const BAND4 = floor(4, true);
  const P: Condition = { kind: 'noiseThreshold', noise: PATCH_NOISE, min: p.patchThreshold, max: PATCH_LIMIT };
  const Pn: Condition = { kind: 'noiseThreshold', noise: PATCH_NOISE, min: 0 - PATCH_LIMIT, max: 0 - p.patchThreshold };
  const LAKE: Condition = { kind: 'lake' };

  const underWater = seq(
    when([biome('warm_ocean', 'beach', 'snowy_beach')], block('sand')),
    when([biome('deep_ocean', 'frozen_ocean')], block('gravel')),
    when([biome('river', 'frozen_river', 'swamp'), P], block('clay')),
    when([LAKE, P], block('clay')),
    when([biome('river', 'frozen_river')], block('dirt')),
    when([LAKE, water(-2, true)], block('sand')),
    when([not(water(-10, true))], block('gravel')),
    when([water(-10, false)], block('sand')),
    block('gravel'),
  );
  const cliffs = seq(when([biome('frozen_peaks')], block('packed_ice')), block('stone'));
  const grassy = seq(
    when([biome('taiga', 'snowy_taiga'), P], block('podzol')),
    when([biome('taiga', 'snowy_taiga'), Pn], block('coarse_dirt')),
    when([biome('savanna'), P], block('coarse_dirt')),
    when([biome('jungle'), P], block('podzol')),
    when([biome('swamp'), P], block('mud')),
    when([biome('windswept_hills'), P], block('gravel')),
    when([biome('windswept_hills'), Pn], block('stone')),
    block('grass_block'),
  );
  const palette = seq(
    when([biome('desert', 'beach', 'snowy_beach', 'river', 'frozen_river', 'ocean', 'deep_ocean', 'warm_ocean', 'frozen_ocean')], block('sand')),
    when([biome('badlands')], seq(when([TOP], block('red_sand')), { kind: 'bandlands' })),
    when([biome('stony_shore', 'volcano')], seq(when([TOP, P], block('gravel')), block('stone'))),
    when([biome('stony_peaks')], seq(when([TOP, P], block('calcite')), block('stone'))),
    when([biome('frozen_peaks')], seq(when([TOP, P], block('packed_ice')), when([TOP], block('snow_block')), block('stone'))),
    when([biome('snowy_slopes', 'jagged_peaks')], seq(when([TOP], block('snow_block')), block('stone'))),
    when([TOP], grassy),
    block('dirt'),
  );
  const band = seq(
    when([biome('desert', 'beach', 'snowy_beach')], block('sandstone')),
    when([biome('badlands')], block('red_sandstone')),
  );
  const skin = seq(
    when([not(water(0, false)), SKIN], underWater),
    when([{ kind: 'steep', min: p.cliffSteep }, { kind: 'yAbove', minY: p.cliffMinY, runTop: true }, SKIN], cliffs),
    when([TOP, { kind: 'temperatureBelow', t: p.snowline }], block('snow_block')),
    when([SKIN], palette),
    when([BAND4], band),
  );
  return seq(
    when([gradient(BEDROCK_LO, BEDROCK_HI)], block('bedrock')),
    when([{ kind: 'skyOpen' }], skin),
    when([gradient(DEEPSLATE_LO, DEEPSLATE_HI)], block('deepslate')),
  );
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, expectTypeOf, test } from 'vitest';
import { COL_FIELD_BOUNDS } from '../../src/core/constants';
import { fnv1a32 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import type { ParamsPatch } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { Xoshiro128 } from '../../src/core/rng';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { compileSpline, evalSpline } from '../../src/core/spline/hermite';
import type { NestedSpline, SplineCoord } from '../../src/core/spline/types';
import { buildColumnSample, newColumnSample, readField, SAMPLE_FIELDS, type SampleField } from '../../src/gen/column/columnStage';
import { createGenContext, type GenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { paramsWith } from '../harness/gen';

/** DT2's columns (test/metrics/region.metric.ts): per profile, uniform over ±1024 chunks (default) or ±4096 (large_biomes). */
const DT2_RANGE = { default: 1024, large_biomes: 4096 } as const;
const COLUMNS = 16;

/** Every field value of `n` columns of `ctx` (the 49 lattice points and `readField` at the 256 positions) outside its bound. */
function violations(ctx: GenContext, columns: readonly (readonly [number, number])[], seen?: Map<SampleField, [number, number]>): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const s = newColumnSample();
  for (const [cx, cz] of columns) {
    buildColumnSample(ctx, cx, cz, s);
    for (const f of SAMPLE_FIELDS) {
      const [lo, hi] = COL_FIELD_BOUNDS[f];
      const check = (v: number, where: string): void => {
        if (!(v >= lo && v <= hi)) out.push(`${f} = ${v} at column (${cx}, ${cz}) ${where}`);
        const m = seen?.get(f);
        if (seen !== undefined) seen.set(f, m === undefined ? [v, v] : [Math.min(m[0], v), Math.max(m[1], v)]);
      };
      for (let k = 0; k < 49; k++) check(s.f[f][k]!, `lattice ${k}`);
      for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) check(readField(s, f, 16 * cx + (p & 15), 16 * cz + (p >> 4)), `position ${p}`);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** A three-level spline (C → E → PV) whose every knot sits at y = `y` with tangents ±1e5 pushing away from it. */
function worstSpline(y: number, coords: readonly SplineCoord[] = ['C', 'E', 'PV']): NestedSpline {
  const [c, ...rest] = coords;
  const s = y > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const at = (): number | NestedSpline => (rest.length === 0 ? y : worstSpline(y, rest));
  return { coord: c!, points: [{ x: -2, y: at(), d: s * 1e5 }, { x: 2, y: at(), d: -s * 1e5 }] };
}

describe('COL_FIELD_BOUNDS (SP3d spec §1.9)', () => {
  test('one frozen closed interval per SAMPLE_FIELDS entry, in its order', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(COL_FIELD_BOUNDS)).toEqual([...SAMPLE_FIELDS]);
    expectTypeOf<keyof typeof COL_FIELD_BOUNDS>().toEqualTypeOf<SampleField>();
    expect(Object.isFrozen(COL_FIELD_BOUNDS)).toBe(true);
    for (const f of SAMPLE_FIELDS) {
      const b = COL_FIELD_BOUNDS[f];
      expect(Object.isFrozen(b)).toBe(true);
      expect(b).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(b[0]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(b[1]);
    }
  });

  test('every field is bounded, the four the default tree reads (offset, jag, sigma, E) included, far below 1e100', () => {
    for (const f of SAMPLE_FIELDS) {
      const [lo, hi] = COL_FIELD_BOUNDS[f];
      expect(Number.isFinite(lo) && Number.isFinite(hi), f).toBe(true);
      expect(Math.max(-lo, hi), f).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1e6);
    }
    expect(COL_FIELD_BOUNDS.offset).toEqual([-600_000, 600_000]);
    expect(COL_FIELD_BOUNDS.jag).toEqual([0, 500_000]);
    expect(COL_FIELD_BOUNDS.sigma).toEqual([0, 500_000]);
    expect(COL_FIELD_BOUNDS.E).toEqual([-1, 1]);
  });

  test("sampled values over DT2's columns (seed '42', both profiles) lie inside their bounds", () => {
    const r = new Xoshiro128(fnv1a32('DT2'));
    for (const profile of ['default', 'large_biomes'] as const) {
      const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile(profile));
      const R = DT2_RANGE[profile];
      const columns = Array.from({ length: COLUMNS }, () => [-R + r.nextInt(2 * R), -R + r.nextInt(2 * R)] as const);
      expect(violations(ctx, columns), profile).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  test("the spline bound: a worst-case three-level spline overshoots its knots by 3 × 1e5, inside offset0's ±5e5", () => {
    for (const y of [320, -64]) {
      const s = compileSpline(worstSpline(y), { coords: ['C', 'E', 'PV'], yMin: -64, yMax: 320 });
      const coords = new Float64Array(6);
      let lo = Infinity;
      let hi = -Infinity;
      for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) for (let j = 0; j <= 40; j++) for (let k = 0; k <= 40; k++) {
        coords[0] = -1 + i / 20; coords[1] = -1 + j / 20; coords[3] = -1 + k / 20;
        const v = evalSpline(s, coords);
        lo = Math.min(lo, v);
        hi = Math.max(hi, v);
      }
      if (y > 0) expect(hi).toBe(320 + 3e5);
      else expect(lo).toBe(-64 - 3e5);
      expect(Math.max(-lo, hi)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(COL_FIELD_BOUNDS.offset0[1]);
      expect(-lo).toBeLessThanOrEqual(-COL_FIELD_BOUNDS.offset0[0]);
    }
  });

  test('worst-case schema-valid shape splines, rivers and lakes: every sampled value stays inside its bound', () => {
    const r = new Xoshiro128(fnv1a32('COL_FIELD_BOUNDS'));
    const columns = Array.from({ length: COLUMNS }, () => [-1024 + r.nextInt(2048), -1024 + r.nextInt(2048)] as const);
    for (const y of [320, -64]) {
      const patch: ParamsPatch = {
        shape: { offset: worstSpline(y), sigma: worstSpline(y > 0 ? 64 : -16), jag: worstSpline(y > 0 ? 128 : -16) },
        lakes: { p: 1, minC: -1, offsetMin: -64, offsetMax: 320, depthMin: 64, depthVar: 64, rimRise: 32, rimSigma: 8, rimWidth: 2 },
        rivers: { depthMin: 32, depthVar: 32, gorgeDepth: 64, valleyFloor: 128, valleyRise: 64 },
      };
      const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), paramsWith(patch));
      const seen = new Map<SampleField, [number, number]>();
      expect(violations(ctx, columns, seen), `knots at ${y}`).toEqual([]);
      // The overshoot is real: offset0 leaves the schema's [−64, 320] by far more than the knots.
      const o = seen.get('offset0')!;
      expect(y > 0 ? o[1] > 1e5 : o[0] < -1e5).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX, RULES_COLUMN_COST_MAX } from '../../src/core/constants';
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import { countTreeNodes } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import { EXPR_CHILD_KEYS, type DensityExpr, type Expr } from '../../src/gen/density/expr';
import { densityColumnCost, rulesColumnCost, structuralCost, workCost } from '../../src/gen/inspect/cost';
import { surfaceFastPath } from '../../src/gen/surface/compile';
import type { Rule } from '../../src/gen/surface/rules';
import { randomDensityExpr, SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES } from '../harness/densityFuzz';
import { legacyDefaultDensityExpr, legacyDefaultSurfaceRules } from '../harness/legacyTrees';
import { paramsWith } from '../harness/gen';
import { testRng } from '../harness/stats';
import { randomSurfaceRules, withRegisteredBlocks } from '../harness/surfaceFuzz';

type Rec = Record<string, unknown>;
const isRec = (v: unknown): v is Rec => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
/** A mutable deep copy of a JSON value. */
const copy = <T>(v: T): T => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)) as T;
/** The object at a dotted path with `[i]` items (`root.a.a`, `rules[2].if`). */
function at(v: unknown, path: string): Rec {
  let x: unknown = v;
  for (const part of path.split('.')) {
    const m = /^(\w+)((?:\[\d+\])*)$/.exec(part)!;
    x = (x as Rec)[m[1]!];
    for (const i of m[2]!.matchAll(/\[(\d+)\]/g)) x = (x as unknown[])[Number(i[1])];
  }
  if (!isRec(x)) throw new Error(`no object at ${path}`);
  return x;
}
const src = DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE as unknown as { root: unknown; defs: unknown };

/** The SP3c static maximum of SD_MAX: ⌊3.25 + 2.75 · 2 · 8⌋ (depthMul ≤ 2, clampSigma ≤ 8). */
const SD_MAX_STATIC = 47;
const VOXELS = 98304;
const CORNERS = 1225;

/** Recursive oracles of the three density costs (small trees only): §1.7 and §5.2 as written. */
function oracle(e: unknown, defs: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>, mode: 'structural' | 'column' | { params: Params }, corner = false): number {
  const n = e as Rec;
  const op = n['op'] as string;
  if (op === 'ref') return oracle(defs[n['name'] as string], defs, mode, corner);
  const keys = op === 'recip' ? ['x'] : op === 'param' ? [] : EXPR_CHILD_KEYS[op as Expr['op']];
  const muted = mode === 'column' && op === 'tap' && Object.hasOwn(n, 'mute');
  const inner = corner || op === 'interpolated';
  if (mode === 'column') {
    const own = (op === 'noise' || op === 'noise2' ? 128 : 1) * (corner ? CORNERS : VOXELS);
    if (muted) return own + (inner ? CORNERS : VOXELS);
    return own + keys.reduce((s, k) => s + oracle(n[k], defs, mode, inner), 0);
  }
  let own = 1;
  if (typeof mode === 'object' && (op === 'noise' || op === 'noise2')) {
    const d = (mode.params.density.noises as Readonly<Record<string, { octaves: number; double: boolean }>>)[n['id'] as string]!;
    own = 4 * d.octaves * (d.double ? 2 : 1);
  }
  const kids = keys.reduce((s, k) => s + oracle(n[k], defs, mode, inner), 0);
  return own + (op === 'interpolated' ? 8 : 1) * kids;
}

describe('structural and work costs (SP3d spec §1.7, §5.2)', () => {
  test('the default root costs 333 as source and 322 as the legacy-built tree', () => {
    expect(structuralCost(src.root, src.defs)).toBe(333);
    const legacy = legacyDefaultDensityExpr(DEFAULTS.density);
    expect(structuralCost(legacy.root, legacy.defs)).toBe(322);
  });

  test('the default work cost is 569 at DEFAULTS: 322 units, 17 of them noises (8 jag, 8 overhang corners, 1 detail)', () => {
    const legacy = legacyDefaultDensityExpr(DEFAULTS.density);
    expect(workCost(legacy, DEFAULTS)).toBe(569);
    expect(322 - 17 + 8 * 16 + 8 * 16 + 8).toBe(569);
    // The configured leaf: 3 octaves of a single-stack jag weigh 12 each.
    const p = paramsWith({ density: { noises: { jag: { octaves: 3, double: false } } } });
    expect(workCost(legacy, p)).toBe(569 - 8 * 16 + 8 * 12);
  });

  test('a ref costs its def; interpolated 1 + 8 × child; a muted tap counts its child; mutes ignored', () => {
    const y = { op: 'y' };
    const defs = { d: { op: 'add', a: y, b: y } };
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'ref', name: 'd' }, defs)).toBe(3);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'neg', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'd' } }, defs)).toBe(4);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'interpolated', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'd' } }, defs)).toBe(1 + 8 * 3);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'tap', name: 't', mute: 0, x: { op: 'ref', name: 'd' } }, defs)).toBe(4);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'recip', x: { op: 'param', path: 'density.noises.jag.clampSigma' } })).toBe(2);
    expect(workCost({ root: { op: 'mul', a: { op: 'noise', id: 'detail' }, b: { op: 'noise2', id: 'jag' } }, defs: {} }, DEFAULTS)).toBe(1 + 8 + 16);
    // A noise the params do not hold weighs the static maximum, 4 × 16 × 2.
    expect(workCost({ root: { op: 'noise', id: 'nope' }, defs: {} }, DEFAULTS)).toBe(128);
  });

  test('own-property lookups: Object.prototype member names are ordinary def names, inherited members are not defs', () => {
    const defs = { constructor: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'y' } }, toString: { op: 'ref', name: 'constructor' } };
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'ref', name: 'toString' }, defs)).toBe(2);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'ref', name: 'hasOwnProperty' }, defs)).toBe(1);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'ref', name: 'valueOf' }, {})).toBe(1);
    expect(densityColumnCost({ root: { op: 'ref', name: 'constructor' }, defs })).toBe(2 * VOXELS);
  });

  test('saturating at 2^31, never throwing: shared-def chains, cycles, 100,000-deep chains, junk', () => {
    const defs: Rec = { d0: { op: 'y' } };
    for (let i = 1; i <= 60; i++) defs[`d${i}`] = { op: 'add', a: { op: 'ref', name: `d${i - 1}` }, b: { op: 'ref', name: `d${i - 1}` } };
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'ref', name: 'd20' }, defs)).toBe(2 ** 21 - 1);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'ref', name: 'd60' }, defs)).toBe(2 ** 31);
    expect(densityColumnCost({ root: { op: 'ref', name: 'd60' }, defs })).toBe(2 ** 31);
    expect(workCost({ root: { op: 'ref', name: 'd60' }, defs }, DEFAULTS)).toBe(2 ** 31);
    const cyc = { a: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'b' } }, b: { op: 'ref', name: 'a' } };
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'ref', name: 'a' }, cyc)).toBe(2 ** 31);
    expect(densityColumnCost({ root: { op: 'ref', name: 'a' }, defs: cyc })).toBe(2 ** 31);
    let deep: unknown = { op: 'y' };
    for (let i = 0; i < 100_000; i++) deep = { op: 'neg', x: deep };
    expect(structuralCost(deep)).toBe(100_001);
    expect(densityColumnCost({ root: deep, defs: {} })).toBe(2 ** 31);
    expect(structuralCost(null)).toBe(0);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'bogus', x: { op: 'y' } })).toBe(1);
    expect(structuralCost({ op: 'add', a: 3, b: [1] })).toBe(1);
    expect(densityColumnCost('x')).toBe(0);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(7)).toBe(0);
    let deepRule: unknown = { kind: 'block', state: 'stone' };
    for (let i = 0; i < 100_000; i++) deepRule = { kind: 'sequence', rules: [deepRule] };
    expect(rulesColumnCost(deepRule)).toBe(100_001 * 256);
  });

  test('the three costs equal their recursive oracles on 300 random trees over the schema noises', () => {
    const next = testRng(4040);
    const p = paramsWith({ density: { noises: { overhang: { octaves: 5 }, detail: { double: false } } } });
    for (let n = 0; n < 300; n++) {
      const e: DensityExpr = randomDensityExpr(next, { noises: SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES });
      expect(structuralCost(e.root, e.defs)).toBe(oracle(e.root, e.defs, 'structural'));
      expect(workCost(e, p)).toBe(oracle(e.root, e.defs, { params: p }));
      expect(densityColumnCost(e)).toBe(oracle(e.root, e.defs, 'column'));
      for (const name of Object.keys(e.defs)) expect(structuralCost(e.defs[name], e.defs)).toBe(oracle(e.defs[name], e.defs, 'structural'));
    }
  });
});

describe('column costs and their maxima (SP3d spec §1.7 "The two column-cost maxima")', () => {
  const DENSITY_DEFAULT = 14_907_917;
  const RULES_DEFAULT = 163 * 256 * (1 + 4 + SD_MAX_STATIC);

  test('the default density column cost: 148 units × 98,304 outside interpolated, 293 × 1,225 inside', () => {
    expect(densityColumnCost(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE)).toBe(DENSITY_DEFAULT);
    expect(148 * VOXELS + 293 * CORNERS).toBe(DENSITY_DEFAULT);
    expect(densityColumnCost(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE)).toBe(oracle(src.root, src.defs as Rec, 'column'));
  });

  test('the default rules column cost: 163 nodes × 256 × (1 + 51), the depth bound 4 + SD_MAX 47', () => {
    expect(countTreeNodes(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES, 'surfaceRules')).toBe(163);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES)).toBe(RULES_DEFAULT);
    expect(RULES_DEFAULT).toBe(2_169_856);
    // The compiler's fast path agrees on the resolved default with SD_MAX at its static maximum.
    const resolved = legacyDefaultSurfaceRules(DEFAULTS.surface);
    expect(surfaceFastPath(resolved, SD_MAX_STATIC)!.maxSurfaceDepth).toBe(4 + SD_MAX_STATIC);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(resolved)).toBe(RULES_DEFAULT);
  });

  test('the maxima are 64 × the defaults and below the saturation', () => {
    expect(DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX).toBe(64 * densityColumnCost(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE));
    expect(RULES_COLUMN_COST_MAX).toBe(64 * rulesColumnCost(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES));
    expect(DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX).toBeLessThan(2 ** 31);
    expect(RULES_COLUMN_COST_MAX).toBeLessThan(2 ** 31);
  });

  test('U2 variants and uiSmoke trees stay within the maxima', () => {
    const muted = copy(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE);
    expect(at(muted, 'root.a.a')['name']).toBe('terrain');
    at(muted, 'root.a.a')['mute'] = 0;
    const islands = copy(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE);
    expect(at(islands, 'root.b')['name']).toBe('islands');
    at(islands, 'root.b.x')['v'] = -10;
    const gradient = copy(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES);
    expect(at(gradient, 'rules[2].if')).toEqual({ kind: 'verticalGradient', trueAtAndBelow: 0, falseAtAndAbove: 8 });
    at(gradient, 'rules[2].if')['falseAtAndAbove'] = 12;
    // Muting terrain replaces the interpolated subtree (1 × 98,304 + 293 × 1,225) by one const at voxel placement.
    expect(densityColumnCost(muted)).toBe(DENSITY_DEFAULT - 293 * CORNERS);
    expect(densityColumnCost(islands)).toBe(DENSITY_DEFAULT);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(gradient)).toBe(RULES_DEFAULT);
    for (const t of [muted, islands]) expect(densityColumnCost(t)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(gradient)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(RULES_COLUMN_COST_MAX);
  });

  test('a default-sized rule tree without a fast path costs 384 / 52 ≈ 7.4 × the default, within 64 ×', () => {
    const noFast = copy(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES);
    const stack: unknown[] = [noFast];
    while (stack.length > 0) {
      const x = stack.pop();
      if (Array.isArray(x)) stack.push(...(x as unknown[]));
      else if (isRec(x)) {
        if (x['kind'] === 'stoneDepth') x['side'] = 'ceiling';
        stack.push(...Object.values(x));
      }
    }
    expect(countTreeNodes(noFast, 'surfaceRules')).toBe(163);
    expect(surfaceFastPath(withRegisteredBlocks(noFast) as Rule, SD_MAX_STATIC)).toBeNull();
    expect(rulesColumnCost(noFast)).toBe(163 * VOXELS);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(noFast) / RULES_DEFAULT).toBeCloseTo(384 / 52, 12);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(noFast)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(RULES_COLUMN_COST_MAX);
  });

  test('refs in a floor offset take the end of their static range that maximises the bound', () => {
    const tree = (offset: unknown, add: boolean): unknown => ({
      kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset, addSurfaceDepth: add }, then: { kind: 'block', state: 'dirt' },
    });
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree(2, false))).toBe(3 * 256 * 3);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree(2, true))).toBe(3 * 256 * (3 + SD_MAX_STATIC));
    // surface.cliffMinY ∈ [−64, 319]: 319 at most, or 0 − (−64) = 64 negated; a bound of 383 or more is the whole column.
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree({ param: 'surface.cliffMinY' }, false))).toBe(3 * 256 * 320);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree({ param: 'surface.cliffMinY', neg: true }, false))).toBe(3 * 256 * 65);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree({ param: 'surface.cliffMinY' }, true))).toBe(3 * 256 * (320 + SD_MAX_STATIC));
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree(384, true))).toBe(3 * VOXELS);
    // A negative bound clamps to one voxel per position; an unknown target or a junk offset counts as unbounded.
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree(-20, false))).toBe(3 * 256);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree({ param: 'surface.nope' }, false))).toBe(3 * VOXELS);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(tree('x', false))).toBe(3 * VOXELS);
  });

  test('rulesColumnCost decides the fast path as surfaceFastPath does, on 600 random trees of the three fuzz styles', () => {
    const next = testRng(4041);
    let fast = 0;
    for (let n = 0; n < 600; n++) {
      const style = (['free', 'fastPath', 'nearMiss'] as const)[n % 3]!;
      const rules = withRegisteredBlocks(randomSurfaceRules(next, { style })) as Rule;
      const fp = surfaceFastPath(rules, SD_MAX_STATIC);
      const nodes = countTreeNodes(rules, 'surfaceRules');
      const perNode = fp === null ? VOXELS : Math.min(VOXELS, 256 * (1 + Math.max(0, fp.maxSurfaceDepth)));
      if (fp !== null) fast++;
      expect(rulesColumnCost(rules)).toBe(Math.min(2 ** 31, nodes * perNode));
    }
    expect(fast).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    expect(fast).toBeLessThan(500);
  });
});
```

```diff
+ *   a + (b − a)·t with t ∈ [0, 0.75] rounds into [min(a, b), max(a, b)]; `interpolated` reads lattice values as they
+ *   are. So a field's lattice interval also holds every value a density node reads.

+ *   [lo, hi] (width W) by at most t(1 − t)(D·h + W) ≤ D + W/4; so from knots in [−64, 320] the three levels give
+ *   [−100160, 100416], [−250304, 250560], [−475520, 475776] ⊂ [−S, S].

+  C: bound(-1, 1),
+  E: bound(-1, 1),
+  W: bound(-1, 1),
+  T: bound(-1, 1),
+  H: bound(-1, 1),
```

Create `src/gen/inspect/cost.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The costs of density and surface-rule trees (SP3d spec §1.7 "Costs" and "The two column-cost maxima", §5.2): one
 * function per cost, the only implementation of it, shared by tier 2 (`gen/density/source.ts`, `gen/surface/source.ts`),
 * the UI and the worker.
 * - `structuralCost(node, defs)`: 1 per node plus its children's costs; a `ref` costs its def; `interpolated` costs
 *   1 + 8 × its child (eight corners per voxel); a muted tap counts its child (mutes ignored). Value-independent.
 * - `workCost(expr, params)`: the structural cost of an evaluated expression with every `noise` / `noise2` weighted
 *   4 × octaves × (double ? 2 : 1) of its configured `density.noises.<id>` leaf (§5.2).
 * - `densityColumnCost(source)`: the source structure with mutes applied and refs expanded (no value is read), every
 *   noise at its static maximum weight (16 octaves, double), every node at voxel placement counted 98,304 times (a
 *   chunk column) and every node under `interpolated` 1,225 times (25 × 49 quart corners).
 * - `rulesColumnCost(source)`: the rule and condition node count times the voxels a column evaluates: 98,304 without a
 *   fast path, or 256 × (1 + the fast path's largest depth bound) with one (SP3c §3.4), each ref at the end of its
 *   static range that maximises the bound and SD_MAX at its static maximum.
 * The weights and factors are module-private (gen exports no numbers); every sum and product saturates at 2^31.
 *
 * Trees are read as JSON values (a source tree, a resolved or a code-built one), never trusted: every walk is iterative
 * (no recursion, whatever the depth), every lookup keyed by tree content is own-property only (`constructor`,
 * `toString`, … are valid def names), nothing throws. A value that is not a plain object is not a node (0); a node of an
 * unknown op has no children; a `ref` to a missing def counts as one node; a ref cycle saturates. Tier 2 refuses all of
 * these anyway: the costs only have to stay finite and deterministic on them.
 */
import { NOISE_FIELD_RANGES, SCHEMA, type Params } from '../../core/params/schema';
import { EXPR_CHILD_KEYS } from '../density/expr';
import { surfaceDepthMax } from '../surface/scan';

const SCHEMA_ = SCHEMA;
const NOISE_RANGES = NOISE_FIELD_RANGES;
const EXPR_CHILDREN = EXPR_CHILD_KEYS;
const SD_MAX_OF = surfaceDepthMax;

type Rec = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
const isRec = (v: unknown): v is Rec => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);

/** Every sum and product saturates here (2^31). */
const SATURATE = 2147483648;
/** Voxels of a chunk column (16 · 16 · 384) and quart corners of a chunk column (5 · 5 · 49). */
const COLUMN_VOXELS = 98304;
const COLUMN_CORNERS = 1225;
/** Positions of a chunk column: a fast-path tree evaluates the top 1 + maxSurfaceDepth voxels of each. */
const COLUMN_POSITIONS = 256;
/** A noise evaluation costs 4 units per octave per stack (§5.2). */
const NOISE_UNITS_PER_OCTAVE = 4;

const sat = (v: number): number => (v < SATURATE ? v : SATURATE);

/** Source child slots: the Expr ops' slots plus the source ops `recip` and `param` (§1.3, §1.4). */
const CHILD_KEYS: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]> = new Map<string, readonly string[]>([
  ...Object.entries(EXPR_CHILDREN), ['recip', ['x']], ['param', []],
]);
const NO_KEYS: readonly string[] = [];

/** The schema's ref targets (§1.3) and their static ranges: number and int leaves under `density.` and `surface.`, and
 * the `clampSigma` field of their noise leaves. */
const TARGET_RANGES: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly [lo: number, hi: number]> = (() => {
  const out = new Map<string, readonly [number, number]>();
  for (const { path, meta } of SCHEMA_.leaves) {
    if (!path.startsWith('density.') && !path.startsWith('surface.')) continue;
    if ((meta.kind === 'number' || meta.kind === 'int') && meta.min !== undefined && meta.max !== undefined) out.set(path, [meta.min, meta.max]);
    else if (meta.kind === 'noise') out.set(`${path}.clampSigma`, [NOISE_RANGES.clampSigma.min, NOISE_RANGES.clampSigma.max]);
  }
  return out;
})();

/** A noise at its static maximum: 16 octaves, double. */
const NOISE_MAX_WEIGHT = NOISE_UNITS_PER_OCTAVE * NOISE_RANGES.octaves.max * 2;
/** SD_MAX at its static maximum: depthMul and the depth noise's clampSigma at the top of their ranges (47). */
const SD_MAX_STATIC = SD_MAX_OF(TARGET_RANGES.get('surface.depthMul')![1], NOISE_RANGES.clampSigma.max);

const opOf = (n: Rec): string | undefined => (Object.hasOwn(n, 'op') && typeof n['op'] === 'string' ? n['op'] : undefined);
const isNoise = (op: string | undefined): boolean => op === 'noise' || op === 'noise2';

/** How a density cost weighs a node. */
interface Model {
  /** The node's own cost at voxel (false) or corner (true) placement; never called for a resolved `ref`. */
  own(n: Rec, op: string | undefined, corner: boolean): number;
  /** The factor on the sum of the children's costs. */
  factor(op: string | undefined): number;
  /** Mutes applied (a muted tap's child is a `const`) or ignored (the tap counts its child). */
  readonly mutes: boolean;
}

/** The child of a muted tap when mutes are applied. */
const MUTE_CONST: Rec = Object.freeze({ op: 'const' });

interface Frame {
  readonly own: number;
  readonly factor: number;
  readonly corner: boolean;
  readonly kids: readonly unknown[];
  /** The def this frame evaluates (memoised when it completes), or null. */
  readonly def: string | null;
  i: number;
  sum: number;
}

/**
 * The cost of `root` under `model`, refs resolved through `defs` (own properties only), by an explicit-stack post-order
 * walk with one memo per (def, placement); a def met again while it is being costed is a cycle and saturates.
 */
function treeCost(root: unknown, defs: unknown, model: Model): number {
  const memo = [new Map<string, number>(), new Map<string, number>()];
  const busy = [new Set<string>(), new Set<string>()];
  const frames: Frame[] = [{ own: 0, factor: 1, corner: false, kids: [root], def: null, i: 0, sum: 0 }];
  /** Starts a child: its cost when known at once, else a frame is pushed and undefined returned. */
  const start = (v: unknown, corner: boolean): number | undefined => {
    if (!isRec(v)) return 0;
    const op = opOf(v);
    const p = corner ? 1 : 0;
    if (op === 'ref') {
      const name = v['name'];
      if (typeof name !== 'string' || !isRec(defs) || !Object.hasOwn(defs, name)) return model.own(v, op, corner);
      const hit = memo[p]!.get(name);
      if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
      if (busy[p]!.has(name)) return SATURATE;
      busy[p]!.add(name);
      frames.push({ own: 0, factor: 1, corner, kids: [defs[name]], def: name, i: 0, sum: 0 });
      return undefined;
    }
    const keys = (op === undefined ? undefined : CHILD_KEYS.get(op)) ?? NO_KEYS;
    const kids: unknown[] = [];
    if (op === 'tap' && model.mutes && Object.hasOwn(v, 'mute')) kids.push(MUTE_CONST);
    else for (const k of keys) kids.push(Object.hasOwn(v, k) ? v[k] : undefined);
    const own = model.own(v, op, corner);
    if (kids.length === 0) return own;
    frames.push({ own, factor: model.factor(op), corner: corner || op === 'interpolated', kids, def: null, i: 0, sum: 0 });
    return undefined;
  };
  for (;;) {
    const f = frames[frames.length - 1]!;
    if (f.i < f.kids.length) {
      const v = start(f.kids[f.i++], f.corner);
      if (v !== undefined) f.sum = sat(f.sum + v);
      continue;
    }
    frames.pop();
    const value = sat(f.own + sat(f.factor * f.sum));
    if (f.def !== null) {
      const p = f.corner ? 1 : 0;
      busy[p]!.delete(f.def);
      memo[p]!.set(f.def, value);
    }
    if (frames.length === 0) return value;
    const parent = frames[frames.length - 1]!;
    parent.sum = sat(parent.sum + value);
  }
}

const STRUCTURAL: Model = {
  own: () => 1,
  factor: (op) => (op === 'interpolated' ? 8 : 1),
  mutes: false,
};

/**
 * The structural cost of the source subtree `node` (§1.7): 1 per node plus its children's costs, a `ref` costing its
 * def in `defs` (the tree's `defs` object), `interpolated` 1 + 8 × its child, a muted tap its child; saturating at
 * 2^31. The default tree's root costs 333 (source) and 322 (resolved).
 */
export function structuralCost(node: unknown, defs?: unknown): number {
  return treeCost(node, defs, STRUCTURAL);
}

/** 4 × octaves × (double ? 2 : 1) of the density noise leaf `id`; a noise the params do not hold weighs its maximum. */
function noiseWeight(params: Params, id: unknown): number {
  const noises: Rec = params.density.noises;
  if (typeof id !== 'string' || !Object.hasOwn(noises, id)) return NOISE_MAX_WEIGHT;
  const n = noises[id];
  if (!isRec(n) || typeof n['octaves'] !== 'number') return NOISE_MAX_WEIGHT;
  return NOISE_UNITS_PER_OCTAVE * n['octaves'] * (n['double'] === true ? 2 : 1);
}

/**
 * The work cost of the evaluated expression `expr` = {root, defs} (§5.2) under `params`: the structural cost with every
 * `noise` / `noise2` weighted by its configured leaf (a default `jag` or `overhang` costs 16, `detail` 8); saturating at
 * 2^31. The default root costs 569 at the default noises (322 structural units, 17 of them noise evaluations).
 */
export function workCost(expr: unknown, params: Params): number {
  if (!isRec(expr)) return 0;
  const model: Model = {
    own: (n, op) => (isNoise(op) ? noiseWeight(params, n['id']) : 1),
    factor: STRUCTURAL.factor,
    mutes: false,
  };
  return treeCost(Object.hasOwn(expr, 'root') ? expr['root'] : undefined, Object.hasOwn(expr, 'defs') ? expr['defs'] : undefined, model);
}

const DENSITY_COLUMN: Model = {
  own: (_n, op, corner) => (isNoise(op) ? NOISE_MAX_WEIGHT : 1) * (corner ? COLUMN_CORNERS : COLUMN_VOXELS),
  factor: () => 1,
  mutes: true,
};

/**
 * The density column cost of the source `{root, defs}` (§1.7 tier 2 step 5): the root's nodes with mutes applied and
 * refs expanded, each noise at its static maximum weight (128), each node at voxel placement × 98,304 and under
 * `interpolated` × 1,225; value-independent, saturating at 2^31. Tier 2 refuses it above `DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX`.
 */
export function densityColumnCost(source: unknown): number {
  if (!isRec(source)) return 0;
  return treeCost(Object.hasOwn(source, 'root') ? source['root'] : undefined, Object.hasOwn(source, 'defs') ? source['defs'] : undefined, DENSITY_COLUMN);
}

/** The largest value a numeric rule field can take: a literal, or a ref at the top of its static range (`neg`: 0 − lo). */
function fieldMax(v: unknown): number {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : Infinity;
  if (!isRec(v) || !Object.hasOwn(v, 'param') || typeof v['param'] !== 'string') return Infinity;
  const r = TARGET_RANGES.get(v['param']);
  if (r === undefined) return Infinity;
  return Object.hasOwn(v, 'neg') && v['neg'] === true ? 0 - r[0] : r[1];
}

const kindOf = (n: Rec): string | undefined => (Object.hasOwn(n, 'kind') && typeof n['kind'] === 'string' ? n['kind'] : undefined);
const field = (n: Rec, k: string): unknown => (Object.hasOwn(n, k) ? n[k] : undefined);

/** A Y-only condition (the compiler's `isYOnly`): a `verticalGradient`, a `yAbove{runTop false}`, or a `not` of one. */
function isYOnly(c: unknown): boolean {
  let x = c;
  for (;;) {
    if (!isRec(x)) return false;
    const k = kindOf(x);
    if (k === 'verticalGradient') return true;
    if (k === 'yAbove') return field(x, 'runTop') === false;
    if (k !== 'not') return false;
    x = field(x, 'if');
  }
}

interface RulePath {
  readonly rule: unknown;
  /** The smallest floor `stoneDepth` bound among the path's conditions (+∞ when none). */
  readonly bound: number;
  /** A floor `stoneDepth` is on the path. */
  readonly bounded: boolean;
  /** Every condition on the path is Y-only. */
  readonly yOnly: boolean;
}

/**
 * The rules column cost of the source root rule (§1.7 `validateRulesSource`): the rule and condition node count times
 * the voxels a column evaluates, 98,304 without a fast path, or 256 × (1 + the largest depth bound) with one (a leaf
 * bounded by its path's floor `stoneDepth` conditions: offset at its maximising end plus SD_MAX's static maximum when
 * `addSurfaceDepth`; else its conditions must all be Y-only, as `surfaceFastPath` decides), the depth bound clamped
 * to 0 … 383 so the factor never exceeds a whole column; saturating at 2^31. Tier 2 refuses it above
 * `RULES_COLUMN_COST_MAX`.
 */
export function rulesColumnCost(source: unknown): number {
  let nodes = 0;
  let fast = true;
  let maxBound = -1;
  const stack: RulePath[] = [{ rule: source, bound: Infinity, bounded: false, yOnly: true }];
  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const { rule, bound, bounded, yOnly } = stack.pop()!;
    if (!isRec(rule)) continue;
    nodes++;
    switch (kindOf(rule)) {
      case 'sequence': {
        const rules = field(rule, 'rules');
        if (!Array.isArray(rules)) break;
        for (let k = rules.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) stack.push({ rule: rules[k], bound, bounded, yOnly });
        break;
      }
      case 'condition': {
        const c = field(rule, 'if');
        for (let x = c; isRec(x); x = kindOf(x) === 'not' ? field(x, 'if') : undefined) nodes++;
        let b = bound;
        let bd = bounded;
        if (isRec(c) && kindOf(c) === 'stoneDepth' && field(c, 'side') === 'floor') {
          b = Math.min(b, fieldMax(field(c, 'offset')) + (field(c, 'addSurfaceDepth') === true ? SD_MAX_STATIC : 0));
          bd = true;
        }
        stack.push({ rule: field(rule, 'then'), bound: b, bounded: bd, yOnly: yOnly && isYOnly(c) });
        break;
      }
      case 'block': case 'bandlands':
        if (bounded) maxBound = Math.max(maxBound, bound);
        else if (!yOnly) fast = false;
        break;
      default: break;
    }
  }
  const perNode = fast ? Math.min(COLUMN_VOXELS, COLUMN_POSITIONS * (1 + Math.max(0, maxBound))) : COLUMN_VOXELS;
  return sat(nodes * perNode);
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, expectTypeOf, test } from 'vitest';
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import { checkJson, type TreeIssueCode } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import type { Issue } from '../../src/core/params/kit';
import { EXPR_CHILD_KEYS, EXPR_OPS, validateExpr, type DensitySourceCode, type ExprErrorCode, type ExprIssue } from '../../src/gen/density/expr';
import {
  ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS, densitySourceValidations, SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, SOURCE_OPS, validateDensitySource,
  type DensitySource, type SourceExpr, type SourceOp,
} from '../../src/gen/density/source';

const C = (v: unknown): unknown => ({ op: 'const', v });
const Y = { op: 'y' };
const P = (path: unknown): unknown => ({ op: 'param', path });
const R = (param: string, neg?: boolean): unknown => (neg === undefined ? { param } : { param, neg });
const doc = (root: unknown, defs: Record<string, unknown> = {}): unknown => ({ root, defs });
const issues = (value: unknown): string[] => validateDensitySource(value).map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`);
const one = (value: unknown): ExprIssue => {
  const out = validateDensitySource(value);
  expect(out.length).toBe(1);
  return out[0]!;
};

const LO = 'density.detailAmpLo'; // number [0, 8]
const HI = 'density.detailAmpHi'; // number [0, 8]
const CS = 'density.noises.jag.clampSigma'; // number [1, 8]
const SNOW = 'surface.snowline'; // number [−1, 1]
const CLIFF_Y = 'surface.cliffMinY'; // int [−64, 319]

describe('the source model (SP3d spec §1.3, §1.4)', () => {
  test('ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS: the number and int leaves under density. and surface., and every density/surface noise clampSigma', () => {
    expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS).toBeInstanceOf(Map);
    expect([...ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.keys()]).toEqual([
      'density.noises.jag.clampSigma', 'density.noises.overhang.clampSigma', 'density.noises.detail.clampSigma',
      'density.detailAmpLo', 'density.detailAmpHi',
      'surface.noises.depth.clampSigma', 'surface.noises.patch.clampSigma', 'surface.noises.bandOffset.clampSigma',
      'surface.depthMul', 'surface.snowline', 'surface.lapse', 'surface.lapseBase', 'surface.cliffSteep', 'surface.cliffMinY',
      'surface.patchThreshold',
    ]);
    expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get(CS)).toEqual({ kind: 'number', lo: 1, hi: 8 });
    expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get(LO)).toEqual({ kind: 'number', lo: 0, hi: 8 });
    expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get(SNOW)).toEqual({ kind: 'number', lo: -1, hi: 1 });
    expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get('surface.lapseBase')).toEqual({ kind: 'int', lo: -64, hi: 319 });
    expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get(CLIFF_Y)).toEqual({ kind: 'int', lo: -64, hi: 319 });
    expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get('surface.depthMul')).toEqual({ kind: 'number', lo: 0, hi: 2 });
    for (const t of ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.values()) {
      expect(Number.isFinite(t.lo) && Number.isFinite(t.hi) && t.lo <= t.hi).toBe(true);
      expect(Object.isFrozen(t)).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const name of ['constructor', 'toString', '__proto__', 'density', 'density.noises.jag', 'climate.tempScale']) {
      expect(ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.has(name)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test('SOURCE_OPS and SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS: the Expr ops plus recip [x] and param []; own-property safe', () => {
    expect(SOURCE_OPS).toEqual([...EXPR_OPS, 'recip', 'param']);
    for (const op of EXPR_OPS) expect(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS[op]).toEqual(EXPR_CHILD_KEYS[op]);
    expect(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS.recip).toEqual(['x']);
    expect(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS.param).toEqual([]);
    expect(Object.keys(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS).sort()).toEqual([...SOURCE_OPS].sort());
    expect(Object.isFrozen(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS)).toBe(true);
    // Tree content is never looked up through the prototype chain.
    expect((SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Record<string, unknown>)['constructor']).toBeUndefined();
    expect((SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Record<string, unknown>)['toString']).toBeUndefined();
    expectTypeOf<SourceOp>().toEqualTypeOf<(typeof EXPR_OPS)[number] | 'recip' | 'param'>();
  });

  test('the default density tree is a valid source and types as DensitySource', () => {
    expect(validateDensitySource(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE)).toEqual([]);
    const d = DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE as unknown as DensitySource;
    expectTypeOf(d.root).toEqualTypeOf<SourceExpr>();
    expect(d.root.op).toBe('max');
  });

  test('source codes are TreeIssueCodes', () => {
    expectTypeOf<ExprErrorCode>().toExtend<TreeIssueCode>();
    expectTypeOf<DensitySourceCode>().toExtend<TreeIssueCode>();
    expectTypeOf<DensitySourceCode>().toEqualTypeOf<
      'UNKNOWN_PARAM' | 'RECIP_OPERAND' | 'RECIP_ZERO' | 'LITERAL_RANGE' | 'SLIDE_SLOPE' | 'TOO_MANY_NODES' | 'TOO_MANY_DEFS'
      | 'EXPANDED_TOO_DEEP' | 'TOO_COSTLY' | 'VALUE_RANGE' | 'COLUMN_COST' | 'TOO_MANY_ISSUES'>();
    expectTypeOf<ExprIssue['code']>().toEqualTypeOf<ExprErrorCode | DensitySourceCode>();
  });
});

describe('validateDensitySource: parameter refs (SP3d spec §1.3)', () => {
  test('a param node names a target; anything else is UNKNOWN_PARAM at its path field', () => {
    for (const path of [LO, HI, CS, SNOW, CLIFF_Y, 'surface.lapse']) expect(issues(doc(P(path)))).toEqual([]);
    for (const path of ['density.nope', 'density.noises.jag', 'density.noises.jag.octaves', 'climate.tempScale', 'constructor', 'toString', '__proto__', '', 3, undefined]) {
      expect(issues(doc({ op: 'add', a: Y, b: P(path) }))).toEqual(['root.b.path: UNKNOWN_PARAM']);
    }
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'param', path: LO, v: 1 }))).toEqual(['root.v: UNKNOWN_KEY']);
  });

  test('refs in every numeric scalar field: clamp and rangeChoice bounds, slide knots, tap.mute (int targets too)', () => {
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: R(SNOW, true), hi: R(CS) }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: R(LO, true), hi: R(CS), inside: C(1), outside: C(0) }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[R(CLIFF_Y, true), R(LO)], [320, R(HI, true)], [400, 0]] }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: R(CLIFF_Y) }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: -1e6 }))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a ref to a missing target is UNKNOWN_PARAM and a malformed ref BAD_FIELD, at the field path (never .param)', () => {
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: R('density.nope'), hi: 1 }))).toEqual(['root.lo: UNKNOWN_PARAM']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: R('constructor') }))).toEqual(['root.hi: UNKNOWN_PARAM']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: R('toString', true) }))).toEqual(['root.mute: UNKNOWN_PARAM']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [1, R('surface.nope')]] }))).toEqual(['root.knots[1][1]: UNKNOWN_PARAM']);
    for (const bad of [{ param: LO, neg: false }, { param: LO, neg: 1 }, { param: LO, x: 1 }, { param: 3 }, {}, { neg: true }]) {
      expect(issues(doc({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: bad, hi: 9, inside: C(1), outside: C(0) }))).toEqual(['root.lo: BAD_FIELD']);
    }
    // Not a number and not a ref.
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: '0', hi: 1 }))).toEqual(['root.lo: NOT_FINITE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [true, 1]] }))).toEqual(['root.knots[1][0]: NOT_FINITE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: [0] }))).toEqual(['root.mute: NOT_FINITE']);
    // const.v stays a literal: its ref form is the param node.
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'const', v: R(LO) }))).toEqual(['root.v: NOT_FINITE']);
  });

  test('order checks hold over the static ranges (a negated ref spans [0 − max, 0 − min])', () => {
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: R(LO), hi: 8 }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: R(LO), hi: 7.5 }))).toEqual(['root: CLAMP_ORDER']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: R(LO, true), hi: 0 }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: R(LO, true), hi: R(SNOW) }))).toEqual(['root: CLAMP_ORDER']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: R(LO), inside: C(1), outside: C(0) }))).toEqual(['root: RANGE_ORDER']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: R(CS), inside: C(1), outside: C(0) }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [R(LO), 1]] }))).toEqual(['root.knots[1]: KNOTS_ORDER']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[R(LO), 0], [8, 1]] }))).toEqual(['root.knots[1]: KNOTS_ORDER']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[R(LO), 0], [8.5, 1]] }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[R(CS, true), 0], [R(LO), 1]] }))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('two refs to the same leaf are independent: refused, and the message says so', () => {
    const clamp = one(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: R(LO), hi: R(LO) }));
    expect([clamp.path, clamp.code]).toEqual(['root', 'CLAMP_ORDER']);
    expect(clamp.message).toMatch(/static range/);
    expect(clamp.message).toMatch(/independent/);
    expect(clamp.message).toMatch(/same parameter/);
    const knots = one(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[R(CS), 0], [R(CS), 1]] }));
    expect([knots.path, knots.code]).toEqual(['root.knots[1]', 'KNOTS_ORDER']);
    expect(knots.message).toMatch(/same parameter/);
    // A literal-only order issue keeps the plain message.
    expect(one(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: 2, hi: 1 })).message).toBe('clamp needs lo ≤ hi');
  });
});

describe('validateDensitySource: recip, names, literals and slopes (SP3d spec §1.4, §1.7 step 1)', () => {
  test('recip takes a const or a param operand (RECIP_OPERAND at the operand)', () => {
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: C(3) }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: C(-0.25) }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: P(CS) }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'mul', a: Y, b: { op: 'recip', x: Y } }))).toEqual(['root.b.x: RECIP_OPERAND']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: { op: 'neg', x: C(2) } }))).toEqual(['root.x: RECIP_OPERAND']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: { op: 'recip', x: C(2) } }))).toEqual(['root.x: RECIP_OPERAND']);
    // A broken operand reports its own issue only.
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: { op: 'sin' } }))).toEqual(['root.x: UNKNOWN_OP']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: P('density.nope') }))).toEqual(['root.x.path: UNKNOWN_PARAM']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip' }))).toEqual(['root.x: NOT_OBJECT']);
  });

  test('a const operand must be non-zero with a finite reciprocal; a param operand\'s range must exclude 0 (RECIP_ZERO)', () => {
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: C(0) }))).toEqual(['root.x: RECIP_ZERO']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: C(1e-320) }))).toEqual(['root.x: RECIP_ZERO']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: P(LO) }))).toEqual(['root.x: RECIP_ZERO']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: P(SNOW) }))).toEqual(['root.x: RECIP_ZERO']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'recip', x: P('surface.depthMul') }))).toEqual(['root.x: RECIP_ZERO']);
    expect(one(doc({ op: 'recip', x: P(LO) })).message).toContain('[0, 8]');
  });

  test('tap names match the key pattern (BAD_NAME); Object.prototype names stay valid', () => {
    for (const name of ['', 'a.b', '_t', '1t', 'a-b', 'x'.repeat(33), 3]) expect(issues(doc({ op: 'tap', name, x: Y }))).toEqual(['root.name: BAD_NAME']);
    for (const name of ['t', 'T_1', 'constructor', 'toString', 'x'.repeat(32)]) expect(issues(doc({ op: 'tap', name, x: Y }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'add', a: { op: 'tap', name: 'valueOf', x: Y }, b: { op: 'tap', name: 'valueOf', x: C(0) } }))).toEqual(['root.b.name: DUPLICATE_TAP']);
  });

  test('literals are within ±1e9 (LITERAL_RANGE): const.v, clamp and rangeChoice bounds, knot coordinates, mute', () => {
    expect(issues(doc(C(1e9)))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc(C(-1e9)))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc(C(1e9 + 1)))).toEqual(['root.v: LITERAL_RANGE']);
    expect(issues(doc(C(-2e9)))).toEqual(['root.v: LITERAL_RANGE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: -1e10, hi: 1e10 }))).toEqual(['root.lo: LITERAL_RANGE', 'root.hi: LITERAL_RANGE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 5e9, inside: C(1), outside: C(0) }))).toEqual(['root.hi: LITERAL_RANGE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[-2e9, 0], [0, 3e9]] }))).toEqual(['root.knots[0][0]: LITERAL_RANGE', 'root.knots[1][1]: LITERAL_RANGE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: -1e10 }))).toEqual(['root.mute: LITERAL_RANGE']);
  });

  test('every slide segment has a finite difference and slope over its ranges (SLIDE_SLOPE at the segment\'s upper knot)', () => {
    // The measured NaN knots of map-density.md §2 (valid as a code-built tree).
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, -1e308], [1, 1e308]] })))
      .toEqual(['root.knots[0][1]: LITERAL_RANGE', 'root.knots[1][1]: LITERAL_RANGE', 'root.knots[1]: SLIDE_SLOPE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [5e-324, 1], [10, 1]] }))).toEqual(['root.knots[1]: SLIDE_SLOPE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [5e-324, 0], [10, 1]] }))).toEqual([]);
    // Ranges: the same segment with a ref value is refused, because some value of the ref makes the slope infinite.
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [5e-324, R(LO)], [10, 1]] }))).toEqual(['root.knots[1]: SLIDE_SLOPE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, R(LO, true)], [1e-300, R(HI)]] }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(one(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [5e-324, 1]] })).message).toMatch(/finite/);
    // Code-built trees keep SP3b's rules.
    expect(validateExpr(doc({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, -1e308], [1, 1e308]] }), () => undefined)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('source ops are unknown to the code-built validator, and tap.mute an unknown key there', () => {
    const noises = () => undefined;
    expect(validateExpr(doc(P(LO)), noises).map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root: UNKNOWN_OP']);
    expect(validateExpr(doc({ op: 'recip', x: C(2) }), noises).map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root: UNKNOWN_OP']);
    expect(validateExpr(doc({ op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: 0 }), noises).map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root.mute: UNKNOWN_KEY']);
    expect(validateExpr(doc({ op: 'tap', name: 'a.b', x: Y }), noises)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('the noises are the schema\'s density noises at their static dims (remap none)', () => {
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'add', a: { op: 'noise2', id: 'jag' }, b: { op: 'noise', id: 'detail' } }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'noise', id: 'jag' }))).toEqual(['root.id: NOISE_DIMS']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'noise2', id: 'fz2a' }))).toEqual(['root.id: UNKNOWN_NOISE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'noise2', id: 'depth' }))).toEqual(['root.id: UNKNOWN_NOISE']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'noise2', id: 'constructor' }))).toEqual(['root.id: UNKNOWN_NOISE']);
  });

  test('the walk goes through recip and param, refs and mutes (mutes ignored), with the SP3b checks', () => {
    const tree = doc({
      op: 'add',
      a: { op: 'tap', name: 'm', mute: 0, x: { op: 'interpolated', x: { op: 'interpolated', x: { op: 'recip', x: C(2) } } } },
      b: { op: 'ref', name: 'd' },
    }, { d: { op: 'mul', a: { op: 'recip', x: P(CS) }, b: { op: 'ref', name: 'missing' } } });
    // Structural issues first; the nesting walk runs only on a structurally valid tree (SP3b's order).
    expect(issues(tree)).toEqual(['defs.d.b.name: UNKNOWN_REF']);
    const nested = doc({ op: 'tap', name: 'm', mute: 0, x: { op: 'interpolated', x: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'interpolated', x: { op: 'recip', x: P(CS) } } } } });
    expect(issues(nested)).toEqual(['root.x.x.x: NESTED_INTERPOLATED']);
    expect(issues(doc({ op: 'ref', name: 'a' }, { a: { op: 'recip', x: C(1) }, b: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'b' } } }))).toEqual(['defs.b.x: REF_CYCLE']);
  });
});

describe('validateDensitySource: issue cap and memo (SP3d spec §1.6, §1.7)', () => {
  test('at most 50 issues, then TOO_MANY_ISSUES at the value ("N more")', () => {
    let root: unknown = C(2e9);
    for (let i = 1; i < 60; i++) root = { op: 'add', a: C(2e9), b: root };
    const out = validateDensitySource(doc(root));
    expect(out.length).toBe(51);
    expect(out.slice(0, 50).every((i) => i.code === 'LITERAL_RANGE')).toBe(true);
    expect(out[50]).toEqual({ path: '', code: 'TOO_MANY_ISSUES', message: '10 more' });
    expect(validateDensitySource(doc(C(1))).length).toBe(0);
  });

  test('a frozen source is validated once (WeakMap memo with a validation counter); an unfrozen one every call', () => {
    const issuesOut: Issue[] = [];
    const clone = checkJson({ root: { op: 'clamp', x: { op: 'y' }, lo: { param: LO }, hi: 1 }, defs: {} }, 'density.defs', issuesOut, 'density');
    expect(issuesOut).toEqual([]);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(clone)).toBe(true);
    const n0 = densitySourceValidations();
    const first = validateDensitySource(clone);
    expect(first.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root: CLAMP_ORDER']);
    expect(densitySourceValidations()).toBe(n0 + 1);
    expect(validateDensitySource(clone)).toBe(first);
    expect(densitySourceValidations()).toBe(n0 + 1);
    // The memoised result cannot be changed by a caller.
    expect(Object.isFrozen(first)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(first[0])).toBe(true);
    // An unfrozen source is validated on every call.
    const loose = { root: { op: 'const', v: 1 }, defs: {} };
    validateDensitySource(loose);
    validateDensitySource(loose);
    expect(densitySourceValidations()).toBe(n0 + 3);
    // The default tree (tier 1's registered clone) hits after its first validation.
    validateDensitySource(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE);
    const n1 = densitySourceValidations();
    expect(validateDensitySource(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE)).toEqual([]);
    expect(densitySourceValidations()).toBe(n1);
  });

  test('never throws on hostile values', () => {
    const hostile: unknown[] = [null, 3, 'x', [], { root: null, defs: null }, { root: { op: 'recip', x: null }, defs: {} },
```

```ts
/**
 * The density source model (SP3d spec §1.3-§1.5, §1.7): the tree the `density.defs` leaf holds, before resolution.
 * It is SP3b's `DensityExpr` plus three source-only forms, resolved away before compilation (D5), so `EXPR_OPS`, the
 * compiler, the bounds and the reference never see them:
 * - the op `{op: 'param', path}`, a leaf standing where a `const` would, whose value is a parameter's;
 * - the op `{op: 'recip', x}`, `1 / x` of a constant operand (a `const`, or a `param` whose static range excludes 0);
 * - tap `mute` (the tap yields the mute value instead of its child), and the ref form `{param, neg?}` in every numeric
 *   scalar field (`clamp` and `rangeChoice` bounds, each knot's y and v, `mute`); `const.v` stays a literal.
 * A ref names one of `ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS`: the `number` and `int` leaves under `density.` and `surface.` and the
 * `clampSigma` field of their noise leaves, each with its static range (value-independence, §1.3: every check holds over
 * the whole range, so a slider move never invalidates a stored tree).
 *
 * `validateDensitySource` is tier 2 for density (§1.7): it never throws, returns at most 50 issues (then one
 * `TOO_MANY_ISSUES` at the value, "N more") with node paths in `validateExpr`'s syntax, and is memoised by identity for
 * frozen sources (tier 1's clones are deep-frozen), so a params document whose tree is unchanged costs one `WeakMap`
 * lookup. Every lookup keyed by tree content is a `Map`, a `Set` or `Object.hasOwn` (`constructor`, `toString`, … are
 * valid names).
 */
import { NOISE_FIELD_RANGES, SCHEMA } from '../../core/params/schema';
import type { SampleField } from '../column/columnStage';
import { EXPR_CHILD_KEYS, EXPR_OPS, validateExpr, type DensityNoiseInfo, type ExprIssue, type ExprOp, type RefTarget } from './expr';

const SCHEMA_ = SCHEMA;
const NOISE_RANGES = NOISE_FIELD_RANGES;
const EXPR_CHILDREN = EXPR_CHILD_KEYS;
const OPS = EXPR_OPS;
const VALIDATE = validateExpr;

/** A numeric field of a source node: a literal, or a parameter ref (`neg`: the value is 0 − v, never −0). */
export interface ParamRef { readonly param: string; readonly neg?: true }
export type SourceNumber = number | ParamRef;

export interface SourceConst { readonly op: 'const'; readonly v: number }
export interface SourceY { readonly op: 'y' }
export interface SourceCol { readonly op: 'col'; readonly field: SampleField }
export interface SourceNoise2 { readonly op: 'noise2'; readonly id: string }
export interface SourceNoise { readonly op: 'noise'; readonly id: string }
export interface SourceBinary { readonly op: 'add' | 'mul' | 'min' | 'max'; readonly a: SourceExpr; readonly b: SourceExpr }
export interface SourceUnary { readonly op: 'neg' | 'abs' | 'square'; readonly x: SourceExpr }
export interface SourceClamp { readonly op: 'clamp'; readonly x: SourceExpr; readonly lo: SourceNumber; readonly hi: SourceNumber }
export type SourceKnot = readonly [y: SourceNumber, v: SourceNumber];
export interface SourceSlide { readonly op: 'slide'; readonly x: SourceExpr; readonly knots: readonly SourceKnot[] }
export interface SourceInterpolated { readonly op: 'interpolated'; readonly x: SourceExpr }
export interface SourceRangeChoice {
  readonly op: 'rangeChoice'; readonly x: SourceExpr; readonly lo: SourceNumber; readonly hi: SourceNumber;
  readonly inside: SourceExpr; readonly outside: SourceExpr;
}
export interface SourceTap { readonly op: 'tap'; readonly name: string; readonly x: SourceExpr; readonly mute?: SourceNumber }
export interface SourceRef { readonly op: 'ref'; readonly name: string }
/** A parameter's value, as a leaf node (resolved to a `const`). */
export interface SourceParam { readonly op: 'param'; readonly path: string }
/** 1 / x of a constant operand (resolved to a `const`). */
export interface SourceRecip { readonly op: 'recip'; readonly x: SourceConst | SourceParam }

export type SourceExpr =
  | SourceConst | SourceY | SourceCol | SourceNoise2 | SourceNoise | SourceBinary | SourceUnary | SourceClamp | SourceSlide
  | SourceInterpolated | SourceRangeChoice | SourceTap | SourceRef | SourceParam | SourceRecip;
export type SourceOp = SourceExpr['op'];

/** The `density.defs` leaf's value: the root and its named sub-expressions, in source form. */
export interface DensitySource {
  readonly root: SourceExpr;
  readonly defs: Readonly<Record<string, SourceExpr>>;
}

/** Every source op: `EXPR_OPS`, then the source-only `recip` and `param`. */
export const SOURCE_OPS: readonly SourceOp[] = Object.freeze([...OPS, 'recip', 'param'] as const);

/**
 * The child slots of each source op in evaluation order: `EXPR_CHILD_KEYS` plus `recip: ['x']` and `param: []`. A frozen
 * object without a prototype, so a lookup by an op read from a tree (`constructor`, `toString`) is undefined.
 */
export const SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS: { readonly [K in SourceOp]: readonly string[] } = Object.freeze(Object.assign(
  Object.create(null) as Record<SourceOp, readonly string[]>,
  EXPR_CHILDREN as { readonly [K in ExprOp]: readonly string[] },
  { recip: Object.freeze(['x']), param: Object.freeze([] as string[]) },
));

/**
 * The parameters a ref may name (§1.3), by schema path, in schema order: every `number` / `int` leaf under `density.`
 * or `surface.` with its `[min, max]`, and `<noise leaf>.clampSigma` for every noise leaf under `density.noises.` and
 * `surface.noises.` with `NOISE_FIELD_RANGES.clampSigma`. Built from the schema's leaves, never from `getPath` (which
 * would read anything). Every target is hashed by the `terrain` stage.
 */
export const ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS: ReadonlyMap<string, RefTarget> = (() => {
  const out = new Map<string, RefTarget>();
  const add = (path: string, kind: RefTarget['kind'], lo: number | undefined, hi: number | undefined): void => {
    if (lo === undefined || hi === undefined || !Number.isFinite(lo) || !Number.isFinite(hi) || lo > hi) {
      throw new Error(`ref target ${path} has no finite static range`);
    }
    out.set(path, Object.freeze({ kind, lo, hi }));
  };
  for (const { path, meta } of SCHEMA_.leaves) {
    if (!path.startsWith('density.') && !path.startsWith('surface.')) continue;
    if (meta.kind === 'number' || meta.kind === 'int') add(path, meta.kind, meta.min, meta.max);
    else if (meta.kind === 'noise' && (path.startsWith('density.noises.') || path.startsWith('surface.noises.'))) {
      add(`${path}.clampSigma`, 'number', NOISE_RANGES.clampSigma.min, NOISE_RANGES.clampSigma.max);
    }
  }
  return out;
})();

/**
 * The density noises a source tree may read, by id, with what validation needs, value-independently: the schema's
 * `density.noises.*` leaves at their dims; remap 'none' when the leaf keeps it (`remapNone`, every density noise), else
 * 'uniform' (a remap the user could switch is refused); clampSigma at its static maximum.
 */
const SOURCE_NOISES: ReadonlyMap<string, DensityNoiseInfo> = (() => {
  const out = new Map<string, DensityNoiseInfo>();
  const prefix = 'density.noises.';
  for (const { path, leaf } of SCHEMA_.leaves) {
    if (leaf.kind !== 'noise' || !path.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
    out.set(path.slice(prefix.length), Object.freeze({
      dims: leaf.dims ?? 2, remap: leaf.remapNone === true ? 'none' : 'uniform', clampSigma: NOISE_RANGES.clampSigma.max,
    }));
  }
  return out;
})();
const SOURCE_MODE = Object.freeze({ targets: ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS });
const noiseInfo = (id: string): DensityNoiseInfo | undefined => SOURCE_NOISES.get(id);

/** Tier 2 keeps at most this many issues, then one `TOO_MANY_ISSUES` (as tier 1, §1.7). */
const MAX_ISSUES = 50;

const MEMO = new WeakMap<object, readonly ExprIssue[]>();
let validations = 0;

/**
 * Tier 2 for a density source tree (§1.7; this task: step 1, per-node structure, and step 3's refs): `validateExpr`'s
 * source mode over the schema's density noises and `ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS`. Never throws; at most 50 issues, then
 * `{path: '', code: 'TOO_MANY_ISSUES', message: '<N> more'}`. The result (frozen, as are its issues) is memoised by
 * identity when `source` is a frozen object: validity is a pure function of the tree, so a frozen tree is validated once.
 */
export function validateDensitySource(source: unknown): readonly ExprIssue[] {
  const key = typeof source === 'object' && source !== null && Object.isFrozen(source) ? source : null;
  if (key !== null) {
    const hit = MEMO.get(key);
    if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
  }
  validations++;
  const all = VALIDATE(source, noiseInfo, SOURCE_MODE);
  const kept: ExprIssue[] = all.length > MAX_ISSUES ? all.slice(0, MAX_ISSUES) : all;
  if (all.length > MAX_ISSUES) kept.push({ path: '', code: 'TOO_MANY_ISSUES', message: `${all.length - MAX_ISSUES} more` });
  const out = Object.freeze(kept.map((i) => Object.freeze(i)));
  if (key !== null) MEMO.set(key, out);
  return out;
}

/** How many times `validateDensitySource` validated (memo misses), for the tests of the memo (§1.8). */
export function densitySourceValidations(): number {
  return validations;
}
```

```diff
+      stack.push({ node: Object.hasOwn(node, key) ? node[key] : undefined, path: `${path}.${key}`, depth: depth + 1 });
+    }
+  }
+  return out;
+}
+
+/** A tree root of the source: `root` or a def, with its own nodes. */
+interface TreeRoot { readonly path: string; readonly node: unknown; readonly def: string | null; readonly nodes: readonly OwnNode[] }
+
+/**
+ * The expanded height of every def (the depth of its deepest node counting through refs, a `ref` being one level above
+ * its def's root), in topological order of the def graph (an iterative post-order, no recursion through refs). Called
+ * on an acyclic graph; a def met again while open (impossible then) adds nothing.
+ */
+function defHeights(trees: ReadonlyMap<string, TreeRoot>): Map<string, number> {
+  const height = new Map<string, number>();
+  const open = new Set<string>();
+  const heightOf = (t: TreeRoot): number => {
+    let h = 0;
+    for (const n of t.nodes) h = Math.max(h, n.depth + (n.ref === null ? 0 : height.get(n.ref) ?? 0));
+    return h;
+  };
+  for (const start of trees.keys()) {
+    if (height.has(start)) continue;
+    const stack: Array<{ readonly name: string; i: number }> = [{ name: start, i: 0 }];
+    open.add(start);
+    while (stack.length > 0) {
+      const f = stack[stack.length - 1]!;
+      const t = trees.get(f.name)!;
+      if (f.i < t.nodes.length) {
+        const target = t.nodes[f.i++]!.ref;
+        if (target !== null && !height.has(target) && !open.has(target)) {
+          open.add(target);
+          stack.push({ name: target, i: 0 });
+        }
+        continue;
+      }
+      stack.pop();
+      open.delete(f.name);
+      height.set(f.name, heightOf(t));
+    }
+  }
+  return height;
+}
+

+ * (step 1, and step 3's refs and iterative def graph), the per-root bounds when the counts hold and the graph is
+ * acyclic (step 4), and only when nothing else is wrong the checks that walk through refs (step 5).

+  const roots: TreeRoot[] = [];

+  if (defs !== null) {
+    for (const name of Object.keys(defs)) {
+      roots.push({ path: `defs.${name}`, node: defs[name], def: name, nodes: ownNodes(defs[name], `defs.${name}`, defs) });
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Step 2: the counts.
+  let nodeCount = 0;
+  for (const t of roots) nodeCount += t.nodes.length;
+  const defCount = defs === null ? 0 : Object.keys(defs).length;
+  if (nodeCount > MAX_NODES) issues.push({ path: '', code: 'TOO_MANY_NODES', message: `${nodeCount} nodes (at most ${MAX_NODES})` });
+  if (defCount > MAX_DEFS) issues.push({ path: 'defs', code: 'TOO_MANY_DEFS', message: `${defCount} defs (at most ${MAX_DEFS})` });
+
+  // Steps 1 and 3.
+  const base = VALIDATE(source, noiseInfo, SOURCE_MODE);
+  issues.push(...base);
+  if (nodeCount > MAX_NODES || defCount > MAX_DEFS || base.some((i) => i.code === 'REF_CYCLE')) return issues;
+
+  // Step 4: every tree root, reachable or not, mutes ignored.
+  const byDef = new Map<string, TreeRoot>();
+  for (const t of roots) if (t.def !== null) byDef.set(t.def, t);
+  const heights = defHeights(byDef);

+    let deepest: OwnNode | null = null;
+    let depth = 0;
+    for (const n of t.nodes) {
+      const d = n.depth + (n.ref === null ? 0 : heights.get(n.ref) ?? 0);
+      if (d > depth) { depth = d; deepest = n; }
+    }
+    if (deepest !== null && depth > MAX_EXPANDED_DEPTH) {
+      issues.push({ path: deepest.path, code: 'EXPANDED_TOO_DEEP', message: `${t.path} reaches depth ${depth} through refs (at most ${MAX_EXPANDED_DEPTH})` });
+    }
```
