```ts
/**
 * Every page session runs tier 2 of the trees (SP3d spec §1.8, D2): each `new WorldSession(` under src/ui/ passes
 * `validateParams` in its arguments (the ?map page builds its session through `openMapSession`, which passes
 * `validateParamTrees`). The engine's own tests may leave the option out.
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { blankJs, lineAt, ROOT, scanTree } from './scan';

const NEW_SESSION = /\bnew\s+WorldSession\s*\(/g;

/** The text between the call's parentheses (`open` is the index of its `(`), or the rest of the file if unbalanced. */
function argsOf(code: string, open: number): string {
  let depth = 0;
  for (let i = open; i < code.length; i++) {
    if (code[i] === '(') depth++;
    else if (code[i] === ')' && --depth === 0) return code.slice(open + 1, i);
  }
  return code.slice(open + 1);
}

/** Line numbers of every `new WorldSession(…)` whose arguments do not name `validateParams` (`code`: comments and strings blanked). */
function unvalidatedSessions(code: string): number[] {
  const lines: number[] = [];
  for (const m of code.matchAll(NEW_SESSION)) {
    if (!/\bvalidateParams\b/.test(argsOf(code, m.index + m[0].length - 1))) lines.push(lineAt(code, m.index));
  }
  return lines;
}

const found = (src: string) => unvalidatedSessions(blankJs(src, { strings: true }));

describe('session detector', () => {
  test('a session built without validateParams is reported, on its own line', () => {
    const src = [
      'const a = new WorldSession(random);',
      'const b = new WorldSession(random, { seedText: s, patch: p });',
      'const c = new WorldSession(',
      '  random,',
      '  { seedText: f(x), profile },',
      ');',
      "const d = new WorldSession(random, { seedText: 'validateParams' });",
      'const e = new WorldSession(random, { seedText: s /* validateParams */ });',
    ].join('\n');
    expect(found(src)).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 7, 8]);
  });

  test('a session that passes validateParams, comments, strings and other classes are not', () => {
    const src = [
      'const a = new WorldSession(random, { seedText: s, validateParams: validateParamTrees });',
      'const b = new WorldSession(random, { ...init, validateParams });',
      'const c = new WorldSession(',
      '  random,',
      '  { seedText: f(x), validateParams: (p) => check(p) },',
      ');',
      '// const d = new WorldSession(random);',
      "const e = 'new WorldSession(random)';",
      'const f = new WorldSessionLike(random);',
      'const g: WorldSession = open();',
    ].join('\n');
    expect(found(src)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

test('every new WorldSession( under src/ui passes validateParams', () => {
  const files = scanTree(ROOT).filter((f) => f.path.startsWith('src/ui/') && /\.[cm]?[jt]s$/.test(f.path));
  const bad = files.flatMap((f) => unvalidatedSessions(f.code).map((line) => `${f.path}:${line}`));
  expect(bad).toEqual([]);
  // The ?map page's session is built in mapState.ts (openMapSession); the scan must see it.
  expect(files.some((f) => f.path === 'src/ui/map/mapState.ts' && f.code.match(NEW_SESSION) !== null)).toBe(true);
});
```

Create `test/unit/mapSession.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The ?map page's session with the real tier 2 (SP3d spec §1.8, §1.11, §1.12): `openMapSession` wires
 * `validateParamTrees` as the session's `validateParams`, so a link, a profile switch or a `hashchange` with a
 * semantically invalid tree is refused, and a slider edit neither revalidates nor copies the trees.
 */
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Seed64 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import type { SessionChange, SessionSnapshot } from '../../src/engine/session';
import { densitySourceValidations } from '../../src/gen/density/source';
import { rulesSourceValidations } from '../../src/gen/surface/source';
import { applyMapHash, DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, decodeMapState, encodeMapState, openMapSession, type MapState, type MapView } from '../../src/ui/map/mapState';
import { densityTree, editedPatch } from './fixtures/editedTrees';

/** While `hooks.badProfile` is set, `resolveProfile('large_biomes')` carries a density tree tier 2 refuses (every real profile passes, §1.8). */
const hooks = vi.hoisted(() => ({ badProfile: false }));
vi.mock('../../src/core/params/profiles', async (importOriginal) => {
  const orig = await importOriginal<typeof import('../../src/core/params/profiles')>();
  return {
    ...orig,
    resolveProfile: (id: Parameters<typeof orig.resolveProfile>[0]): Params => {
      const p = orig.resolveProfile(id);
      if (!hooks.badProfile || id !== 'large_biomes') return p;
      return { ...p, density: { ...p.density, defs: { root: { op: 'add', a: { op: 'y' }, b: { op: 'bogus' } }, defs: {} } } } as unknown as Params;
    },
  };
});

const random = (): Seed64 => [3, 9];
const VIEW: MapView = DEFAULT_MAP_STATE.view;

/** The default density tree with `root.b.x` (the islands constant) replaced by an unknown op: tier 1 passes, tier 2 does not. */
function bogusDensity(): unknown {
  const t = densityTree();
  t['root'].b.x = { op: 'bogus' };
  return t;
}
const bogusState = (view: MapView = VIEW): MapState => ({ ...DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, seed: '7', patch: { density: { defs: bogusDensity() } } as MapState['patch'], view });
const historyOf = (w: object) => (w as unknown as { history: { snap: SessionSnapshot }[] }).history;
const defsOf = (patch: unknown) => (patch as { density: { defs: unknown } }).density.defs;
const rulesOf = (patch: unknown) => (patch as { surface: { rules: unknown } }).surface.rules;

describe('openMapSession: the constructor runs tier 2', () => {
  test('a tier-2-invalid tree in the start state opens the defaults with the notice naming its path and code', () => {
    const w = openMapSession(bogusState(), random);
    expect(w.initNotice).toBe('invalid patch (density.defs.root.b.x UNKNOWN_OP); opened the default profile with no changes');
    expect([w.state.seedText, w.state.profile, w.state.patch, w.state.epoch]).toEqual(['7', 'default', {}, 0]);
    expect(w.state.params.density.defs).toBe(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE);
  });

  test('a fresh tab: decodeMapState checks tier 1 only, the session refuses the tree', () => {
    const d = decodeMapState(`#${encodeMapState(bogusState())}`);
    expect(d.error).toBeNull();
    const w = openMapSession(d.state, random);
    expect(w.initNotice).toMatch(/^invalid patch \(density\.defs\.root\.b\.x UNKNOWN_OP\); /);
    expect(w.modifiedCount('')).toBe(0);
  });

  test('a valid edited start state opens as it is', () => {
    const w = openMapSession({ ...DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, patch: editedPatch() }, random);
    expect(w.initNotice).toBeNull();
    expect([w.state.profile, w.modifiedCount(''), w.modified('density.defs'), w.modified('surface.rules')]).toEqual(['default', 2, true, true]);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(w.state.params.density.defs)).toBe(true);
  });

  test('the default start state opens the default trees with no notice', () => {
    const w = openMapSession(DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, random);
    expect(w.initNotice).toBeNull();
    expect(w.state.params.density.defs).toBe(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE);
    expect(w.state.params.surface.rules).toBe(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES);
  });
});

describe('openMapSession: setProfile, commits and loads run tier 2', () => {
  test('setProfile refuses a profile whose trees tier 2 refuses; nothing changes', () => {
    const w = openMapSession({ ...DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, patch: { climate: { scaleMul: 2 } } }, random);
    const before = w.state;
    hooks.badProfile = true;
    try {
      const r = w.setProfile('large_biomes');
      expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
      if (r.ok) return;
      expect(r.issues.map((i) => `${i.path} ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['density.defs.root.b UNKNOWN_OP']);
      expect(w.state).toBe(before);
    } finally {
      hooks.badProfile = false;
    }
    expect(w.setProfile('large_biomes').ok).toBe(true);
  });

  test('a commit of a tier-2-invalid tree is refused with its path; the tree is kept', () => {
    const w = openMapSession(DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, random);
    const r = w.set('density.defs', bogusDensity());
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.issues.map((i) => `${i.path} ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['density.defs.root.b.x UNKNOWN_OP']);
    expect(w.state.params.density.defs).toBe(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE);
  });

  test('a tier-2-invalid hash is refused through applyMapHash (hashchange): the draft and history are unchanged', () => {
    const w = openMapSession({ ...DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, patch: { climate: { scaleMul: 2 } } }, random);
    const before = w.state;
    const changes: SessionChange[] = [];
    w.subscribe((_s, c) => changes.push(c));
    const views: MapView[] = [];
    const view: MapView = { ...VIEW, x: 640, layer: 'relief' };
    expect(applyMapHash(`#${encodeMapState(bogusState(view))}`, w, (v) => views.push(v))).toBe('map URL ignored: density.defs.root.b.x UNKNOWN_OP');
    expect(w.state).toBe(before);
    expect(changes).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.canUndo).toBe(false);
    // The view is applied before the load (SP2b §1.4), so it moves; the draft does not.
    expect(views).toEqual([view]);
    // A valid edited hash then loads.
    expect(applyMapHash(`#${encodeMapState({ ...DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, patch: editedPatch() })}`, w, () => {})).toBeNull();
    expect(w.modified('density.defs')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('openMapSession: slider edits keep the trees (SP3d spec §1.12)', () => {
  test('a slider-only commit misses neither memo (no tier-2 revalidation)', () => {
    const w = openMapSession({ ...DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, patch: editedPatch() }, random);
    const d0 = densitySourceValidations();
    const r0 = rulesSourceValidations();
    expect(w.set('climate.scaleMul', 2).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(w.set('density.detailAmpLo', 0.7).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(w.set('surface.snowline', -0.25).ok).toBe(true);
    expect([densitySourceValidations() - d0, rulesSourceValidations() - r0]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    // So is an undo and a redo of them.
    expect(w.undo() && w.undo() && w.redo()).toBe(true);
    expect([densitySourceValidations() - d0, rulesSourceValidations() - r0]).toEqual([0, 0]);
  });

  test('two slider edits keep the same density.defs object in the state and in both history snapshots', () => {
    const w = openMapSession({ ...DEFAULT_MAP_STATE, patch: editedPatch() }, random);
    const defs = w.state.params.density.defs;
    const rules = w.state.params.surface.rules;
    expect(defs).not.toBe(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE);
    expect(defsOf(w.state.patch)).toBe(defs);
    expect(w.set('climate.scaleMul', 2).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(w.set('climate.scaleMul', 3).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(w.state.params.density.defs).toBe(defs);
    expect(w.state.params.surface.rules).toBe(rules);
    expect(defsOf(w.state.patch)).toBe(defs);
    const history = historyOf(w);
    expect(history.length).toBe(3);
    for (const e of history) {
      expect(defsOf(e.snap.patch)).toBe(defs);
      expect(rulesOf(e.snap.patch)).toBe(rules);
    }
    expect(w.undo()).toBe(true);
    expect([w.state.params.climate.scaleMul, w.state.params.density.defs]).toEqual([2, defs]);
    expect(w.state.params.density.defs).toBe(defs);
  });
});
```

- Ruling: `openMapSession(decoded: MapState, random: () => Seed64): WorldSession` lives in `src/ui/map/mapState.ts` and takes the (perf-pinned) start state, not the `{state, error}` pair: `mapPage.ts` keeps `decoded.error ?? session.initNotice` as its start notice; it is now the only `new WorldSession(` under `src/ui/` (mapState.ts value-imports `engine/session` and `gen/trees`, which `ui/` may) — cost if wrong: a signature change in one caller.
- Ruling: a tier-2-invalid `hashchange` keeps SP2b's order (view, then `load`, pinned as `['view', 'load']` in `mapState.test.ts`): `decodeMapState` checks tier 1 only (§1.8), so the hash's view is applied and then the session refuses the draft — the notice is `map URL ignored: density.defs.root.b.x UNKNOWN_OP`, the draft, history and notifications are unchanged, the view moves (pinned), and the page's `writeUrl` rewrites the address bar to the current draft at that view. Not reordered (that would change a pinned SP2b order) and no tier 2 in `decodeMapState` (that would validate every tree twice per hash; §1.8 says the constructor/`load` refuse it) — cost if wrong: a reorder in `applyMapHash` and one pin.
- Ruling: the oversize notice — `Notices` gains `hide(text)` (removes the notice with that text); `urlWriter.ts` exports the pure `oversizeNotice(notices: Pick<Notices, 'show' | 'hide'>)` → `onOversize`, which shows `URL_OVERSIZE_NOTICE` as `warn` without a timeout on `true` and hides it on `false`; `mapPage.ts` passes it as the writer's 4th argument. The viewer may dismiss it (every `show` notice has ×); it reappears on the next oversize transition only — cost if wrong: a non-dismissible notice kind.
- Ruling: worker configure — `issues = r.ok ? validateParamTrees(r.value) : r.issues`, BAD_PARAMS message `<path>: <code>` joined by `; ` over the first 5 (the `checkParams` format); a refused configure keeps the configured epoch and its context (pinned: a point job of the earlier epoch still answers). Tier 2 runs on `checkParams`' value, so a registered tree is a memo hit — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: `setProfile`'s refusal through `openMapSession` uses `vi.mock` of `core/params/profiles` (the first `vi.mock` in the suite): every real ready profile passes tier 2 (the §1.8 invariant), so a hoisted flag makes `resolveProfile('large_biomes')` carry `root.b = {op: 'bogus'}` for one test (`cave_heavy` is not ready before SP6) — cost if wrong: one test rewritten.
- Ruling: "both history snapshots" are read through a test-only cast of the session's private `history` (3 entries: the start and two slider edits, each `snap.patch.density.defs` and `surface.rules` the same object as `state.params`), plus an undo that keeps the object; the memo test also covers `density.detailAmpLo` and `surface.snowline` slider edits and an undo/undo/redo (counters unchanged) — cost if wrong: a public accessor later.
- Ruling: the arch grep (`test/arch/uiSessions.test.ts`) matches `new WorldSession(` on code with comments and strings blanked and requires the identifier `validateParams` inside the call's balanced parentheses; it also asserts the scan sees mapState.ts's call (so the grep cannot pass vacuously); aliased constructors are out of its scope — cost if wrong: a stricter detector.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { canonicalJSON } from '../../src/core/params/canonical';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import type { JsonFormat } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import { applyPatch, type Issue } from '../../src/core/params/kit';
import { SCHEMA, type Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import { buildColumnSample, newColumnSample, type ColumnSample } from '../../src/gen/column/columnStage';
import { compileDensity, cornerValueIndex } from '../../src/gen/density/compile';
import { densityNoiseSource } from '../../src/gen/density/context';
import { createDensityReference, interpolatedNodes } from '../../src/gen/density/reference';
import { resolveDensity } from '../../src/gen/density/source';
import { terrainSurfaceDebug } from '../../src/gen/pipeline/terrainStage';
import { compileSurfaceRules } from '../../src/gen/surface/compile';
import { surfaceContextOf } from '../../src/gen/surface/context';
import { createSurfaceReference } from '../../src/gen/surface/reference';
import { newSurfaceScan, runAt, type SurfaceScan } from '../../src/gen/surface/scan';
import { resolveRules } from '../../src/gen/surface/source';
import { validateParamTrees } from '../../src/gen/trees';
import { randomDensityExpr, SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES } from '../harness/densityFuzz';
import { ctxFor } from '../harness/gen';
import { testRng } from '../harness/stats';
import { SCHEMA_SURFACE_NOISES, SURFACE_FUZZ_NOISES } from '../harness/surfaceFuzz';
import {
  BREAKING_MUTATIONS, cloneTree, mutateTree, mutationBase, mutationsOf, PRESERVING_MUTATIONS, type MutationName,
} from '../harness/treeMutator';

/**
 * The untrusted-JSON fuzz (SP3d spec §10): 2,000 mutated values per format, each judged as the session judges a leaf
 * value (tier 1 through `applyPatch`, then tier 2 through `validateParamTrees`). A refused value never throws and every
 * issue path is the leaf path followed by the path of the value itself, a node or a field of the value (an existing
 * one, or a missing field of an existing node); an accepted value prints canonically, resolves, and its compiled tree
 * equals the reference evaluator (`Object.is`, every value finite) at sampled voxels and corners of two real columns
 * of seed '42'; for rules the fast path equals full evaluation there.
 */
const CTX = ctxFor('42');
const COLUMNS: readonly (readonly [number, number])[] = [[3, -2], [-40, 25]];
const LEAF: Readonly<Record<JsonFormat, string>> = { density: 'density.defs', surfaceRules: 'surface.rules' };
const VALUES = 2000;

interface Judged { readonly issues: readonly Issue[]; readonly params: Params | null }

/** The value as the session would judge it as its leaf (DEFAULTS ⊕ the leaf). */
function judge(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat): Judged {
  const patch = format === 'density' ? { density: { defs: value } } : { surface: { rules: value } };
  const r = applyPatch(SCHEMA, DEFAULTS, patch);
  if (!r.ok) return { issues: r.issues, params: null };
  const issues = validateParamTrees(r.value);
  return { issues, params: issues.length > 0 ? null : r.value };
}

/**
 * The segments of a node path after the leaf path (`.root.a.x`, `.defs."__proto__"`, `.root.rules[1].if.biomes[0]`):
 * names, array indices, and quoted keys (`complete` false for a key cut to 40 characters). Null when it does not parse.
 */
function segments(rest: string): Array<{ key: string; index: boolean; complete: boolean }> | null {
  const out: Array<{ key: string; index: boolean; complete: boolean }> = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < rest.length) {
    if (rest[i] === '[') {
      const j = rest.indexOf(']', i);
      if (j < 0 || !/^\d+$/.test(rest.slice(i + 1, j))) return null;
      out.push({ key: rest.slice(i + 1, j), index: true, complete: true });
      i = j + 1;
    } else if (rest[i] === '.' && rest[i + 1] === '"') {
      let j = i + 2;
      while (j < rest.length && rest[j] !== '"') j += rest[j] === '\\' ? 2 : 1;
      if (j >= rest.length) {
        out.push({ key: rest.slice(i + 1), index: false, complete: false });
        i = rest.length;
      } else {
        out.push({ key: JSON.parse(rest.slice(i + 1, j + 1)) as string, index: false, complete: true });
        i = j + 1;
      }
    } else if (rest[i] === '.') {
      const m = /^[^.[]+/.exec(rest.slice(i + 1));
      if (m === null) return null;
      out.push({ key: m[0], index: false, complete: true });
      i += 1 + m[0].length;
    } else {
      return null;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Whether issue `path` is the leaf path plus the path of the value, a node or a field of `value` (see the file comment). */
function namesNodeOrField(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat, path: string): boolean {
  const leaf = LEAF[format];
  if (path === leaf) return true;
  if (!path.startsWith(`${leaf}.`) && !path.startsWith(`${leaf}[`)) return false;
  const segs = segments(path.slice(leaf.length));
  if (segs === null) return false;
  if (format === 'surfaceRules') {
    // Rule ids start at `root`, the value itself (§1.2).
    if (segs.length === 0 || segs[0]!.key !== 'root' || segs[0]!.index || !segs[0]!.complete) return false;
    segs.shift();
  }
  let cur: unknown = value;
  for (let k = 0; k < segs.length; k++) {
    const s = segs[k]!;
    const last = k === segs.length - 1;
    if (typeof cur !== 'object' || cur === null) return false;
    if (!s.complete) {
      // A key cut to 40 characters: some own key's quoted form starts with it.
      return last && !Array.isArray(cur) && Object.keys(cur).some((key) => JSON.stringify(key).startsWith(s.key));
    }
    if (Array.isArray(cur) !== s.index) return false;
    if (Object.hasOwn(cur, s.key)) cur = (cur as Record<string, unknown>)[s.key];
    else return last; // a missing field of an existing node
  }
  return true;
}

/** A failure description, or null: the value's issues name its nodes and fields. */
function pathProblem(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat, issues: readonly Issue[]): string | null {
  if (issues.length === 0) return 'refused without an issue';
  for (const i of issues) if (!namesNodeOrField(value, format, i.path)) return `issue path ${i.path} (${i.code}) names no node or field`;
  return null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- density: compiled == reference on two real columns
const D_NOISES = densityNoiseSource(CTX);
const D_SAMPLES: readonly ColumnSample[] = COLUMNS.map(([cx, cz]) => buildColumnSample(CTX, cx, cz, newColumnSample()));

/** Mismatches of an accepted density value: compiled ≠ reference or a non-finite value at 8 voxels and their cell corners per column. */
function densityProblems(params: Params, next: () => number): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  canonicalJSON(params.density.defs);
  const expr = resolveDensity(params.density.defs, params);
  const c = compileDensity(expr, D_NOISES);
  const ref = createDensityReference(expr, D_NOISES);
  const interp = interpolatedNodes(expr).map((n) => ({ inner: n.x, slot: c.interpolatedSlot(n) }));
  for (const s of D_SAMPLES) {
    c.columnFn(s);
    c.positionFn(s);
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      const lx = next() % 16, lz = next() % 16, y = -64 + (next() % 384);
      const x = 16 * s.cx + lx, z = 16 * s.cz + lz;
      const v = c.voxelFn(lx, y, lz), rv = ref.voxel(s, x, y, z);
      if (!Object.is(v, rv) || !Number.isFinite(v)) out.push(`voxel (${x}, ${y}, ${z}): compiled ${v}, reference ${rv}`);
      const ci = lx >> 2, ck = (y + 64) >> 3, cj = lz >> 2;
      c.cellCorners(ci, ck, cj);
      for (const { inner, slot } of interp) {
        for (let d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
          const ii = ci + (d & 1), kk = ck + ((d >> 2) & 1), jj = cj + ((d >> 1) & 1);
          const cv = c.cornerValues[cornerValueIndex(slot, ii, kk, jj)]!, rc = ref.corner(s, inner, ii, kk, jj);
          if (!Object.is(cv, rc) || !Number.isFinite(cv)) out.push(`corner (${ii}, ${kk}, ${jj}) of (${s.cx}, ${s.cz}): compiled ${cv}, reference ${rc}`);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- rules: compiled == reference, fast == full on two real columns
const SC = surfaceContextOf(CTX);
const SCANS: readonly SurfaceScan[] = COLUMNS.map(([cx, cz]) => {
  const scan = newSurfaceScan();
  terrainSurfaceDebug(CTX, cx, cz, scan);
  return scan;
});
const FAST = new Uint16Array(98304);
const FULL = new Uint16Array(98304);

/**
 * Mismatches of an accepted rule value at 16 solid voxels per column (10 within 11 voxels of the sky-open top, 6
 * anywhere), and, when the tree has a fast path, the voxels where the fast path's whole-column fill ≠ full evaluation.
 */
function rulesProblems(params: Params, next: () => number): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  canonicalJSON(params.surface.rules);
  const rules = resolveRules(params.surface.rules, params);
  const compiled = compileSurfaceRules(CTX.seed, rules, SC.noises, SC.settings, SC.bands);
  const reference = createSurfaceReference(CTX.seed, rules, SC.noises, SC.bands);
  for (const [n, scan] of SCANS.entries()) {
    for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
      const p = next() % 256;
      const first = scan.runFirst[p]!;
      const y = k < 10 && first < scan.runFirst[p + 1]! ? scan.runTop[first]! - (next() % 12) : -63 + (next() % 383);
      if (y < -63 || runAt(scan, p, y) < 0) continue;
      const cs = compiled.state(scan, p, y), rs = reference.state(scan, SC.settings, p, y);
      if (cs !== rs) out.push(`column ${n} (${p}, ${y}): compiled state ${cs}, reference ${rs}`);
    }
    if (compiled.fastPath !== null) {
      FAST.fill(0);
      FULL.fill(0);
      compiled.fillColumn(scan, FAST, true);
      compiled.fillColumn(scan, FULL, false);
      let diff = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 98304; i++) if (FAST[i] !== FULL[i]) diff++;
      if (diff > 0) out.push(`column ${n}: fast path ≠ full evaluation at ${diff} voxels`);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

interface FuzzStats {
  readonly accepted: number;
  readonly byName: Map<MutationName, { accepted: number; refused: number }>;
  readonly problems: string[];
}

function fuzz(format: JsonFormat, seed: number): FuzzStats {
  const next = testRng(seed);
  const byName = new Map<MutationName, { accepted: number; refused: number }>();
  const problems: string[] = [];
  let accepted = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < VALUES; i++) {
    const base = mutationBase(next, format);
    const m = mutateTree(next, base, format, { count: 1 + (next() % 2) });
    const at = `value ${i} (${m.names.join(' + ')})`;
    let judged: Judged;
    try {
      judged = judge(m.value, format);
    } catch (e) {
      problems.push(`${at}: validation threw ${(e as Error).message}`);
      continue;
    }
    const ok = judged.params !== null;
    for (const name of m.names) {
      const s = byName.get(name) ?? { accepted: 0, refused: 0 };
      if (ok) s.accepted++;
      else s.refused++;
      byName.set(name, s);
    }
    if (!ok) {
      const p = pathProblem(m.value, format, judged.issues);
      if (p !== null) problems.push(`${at}: ${p}`);
      continue;
    }
    accepted++;
    try {
      const ps = format === 'density' ? densityProblems(judged.params!, next) : rulesProblems(judged.params!, next);
      for (const p of ps.slice(0, 3)) problems.push(`${at}: ${p}`);
    } catch (e) {
      problems.push(`${at}: accepted, then threw ${(e as Error).message}`);
    }
  }
  return { accepted, byName, problems };
}

describe('treeMutator: the untrusted-JSON fuzz (SP3d spec §10)', () => {
  for (const format of ['density', 'surfaceRules'] as const) {
    test(`${format}: 2,000 mutated values are refused with node paths or accepted and sound; ≥ 25 % accepted`, () => {
      const r = fuzz(format, format === 'density' ? 1601 : 1602);
      expect(r.problems.slice(0, 10), `${r.problems.length} problems`).toEqual([]);
      expect(r.accepted).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(VALUES / 4);
      // Every mutation of the format occurs; breaking ones are mostly refused, preserving ones mostly accepted.
      for (const cls of ['breaking', 'preserving'] as const) {
        let acc = 0, all = 0;
        for (const name of mutationsOf(format, cls)) {
          const s = r.byName.get(name);
          expect(s, `${format}: ${name} never applied`).toBeDefined();
          acc += s!.accepted;
          all += s!.accepted + s!.refused;
        }
        if (cls === 'breaking') expect(acc / all).toBeLessThan(0.25);
        else expect(acc / all).toBeGreaterThan(0.5);
      }
    });
  }
});

describe('treeMutator: the mutator', () => {
  test('mutations never change their base, are reproducible from the seed and keep −0 and own __proto__ keys', () => {
    for (const format of ['density', 'surfaceRules'] as const) {
      const a = testRng(7), b = testRng(7);
      for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
        const base = mutationBase(a, format);
        const before = JSON.stringify(base);
        const m = mutateTree(a, base, format);
        expect(JSON.stringify(base)).toBe(before);
        const m2 = mutateTree(b, mutationBase(b, format), format);
        expect(m2.names).toEqual(m.names);
        expect(JSON.stringify(m2.value)).toBe(JSON.stringify(m.value));
      }
    }
    const v = { a: -0, b: [-0, { c: 1 }] } as Record<string, unknown>;
    Object.defineProperty(v, '__proto__', { value: { op: 'y' }, enumerable: true, writable: true, configurable: true });
    const c = cloneTree(v) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(Object.is(c['a'], -0)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.is((c['b'] as unknown[])[0], -0)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.hasOwn(c, '__proto__')).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(c)).toBe(Object.prototype);
    expect(c).not.toBe(v);
  });

  test('the class option draws only that class; the catalogue per format', () => {
    const next = testRng(8);
    for (const format of ['density', 'surfaceRules'] as const) {
      for (const cls of ['breaking', 'preserving'] as const) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
          const m = mutateTree(next, format === 'density' ? DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE : DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES, format, { cls, count: 3 });
          expect(m.cls).toBe(cls);
          expect(m.names).toHaveLength(3);
          for (const n of m.names) expect(n === 'wrap' || mutationsOf(format, cls).includes(n)).toBe(true);
        }
      }
    }
    expect(mutationsOf('density', 'breaking')).not.toContain('airBlock');
    expect(mutationsOf('surfaceRules', 'breaking')).not.toContain('refCycle');
    expect(mutationsOf('surfaceRules', 'preserving')).not.toContain('muteTap');
    expect(new Set([...BREAKING_MUTATIONS, ...PRESERVING_MUTATIONS]).size).toBe(BREAKING_MUTATIONS.length + PRESERVING_MUTATIONS.length);
  });

  test('preserving mutations of the defaults are accepted and differ from the default most of the time', () => {
    for (const format of ['density', 'surfaceRules'] as const) {
      const next = testRng(9);
      const base = format === 'density' ? DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE : DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES;
      const text = canonicalJSON(base);
      let kept = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        const m = mutateTree(next, base, format, { cls: 'preserving', count: 1 + (next() % 3) });
        const j = judge(m.value, format);
        if (j.params !== null && canonicalJSON(format === 'density' ? j.params.density.defs : j.params.surface.rules) !== text) kept++;
      }
      expect(kept, format).toBeGreaterThan(120);
    }
  });

  test('the bases: the defaults and fuzz trees over the schema noises, which pass both tiers (density: with negativeZero false)', () => {
    for (const format of ['density', 'surfaceRules'] as const) {
      const next = testRng(10);
      let defaults = 0, valid = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        const b = mutationBase(next, format);
        if (b === DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE || b === DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES) { defaults++; continue; }
        if (judge(b, format).params !== null) valid++;
      }
      expect(defaults).toBeGreaterThan(70);
      expect(defaults).toBeLessThan(130);
      expect(valid, format).toBe(200 - defaults);
    }
  });
});

describe('the fuzz harness options for json leaves (SP3d spec §10)', () => {
  test('randomDensityExpr negativeZero false: the same trees with every −0 written +0', () => {
    const throws = (v: unknown): boolean => {
      try { canonicalJSON(v); return false; } catch { return true; }
    };
    const a = testRng(21), b = testRng(21);
    let withNegativeZero = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
      const x = randomDensityExpr(a, { noises: SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES });
      const y = randomDensityExpr(b, { noises: SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES, negativeZero: false });
      // JSON prints −0 as 0: equal texts mean equal trees but for the sign of their zeros (and the streams stayed aligned).
      expect(JSON.stringify(y)).toBe(JSON.stringify(x));
      expect(throws(y)).toBe(false);
      if (throws(x)) withNegativeZero++;
    }
    expect(withNegativeZero).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  });

  test('SCHEMA_SURFACE_NOISES: the schema surface noises, none of the fuzz-only ones', () => {
    expect(SCHEMA_SURFACE_NOISES).toEqual(['surface.noises.depth', 'surface.noises.patch', 'surface.noises.bandOffset']);
    for (const id of SURFACE_FUZZ_NOISES) if (!SCHEMA_SURFACE_NOISES.includes(id)) expect(id).toBe('surface.noises.fuzzB');
  });
});
```

Create `test/harness/treeMutator.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The untrusted-JSON mutator (SP3d spec §10 "Fuzz of untrusted JSON", §7 DT2's edited parts): random edits of a
 * `density.defs` or `surface.rules` value, drawn from a u32 stream (`testRng`, or a Xoshiro128's `nextU32`), so a seed
 * reproduces every value.
 *
 * - Bases (`mutationBase`): the default tree of the format (`DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE`, `DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES`) or a
 *   valid-by-construction fuzz tree drawn over the schema's noises (`randomDensityExpr` with `SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES` and
 *   `negativeZero: false`; `randomSurfaceRules` with `SCHEMA_SURFACE_NOISES`, any style), so tier 2 does not refuse a
 *   base for its noise ids alone.
 * - Breaking mutations (`BREAKING_MUTATIONS`): delete or add keys, swap ops and kinds, numbers set to −0, NaN, ±∞,
 *   ±1e308, ±(1e9 + 1) and huge or tiny exponents, very deep and very wide nesting, arrays, strings and other
 *   primitives in node slots, def, tap, biome, block, noise and field names empty, dotted, `__proto__` (an own key, as
 *   `JSON.parse` makes it), `constructor`, `toString` and over-long, param paths of the same names and to missing or
 *   non-numeric targets, refs to missing defs, ref cycles, knots with overflowing slopes, air and unknown blocks,
 *   oversized values (too many values, too long arrays and strings, too large a text).
 * - Structure-preserving mutations (`PRESERVING_MUTATIONS`): change a literal within its range, swap two siblings,
 *   replace a literal by a param ref (int fields take only int targets), wrap a node in a tap (rules: a rule in a
 *   one-child sequence, a condition in a double `not`), mute a tap, add a def and reference it (rules: duplicate a
 *   branch).
 *
 * A mutation never changes its input (the bases are frozen): it works on a copy (`cloneTree`, which keeps −0 and own
 * `__proto__` keys). Breaking mutations are not guaranteed to be refused, nor preserving ones accepted: the fuzz only
 * requires that every value is either refused with paths or accepted and then sound. Lookups keyed by tree content use
 * own properties only (names such as `constructor` are valid).
 */
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import type { JsonFormat } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import { ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS, SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, SOURCE_OPS, type SourceOp } from '../../src/gen/density/source';
import { CONDITION_KINDS, RULE_KINDS } from '../../src/gen/surface/rules';
import { randomDensityExpr, SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES } from './densityFuzz';
import { testFloat } from './stats';
import { randomSurfaceRules, SCHEMA_SURFACE_NOISES, type SurfaceFuzzStyle } from './surfaceFuzz';

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
type Container = Obj | unknown[];

export type MutationClass = 'breaking' | 'preserving';

export const BREAKING_MUTATIONS = [
  'deleteKey', 'addKey', 'swapOp', 'badNumber', 'deepNesting', 'wideNesting', 'wrongType', 'badName', 'refCycle',
  'missingTarget', 'knotsOverflow', 'airBlock', 'oversized',
] as const;
export const PRESERVING_MUTATIONS = ['changeLiteral', 'swapSiblings', 'literalToParam', 'wrap', 'muteTap', 'addDef'] as const;
export type MutationName = (typeof BREAKING_MUTATIONS)[number] | (typeof PRESERVING_MUTATIONS)[number];

/** The mutations that exist for a format (the others have no counterpart there). */
const DENSITY_ONLY: ReadonlySet<MutationName> = new Set(['refCycle', 'knotsOverflow', 'muteTap']);
const RULES_ONLY: ReadonlySet<MutationName> = new Set(['airBlock']);
export function mutationsOf(format: JsonFormat, cls: MutationClass): readonly MutationName[] {
  const all: readonly MutationName[] = cls === 'breaking' ? BREAKING_MUTATIONS : PRESERVING_MUTATIONS;
  return all.filter((m) => (format === 'density' ? !RULES_ONLY.has(m) : !DENSITY_ONLY.has(m)));
}

export interface TreeMutation {
  /** The mutated value (a fresh tree; the base is never changed). */
  readonly value: unknown;
  /** The mutations applied, in order. */
  readonly names: readonly MutationName[];
  readonly cls: MutationClass;
}

export interface MutateOptions {
  /** Only this class (default: breaking or preserving, one draw). */
  readonly cls?: MutationClass;
  /** Mutations applied one after the other (default 1). */
  readonly count?: number;
}

/**
 * A deep copy of a JSON-like value (plain objects and arrays; primitives as they are, −0 included): every own enumerable
 * key is defined with `Object.defineProperty`, so a `__proto__` key stays an own key. Recursive: for bases and the
 * values this module builds, not for adversarial input.
 */
export function cloneTree(v: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(cloneTree);
  if (typeof v !== 'object' || v === null) return v;
  const out: Obj = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(v)) define(out, k, cloneTree((v as Obj)[k]));
  return out;
}

function define(o: Obj, k: string, v: unknown): void {
  Object.defineProperty(o, k, { value: v, enumerable: true, writable: true, configurable: true });
}

const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Obj => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
const own = (o: Obj, k: string): unknown => (Object.hasOwn(o, k) ? o[k] : undefined);

/**
 * A base value for the fuzz: half the time the format's default tree, else a fuzz tree over the schema's noises (density:
 * at most 3 defs, height ≤ 6; rules: the three styles in turn by draw). The default is returned as itself (frozen).
 */
export function mutationBase(next: () => number, format: JsonFormat): unknown {
  if (next() % 2 === 0) return format === 'density' ? DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE : DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES;
  if (format === 'density') return randomDensityExpr(next, { noises: SCHEMA_DENSITY_NOISES, negativeZero: false });
  const styles: readonly SurfaceFuzzStyle[] = ['free', 'fastPath', 'nearMiss'];
  return randomSurfaceRules(next, { style: styles[next() % 3]!, noises: SCHEMA_SURFACE_NOISES });
}

/** A slot holding a node: `parent[key]` is a node object (density op node; rules rule or condition). */
interface Slot {
  readonly parent: Container;
  readonly key: string | number;
  /** density: 'node'; rules: 'rule' or 'cond'. */
  readonly role: 'node' | 'rule' | 'cond';
  /** Inside an `interpolated` (density), for information only. */
  readonly depth: number;
}

/** A numeric field: `parent[key]` is a number (or, with `ref`, a ref object `{param, neg?}`). */
interface Field {
  readonly parent: Container;
  readonly key: string | number;
  /** An int field of the rules (offset, minY, the gradient bounds). */
  readonly int: boolean;
  /** density: a field that takes the ref form (not `const.v`, which takes a `param` node). */
  readonly refable: boolean;
}

const RULE_INT_FIELDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['offset', 'minY', 'trueAtAndBelow', 'falseAtAndAbove']);
const RULE_NUMBER_FIELDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['offset', 'minY', 'trueAtAndBelow', 'falseAtAndAbove', 'min', 'max', 't']);
const DENSITY_REF_FIELDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['lo', 'hi', 'mute']);
const SOURCE_OP_SET: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>(SOURCE_OPS);

/** Child keys of a density node (unknown op: none). */
function densityKids(n: Obj): readonly string[] {
  const op = own(n, 'op');
  return typeof op === 'string' && SOURCE_OP_SET.has(op) ? SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS[op as SourceOp] : [];
}

/** The mutable model of one value: a holder whose `v` is the tree, its node slots and numeric fields. */
class Tree {
  readonly holder: Obj;
  readonly format: JsonFormat;
  constructor(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat) {
    this.format = format;
    this.holder = {};
    define(this.holder, 'v', cloneTree(value));
  }

  get value(): unknown { return this.holder['v']; }

  /** Every node slot, in pre-order (iterative). */
  slots(): Slot[] {
    const out: Slot[] = [];
    const stack: Slot[] = [];
    const v = this.value;
    if (this.format === 'density') {
      if (!isObj(v)) return out;
      const defs = own(v, 'defs');
      if (isObj(defs)) for (const k of Object.keys(defs).reverse()) stack.push({ parent: defs, key: k, role: 'node', depth: 1 });
      stack.push({ parent: v, key: 'root', role: 'node', depth: 1 });
    } else {
      stack.push({ parent: this.holder, key: 'v', role: 'rule', depth: 1 });
    }
    while (stack.length > 0) {
      const s = stack.pop()!;
      const n = (s.parent as Obj)[s.key as string];
      if (!isObj(n)) continue;
      out.push(s);
      if (s.depth > 400) continue;
      const kids: Slot[] = [];
      if (this.format === 'density') {
        for (const k of densityKids(n)) kids.push({ parent: n, key: k, role: 'node', depth: s.depth + 1 });
      } else if (s.role === 'rule') {
        const rules = own(n, 'rules');
        if (Array.isArray(rules)) for (let i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) kids.push({ parent: rules, key: i, role: 'rule', depth: s.depth + 1 });
        if (Object.hasOwn(n, 'if')) kids.push({ parent: n, key: 'if', role: 'cond', depth: s.depth + 1 });
        if (Object.hasOwn(n, 'then')) kids.push({ parent: n, key: 'then', role: 'rule', depth: s.depth + 1 });
      } else if (Object.hasOwn(n, 'if')) {
        kids.push({ parent: n, key: 'if', role: 'cond', depth: s.depth + 1 });
      }
      for (let i = kids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) stack.push(kids[i]!);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Every numeric literal field of the nodes (density: scalar fields and knot coordinates; rules: the nine fields). */
  fields(withRefs = false): Field[] {
    const out: Field[] = [];
    const isNum = (x: unknown): boolean => typeof x === 'number' || (withRefs && isObj(x) && Object.hasOwn(x, 'param'));
    for (const s of this.slots()) {
      const n = (s.parent as Obj)[s.key as string] as Obj;
      if (this.format === 'density') {
        for (const k of Object.keys(n)) {
          const x = n[k];
          if (k === 'knots' && Array.isArray(x)) {
            for (const kn of x) if (Array.isArray(kn)) for (let i = 0; i < kn.length; i++) if (isNum(kn[i])) out.push({ parent: kn, key: i, int: false, refable: true });
          } else if (isNum(x)) {
            out.push({ parent: n, key: k, int: false, refable: DENSITY_REF_FIELDS.has(k) });
          }
        }
      } else {
        for (const k of Object.keys(n)) {
          if (RULE_NUMBER_FIELDS.has(k) && isNum(n[k])) out.push({ parent: n, key: k, int: RULE_INT_FIELDS.has(k), refable: true });
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Every name already used as a def or tap name (density), for fresh names. */
  names(): Set<string> {
    const out = new Set<string>();
    const v = this.value;
    if (isObj(v) && isObj(own(v, 'defs'))) for (const k of Object.keys(own(v, 'defs') as Obj)) out.add(k);
    for (const s of this.slots()) {
      const n = (s.parent as Obj)[s.key as string] as Obj;
      const name = own(n, 'name');
      if (typeof name === 'string') out.add(name);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** The defs object of a density value (created when missing and the value is an object), else undefined. */
  defs(): Obj | undefined {
    const v = this.value;
    if (!isObj(v)) return undefined;
    let d = own(v, 'defs');
    if (!isObj(d)) {
      d = {};
      define(v, 'defs', d);
    }
    return d as Obj;
  }
}

const getSlot = (s: Slot): Obj => (s.parent as Obj)[s.key as string] as Obj;
function setSlot(s: Slot | Field, v: unknown): void {
  if (Array.isArray(s.parent)) s.parent[s.key as number] = v;
  else define(s.parent, s.key as string, v);
}

/** Names that are empty, dotted, `__proto__`, `Object.prototype` members, malformed or over-long. */
const BAD_NAMES: readonly string[] = [
  '', 'a.b', '__proto__', 'constructor', 'toString', 'valueOf', 'hasOwnProperty', '1abc', 'a-b', 'x'.repeat(33), 'y'.repeat(300),
];
/** Numbers no tree may hold, or only in some places: −0, non-finite, beyond the literal range, extreme exponents. */
const BAD_NUMBERS: readonly number[] = [-0, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, 1e308, -1e308, 1e9 + 1, -(1e9 + 1), 1e300, -1e200, 5e-324, 1e-300];
/** Param paths that are not targets: missing, non-numeric, outside the density / surface groups, prototype names. */
const BAD_PARAM_PATHS: readonly string[] = [
  'density.nope', 'density.noises.jag', 'density.noises.jag.wavelength', 'density.defs', 'surface.rules', 'climate.scaleMul',
  'surface.noises.depth', 'constructor', '__proto__', 'toString', '', 'density.detailAmpLo.x',
];
const TARGETS: readonly string[] = [...ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.keys()];
const INT_TARGETS: readonly string[] = TARGETS.filter((t) => ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get(t)!.kind === 'int');

/** −0 never: a product or difference that gives −0 is written +0. */
const plus0 = (v: number): number => (v === 0 ? 0 : v);

/** One mutation per call; `mutate` returns false when it does not apply to this tree. */
class Mutator {
  private readonly next: () => number;
  private readonly t: Tree;
  constructor(next: () => number, t: Tree) {
    this.next = next;
    this.t = t;
  }

  private pick<T>(xs: readonly T[]): T { return xs[this.next() % xs.length]!; }
  private int(lo: number, hi: number): number { return lo + (this.next() % (hi - lo + 1)); }
  private fresh(prefix: string): string {
    const used = this.t.names();
    for (let k = 1; ; k++) if (!used.has(`${prefix}${k}`)) return `${prefix}${k}`;
  }

  /** A small valid leaf node of the format's slot role. */
  private leaf(role: Slot['role']): Obj {
    if (role === 'node') return this.next() % 2 === 0 ? { op: 'y' } : { op: 'const', v: this.int(-8, 8) };
    if (role === 'cond') return { kind: 'skyOpen' };
    return { kind: 'block', state: 'stone' };
  }

  mutate(name: MutationName): boolean {
    const t = this.t;
    const density = t.format === 'density';
    const slots = t.slots();
    const slot = slots.length > 0 ? this.pick(slots) : undefined;
    switch (name) {
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- breaking
      case 'deleteKey': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        const n = getSlot(slot);
        const keys = Object.keys(n);
        if (keys.length === 0) return false;
        delete n[this.pick(keys)];
        return true;
      }
      case 'addKey': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        const key = this.pick(['extra', 'scale', 'weight', 'note', 'children', density ? 'kind' : 'op', density ? 'then' : 'x']);
        define(getSlot(slot), key, this.pick<unknown>([1, 'x', true, {}, [0], { op: 'y' }, { kind: 'skyOpen' }]));
        return true;
      }
      case 'swapOp': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        const n = getSlot(slot);
        const key = density ? 'op' : 'kind';
        const choices: readonly string[] = density
          ? [...SOURCE_OPS, 'bogus', 'Add', '']
          : [...RULE_KINDS, ...CONDITION_KINDS, 'bogus', ''];
        define(n, key, this.pick(choices));
        return true;
      }
      case 'badNumber': {
        const fields = t.fields();
        const bad = this.pick(BAD_NUMBERS);
        if (fields.length === 0) {
          if (slot === undefined) return false;
          setSlot(slot, density ? { op: 'const', v: bad } : { kind: 'steep', min: bad });
          return true;
        }
        setSlot(this.pick(fields), bad);
        return true;
      }
      case 'deepNesting': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        const depth = this.int(20, 200);
        let v: unknown = getSlot(slot);
        const arrays = this.next() % 4 === 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
          if (arrays) v = [v];
          else if (density) v = { op: this.pick(['neg', 'abs', 'square']), x: v };
          else v = slot.role === 'cond' ? { kind: 'not', if: v } : { kind: 'sequence', rules: [v] };
        }
        setSlot(slot, v);
        return true;
      }
      case 'wideNesting': {
        const width = this.next() % 2 === 0 ? this.int(65, 300) : this.int(300, 6000);
        if (density) {
          if (this.next() % 3 === 0) {
            const defs = t.defs();
            if (defs === undefined) return false;
            for (let i = 0; i < width && i < 2000; i++) define(defs, `w${i}`, { op: 'const', v: i });
            return true;
          }
          if (slot === undefined) return false;
          // A balanced add tree over `width` leaves (iterative pairing).
          let level: unknown[] = Array.from({ length: width }, (_, i) => (i % 2 === 0 ? { op: 'y' } : { op: 'const', v: i }));
          while (level.length > 1) {
            const up: unknown[] = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < level.length; i += 2) up.push(i + 1 < level.length ? { op: 'add', a: level[i], b: level[i + 1] } : level[i]);
            level = up;
          }
          setSlot(slot, level[0]);
          return true;
        }
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        if (this.next() % 2 === 0) {
          const biomes = Array.from({ length: width }, () => this.pick(['plains', 'desert', 'ocean', 'beach']));
          const cond = { kind: 'biome', biomes };
          setSlot(slot, slot.role === 'cond' ? cond : { kind: 'condition', if: cond, then: getSlot(slot) });
          return true;
        }
        if (slot.role === 'cond') return false;
        setSlot(slot, { kind: 'sequence', rules: Array.from({ length: width }, () => ({ kind: 'block', state: 'stone' })) });
        return true;
      }
      case 'wrongType': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        setSlot(slot, this.pick<unknown>([[], [1, 2], ['add'], 'add', 'stone', 3, -0, true, null, {}, [{ op: 'y' }]]));
        return true;
      }
      case 'badName': {
        const bad = this.pick(BAD_NAMES);
        if (density) {
          const r = this.next() % 4;
          if (r === 0 || slot === undefined) {
            // A def under the bad name, referenced from a slot (an own `__proto__` key, as JSON.parse makes it).
            const defs = t.defs();
            if (defs === undefined) return false;
            define(defs, bad, { op: 'const', v: 1 });
            if (slot !== undefined) setSlot(slot, { op: 'ref', name: bad });
            return true;
          }
          const field = this.pick(['tap', 'param', 'noise', 'col', 'ref']);
          if (field === 'tap') setSlot(slot, { op: 'tap', name: bad, x: getSlot(slot) });
          else if (field === 'param') setSlot(slot, { op: 'param', path: bad });
          else if (field === 'noise') setSlot(slot, { op: this.pick(['noise', 'noise2']), id: bad });
          else if (field === 'col') setSlot(slot, { op: 'col', field: bad });
          else setSlot(slot, { op: 'ref', name: bad });
          return true;
        }
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        if (this.next() % 4 === 0) {
          define(getSlot(slot), bad, 1);
          return true;
        }
        if (slot.role === 'cond') {
          setSlot(slot, this.pick<Obj>([
            { kind: 'biome', biomes: ['plains', bad] },
            { kind: 'noiseThreshold', noise: bad, min: 0, max: 1 },
            { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: bad, offset: 0, addSurfaceDepth: false },
            { kind: 'steep', min: { param: bad } },
          ]));
        } else {
          setSlot(slot, { kind: 'block', state: bad });
        }
        return true;
      }
      case 'refCycle': {
        const defs = t.defs();
        if (defs === undefined) return false;
        const a = this.fresh('c'), b = `${a}x`;
        if (this.next() % 2 === 0) {
          define(defs, a, { op: 'add', a: { op: 'ref', name: b }, b: { op: 'y' } });
          define(defs, b, { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'ref', name: a } });
        } else {
          define(defs, a, { op: 'abs', x: { op: 'ref', name: a } });
        }
        if (slot !== undefined && this.next() % 2 === 0) setSlot(slot, { op: 'ref', name: a });
        return true;
      }
      case 'missingTarget': {
        const path = this.pick(BAD_PARAM_PATHS);
        if (density) {
          const r = this.next() % 3;
          if (r === 0 && slot !== undefined) setSlot(slot, { op: 'ref', name: this.fresh('missing') });
          else if (r === 1 && slot !== undefined) setSlot(slot, { op: 'param', path });
          else {
            const fields = t.fields().filter((f) => f.refable);
            if (fields.length === 0) return false;
            setSlot(this.pick(fields), this.pick<unknown>([{ param: path }, { param: path, neg: true }, { param: 3 }, { param: TARGETS[0], neg: false }, {}]));
          }
          return true;
        }
        const fields = t.fields(true);
        if (fields.length === 0) return false;
        const f = this.pick(fields);
        const nonInt = TARGETS.filter((x) => ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.get(x)!.kind !== 'int');
        setSlot(f, this.pick<unknown>([{ param: path }, { param: path, neg: true }, { param: 7 }, { param: this.pick(nonInt), neg: false }, { neg: true }, f.int ? { param: this.pick(nonInt) } : { param: 'surface.snowline', scale: 2 }]));
        return true;
      }
      case 'knotsOverflow': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        const knots = this.pick<unknown>([
          [[0, -1e9], [5e-324, 1e9]], [[0, -1e308], [1, 1e308]], [[-64, 0], [1e-300, 1e9], [320, 0]],
          [[0, { param: 'density.detailAmpLo' }], [1e-310, { param: 'density.detailAmpHi', neg: true }]],
        ]);
        const n = getSlot(slot);
        if (own(n, 'op') === 'slide') define(n, 'knots', knots);
        else setSlot(slot, { op: 'slide', x: n, knots });
        return true;
      }
      case 'airBlock': {
        const blocks = slots.filter((s) => s.role === 'rule' && own(getSlot(s), 'kind') === 'block');
        const state = this.pick(['air', 'air', 'minecraft:air', 'stone[x=1]', 'Stone', 'water']);
        if (blocks.length > 0) define(getSlot(this.pick(blocks)), 'state', state);
        else if (slot !== undefined && slot.role === 'rule') setSlot(slot, { kind: 'block', state });
        else return false;
        return true;
      }
      case 'oversized': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        const n = getSlot(slot);
        switch (this.next() % 4) {
          case 0: // > 65,536 values in arrays of ≤ 1,000 items
            define(n, 'extra', Array.from({ length: 70 }, (_, i) => Array.from({ length: 1000 }, (__, j) => i + j)));
            break;
          case 1: // an array of 1,025 … 3,000 items
            define(n, 'extra', Array.from({ length: this.int(1025, 3000) }, (_, i) => i % 7));
            break;
          case 2: // a string of 257 … 2,000 units
            define(n, density ? 'name' : 'state', 'z'.repeat(this.int(257, 2000)));
            break;
          default: // a canonical text above 128 KiB
            define(n, 'extra', Array.from({ length: 600 }, (_, i) => `${i}`.padEnd(250, 'q')));
            break;
        }
        return true;
      }
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- structure-preserving
      case 'changeLiteral': {
        const fields = t.fields();
        if (fields.length === 0) return false;
        const f = this.pick(fields);
        const v = (f.parent as Obj)[f.key as string] as number;
        let w: number;
        if (f.int || (!density && Number.isInteger(v) && f.key !== 'min' && f.key !== 'max' && f.key !== 't')) {
          w = v + this.pick([-3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3]);
        } else if (v === 0) {
          w = this.int(-4, 4) / 4;
        } else {
          w = v * (0.5 + testFloat(this.next));
          if (Math.abs(w) < 1e9) w = Math.round(w * 1000) / 1000;
        }
        setSlot(f, plus0(w));
        return true;
      }
      case 'swapSiblings': {
        if (density) {
          const pairs = slots.map(getSlot).filter((n) => ['add', 'mul', 'min', 'max', 'rangeChoice'].includes(own(n, 'op') as string));
          if (pairs.length === 0) return false;
          const n = this.pick(pairs);
          const [ka, kb] = own(n, 'op') === 'rangeChoice' ? ['inside', 'outside'] : ['a', 'b'];
          const a = n[ka!];
          define(n, ka!, n[kb!]);
          define(n, kb!, a);
          return true;
        }
        const seqs = slots.map(getSlot).filter((n) => Array.isArray(own(n, 'rules')) && (own(n, 'rules') as unknown[]).length >= 2);
        const lists = slots.map(getSlot).filter((n) => Array.isArray(own(n, 'biomes')) && (own(n, 'biomes') as unknown[]).length >= 2);
        const arrays = [...seqs.map((n) => n['rules'] as unknown[]), ...lists.map((n) => n['biomes'] as unknown[])];
        if (arrays.length === 0) return false;
        const xs = this.pick(arrays);
        const i = this.next() % xs.length;
        let j = this.next() % xs.length;
        if (j === i) j = (i + 1) % xs.length;
        const x = xs[i];
        xs[i] = xs[j];
        xs[j] = x;
        return true;
      }
      case 'literalToParam': {
        if (density) {
          const consts = slots.filter((s) => own(getSlot(s), 'op') === 'const');
          const fields = t.fields().filter((f) => f.refable);
          const neg = this.next() % 3 === 0;
          if (consts.length > 0 && (fields.length === 0 || this.next() % 2 === 0)) {
            setSlot(this.pick(consts), { op: 'param', path: this.pick(TARGETS) });
            return true;
          }
          if (fields.length === 0) return false;
          setSlot(this.pick(fields), neg ? { param: this.pick(TARGETS), neg: true } : { param: this.pick(TARGETS) });
          return true;
        }
        const fields = t.fields();
        if (fields.length === 0) return false;
        const f = this.pick(fields);
        const path = this.pick(f.int ? INT_TARGETS : TARGETS);
        setSlot(f, this.next() % 3 === 0 ? { param: path, neg: true } : { param: path });
        return true;
      }
      case 'wrap': {
        if (slot === undefined) return false;
        const n = getSlot(slot);
        if (density) setSlot(slot, { op: 'tap', name: this.fresh('w'), x: n });
        else if (slot.role === 'cond') setSlot(slot, { kind: 'not', if: { kind: 'not', if: n } });
        else setSlot(slot, { kind: 'sequence', rules: [n] });
        return true;
      }
      case 'muteTap': {
        const taps = slots.filter((s) => own(getSlot(s), 'op') === 'tap');
        let tap: Obj;
        if (taps.length > 0) tap = getSlot(this.pick(taps));
        else {
          if (slot === undefined) return false;
          tap = { op: 'tap', name: this.fresh('m'), x: getSlot(slot) };
          setSlot(slot, tap);
        }
        define(tap, 'mute', this.pick<unknown>([0, 1, -1, -1000000, 1000000, 0.5, -10, { param: this.pick(TARGETS) }, { param: this.pick(TARGETS), neg: true }]));
        return true;
      }
      case 'addDef': {
        if (density) {
          const defs = t.defs();
          if (defs === undefined || slot === undefined) return false;
          const name = this.fresh('def');
          define(defs, name, getSlot(slot));
          setSlot(slot, { op: 'ref', name });
          return true;
        }
        const seqs = slots.map(getSlot).filter((n) => Array.isArray(own(n, 'rules')) && (own(n, 'rules') as unknown[]).length >= 1);
        if (seqs.length === 0) return false;
        const rules = this.pick(seqs)['rules'] as unknown[];
        const i = this.next() % rules.length;
        rules.splice(i + 1, 0, cloneTree(rules[i]));
        return true;
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * `count` mutations (default 1) of a copy of `base` (a value of `format`), each drawn from `opts.cls` or, without it,
 * from one class drawn first (breaking or preserving, one in two). A mutation that does not apply to the tree is
 * redrawn; after 16 misses the value is wrapped (density: in a tap; rules: in a sequence), which always applies.
 */
export function mutateTree(next: () => number, base: unknown, format: JsonFormat, opts: MutateOptions = {}): TreeMutation {
  const cls: MutationClass = opts.cls ?? (next() % 2 === 0 ? 'breaking' : 'preserving');
  const names = mutationsOf(format, cls);
  const tree = new Tree(base, format);
  const m = new Mutator(next, tree);
  const applied: MutationName[] = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < (opts.count ?? 1); c++) {
    let done = false;
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 16 && !done; tries++) {
      const name = names[next() % names.length]!;
      if (m.mutate(name)) { applied.push(name); done = true; }
    }
    if (!done && m.mutate('wrap')) applied.push('wrap');
  }
  return { value: tree.value, names: applied, cls };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX, SLICE_RULE_NA } from '../../src/core/constants';
import type { GenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { createDensityReference } from '../../src/gen/density/reference';
import { probe } from '../../src/gen/density/probe';
import { resolveDensity } from '../../src/gen/density/source';
import { densityColumnCost } from '../../src/gen/inspect/cost';
import {
  densityReferenceOf, evaluateFieldSlice, fieldSliceProblem, nodeReferenceOf, probeField, sliceSampleVoxel,
  type FieldSliceRequest, type FieldSliceValues, type SliceField, type SliceGeometry, type TColumnSource,
} from '../../src/gen/inspect/fieldSlice';
import { surfaceContextOf } from '../../src/gen/surface/context';
import { surfaceProbe, surfaceProbeColumn } from '../../src/gen/surface/probe';
import { createSurfaceReference } from '../../src/gen/surface/reference';
import type { Condition } from '../../src/gen/surface/rules';
import { validateParamTrees } from '../../src/gen/trees';
import { segmentPointAt, type Segment } from '../../src/metrics/crossSection';
import { fillColumnT } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { WATER_SOURCE } from '../../src/world/blocks/fluid';
import { createStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { ctxFor, paramsWith } from '../harness/gen';
import { densityTree, heavyDetailPatch, terrainMuted } from './fixtures/editedTrees';

type Tree = Record<string, any>;
const MiB = 1 << 20;
const NEVER = (): boolean => false;

/** uiSmoke's mountain line and a coast line of the review slices (sea, beach and land at seed '42'; 64 chunk columns, so
 * one store holds them all on its 64 × 64 torus). */
const MOUNTAIN: Segment = { ax: -1664, az: 8, bx: -640, bz: 8 };
const COAST: Segment = { ax: -27136, az: -31992, bx: -26113, bz: -31992 };

const vertical = (s: Segment, n = 32): SliceGeometry => ({ plane: 'vertical', n, pointAt: (i) => segmentPointAt(s, i, n) });
const horizontal = (n = 32, extent = 256, cx = 0, cz = 0, y = 63): SliceGeometry => ({ plane: 'horizontal', n, cx, cz, y, extent });

const ctxWith = (tree: Tree): GenContext => ctxFor('42', { density: { defs: tree } } as never);

/** A T-column source over a store of its own: `fillColumnT` on first use (the T stage's states and fluid). */
function storeColumns(ctx: GenContext): TColumnSource {
  const store = createStore({ shared: false, maxBlockBytes: 32 * MiB, maxByteBytes: 16 * MiB });
  return (cx, cz, stop) => {
    if (store.proto(cx, cz) === null && !fillColumnT(store, ctx, cx, cz, stop)) return null;
    return store.proto(cx, cz);
  };
}

function run(ctx: GenContext, geometry: SliceGeometry, field: SliceField, path = '', from = 0, to = geometry.n): FieldSliceValues {
  const r = evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, { geometry, field, path, from, to }, NEVER, field === 'blocks' ? storeColumns(ctx) : undefined);
  if (r === null) throw new Error('stopped');
  return r;
}

/** Every sample (c, k) of a part with its voxel and its value index. */
function* samples(g: SliceGeometry, from = 0, to = g.n): Generator<{ c: number; k: number; i: number; x: number; y: number; z: number }> {
  for (let c = from; c < to; c++) {
    for (let k = 0; k < g.n; k++) {
      const [x, y, z] = sliceSampleVoxel(g, c, k);
      yield { c, k, i: (c - from) * g.n + k, x, y, z };
    }
  }
}

const bytes = (v: FieldSliceValues): number[] => [...new Uint8Array(v.values.buffer)].concat(v.fluid === null ? [] : [...v.fluid]);

describe('evaluateFieldSlice: density (SP3d spec §4.1, §5.1)', () => {
  const ctx = ctxFor('42');
  const dc = surfaceContextOf(ctx).density;

  test.each([
    ['vertical, mountain line', vertical(MOUNTAIN)],
    ['horizontal, extent 256 at (0, 0), y 63', horizontal()],
    ['horizontal, extent 8192 at (-1152, 8), y 100', horizontal(32, 8192, -1152, 8, 100)],
  ])('%s: every sample equals the compiled probe at its voxel', (_name, g) => {
    const r = run(ctx, g, 'density');
    expect(r.field).toBe('density');
    expect(r.values).toBeInstanceOf(Float64Array);
    expect(r.values.length).toBe(32 * 32);
    let solid = 0;
    for (const { i, x, y, z } of samples(g)) {
      const want = probe(dc, x, y, z);
      if (!Object.is(r.values[i], want)) throw new Error(`(${x}, ${y}, ${z}): slice ${r.values[i]} probe ${want}`);
      if (want > 0) solid++;
    }
    if (g.plane === 'vertical') expect(solid).toBeGreaterThan(100);
  });

  test('a horizontal slice reads corner samples: the ColumnCache stays empty', () => {
    const fresh = ctxFor('42');
    run(fresh, horizontal(32, 2048), 'density');
    expect(surfaceContextOf(fresh).density.columns.size).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('evaluateFieldSlice: node (SP3d spec §3.4)', () => {
  // The terrain tap muted to 0: its subtree leaves the resolved tree, but the inspector evaluates it from the source.
  const tree = terrainMuted(0);
  const ctx = ctxWith(tree);
  const noises = surfaceContextOf(ctx).density.noises;
  const path = 'root.a.a.x.x.a';

  /** The source subtree at `path` of the source tree, resolved on its own (inside interpolated, so wrapped). */
  const separately = createDensityReference(
    resolveDensity({ root: { op: 'interpolated', x: tree['root'].a.a.x.x.a }, defs: {} }, ctx.params),
    noises,
  );

  test.each([['vertical', vertical(MOUNTAIN)], ['horizontal', horizontal(32, 1024, -1152, 8, 90)]])(
    '%s: a node under a muted tap equals reference.voxel of its separately resolved subtree',
    (_name, g) => {
      const r = run(ctx, g, 'node', path);
      const d = run(ctx, g, 'density');
      const cols = surfaceContextOf(ctx).density.columns;
      let differs = 0;
      for (const { i, x, y, z } of samples(g)) {
        const want = separately.voxel(cols.get(x >> 4, z >> 4), x, y, z);
        if (!Object.is(r.values[i], want)) throw new Error(`(${x}, ${y}, ${z}): slice ${r.values[i]} separately ${want}`);
        if (!Object.is(r.values[i], d.values[i])) differs++;
      }
      expect(differs).toBeGreaterThan(500);
    },
  );

  test('a selected muted tap shows its subtree: equal to the unmuted tree\'s tap', () => {
    const plain = ctxFor('42');
    const g = vertical(MOUNTAIN);
    expect(bytes(run(ctx, g, 'node', 'root.a.a'))).toEqual(bytes(run(plain, g, 'node', 'root.a.a')));
    // While the density of the muted tree is the islands floor everywhere (terrain 0 + detail, max −1e6).
    expect(bytes(run(ctx, g, 'density'))).not.toEqual(bytes(run(plain, g, 'density')));
  });

  test('`root` is the final density', () => {
    const g = horizontal();
    expect(bytes(run(ctx, g, 'node', 'root'))).toEqual(bytes(run(ctx, g, 'density')));
  });
});

describe('evaluateFieldSlice: blocks and rule (SP3d spec §4.1)', () => {
  const ctx = ctxFor('42');
  const sc = surfaceContextOf(ctx);

  test('blocks equals the T stage\'s states and fluid, which agree with surfaceProbe and the probe column\'s water', () => {
    const g = vertical(COAST);

    expect(r.field).toBe('blocks');
    expect(r.values).toBeInstanceOf(Uint16Array);

    for (const { i, x, y, z } of samples(g)) {
```
