```ts
      expect(r.values[i]).toBe(surfaceProbe(sc, x, y, z).state);
      const c = surfaceProbeColumn(sc, x >> 4, z >> 4);
      const at = ((y + 64) << 8) | ((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15);
      expect(r.fluid![i]).toBe(c.solid[at] === 0 && c.water[at] !== 0 ? WATER_SOURCE : 0);
      if (r.fluid![i] !== 0) water++;
    }
    expect(water).toBeGreaterThan(20);
  });

  test('a rule mask: 1 where the voxel\'s rule path passes through the rule, n/a on air and water', () => {
    const g = vertical(COAST);
    let ones = 0, zeros = 0, naAir = 0, naWater = 0;
    for (const id of ['root.rules[2]', 'root', 'root.rules[1].then']) {
      expect(sc.reference.nodeAt(id)?.kind).toBe('rule');
      const r = run(ctx, g, 'rule', id);
      expect(r.values).toBeInstanceOf(Uint8Array);
      for (const { i, x, y, z } of samples(g)) {
        const c = surfaceProbeColumn(sc, x >> 4, z >> 4);
        const at = ((y + 64) << 8) | ((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15);
        if (c.solid[at] === 0) {
          expect(r.values[i]).toBe(SLICE_RULE_NA);
          if (c.water[at] !== 0) naWater++;
          else naAir++;
          continue;
        }
        const want = surfaceProbe(sc, x, y, z).path.includes(id) ? 1 : 0;
        expect(r.values[i]).toBe(want);
        if (want === 1) ones++;
        else zeros++;
      }
    }
    expect([ones, zeros, naAir, naWater].every((v) => v > 20)).toBe(true);
  });

  test('a condition mask: 1 where the condition alone holds (whether the walk reaches it or not)', () => {
    const g = vertical(COAST);
    const conditionIds = ['root.rules[2].if', 'root.rules[1].then.rules[2].if', 'root.rules[1].then.rules[0].if.if'];
    for (const id of conditionIds) {
      const found = sc.reference.nodeAt(id);
      expect(found?.kind).toBe('condition');
      const alone = createSurfaceReference(ctx.seed, { kind: 'condition', if: (found as { condition: Condition }).condition, then: { kind: 'block', state: 'stone' } }, sc.noises);
      const r = run(ctx, g, 'rule', id);
      let ones = 0, zeros = 0;
      for (const { i, x, y, z } of samples(g)) {
        const c = surfaceProbeColumn(sc, x >> 4, z >> 4);
        const p = ((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15);
        if (c.solid[((y + 64) << 8) | p] === 0) {
          expect(r.values[i]).toBe(SLICE_RULE_NA);
          continue;
        }
        const want = alone.evaluate(c.scan, sc.settings, p, y).path.length > 0 ? 1 : 0;
        expect(r.values[i]).toBe(want);
        if (want === 1) ones++;
        else zeros++;
      }
      expect(ones).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(zeros).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });
});

describe('evaluateFieldSlice: parts and stop (SP3d spec §5.1, §5.2)', () => {
  const cases: Array<[string, SliceGeometry, SliceField, string]> = [
    ['density vertical', vertical(MOUNTAIN), 'density', ''],
    ['density horizontal', horizontal(32, 512, 100, -300, 70), 'density', ''],
    ['node vertical', vertical(MOUNTAIN), 'node', 'root.a.a.x.x.b'],
    ['node horizontal', horizontal(32, 512, 100, -300, 70), 'node', 'root.a.b'],
    ['blocks vertical', vertical(COAST), 'blocks', ''],
    ['rule vertical', vertical(COAST), 'rule', 'root.rules[1].then'],
  ];

  test.each(cases)('%s: the concatenated parts equal the whole, bit for bit, on another context', (_name, g, field, path) => {
    const whole = run(ctxFor('42'), g, field, path);
    const other = ctxFor('42');
    const parts = [[0, 7], [7, 8], [8, 32]].map(([from, to]) => run(other, g, field, path, from, to));
    expect(parts.flatMap((p) => [...new Uint8Array(p.values.buffer)])).toEqual([...new Uint8Array(whole.values.buffer)]);
    if (field === 'blocks') expect(parts.flatMap((p) => [...p.fluid!])).toEqual([...whole.fluid!]);
    expect(parts.map((p) => p.values.length)).toEqual([7 * 32, 32, 24 * 32]);
  });

  test.each(cases.filter(([, , f]) => f !== 'blocks'))('%s: stop() is polled once per sample, and a stop returns null', (_name, g, field, path) => {
    const ctx = ctxFor('42');
    let polls = 0;
    const req: FieldSliceRequest = { geometry: g, field, path, from: 3, to: 9 };
    expect(evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req, () => { polls++; return false; })).not.toBeNull();
    // rule: plus 6 polls in each of the 6 probe-column builds (the density fill polls every 8 of its 48 corner rows).
    expect(polls).toBe(field === 'rule' ? 6 * 32 + 6 * 6 : 6 * 32);
    let left = 40;
    expect(evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req, () => --left < 0)).toBeNull();
    expect(left).toBe(-1);
  });

  test('a rule part, and a rule probe, stop within 50 ms of stop() on a heavy valid tree: the probe column\'s build polls it', () => {
    // heavyDetailPatch: tier-2 valid, its probe column takes about 0.1 s to build (its density fill), which the part
    // must not finish once stop() is true.
    const patch = heavyDetailPatch(32);
    const params = paramsWith(patch);
    expect(validateParamTrees(params)).toEqual([]);
    const cost = densityColumnCost(params.density.defs);
    expect(cost).toBeGreaterThan(400_000_000);
    expect(cost).toBeLessThanOrEqual(DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX);
    // A 32-sample line whose sample columns lie in distinct chunk columns. stop() turns true right after the poll that
    // precedes the second column's build: the 32nd poll made while the cache holds the first column (its samples 1-31,
    // then sample 0 of the second column).
    const g = vertical({ ax: 0, az: 0, bx: 4000, bz: 300 });
    for (let trial = 0; trial < 2; trial++) {
      const ctx = ctxFor('42', patch);
      const cache = surfaceContextOf(ctx).probeColumn;
      let held = 0;
      let firedAt = 0;
      const stop = (): boolean => {
        if (firedAt > 0) return true;
        if (cache.valid && ++held === 32) firedAt = performance.now();
        return false;
      };
      expect(evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, { geometry: g, field: 'rule', path: 'root.rules[1].then', from: 0, to: 32 }, stop)).toBeNull();
      const latency = performance.now() - firedAt;
      expect(latency, `rule part, trial ${trial}: ${latency.toFixed(1)} ms`).toBeLessThan(50);
      // The abandoned build leaves the one-column cache empty, so the next request rebuilds that column.
      expect(cache.valid).toBe(false);
      // A rule probe on another column: stop() turns true right after the poll before its build.
      let probePolls = 0;
      let probeFired = 0;
      const probeStop = (): boolean => {
        probePolls++;
        if (probePolls === 1) { probeFired = performance.now(); return false; }
        return true;
      };
      expect(probeField(ctx, 'rule', 'root', 2000 + 64 * trial, 90, 150, probeStop)).toBeNull();
      const probeLatency = performance.now() - probeFired;
      expect(probeLatency, `rule probe, trial ${trial}: ${probeLatency.toFixed(1)} ms`).toBeLessThan(50);
    }
  });

  test('blocks: a stop inside the T-column source or between samples returns null', () => {
    const ctx = ctxFor('42');
    const req: FieldSliceRequest = { geometry: vertical(COAST), field: 'blocks', path: '', from: 0, to: 4 };
    expect(evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req, () => true, storeColumns(ctx))).toBeNull();
    expect(evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req, NEVER, () => null)).toBeNull();
    let polls = 0;
    expect(evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req, () => { polls++; return false; }, storeColumns(ctx))).not.toBeNull();
    expect(polls).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4 * 32);
  });
});

describe('probeField (SP3d spec §5.3): one sample, exactly as the slice', () => {
  const ctx = ctxWith(terrainMuted(0));

  test.each([
    ['density', 'vertical', vertical(MOUNTAIN), ''],
    ['density', 'horizontal', horizontal(32, 4096, 0, 0, 40), ''],
    ['node', 'vertical', vertical(MOUNTAIN), 'root.a.a.x.x.a'],
    ['node', 'horizontal', horizontal(32, 4096, 0, 0, 40), 'root.a.a.x'],
    ['rule', 'vertical', vertical(COAST), 'root.rules[1].then'],
    ['rule', 'vertical', vertical(COAST), 'root.rules[2].if'],
  ] as const)('%s on a %s plane', (field, _plane, g, path) => {
    const r = run(ctx, g, field, path);
    let i = 0;
    for (const s of samples(g)) {
      if ((s.c * 7 + s.k) % 5 !== 0) continue;
      expect(Object.is(probeField(ctx, field, path, s.x, s.y, s.z, NEVER), r.values[s.i])).toBe(true);
      i++;
    }
    expect(i).toBeGreaterThan(150);
  });

  test('the bedrock at y −64 is n/a for rule; density is evaluated there', () => {
    expect(probeField(ctx, 'rule', 'root', 0, -64, 0, NEVER)).toBe(SLICE_RULE_NA);
    expect(probeField(ctx, 'density', '', 0, -64, 0, NEVER)).toBe(probe(surfaceContextOf(ctx).density, 0, -64, 0));
  });

  test('stop() is polled before the column and before evaluating', () => {
    for (const field of ['density', 'node', 'rule'] as const) {
      const path = field === 'node' ? 'root.a' : field === 'rule' ? 'root' : '';
      let polls = 0;
      expect(probeField(ctx, field, path, 5, 70, -9, () => { polls++; return false; })).not.toBeNull();
      // rule: plus the 6 polls of the probe column's density fill.
      expect(polls).toBe(field === 'rule' ? 2 + 6 : 2);
      expect(probeField(ctx, field, path, 5, 70, -9, () => true)).toBeNull();
      let n = 0;
      expect(probeField(ctx, field, path, 5, 70, -9, () => ++n > 1)).toBeNull();
    }
  });

  test('refusals: non-integer or out-of-window coordinates, y outside −64 … 319, a bad field or path', () => {
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'density', '', 0.5, 0, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'density', '', 524288, 0, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'density', '', 0, 320, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'density', '', 0, -65, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'blocks' as never, '', 0, 0, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'node', 'root.q', 0, 0, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(/names no node/);
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'rule', 'root.rules[99]', 0, 0, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(/no rule or condition/);
    expect(() => probeField(ctx, 'density', 'root', 0, 0, 0, NEVER)).toThrow(/takes no node path/);
  });
});

describe('field problems and argument checks (SP3d spec §5.1)', () => {
  const ctx = ctxFor('42');

  test('fieldSliceProblem', () => {
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'density', '', 'horizontal')).toBeNull();
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'node', 'root.a.b.b', 'horizontal')).toBeNull();
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'node', 'defs.x', 'vertical')).toBe('path "defs.x" names no node of density.defs');
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'node', 'root.b.x.v', 'vertical')).toBe('path "root.b.x.v" names no node of density.defs');
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'node', 'constructor', 'vertical')).toBe('path "constructor" names no node of density.defs');
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'rule', 'root.rules[2].if', 'vertical')).toBeNull();
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'rule', 'root.rules[2].if.falseAtAndAbove', 'vertical')).toBe('path "root.rules[2].if.falseAtAndAbove" names no rule or condition of surface.rules');
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'rule', 'root', 'horizontal')).toBe('field rule has no horizontal slice');
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'blocks', '', 'horizontal')).toBe('field blocks has no horizontal slice');
    expect(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, 'blocks', 'root', 'vertical')).toBe('field blocks takes no node path (got "root")');
  });

  test('evaluateFieldSlice refuses bad ranges, geometries, fields and a blocks request without a T-column source', () => {
    const g = vertical(MOUNTAIN);
    const req = (over: Partial<FieldSliceRequest>): FieldSliceRequest => ({ geometry: g, field: 'density', path: '', from: 0, to: 32, ...over });
    for (const [from, to] of [[5, 5], [0, 33], [-1, 4], [0.5, 4]]) expect(() => evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req({ from, to }), NEVER)).toThrow(/range/);
    expect(() => evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req({ geometry: { ...g, n: 64 } as SliceGeometry }), NEVER)).toThrow(/not a slice size/);
    expect(() => evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req({ geometry: horizontal(32, 8192, 524288 - 4095) }), NEVER)).toThrow(/world window/);
    expect(() => evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req({ geometry: horizontal(), field: 'rule', path: 'root' }), NEVER)).toThrow(/no horizontal slice/);
    expect(() => evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, req({ field: 'blocks' }), NEVER)).toThrow(/T-column source/);
  });
});

describe('DensityReference memos (SP3d spec §5.1, §5.3)', () => {
  test('densityReferenceOf: one per GenContext, over the stage\'s own resolved tree', () => {
    const a = ctxFor('42');
    const b = ctxFor('42');
    expect(densityReferenceOf(a)).toBe(densityReferenceOf(a));
    expect(densityReferenceOf(a).expr).toBe(surfaceContextOf(a).density.expr);
    expect(densityReferenceOf(b)).not.toBe(densityReferenceOf(a));
  });

  test('nodeReferenceOf: per (context, path), an LRU of 8 paths', () => {
    const ctx = ctxFor('42');
    const paths = ['root', 'root.a', 'root.b', 'root.b.x', 'root.a.a', 'root.a.b', 'root.a.b.a', 'root.a.b.b', 'root.a.a.x'];
    const first = new Map(paths.slice(0, 8).map((p) => [p, nodeReferenceOf(ctx, p)]));
    for (const p of paths.slice(0, 8)) expect(nodeReferenceOf(ctx, p)).toBe(first.get(p));
    expect(nodeReferenceOf(ctx, paths[8]!)).toBe(nodeReferenceOf(ctx, paths[8]!));
    // 'root' was the least recently used of the eight: it was evicted by the ninth path; 'root.a' was not.
    expect(nodeReferenceOf(ctx, 'root.a')).toBe(first.get('root.a'));
    expect(nodeReferenceOf(ctx, 'root')).not.toBe(first.get('root'));
    expect(nodeReferenceOf(ctxFor('42'), 'root.a')).not.toBe(first.get('root.a'));
    expect(() => nodeReferenceOf(ctx, 'root.zz')).toThrow(RangeError);
  });

  test('a node reference evaluates the resolved node expression: the islands tap is its const', () => {
    const tree = densityTree();
    tree['root'].b.x.v = -10;
    const ctx = ctxWith(tree);
    const s = surfaceContextOf(ctx).density.columns.get(0, 0);
    expect(nodeReferenceOf(ctx, 'root.b').voxel(s, 3, 200, 4)).toBe(-10);
    expect(nodeReferenceOf(ctx, 'root.b.x').voxel(s, 3, 200, 4)).toBe(-10);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest';
import { evaluateFieldSlice, probeField, sliceSampleVoxel, type SliceGeometry } from '../../src/gen/inspect/fieldSlice';
import { segmentPointAt } from '../../src/metrics/crossSection';
import { ctxFor } from '../harness/gen';

// A valid tree never evaluates to NaN or ±∞ (SP3d spec §1.9), so the reference is wrapped to return them: the slice and
// the probe must hand such values on unchanged (§3.6 shows NaN, +∞ and −∞; §5.3's reply guard accepts any number).
vi.mock('../../src/gen/density/reference', async (importOriginal) => {
  const real = await importOriginal<typeof import('../../src/gen/density/reference')>();
  const odd = (x: number, y: number, z: number): number | null => {
    const k = (Math.imul(x ^ Math.imul(z, 0x27d4eb2f), 0x9e3779b1) ^ Math.imul(y, 0x85ebca77)) >>> 30;
    return k === 0 ? Number.NaN : k === 1 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : k === 2 ? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY : null;
  };
  return {
    ...real,
    createDensityReference: (...args: Parameters<typeof real.createDensityReference>) => {
      const ref = real.createDensityReference(...args);
      return { ...ref, voxel: (s, x, y, z, e) => odd(x, y, z) ?? ref.voxel(s, x, y, z, e) } satisfies typeof ref;
    },
  };
});

const NEVER = (): boolean => false;
/** The voxels the wrapped reference answers with a non-finite value (a hash of x, y and z; about a quarter stay finite). */
const odd = (x: number, y: number, z: number): number | null => {
  const k = (Math.imul(x ^ Math.imul(z, 0x27d4eb2f), 0x9e3779b1) ^ Math.imul(y, 0x85ebca77)) >>> 30;
  return k === 0 ? Number.NaN : k === 1 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : k === 2 ? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY : null;
};

describe('non-finite values pass through unchanged (SP3d spec §3.6, §5.3)', () => {
  const ctx = ctxFor('42');
  const planes: Array<[string, SliceGeometry]> = [
    ['vertical', { plane: 'vertical', n: 32, pointAt: (i) => segmentPointAt({ ax: -1664, az: 8, bx: -640, bz: 8 }, i, 32) }],
    ['horizontal', { plane: 'horizontal', n: 32, cx: 0, cz: 0, y: 64, extent: 256 }],
  ];

  test.each(planes)('%s slice and probe: NaN, +∞ and −∞ as the reference returns them', (_name, g) => {
    for (const [field, path] of [['density', ''], ['node', 'root.a']] as const) {
      const r = evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, { geometry: g, field, path, from: 0, to: 32 }, NEVER)!;
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (let c = 0; c < 32; c++) {
        for (let k = 0; k < 32; k++) {
          const [x, y, z] = sliceSampleVoxel(g, c, k);
          const v = r.values[c * 32 + k]!;
          const want = odd(x, y, z);
          if (want !== null) {
            expect(Object.is(v, want)).toBe(true);
            seen.add(String(v));
          } else {
            expect(Number.isFinite(v)).toBe(true);
          }
          if ((c + k) % 9 === 0) expect(Object.is(probeField(ctx, field, path, x, y, z, NEVER), v)).toBe(true);
        }
      }
      expect([...seen].sort()).toEqual(['-Infinity', 'Infinity', 'NaN']);
    }
  });
});
```

```diff
+ * A tree that reads `col steep` at the default's weight (work cost 569 + 2): the islands const replaced by
+ * add(const −1e6, col steep), so its horizontal slices take corner samples with steep (spec §4.4, §5.2).
+ */
+export function steepTree(): Tree {
+  const t = densityTree();
+  t['root'].b.x = { op: 'add', a: { op: 'const', v: -1000000 }, b: { op: 'col', field: 'steep' } };
+  return t;

+/**
+ * A heavy tier-2-valid density patch (spec §4.5, §10: a configure stops a part within 50 ms for every field): the
+ * default root plus mul(20, a balanced add of `leaves` (a power of 2) `noise detail` leaves), the detail noise at 16
+ * octaves, double. At 32 leaves its column cost is about 0.4 G of `DENSITY_COLUMN_COST_MAX`'s 0.95 G, and the T column
+ * (or a rule probe column) takes about 0.1 s to fill.
+ */
+export function heavyDetailPatch(leaves = 32): ParamsPatch {
+  let level: Tree[] = Array.from({ length: leaves }, () => ({ op: 'noise', id: 'detail' }));
+  while (level.length > 1) {
+    const next: Tree[] = [];
+    for (let i = 0; i < level.length; i += 2) next.push({ op: 'add', a: level[i], b: level[i + 1] });
+    level = next;
+  }
+  const t = densityTree();
+  t['root'] = { op: 'add', a: t['root'], b: { op: 'mul', a: { op: 'const', v: 20 }, b: level[0] } };
+  return { density: { noises: { detail: { octaves: 16, double: true } }, defs: t } } as ParamsPatch;
+}
```

Create `test/unit/sliceCost.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import {
  COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST, CORNER_SAMPLE_COST, CORNER_STEEP_COST, DRAFT_BUDGET, PART_BUDGET, REQUEST_BUDGET, SLICE_RULE_NA,
} from '../../src/core/constants';
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import { densityColumnCost, ruleNodeCount, rulesColumnCost, tColumnCost, workCost } from '../../src/gen/inspect/cost';
import { evaluatedExpression, sliceCostOf } from '../../src/gen/inspect/fieldSlice';
import { paramsWith } from '../harness/gen';
import { steepTree, terrainMuted } from './fixtures/editedTrees';

type Tree = Record<string, any>;

/** Params with `density.defs` = `tree`. */
const withTree = (tree: Tree): Params => paramsWith({ density: { defs: tree } } as never);


describe('the slice work-bound constants (SP3d spec §5.2, core/constants.ts)', () => {
  test('acquisition costs, budgets and the rule field\'s n/a value', () => {
    expect([COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST, CORNER_SAMPLE_COST, CORNER_STEEP_COST]).toEqual([2 ** 15, 2 ** 11, 5 * 2 ** 10]);
    expect([PART_BUDGET, DRAFT_BUDGET, REQUEST_BUDGET]).toEqual([2 ** 23, 2 ** 24, 2 ** 27]);
    expect(SLICE_RULE_NA).toBe(255);
  });
});

describe('the T column work and the rule node count (SP3d spec §5.2, gen/inspect/cost.ts)', () => {
  test('the default trees: density column work at the configured noise weights, rules column cost, node count', () => {
    // Voxel placement: 20 nodes + detail (1 octave, double: 8) = 28 units; under interpolated: 37 nodes + jag and
    // overhang (2 octaves, double: 16 each) = 69 units.
    expect(densityColumnCost(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, DEFAULTS)).toBe(28 * 98304 + 69 * 1225);
    expect(densityColumnCost(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE)).toBe(14_907_917);
    expect(ruleNodeCount(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES)).toBe(163);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES)).toBe(2_169_856);
    expect(tColumnCost(DEFAULTS)).toBe(2_837_037 + 2_169_856);
  });

  test('every noise at its static maximum weight gives the static density column cost', () => {
    const max = { octaves: 16, double: true };
    const p = {
      ...DEFAULTS,
      density: { ...DEFAULTS.density, noises: { jag: { ...DEFAULTS.density.noises.jag, ...max }, overhang: { ...DEFAULTS.density.noises.overhang, ...max }, detail: { ...DEFAULTS.density.noises.detail, ...max } } },
    } as Params;
    expect(densityColumnCost(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, p)).toBe(densityColumnCost(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE));
  });

  test('a muted terrain tap drops its subtree from the T column work, mutes applied', () => {
    const p = withTree(terrainMuted(0));
    // The interpolated node (voxel placement) becomes the mute's const; its 69 corner units go.
    expect(densityColumnCost(p.density.defs, p)).toBe(28 * 98304);
    expect(tColumnCost(p)).toBe(28 * 98304 + 2_169_856);
  });
});

describe('sliceCostOf (SP3d spec §5.2)', () => {
  test('the defaults: vertical 128² ≈ 13.5 M and horizontal 128² ≈ 42.9 M units', () => {
    expect(workCost(evaluatedExpression(DEFAULTS, 'density', ''), DEFAULTS)).toBe(569);
    const v = sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'density', '', 'vertical', 128);
    const h = sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'density', '', 'horizontal', 128);
    expect(v).toBe(128 * 569 + COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST);
    expect(h).toBe(128 * (569 + CORNER_SAMPLE_COST));
    expect(128 * v).toBe(13_516_800);
    expect(128 * h).toBe(42_876_928);
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'density', '', 'vertical', 32)).toBe(32 * 569 + COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST);
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root', 'vertical', 128)).toBe(v);
  });

  test('a node inside interpolated is costed wrapped (1 + 8 × its subtree); one outside is not', () => {
    const inside = evaluatedExpression(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.a.a.x.x.a');
    expect(inside.root.op).toBe('interpolated');
    const bare = { root: (inside.root as { x: unknown }).x, defs: inside.defs };
    const c = workCost(inside, DEFAULTS);
    expect(c).toBe(1 + 8 * workCost(bare, DEFAULTS));
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.a.a.x.x.a', 'vertical', 128)).toBe(128 * c + COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST);
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.a.a.x.x.a', 'horizontal', 32)).toBe(32 * (c + CORNER_SAMPLE_COST));
    const tap = evaluatedExpression(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.a.a');
    expect(tap.root.op).toBe('tap');
    expect(workCost(tap, DEFAULTS)).toBe(1 + workCost({ root: (tap.root as { x: unknown }).x, defs: {} }, DEFAULTS));
    // The detail term (voxel placement): mul(noise detail, amplitude) = 1 + 8 + its amplitude's folded nodes.
    expect(evaluatedExpression(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.a.b').root.op).toBe('mul');
  });

  test('horizontal: a node reading col steep through the evaluated expression pays CORNER_STEEP_COST per sample', () => {
    const p = withTree(steepTree());
    const c = workCost(evaluatedExpression(p, 'density', ''), p);
    expect(c).toBe(569 + 2);
    expect(sliceCostOf(p, 'density', '', 'horizontal', 128)).toBe(128 * (c + CORNER_STEEP_COST));
    expect(sliceCostOf(p, 'node', 'root.b', 'horizontal', 128)).toBe(128 * (workCost(evaluatedExpression(p, 'node', 'root.b'), p) + CORNER_STEEP_COST));
    expect(sliceCostOf(p, 'node', 'root.a', 'horizontal', 128)).toBe(128 * (workCost(evaluatedExpression(p, 'node', 'root.a'), p) + CORNER_SAMPLE_COST));
    expect(sliceCostOf(p, 'density', '', 'vertical', 128)).toBe(128 * c + COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST);
  });

  test('a steep-reading horizontal 128² slice of a default-weight tree fits REQUEST_BUDGET, and its 32² draft DRAFT_BUDGET', () => {
    // The acquisition alone must leave room in every budget: n² × CORNER_STEEP_COST = REQUEST_BUDGET at n = 128 with
    // 2^13 (every steep-reading tree refused, "limit 0"); calibrated at 5 × 2^10 (64.5 µs measured, Task 19) it leaves
    // 3,072 units per sample for a 128² slice (5.4 × the default's 569) and 11,264 for a draft.
    const room = (n: number, budget: number, perSample: number) => Math.min(Math.floor(budget / (n * n)), Math.floor(PART_BUDGET / n)) - perSample;
    expect([room(128, REQUEST_BUDGET, CORNER_STEEP_COST), room(32, DRAFT_BUDGET, CORNER_STEEP_COST)]).toEqual([3072, 11_264]);
    expect([room(128, REQUEST_BUDGET, CORNER_SAMPLE_COST), room(32, DRAFT_BUDGET, CORNER_SAMPLE_COST)]).toEqual([6144, 14_336]);
    expect(CORNER_STEEP_COST).toBeGreaterThan(CORNER_SAMPLE_COST);
    for (const n of [32, 128]) expect(room(n, n === 32 ? DRAFT_BUDGET : REQUEST_BUDGET, CORNER_STEEP_COST), `n ${n}`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4 * 569);
    const p = withTree(steepTree());
    for (const [field, path] of [['density', ''], ['node', 'root.b'], ['node', 'root.b.x']] as const) {
      const c = workCost(evaluatedExpression(p, field, path), p);
      for (const [n, budget] of [[32, DRAFT_BUDGET], [128, REQUEST_BUDGET]] as const) {
        const cost = sliceCostOf(p, field, path, 'horizontal', n);
        expect(cost, `${field} ${path} ${n}`).toBe(n * (c + CORNER_STEEP_COST));
        expect(n * cost, `${field} ${path} ${n}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(budget);
        expect(cost, `${field} ${path} ${n}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(PART_BUDGET);
      }
    }
  });

  test('blocks: one T column per sample column; rule: plus n × the rule node count', () => {
    const t = tColumnCost(DEFAULTS);
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'blocks', '', 'vertical', 128)).toBe(t);
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'blocks', '', 'vertical', 32)).toBe(t);
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'rule', 'root.rules[2]', 'vertical', 128)).toBe(t + 128 * 163);
    expect(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'rule', 'root', 'vertical', 32)).toBe(t + 32 * 163);
  });

  test('the costs follow the configured params: a muted tap and the noise octaves', () => {
    const muted = withTree(terrainMuted(0));
    expect(sliceCostOf(muted, 'node', 'root.a.a.x', 'vertical', 128)).toBe(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.a.a.x', 'vertical', 128));
    expect(sliceCostOf(muted, 'density', '', 'vertical', 128)).toBeLessThan(sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'density', '', 'vertical', 128));
    const octaves = paramsWith({ density: { noises: { detail: { octaves: 4 } } } } as never);
    expect(workCost(evaluatedExpression(octaves, 'density', ''), octaves)).toBe(569 - 8 + 32);
  });

  test('refusals: an n outside SLICE_NS, blocks or rule on a horizontal plane, a path naming no node', () => {
    expect(() => sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'density', '', 'vertical', 64)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'blocks', '', 'horizontal', 128)).toThrow(/no horizontal slice/);
    expect(() => sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'rule', 'root', 'horizontal', 32)).toThrow(/no horizontal slice/);
    expect(() => sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.zz', 'vertical', 32)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, 'node', 'root.a.lo', 'vertical', 32)).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});
```

Create `test/unit/surfaceReferenceNodes.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import type { Seed64 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import { createSurfaceReference, ruleNodeAt } from '../../src/gen/surface/reference';
import { conditionThenId, ROOT_RULE_ID, sequenceChildId, type Condition, type Rule } from '../../src/gen/surface/rules';
import { newSurfaceScan, scanColumn } from '../../src/gen/surface/scan';
import { surfaceContextOf } from '../../src/gen/surface/context';
import { ctxFor } from '../harness/gen';
import {
  randomSurfaceColumn, randomSurfaceRules, surfaceFuzzNoiseSource, surfaceFuzzSettings,
} from '../harness/surfaceFuzz';
import { testRng } from '../harness/stats';

/** Every rule and condition of `tree` with its id (SP3c's ids; `.if` into a condition, again into each `not`). */
function nodesOf(tree: Rule): Array<{ id: string; kind: 'rule'; node: Rule } | { id: string; kind: 'condition'; node: Condition }> {
  const out: Array<{ id: string; kind: 'rule'; node: Rule } | { id: string; kind: 'condition'; node: Condition }> = [];
  const walk = (r: Rule, id: string): void => {
    out.push({ id, kind: 'rule', node: r });
    if (r.kind === 'sequence') r.rules.forEach((c, k) => walk(c, sequenceChildId(id, k)));
    if (r.kind === 'condition') {
      let c: Condition = r.if;
      let cid = `${id}.if`;
      for (;;) {
        out.push({ id: cid, kind: 'condition', node: c });
        if (c.kind !== 'not') break;
        c = c.if;
        cid = `${cid}.if`;
      }
      walk(r.then, conditionThenId(id));
    }
  };
  walk(tree, ROOT_RULE_ID);
  return out;
}

describe('ruleNodeAt and SurfaceReference.nodeAt (SP3d spec §4.1)', () => {
  const sc = surfaceContextOf(ctxFor('42'));
  const tree = sc.rules;

  test('every rule and condition of the default tree is found by its id, as the tree\'s own object', () => {
    const nodes = nodesOf(tree);
    expect(nodes.length).toBe(163);
    for (const { id, kind, node } of nodes) {
      const got = sc.reference.nodeAt(id);
      expect(got?.kind, id).toBe(kind);
      expect(got !== undefined && (got.kind === 'rule' ? got.rule : got.condition), id).toBe(node);
    }
    expect(sc.reference.nodeAt('root')).toEqual({ kind: 'rule', rule: tree });
  });

  test('random fuzz trees: every id round-trips, through nested nots too', () => {
    const next = testRng(1717);
    let conditions = 0, nots = 0;
    for (let t = 0; t < 60; t++) {
      const r = randomSurfaceRules(next, { style: (['free', 'fastPath', 'nearMiss'] as const)[t % 3] });
      for (const { id, kind, node } of nodesOf(r)) {
        const got = ruleNodeAt(r, id);
        expect(got !== undefined && (got.kind === 'rule' ? got.rule : got.condition), id).toBe(node);
        expect(got!.kind).toBe(kind);
        if (kind === 'condition') conditions++;
        if (kind === 'condition' && id.endsWith('.if.if')) nots++;
      }
    }
    expect(conditions).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    expect(nots).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test.each([
    [''], ['roots'], ['rule'], ['root.'], ['root.rules[01]'], ['root.rules[-1]'], ['root.rules[999]'], ['root.rules[1e1]'],
    ['root.then'], ['root.if'], ['root.rules[2].if.falseAtAndAbove'], ['root.rules[2].if.if'], ['root.rules[2].then.then'],
    ['root.rules[2].rules[0]'], ['root.rules[0].if.if.if'], ['root.rules[0]x'], ['constructor'], ['root.rules[0].__proto__'],
  ])('%j names no node', (id) => {
    expect(sc.reference.nodeAt(id)).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe('SurfaceReference.conditionHolds (SP3d spec §4.1)', () => {
  test('on fuzz columns it equals a one-condition tree\'s verdict for every condition of fuzz trees', () => {
    const next = testRng(9091);
    const seed: Seed64 = [7, 11];
    const noises = surfaceFuzzNoiseSource(seed);
    const set = surfaceFuzzSettings(seed, undefined, noises);
    let checked = 0, held = 0;
    for (let round = 0; round < 6; round++) {
      const col = randomSurfaceColumn(next);
      const scan = scanColumn(newSurfaceScan(), set, col.sample, col.solid, col.water, col.biomes);
      const tree = randomSurfaceRules(next, { style: (['free', 'fastPath', 'nearMiss'] as const)[round % 3] });
      const ref = createSurfaceReference(seed, tree, noises);
      for (const { id, node } of nodesOf(tree).filter((n) => n.kind === 'condition')) {
        const alone = createSurfaceReference(seed, { kind: 'condition', if: node as Condition, then: { kind: 'block', state: 'stone' } }, noises);
        for (let p = next() % 11; p < 256; p += 11) {
          for (let y = -63; y <= 319; y += 1 + (next() % 9)) {
            if (col.solid[256 * (y + 64) + p] === 0) continue;
            const want = alone.evaluate(scan, set, p, y).path.length > 0;
            expect(ref.conditionHolds(id, scan, set, p, y)).toBe(want);
            checked++;
            if (want) held++;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    expect(checked).toBeGreaterThan(2000);
    expect(held).toBeGreaterThan(checked / 20);
    expect(held).toBeLessThan(checked);
  });

  test('a rule id, an unknown id or a non-solid voxel is a RangeError', () => {
    const next = testRng(5);
    const seed: Seed64 = [1, 2];
    const noises = surfaceFuzzNoiseSource(seed);
    const set = surfaceFuzzSettings(seed, undefined, noises);
    const col = randomSurfaceColumn(next);
    const scan = scanColumn(newSurfaceScan(), set, col.sample, col.solid, col.water, col.biomes);
    const tree: Rule = { kind: 'sequence', rules: [{ kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'not', if: { kind: 'skyOpen' } }, then: { kind: 'block', state: 'stone' } }] };
    const ref = createSurfaceReference(seed, tree, noises);
    let p = 0, y = -63;
    while (col.solid[256 * (y + 64) + p] === 0) p++;
    expect(() => ref.conditionHolds('root.rules[0]', scan, set, p, y)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => ref.conditionHolds('root.rules[1].if', scan, set, p, y)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(typeof ref.conditionHolds('root.rules[0].if', scan, set, p, y)).toBe('boolean');
    expect(ref.conditionHolds('root.rules[0].if.if', scan, set, p, y)).toBe(!ref.conditionHolds('root.rules[0].if', scan, set, p, y));
    let ya = 319;
    while (col.solid[256 * (ya + 64) + p] !== 0) ya--;
    expect(() => ref.conditionHolds('root.rules[0].if', scan, set, p, ya)).toThrow(/not solid/);
  });
});
```

```diff
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Field evaluation (§4.1, §5.1, §5.3)
+
+/** A slice field (§4.1): `node` is the `selected` field on a density node, `rule` on a rule or condition. */
+export type SliceField = 'density' | 'node' | 'blocks' | 'rule';
+/** The fields `probeField` answers (§5.3). */
+export type ProbeField = 'density' | 'node' | 'rule';
+
+/** One part of a slice: the plane, the field, the node path inside its leaf ('' for density and blocks), [from, to). */
+export interface FieldSliceRequest {
+  readonly geometry: SliceGeometry;
+  readonly field: SliceField;
+  readonly path: string;
+  readonly from: number;
+  readonly to: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The T stage's output for the `blocks` field: the proto view of column (cx, cz) generated for the context, or null
+ * when `stop()` fired. The view must stay valid until the next call (the evaluation reads one column at a time).
+ */
+export type TColumnSource = (cx: number, cz: number, stop: () => boolean) => ColumnView | null;
+
+/**
+ * A part's values, each sample column's n samples in row order at (c − from)·n + k: Float64 values for `density` and
+ * `node`; u16 block states plus u8 fluid for `blocks`; u8 for `rule` (0, 1 or `SLICE_RULE_NA`).
+ */
+export type FieldSliceValues =
+  | { readonly field: 'density' | 'node'; readonly values: Float64Array<ArrayBuffer>; readonly fluid: null }
+  | { readonly field: 'blocks'; readonly values: Uint16Array<ArrayBuffer>; readonly fluid: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> }
+  | { readonly field: 'rule'; readonly values: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>; readonly fluid: null };
+
+/** A DensityReference with the way a horizontal plane samples its expression. */
+interface RefEntry {
+  readonly ref: DensityReference;
+  readonly sampling: HorizontalSampling;
+}
+
+const DENSITY_REFS = new WeakMap<GenContext, RefEntry>();
+const NODE_REFS = new WeakMap<GenContext, Map<string, RefEntry>>();
+/** Node paths whose DensityReference a context keeps (§5.1). */
+const NODE_LRU = 8;
+
+const entryOf = (expr: DensityExpr, ctx: GenContext): RefEntry => ({
+  ref: REFERENCE(expr, SURFACE_CONTEXT(ctx).density.noises),
+  sampling: horizontalSampling(expr),
+});
+
+function densityEntry(ctx: GenContext): RefEntry {
+  let e = DENSITY_REFS.get(ctx);
+  if (e === undefined) {
+    e = entryOf(SURFACE_CONTEXT(ctx).density.expr, ctx);
+    DENSITY_REFS.set(ctx, e);
+  }
+  return e;
+}
+
+function nodeEntry(ctx: GenContext, path: string): RefEntry {
+  let lru = NODE_REFS.get(ctx);
+  if (lru === undefined) {
+    lru = new Map<string, RefEntry>();
+    NODE_REFS.set(ctx, lru);
+  }
+  let e = lru.get(path);
+  if (e !== undefined) {
+    lru.delete(path);
+  } else {
+    e = entryOf(RESOLVE_NODE(ctx.params.density.defs, path, ctx.params), ctx);
+    if (lru.size >= NODE_LRU) lru.delete(lru.keys().next().value!);
+  }
+  lru.set(path, e);
+  return e;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The DensityReference of the `density` field (§5.3): the reference evaluator of the stage's own resolved tree,
+ * `surfaceContextOf(ctx).density.expr`, built once per GenContext (a WeakMap keyed by the context).
+ */
+export function densityReferenceOf(ctx: GenContext): DensityReference {
+  return densityEntry(ctx).ref;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The DensityReference of the `node` field at the density node `path` (§3.4, §5.1): the reference evaluator of
+ * `resolveDensityNode(ctx.params.density.defs, path, ctx.params)`, memoised per (GenContext, path) in an LRU of 8 paths.
+ * A path that names no node throws resolveDensityNode's RangeError.
+ */
+export function nodeReferenceOf(ctx: GenContext, path: string): DensityReference {
+  return nodeEntry(ctx, path).ref;
+}

+/**
+ * Why `field` at `path` has no slice or probe on `plane` in `ctx`, or null (the worker's BAD_ARGS, §5.1): `blocks` and
+ * `rule` exist on vertical planes only; `density` and `blocks` take the path ''; `node` a path naming a node of the
+ * source tree `density.defs` (own properties only); `rule` the id of a rule or condition of `surface.rules`.
+ */
+export function fieldSliceProblem(ctx: GenContext, field: SliceField, path: string, plane: SliceGeometry['plane']): string | null {
+  if ((field === 'blocks' || field === 'rule') && plane !== 'vertical') return `field ${field} has no ${plane} slice`;
+  switch (field) {
+    case 'density': case 'blocks':
+      return path === '' ? null : `field ${field} takes no node path (got ${JSON.stringify(path)})`;
+    case 'node':
+      try {
+        nodeEntry(ctx, path);
+        return null;
+      } catch (e) {
+        if (e instanceof RangeError) return `path ${JSON.stringify(path)} names no node of density.defs`;
+        throw e;
+      }
+    case 'rule':
+      return SURFACE_CONTEXT(ctx).reference.nodeAt(path) === undefined ? `path ${JSON.stringify(path)} names no rule or condition of surface.rules` : null;
+    default:

+  }
+}
+
+function requireProblemFree(problem: string | null, what: string): void {
+  if (problem !== null) throw new RangeError(`${what}: ${problem}`);
+}
+
+/** The `rule` field at the voxel (p, y) of a probe column: SLICE_RULE_NA off the solid voxels, else 0 or 1. */
+function ruleValue(sc: SurfaceContext, node: RuleNodeRef, id: string, c: SurfaceProbeColumn, p: number, y: number): number {
+  if (y < MIN_Y_ + 1 || c.solid[((y - MIN_Y_) << 8) | p] === 0) return RULE_NA;
+  if (node.kind === 'condition') return sc.reference.conditionHolds(id, c.scan, sc.settings, p, y) ? 1 : 0;
+  return sc.reference.evaluate(c.scan, sc.settings, p, y).path.includes(id) ? 1 : 0;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The samples [from, to) of `req` in `ctx` (§5.1), or null when `stop()` fired (polled once per sample). Throws a
+ * RangeError for a geometry with a problem (`sliceGeometryProblem`), a range that is not integers with
+ * 0 ≤ from < to ≤ n, a `fieldSliceProblem`, a vertical point outside the window, or `blocks` without `tColumns`.
+ * Vertical `density`/`node` samples read the ColumnCache's ColumnSample of each chunk column; horizontal ones corner
+ * samples memoised over this part (or full samples, `horizontalSampling`); `rule` the SurfaceContext's probe column, whose
+ * build polls `stop()` too (`surfaceProbeColumn`'s density fill).
+ */
+export function evaluateFieldSlice(ctx: GenContext, req: FieldSliceRequest, stop: () => boolean, tColumns?: TColumnSource): FieldSliceValues | null {
+  const g = req.geometry;
+  const { field, path, from, to } = req;
+  requireProblemFree(sliceGeometryProblem(g), 'fieldSlice');
+  const n = g.n;
+  if (!Number.isInteger(from) || !Number.isInteger(to) || from < 0 || from >= to || to > n) throw new RangeError(`fieldSlice: range [${from}, ${to}) is not inside [0, ${n})`);
+  requireProblemFree(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, field, path, g.plane), 'fieldSlice');

+  const xs = new Int32Array(n);

+    if (g.plane === 'vertical') ys[k] = sliceRowY(k, n);
+    else xs[k] = horizontalCoord(g.cx, g.extent, k, n);
+  }
+  const sc = SURFACE_CONTEXT(ctx);

+  if (field === 'density' || field === 'node') {
+    const { ref, sampling } = field === 'density' ? densityEntry(ctx) : nodeEntry(ctx, path);
+    const values = new Float64Array(size);
+    const columns = sc.density.columns;
+    if (g.plane === 'vertical') {
+      for (let c = from; c < to; c++) {
+        const [x, , z] = sliceSampleVoxel(g, c, 0);

+        const base = (c - from) * n;

+          if (stop()) return null;
+          const x = xs[k]!;
+          const s = sampler === null ? columns.get(x >> 4, z >> 4) : sampler.sample(x, z);

+  if (field === 'blocks') {

+    const fluid = new Uint8Array(size);

+      const [x, , z] = sliceSampleVoxel(g, c, 0);
+      const cx = x >> 4, cz = z >> 4;
+      const base = (c - from) * n;
+      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
+        if (stop()) return null;
+        if (view === null || view.cx !== cx || view.cz !== cz) {

+          if (view === null) return null;
+        }
+        values[base + k] = view.block(x & 15, ys[k]!, z & 15);

+      }
+    }

+  }

+  const node = sc.reference.nodeAt(path)!;
+  const values = new Uint8Array(size);
+  for (let c = from; c < to; c++) {
+    const [x, , z] = sliceSampleVoxel(g, c, 0);

+    const p = ((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15);
+    const base = (c - from) * n;

+      if (stop()) return null;
+      // The probe column's density fill polls stop() too: a column of a heavy valid tree takes about 0.1 s to build.
+      const col = PROBE_COLUMN(sc, cx, cz, stop);

+    }
+  }

+}
+
+/**
+ * The value of `field` at `path` at world voxel (x, y, z) (§5.3, the hover's `fieldProbe`): exactly the slice's
+ * sample there (density and node: the reference on the ColumnCache's ColumnSample; rule: 0, 1 or `SLICE_RULE_NA`), or
+ * null when `stop()` fired; polled before acquiring the column and before evaluating. Non-finite values are returned
+ * as they are. Throws a RangeError for non-integer coordinates, (x, z) outside the window, y outside −64 … 319, or a
+ * `fieldSliceProblem` (as on a vertical plane).
+ */
+export function probeField(ctx: GenContext, field: ProbeField, path: string, x: number, y: number, z: number, stop: () => boolean): number | null {
+  if (!Number.isInteger(x) || !Number.isInteger(z) || !IN_WINDOW(x, z)) throw new RangeError(`fieldProbe: (x, z) = (${x}, ${z}) is not an integer position in the world window`);
+  if (!Number.isInteger(y) || y < MIN_Y_ || y > MAX_Y_) throw new RangeError(`fieldProbe: y ${y} is not an integer in [${MIN_Y_}, ${MAX_Y_}]`);
+  if (field !== 'density' && field !== 'node' && field !== 'rule') throw new RangeError(`fieldProbe: unknown field ${JSON.stringify(field)}`);
+  requireProblemFree(fieldSliceProblem(ctx, field, path, 'vertical'), 'fieldProbe');
+  const sc = SURFACE_CONTEXT(ctx);
+  const cx = x >> 4, cz = z >> 4;
+  if (stop()) return null;
+  if (field === 'rule') {
+    const c = PROBE_COLUMN(sc, cx, cz, stop);
+    if (c === null || stop()) return null;
+    return ruleValue(sc, sc.reference.nodeAt(path)!, path, c, ((z & 15) << 4) | (x & 15), y);
+  }
+  const { ref } = field === 'density' ? densityEntry(ctx) : nodeEntry(ctx, path);
+  const s = sc.density.columns.get(cx, cz);
+  if (stop()) return null;
+  return ref.voxel(s, x, y, z);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// The work bound's column cost (§5.2)
+
+/** Every cost sum and product saturates here (2^31). */
+const COST_SATURATE = 2147483648;
+const satCost = (v: number): number => (v < COST_SATURATE ? v : COST_SATURATE);
+
+/**
+ * The evaluated expression of a density field (§5.2): `density` the resolved tree (`resolveDensity`), `node` §3.4's
+ * expression of the node at `path` (`resolveDensityNode`, wrapped in `interpolated` when it has an interpolated
+ * ancestor). Throws as the resolvers do (a path naming no node: RangeError).
+ */
+export function evaluatedExpression(params: Params, field: 'density' | 'node', path: string): DensityExpr {
+  return field === 'density' ? RESOLVE(params.density.defs, params) : RESOLVE_NODE(params.density.defs, path, params);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The work-bound cost of one sample column of a slice (§5.2): n × (c + perSample) + perColumn, saturating at 2^31.
+ * `density` / `node`: c = the evaluated expression's work cost (`workCost`); vertical perColumn `COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST`;
+ * horizontal perSample `CORNER_SAMPLE_COST`, `CORNER_STEEP_COST` when the expression reads `col steep`, or
+ * `COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST` when it takes full samples. `blocks`: perColumn one T column (`tColumnCost`); `rule`: the same
+ * plus n × the rule tree's node count. The UI passes it to the pool and the worker recomputes it from its configured
+ * params. Throws a RangeError for n ∉ SLICE_NS or `blocks` / `rule` on a horizontal plane, and as
+ * `evaluatedExpression` for a bad node path.
+ */
+export function sliceCostOf(params: Params, field: SliceField, path: string, plane: SliceGeometry['plane'], n: number): number {
+  checkN(n);
+  if (plane !== 'vertical' && plane !== 'horizontal') throw new RangeError(`sliceCostOf: unknown plane ${JSON.stringify(plane)}`);
+  switch (field) {
+    case 'density': case 'node': {
+      const e = evaluatedExpression(params, field, path);
+      const c = WORK_COST(e, params);
+      if (plane === 'vertical') return satCost(satCost(n * c) + COLUMN_COST);
+      const mode = horizontalSampling(e);
+      const per = mode === 'full' ? COLUMN_COST : mode === 'cornerSteep' ? STEEP_COST : CORNER_COST;
+      return satCost(n * (c + per));
+    }
+    case 'blocks': case 'rule': {
+      if (plane !== 'vertical') throw new RangeError(`sliceCostOf: field ${field} has no ${plane} slice`);
+      const t = T_COLUMN_COST(params);
+      return field === 'blocks' ? t : satCost(t + n * RULE_NODES(params.surface.rules));
+    }
+    default:
+      throw new RangeError(`sliceCostOf: unknown field ${JSON.stringify(field)}`);
+  }
+}
```

```bash
gen/inspect/fieldSlice.ts evaluates a range of sample columns of a vertical
or horizontal slice for the density, node, blocks and rule fields (SP3d spec
§3.4, §4.1, §5.1): density and node by the reference evaluator, with a

through an injected T-column source; rule masks through the surface probe's

sample and, for rule, inside the probe column's density fill (a stop
overload of surfaceProbeColumn), so a rule part on a heavy valid tree stops
within 50 ms. probeField evaluates one voxel exactly as a slice sample (§5.3).
sliceCostOf and evaluatedExpression give §5.2's column cost from params;
they live in fieldSlice.ts because cost.ts is imported by the density
source module whose resolvers they need.

gen/inspect/cost.ts gains the configured-weight density column cost, the
rule node count and the T column cost. The surface reference gains
nodeAt(id) and conditionHolds(id, scan, set, p, y). core/constants.ts holds
the acquisition costs (CORNER_STEEP_COST at its measured 5,120: 2^13 left a
steep-reading tree's 128² horizontal slice no room), the three budgets and
SLICE_RULE_NA.
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import { createWorkerPool, type WorkerLike } from '../../src/engine/workerPool';
import { COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST, PART_BUDGET } from '../../src/workers/protocol';
import { createTaskHandler } from '../../src/workers/taskHandler';

// Tier 2's column-cost bound keeps every valid tree's per-sample work cost far below PART_BUDGET (about 6.2 M units at
// most under `interpolated`), so the worker's bound (P3) is reached here by a work cost forced to PART_BUDGET.
const HEAVY = vi.hoisted(() => ({ on: false }));
vi.mock('../../src/gen/inspect/cost', async (importOriginal) => {
  const real = await importOriginal<typeof import('../../src/gen/inspect/cost')>();
  return { ...real, workCost: (...args: Parameters<typeof real.workCost>) => (HEAVY.on ? 8_388_608 : real.workCost(...args)) };
});

afterEach(() => { HEAVY.on = false; });

const configure = { type: 'configure', epoch: 3, seedText: '42', params: DEFAULTS, abort: null };
const probe = (field: string, path: string) => ({ type: 'fieldProbe', jobId: 5, epoch: 3, field, path, x: -1200, y: 90, z: 8 });
const slice = (field: string, path: string) => ({ type: 'fieldSlice', jobId: 9, epoch: 3, plane: 'vertical', ax: -1664, az: 8, bx: -640, bz: 8, y: 63, n: 32, field, path, from: 0, to: 1 });

describe('the worker refuses a probe or a part above PART_BUDGET (SP3d spec §5.2, §5.3, P3)', () => {
  test('fieldProbe of density or node: BAD_ARGS too heavy when work cost + COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST exceeds PART_BUDGET; rule is never refused', () => {
    const h = createTaskHandler();
    h.handle(configure);
    expect(h.handle(probe('density', '')).msg.type).toBe('fieldProbeResult');
    HEAVY.on = true;
    for (const [field, path] of [['density', ''], ['node', 'root.a']]) {
      expect(h.handle(probe(field!, path!)).msg).toEqual({ type: 'error', jobId: 5, epoch: 3, code: 'BAD_ARGS', message: `too heavy: 1 × ${PART_BUDGET + COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST} work units exceed the part budget ${PART_BUDGET}` });
      expect(h.handle(slice(field!, path!)).msg).toMatchObject({ type: 'error', code: 'BAD_ARGS', message: `too heavy: 1 × ${32 * PART_BUDGET + COLUMN_SAMPLE_COST} work units exceed the part budget ${PART_BUDGET}` });
    }
    expect(h.handle(probe('rule', 'root.rules[2]')).msg.type).toBe('fieldProbeResult');
    expect(h.handle(slice('rule', 'root.rules[2]')).msg.type).toBe('fieldSliceResult');
  });
  test('pool.fieldProbe rejects with the worker\'s BAD_ARGS', async () => {
    const h = createTaskHandler();
    const w: WorkerLike = { onmessage: null, postMessage(m) { setTimeout(() => w.onmessage?.({ data: h.handle(m).msg }), 0); }, terminate() {} };
    const pool = createWorkerPool(1, () => w);
    await pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    HEAVY.on = true;
    await expect(pool.fieldProbe({ field: 'node', path: 'root.a', x: 0, y: 70, z: 0 })).rejects.toThrow(/^BAD_ARGS: too heavy: /);
    pool.terminate();
  });
});
```

```ts
const pMsg = (field: string, path: string, x: number, y: number, z: number) => ({ type: 'fieldProbe', jobId: 5, epoch: 3, field, path, x, y, z });

const hGeom: SliceGeometry = { plane: 'horizontal', n: 32, cx: -1152, cz: 8, y: 100, extent: 2048 };
```

Create `test/unit/fieldSlicePool.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import type { GenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { evaluateFieldSlice, probeField, sliceCostOf, type FieldSliceValues, type SliceField, type SliceGeometry, type TColumnSource } from '../../src/gen/inspect/fieldSlice';
import { createWorkerPool, JobCancelled, SliceTooHeavy, type WorkerLike, type WorkerPool } from '../../src/engine/workerPool';
import { segmentPointAt, type Segment } from '../../src/metrics/crossSection';
import { fillColumnT } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { createStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { DRAFT_BUDGET, PART_BUDGET, planFieldSlice, REQUEST_BUDGET, type FieldSliceSpec, type ToWorker } from '../../src/workers/protocol';
import { createTaskHandler } from '../../src/workers/taskHandler';
import { ctxFor } from '../harness/gen';

const NEVER = (): boolean => false;
const MOUNTAIN: Segment = { ax: -1664, az: 8, bx: -640, bz: 8 };
const COAST: Segment = { ax: -27136, az: -31992, bx: -26113, bz: -31992 };

/** A worker running the real handler asynchronously; `edit` may rewrite its replies. */
function fakeWorker(log: ToWorker[], edit: (reply: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown = (r) => r): WorkerLike {
  const h = createTaskHandler();
  const w: WorkerLike = {
    onmessage: null,
    postMessage(msg) {
      log.push(msg);
      setTimeout(() => w.onmessage?.({ data: edit(h.handle(msg).msg as unknown as Record<string, unknown>) }), 0);
    },
    terminate() {},
  };
  return w;
}
/** A worker running the real handler that holds its fieldSlice messages until flush(). */
function heldWorker(log: ToWorker[], replies: unknown[]): WorkerLike & { flush(): void } {
  const h = createTaskHandler();
  const held: ToWorker[] = [];
  const answer = (msg: ToWorker) => {
    const data = h.handle(msg).msg;
    replies.push(data);
    setTimeout(() => w.onmessage?.({ data }), 0);
  };
  const w: WorkerLike & { flush(): void } = {
    onmessage: null,
    postMessage(msg) {
      log.push(msg);
      if (msg.type === 'fieldSlice') held.push(msg);
      else setTimeout(() => answer(msg), 0);
    },
    flush() { for (const m of held.splice(0)) answer(m); },
    terminate() {},
  };
  return w;
}
const settle = <T>(p: Promise<T>): Promise<T | Error> => p.catch((e: unknown) => (e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e))));
const partsOf = (log: readonly ToWorker[]) => log.flatMap((m) => (m.type === 'fieldSlice' ? [[m.from, m.to]] : []));
const bytes = (v: ArrayBufferView): Buffer => Buffer.from(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, v.byteLength);

function storeColumns(ctx: GenContext): TColumnSource {
  const store = createStore({ shared: false, maxBlockBytes: 32 << 20, maxByteBytes: 16 << 20 });
  return (cx, cz, stop) => (store.proto(cx, cz) === null && !fillColumnT(store, ctx, cx, cz, stop) ? null : store.proto(cx, cz));
}

const vReq = (s: Segment, field: SliceField, path = '', n = 32): FieldSliceSpec => ({ plane: 'vertical', ...s, y: 63, n, field, path });
const hReq = (field: SliceField, path = '', n = 32): FieldSliceSpec => ({ plane: 'horizontal', cx: -1152, cz: 8, y: 100, extent: 2048, n, field, path });
const geometryOf = (r: FieldSliceSpec): SliceGeometry => (r.plane === 'vertical'
  ? { plane: 'vertical', n: r.n, pointAt: (i) => segmentPointAt(r, i, r.n) }
  : { plane: 'horizontal', n: r.n, cx: r.cx, cz: r.cz, y: r.y, extent: r.extent });
const costOf = (r: FieldSliceSpec) => sliceCostOf(DEFAULTS, r.field, r.path, r.plane, r.n);

/** The whole slice evaluated in one piece in-process (the single-worker reference). */
const single = (r: FieldSliceSpec): FieldSliceValues => {
  const ctx = ctxFor('42');
  return evaluateFieldSlice(ctx, { geometry: geometryOf(r), field: r.field, path: r.path, from: 0, to: r.n }, NEVER, r.field === 'blocks' ? storeColumns(ctx) : undefined)!;
};

const REQUESTS: Array<[string, FieldSliceSpec]> = [
  ['vertical density', vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density')],
  ['vertical node', vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'node', 'root.a.a.x.x')],
  ['horizontal density', hReq('density')],
  ['horizontal node', hReq('node', 'root.a.b')],
  ['vertical blocks', vReq(COAST, 'blocks')],
  ['vertical rule', vReq(COAST, 'rule', 'root.rules[1].then')],
];

describe('pool.fieldSlice: split, merge and refusals (SP3d spec §5.1, §5.2)', () => {
  const wants = new Map(REQUESTS.map(([name, r]) => [name, single(r)]));

  test.each([[1], [2], [3], [6]])('pool.size %i: the merged slice of every field and plane is bit-identical to the single evaluation, split by planFieldSlice', async (size) => {
    const log: ToWorker[] = [];
    const pool = createWorkerPool(size, () => fakeWorker(log));
    await pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    for (const [name, req] of REQUESTS) {
      // The real column cost within the draft budget, then a client cost PART_BUDGET / 4 (over a budget that admits it)
      // that forces parts of 4 sample columns.
      for (const [columnCost, budget] of [[costOf(req), DRAFT_BUDGET], [req.field === 'density' || req.field === 'node' ? PART_BUDGET / 4 : null, 2 ** 40]] as const) {
        if (columnCost === null) continue;
        log.length = 0;
        const r = await pool.fieldSlice(req, { priority: 500, columnCost, budget }).promise;
        const want = wants.get(name)!;
        expect([r.n, r.field], name).toEqual([32, req.field]);
        expect(bytes(r.values).equals(bytes(want.values)), `${name} values, cost ${columnCost}`).toBe(true);
        expect(r.fluid === null ? null : bytes(r.fluid).equals(bytes(want.fluid!)), `${name} fluid`).toBe(want.fluid === null ? null : true);
        const plan = planFieldSlice(32, columnCost, size, req.field === 'blocks' || req.field === 'rule' ? null : budget);
        if (plan.refused) throw new Error('refused');
        expect(partsOf(log), name).toEqual(plan.ranges);
      }
    }
    pool.terminate();
  }, 120_000);
  test('a 128² vertical density slice at the defaults runs as 6 parts of at most k = 79 sample columns on 6 workers', async () => {
    const log: ToWorker[] = [];
    const pool = createWorkerPool(6, () => fakeWorker(log));
    await pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    const req = vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density', '', 128);
    const r = await pool.fieldSlice(req, { priority: 500, columnCost: costOf(req), budget: REQUEST_BUDGET }).promise;
    expect(partsOf(log)).toEqual([[0, 21], [21, 42], [42, 64], [64, 85], [85, 106], [106, 128]]);
    expect(bytes(r.values).equals(bytes(single(req).values))).toBe(true);
    pool.terminate();
  }, 60_000);
  test('the parts are one group at the given priority: a draft at 2 runs after preview tiles at distance 0 and 1, before 3', async () => {
    const order: string[] = [];
    const pool = createWorkerPool(1, () => {
      const w = fakeWorker([]);
      const post = w.postMessage.bind(w);
      w.postMessage = (m) => { if (m.type !== 'configure') order.push(m.type === 'mapTile' ? `tile ${m.tx}` : `${m.type} ${m.type === 'fieldSlice' ? m.from : ''}`); post(m); };
      return w;
    });
    const ready = pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    const req = vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density');
    const jobs = [pool.tile({ layer: 'C', level: 256, tx: 3, tz: 0 }, 3), pool.fieldSlice(req, { priority: 2, columnCost: PART_BUDGET / 16, budget: DRAFT_BUDGET }).promise,
      pool.tile({ layer: 'C', level: 256, tx: 0, tz: 0 }, 0), pool.tile({ layer: 'C', level: 256, tx: 1, tz: 0 }, 1)];
    await ready;
    await Promise.all(jobs);
    expect(order).toEqual(['tile 0', 'tile 1', 'fieldSlice 0', 'fieldSlice 16', 'tile 3']);
    pool.terminate();
  });
  test('a density or node request above its budget is refused before any job (SliceTooHeavy with the cost and the limit); blocks and rule never are', async () => {
    const log: ToWorker[] = [];
    const pool = createWorkerPool(2, () => fakeWorker(log));
    await pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    for (const [req, budget] of [[vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density', '', 128), REQUEST_BUDGET], [hReq('node', 'root.a.b'), DRAFT_BUDGET]] as const) {
      const limit = Math.floor(budget / req.n);
      const e = await settle(pool.fieldSlice(req, { priority: 500, columnCost: limit + 1, budget }).promise);
      expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(SliceTooHeavy);
      expect([(e as SliceTooHeavy).columnCost, (e as SliceTooHeavy).limit, (e as Error).message]).toEqual([limit + 1, limit, `too heavy: column cost ${limit + 1}, limit ${limit}`]);
    }
    expect([log.filter((m) => m.type === 'fieldSlice'), pool.queued]).toEqual([[], 0]);
    const r = await pool.fieldSlice(vReq(COAST, 'rule', 'root.rules[2]'), { priority: 500, columnCost: 2 ** 31, budget: 1 }).promise;
    expect(r.values.length).toBe(32 * 32);
    expect(partsOf(log).length).toBe(32);
    await expect(pool.fieldSlice(vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density'), { priority: 500, columnCost: 0, budget: DRAFT_BUDGET }).promise).rejects.toThrow(RangeError);
    pool.terminate();
  });
  test('the worker\'s bound check refuses a client column cost below its own (BAD_ARGS, too heavy), and a bad request rejects with its BAD_ARGS', async () => {
    const pool = createWorkerPool(1, () => fakeWorker([]));
    await pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    await expect(pool.fieldSlice(vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density', '', 128), { priority: 500, columnCost: 1, budget: REQUEST_BUDGET }).promise).rejects.toThrow(/^BAD_ARGS: too heavy: 128 × 105600/);
    await expect(pool.fieldSlice(vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'node', 'root.nope'), { priority: 500, columnCost: 1, budget: DRAFT_BUDGET }).promise).rejects.toThrow(/^BAD_ARGS: path "root.nope" names no node/);
    await expect(pool.fieldSlice(hReq('blocks'), { priority: 500, columnCost: 1, budget: DRAFT_BUDGET }).promise).rejects.toThrow(/^BAD_ARGS: field blocks has no horizontal slice/);
    pool.terminate();
  });
  test('cancel() drops the queued parts (JobCancelled); running parts finish and their results are discarded (P1); the pool goes on', async () => {
    const log: ToWorker[] = [];
    const replies: unknown[] = [];
    const held = [heldWorker(log, replies), heldWorker(log, replies)];
    let k = 0;
    const pool = createWorkerPool(2, () => held[k++]!);
    await pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    const req = vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density');
    // k = 8: four parts, two running and two queued.
    const h = pool.fieldSlice(req, { priority: 500, columnCost: PART_BUDGET / 8, budget: 2 ** 40 });
    const got = settle(h.promise);
    expect([pool.probe().busy, pool.queued, partsOf(log)]).toEqual([2, 2, [[0, 8], [8, 16]]]);
    h.cancel();

    expect(replies.map((r) => (r as { type: string }).type).filter((t) => t !== 'ready')).toEqual(['fieldSliceResult', 'fieldSliceResult']);
    expect([pool.probe().busy, partsOf(log).length]).toEqual([0, 2]);
    h.cancel();
    const next = pool.fieldSlice(req, { priority: 500, columnCost: costOf(req), budget: DRAFT_BUDGET });
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
    for (const w of held) w.flush();
    expect(bytes((await next.promise).values).equals(bytes(single(req).values))).toBe(true);
    pool.terminate();
  });
  test('each part reply is checked against its request (n, field, range); a reply failing its guard rejects with BAD_MESSAGE and frees the worker', async () => {
    const req = vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density');
    const tamper = (edit: (r: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown) => createWorkerPool(1, () => fakeWorker([], (r) => (r['type'] === 'fieldSliceResult' ? edit(r) : r)));
    const opts = { priority: 500, columnCost: PART_BUDGET / 16, budget: DRAFT_BUDGET };
    const relabelled = tamper((r) => ({ ...r, field: 'node' }));
    await relabelled.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    await expect(relabelled.fieldSlice(req, opts).promise).rejects.toThrow(/^fieldSlice part: n 32, field node, samples \[0, 16\); expected n 32, field density, samples \[0, 16\)$/);
    const shifted = tamper((r) => ({ ...r, from: (r['from'] as number) + 16, to: (r['to'] as number) + 16 }));
    await shifted.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    await expect(shifted.fieldSlice(req, opts).promise).rejects.toThrow(/^fieldSlice part: n 32, field density, samples \[16, 32\)/);
    const log: ToWorker[] = [];
    const truncated = createWorkerPool(1, () => fakeWorker(log, (r) => (r['type'] === 'fieldSliceResult' ? { ...r, values: (r['values'] as ArrayBuffer).slice(8) } : r)));
    await truncated.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    await expect(truncated.fieldSlice(req, opts).promise).rejects.toThrow('BAD_MESSAGE: fieldSliceResult: values of 4088 bytes, expected 4096');
    // The second part was dropped with the group; the freed worker answers the next job.
    expect(partsOf(log)).toEqual([[0, 16]]);
    expect((await truncated.point(1, 2)).z).toBe(2);
    for (const p of [relabelled, shifted, truncated]) p.terminate();
  });
});

describe('pool.fieldProbe (SP3d spec §5.3)', () => {
  test('one job at the point priority (−1) by default, resolving with probeField; BAD_ARGS rejects; non-finite values are returned', async () => {
    const log: ToWorker[] = [];
    const pool: WorkerPool = createWorkerPool(2, () => fakeWorker(log));
    await pool.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    const ctx = ctxFor('42');
    for (const [field, path, x, y, z] of [['density', '', -1200, 90, 8], ['node', 'root.a.a.x.x', -1200, 90, 8], ['rule', 'root.rules[2]', -1200, -40, 8], ['rule', 'root', -1200, 300, 8]] as const) {
      expect(await pool.fieldProbe({ field, path, x, y, z })).toBe(probeField(ctx, field, path, x, y, z, NEVER));
    }
    expect(log.filter((m) => m.type === 'fieldProbe').map((m) => (m as { field: string }).field)).toEqual(['density', 'node', 'rule', 'rule']);
    await expect(pool.fieldProbe({ field: 'density', path: '', x: 0.5, y: 70, z: 0 })).rejects.toThrow(/^BAD_ARGS: /);
    const order: string[] = [];
    const one = createWorkerPool(1, () => {
      const w = fakeWorker([], (r) => (r['type'] === 'fieldProbeResult' ? { ...r, value: [Number.NaN, Infinity, -Infinity][order.filter((o) => o === 'fieldProbe').length - 1] } : r));
      const post = w.postMessage.bind(w);
      w.postMessage = (m) => { if (m.type !== 'configure') order.push(m.type === 'mapTile' ? 'tile' : m.type); post(m); };
      return w;
    });
    const ready = one.configure('42', DEFAULTS);
    const tile = one.tile({ layer: 'C', level: 256, tx: 0, tz: 0 }, 0);
    const probes = [one.fieldProbe({ field: 'density', path: '', x: 0, y: 70, z: 0 }), one.fieldProbe({ field: 'density', path: '', x: 1, y: 70, z: 0 }, 5), one.fieldProbe({ field: 'node', path: 'root.a', x: 2, y: 70, z: 0 }, 6)];
    await ready;
    await tile;
    expect((await Promise.all(probes)).map(String)).toEqual(['NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity']);
    expect(order).toEqual(['fieldProbe', 'tile', 'fieldProbe', 'fieldProbe']);
    const idle = createWorkerPool(1, () => ({ onmessage: null, postMessage() {}, terminate() {} }));
    void settle(idle.fieldProbe({ field: 'density', path: '', x: 0, y: 70, z: 0 }));
    void settle(idle.fieldSlice(vReq(MOUNTAIN, 'density'), { priority: 500, columnCost: 1, budget: DRAFT_BUDGET }).promise);
    expect(idle.probe().jobs).toEqual([{ worker: 0, type: 'fieldProbe', epoch: -1, level: null }]);
    for (const p of [pool, one, idle]) p.terminate();
  });
});
```

```ts
const V = { type: 'fieldSlice', jobId: 1, epoch: 2, plane: 'vertical', ax: -1664, az: 8, bx: -640, bz: 8, y: 63, n: 128, field: 'density', path: '', from: 0, to: 64 };
const H = { type: 'fieldSlice', jobId: 1, epoch: 2, plane: 'horizontal', cx: 0, cz: 0, y: 63, extent: 2048, n: 32, field: 'node', path: 'root.a', from: 3, to: 9 };
const P = { type: 'fieldProbe', jobId: 4, epoch: 2, field: 'rule', path: 'root.rules[2]', x: 5, y: 63, z: -9 };
const without = (m: Record<string, unknown>, k: string) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(m).filter(([key]) => key !== k));

describe('fieldSlice and fieldProbe messages: parseToWorker checks the shape only (SP3d spec §5.1, §5.3)', () => {
  test('both planes and the probe parse; values the handler refuses (n, window, y, extent, range, path) still parse', () => {
    for (const m of [V, H, P, { ...V, n: 64, ax: 9e9, y: 1000, from: -3, to: 1.5, path: 'nope' }, { ...H, extent: 300, cx: 0.5, field: 'blocks' }, { ...P, x: Number.NaN, field: 'density', path: '' }]) {
      expect(parseToWorker(m), JSON.stringify(m)).not.toBeNull();
    }
    expect(parseToWorker({ ...V, path: 'x'.repeat(512) })).not.toBeNull();
  });
  test('the plane\'s keys must be present and the other plane\'s absent; y is required on both planes', () => {
    for (const k of ['ax', 'az', 'bx', 'bz', 'y', 'n', 'from', 'to', 'path', 'field', 'jobId', 'epoch']) expect(parseToWorker(without(V, k)), `vertical without ${k}`).toBeNull();
    for (const k of ['cx', 'cz', 'y', 'extent', 'n', 'from', 'to', 'path', 'field']) expect(parseToWorker(without(H, k)), `horizontal without ${k}`).toBeNull();
    for (const k of ['cx', 'cz', 'extent']) expect(parseToWorker({ ...V, [k]: 0 }), `vertical with ${k}`).toBeNull();
    for (const k of ['ax', 'az', 'bx', 'bz']) expect(parseToWorker({ ...H, [k]: 0 }), `horizontal with ${k}`).toBeNull();
    expect(parseToWorker({ ...V, cx: undefined })).toBeNull();
  });
  test('types: integer jobId and epoch, numeric coordinates, a known plane and field, a path string of at most 512 characters', () => {
    for (const m of [
      { ...V, jobId: 1.5 }, { ...V, epoch: null }, { ...V, plane: 'diagonal' }, { ...V, field: 'steep' }, { ...V, field: 'constructor' }, { ...V, path: 3 },
      { ...V, path: 'x'.repeat(513) }, { ...V, ax: '0' }, { ...V, y: null }, { ...V, n: '128' }, { ...V, from: undefined }, { ...H, extent: '2048' }, { ...H, cz: null },
    ]) expect(parseToWorker(m), JSON.stringify(m).slice(0, 120)).toBeNull();
    for (const m of [{ ...P, field: 'blocks' }, { ...P, path: null }, { ...P, path: 'x'.repeat(513) }, { ...P, x: '1' }, without(P, 'z'), { ...P, jobId: 'a' }]) {
      expect(parseToWorker(m), JSON.stringify(m).slice(0, 120)).toBeNull();

});

describe('fieldSliceResult and fieldProbeResult: parseFromWorker and the guard-failure outcome (SP3d spec §5.1, §5.3)', () => {
  const result = (field: string, n: number, from: number, to: number, values: unknown, fluid: unknown = null, jobId: unknown = 7) =>
    ({ type: 'fieldSliceResult', jobId, epoch: 2, n, field, from, to, values, fluid });
  const ok = (field: string, n: number, from: number, to: number) => {
    const b = fieldSliceBytes(n, field as never, to - from);
    return result(field, n, from, to, new ArrayBuffer(b.values), b.fluid === 0 ? null : new ArrayBuffer(b.fluid));
  };

  test('the exact byte lengths: Float64 for density and node, u16 states plus u8 fluid for blocks, u8 for rule', () => {
    expect([fieldSliceBytes(128, 'density', 3), fieldSliceBytes(32, 'node', 32), fieldSliceBytes(128, 'blocks', 1), fieldSliceBytes(32, 'rule', 5)])
      .toEqual([{ values: 3072, fluid: 0 }, { values: 8192, fluid: 0 }, { values: 256, fluid: 128 }, { values: 160, fluid: 0 }]);
    for (const field of ['density', 'node', 'blocks', 'rule']) {
      for (const [n, from, to] of [[128, 0, 128], [32, 31, 32], [128, 79, 100]] as const) expect(parseFromWorker(ok(field, n, from, to)), `${field} ${n} [${from}, ${to})`).toMatchObject({ type: 'fieldSliceResult' });
    }
  });
  test('a readable envelope with a failing body is {bad, jobId, reason}: n, field, range and byte lengths', () => {
    const bad = (m: unknown) => parseFromWorker(m) as { bad?: boolean; jobId?: number; reason?: string } | null;
    const f64 = (k: number) => new ArrayBuffer(8 * k);
    for (const m of [
      result('density', 64, 0, 64, f64(64 * 64)), result('density', 128, 0, 129, f64(128 * 129)), result('density', 128, 5, 5, f64(0)), result('density', 128, 1.5, 3, f64(128)),
      result('steep', 32, 0, 1, f64(32)), result('density', 32, 0, 1, f64(31)), result('density', 32, 0, 1, new Float64Array(32)), result('density', 32, 0, 1, f64(32), new ArrayBuffer(32)),
      result('blocks', 32, 0, 1, new ArrayBuffer(64), null), result('blocks', 32, 0, 1, new ArrayBuffer(64), new ArrayBuffer(31)), result('blocks', 32, 0, 1, new ArrayBuffer(32), new ArrayBuffer(32)),
      result('rule', 32, 0, 2, new ArrayBuffer(63)), result('node', 32, 0, 1, f64(32), new ArrayBuffer(0)), { ...ok('rule', 32, 0, 1), epoch: null },
    ]) {
      const r = bad(m);
      expect(r, JSON.stringify(m)).toMatchObject({ bad: true, jobId: 7 });
      expect(typeof r!.reason).toBe('string');
      expect(r!.reason!.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
    expect(bad(result('density', 64, 0, 64, f64(64 * 64)))!.reason).toMatch(/^fieldSliceResult: n 64/);
    expect(bad(result('density', 32, 0, 1, f64(31)))!.reason).toBe('fieldSliceResult: values of 248 bytes, expected 256');
    // Without a readable jobId the reply is not a job's: null, as before.
    expect(parseFromWorker(result('density', 64, 0, 64, f64(64 * 64), null, 1.5))).toBeNull();
    expect(parseFromWorker(result('density', 32, 0, 1, f64(32), null, null))).toBeNull();
  });
  test('fieldProbeResult accepts any number, NaN and ±∞ included', () => {
    for (const value of [0, -1.5e300, Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY, SLICE_RULE_NA]) {
      const r = parseFromWorker({ type: 'fieldProbeResult', jobId: 3, epoch: 1, value });
      expect(r).toMatchObject({ type: 'fieldProbeResult', jobId: 3, epoch: 1 });
      expect(Object.is((r as { value: number }).value, value)).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const value of ['1', null, undefined, 1n]) expect(parseFromWorker({ type: 'fieldProbeResult', jobId: 3, epoch: 1, value })).toMatchObject({ bad: true, jobId: 3 });
  });
  test('every job reply with a readable jobId fails as {bad} rather than null, so the pool can free the worker', () => {
    const cases: Array<[unknown, RegExp]> = [
      [{ type: 'tile', jobId: 1, epoch: 0, rgba: new ArrayBuffer(10) }, /^tile: /],
      [{ type: 'pointResult', jobId: 1, epoch: 0, fields: null }, /^pointResult: /],
      [{ type: 'spawnResult', jobId: 1, epoch: 0 }, /^spawnResult: /],
      [{ type: 'statsResult', jobId: 1, epoch: 0, kind: 'nope', data: new ArrayBuffer(8) }, /^statsResult: /],
      [{ type: 'sliceResult', jobId: 1, epoch: 0, from: 0, to: 512, blocks: new ArrayBuffer(1), fluid: new ArrayBuffer(1) }, /^sliceResult: /],
      [{ type: 'surfaceProbeResult', jobId: 1, epoch: 0, state: -1, path: [] }, /^surfaceProbeResult: /],
      [{ type: 'selftestResult', jobId: 1, key: 3, actual: null, error: null }, /^selftestResult: /],
      [{ type: 'error', jobId: 1, epoch: 0, code: 5, message: 'x' }, /^error: /],
    ];
    for (const [m, reason] of cases) {
      const r = parseFromWorker(m) as { bad?: boolean; jobId?: number; reason?: string } | null;
      expect(r, JSON.stringify(m)).toMatchObject({ bad: true, jobId: 1 });
      expect(r!.reason).toMatch(reason);
    }
    for (const m of [{ type: 'ready', epoch: 'x' }, { type: 'nope', jobId: 1 }, 'x', null, { type: 'tile', jobId: '1' }, { type: 'error', jobId: null, epoch: 1.5, code: 'X', message: 'x' }]) expect(parseFromWorker(m)).toBeNull();
```
