Create `src/ui/inspector/editorModel.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The Density tab's JSON editor model (SP3d spec §3.5, §1.8 "in the editors", D18): one per tree leaf, pure, with an
 * injected clock and session. It holds the buffer and decides when it is clean (equal to the print of the session's
 * current tree), validates as you type after a 150 ms debounce without applying (parse, then tier 1 `checkJson` and
 * tier 2 `validateParamTrees`, the functions the session runs), lists the issues as `<node path>: CODE — message` (at
 * most 50 lines and an "N more" line), refuses a buffer over 512 KiB ("too large to validate"), and implements Apply
 * (one `session.set(<leaf>, tree)`; an invalid tree is never sent), Reset (`session.reset(<leaf>)`) and Escape (revert
 * the buffer). The dirty-buffer rule: when the leaf's value changes from elsewhere (undo, a form edit, a preset load) a
 * clean buffer is re-printed and a dirty one is kept with `stale` set ("Revert to the current tree"); other leaves
 * never touch it. Every re-print restores the caret and the scroll anchor on the same node path. `jsonEditor.ts`
 * binds it to the DOM.
 */
import { checkJson, type JsonFormat, type JsonValue } from '../../core/params/json';
import type { Issue } from '../../core/params/kit';
import type { Params } from '../../core/params/schema';
import type { SessionResult } from '../../engine/session';
import { validateParamTrees } from '../../gen/trees';
import { nodeAt, parseTree, printTree, type SyntaxIssue, type TreeRanges } from './jsonText';

/** The two tree leaves (§1.2). */
export type TreeLeaf = 'density.defs' | 'surface.rules';
export const TREE_LEAVES: readonly TreeLeaf[] = Object.freeze(['density.defs', 'surface.rules']);

/** A buffer longer than this (UTF-16 units, 512 KiB) is not parsed (§3.5). */
export const EDITOR_TEXT_MAX = 512 * 1024;
/** Issue lines shown before one "N more" line (§3.5). */
export const EDITOR_ISSUE_LINES = 50;
/** Validation runs this long after the last keystroke (§3.5). */
export const EDITOR_DEBOUNCE_MS = 150;

export const TOO_LARGE_TEXT = 'too large to validate';

export function formatOfLeaf(leaf: TreeLeaf): JsonFormat {
  return leaf === 'density.defs' ? 'density' : 'surfaceRules';
}

/** The leaf's value in a params document. */
export function leafValue(params: Params, leaf: TreeLeaf): JsonValue {
  return leaf === 'density.defs' ? params.density.defs : params.surface.rules;
}

/** `params` with the leaf's value replaced by `value` (the other leaf and groups shared). */
function withLeaf(params: Params, leaf: TreeLeaf, value: JsonValue): Params {
  if (leaf === 'density.defs') return { ...params, density: { ...params.density, defs: value } };
  return { ...params, surface: { ...params.surface, rules: value } };
}

export interface EditorClock {
  setTimeout(fn: () => void, ms: number): number;
  clearTimeout(id: number): void;
}

/** The part of `WorldSession` the editor uses. */
export interface EditorSession {
  readonly state: { readonly params: Params };
  set(path: string, value: unknown): SessionResult;
  reset(path: string): SessionResult;
}

/**
 * `clean`: the buffer is the print of the session's tree; `pending`: typed, validation not run yet; `valid` / `invalid`:
 * validated (issues listed); `syntax`: does not parse; `tooLarge`: over EDITOR_TEXT_MAX, not parsed.
 */
export type EditorStatus = 'clean' | 'pending' | 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'syntax' | 'tooLarge';

/** An issue at a node path inside the leaf ('' is the value itself); `code` is a tier-1, tier-2 or session code. */
export interface EditorIssue {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly code: string;
  readonly message: string;
}

export interface EditorState {
  readonly leaf: TreeLeaf;
  readonly text: string;
  readonly clean: boolean;
  readonly status: EditorStatus;
  /** At most EDITOR_ISSUE_LINES, never a TOO_MANY_ISSUES entry (counted in `more`). */
  readonly issues: readonly EditorIssue[];
  /** Issues not listed (the validators' "N more" included). */
  readonly more: number;
  readonly syntax: SyntaxIssue | null;
  /** The ranges of `text` when it is clean or parses, else null (highlighting and caret → node, §3.2). */
  readonly ranges: TreeRanges | null;
  /** The leaf changed elsewhere while the buffer was dirty: offer "Revert to the current tree" (§3.5). */
  readonly stale: boolean;
  /** Caret and scroll anchor offsets in `text` (the DOM reports them; a re-print maps them by node path). */
  readonly caret: number;
  readonly scrollAnchor: number;
  /** Bumps whenever the model replaces the text itself (a re-print), so the DOM rewrites the textarea. */
  readonly revision: number;
}

export interface EditorModel {
  readonly state: EditorState;
  subscribe(listener: (s: EditorState) => void): () => void;
  /** Typed text (an `input` event) with the caret after it. */
  edit(text: string, caret: number): void;
  /** The caret moved or the text scrolled (`scrollAnchor`: the offset of the first visible line). */
  setCaret(caret: number, scrollAnchor?: number): void;
  /** Validates now if a validation is pending, then sends a valid dirty tree; false when nothing was applied. */
  apply(): boolean;
  /** The profile's tree (`session.reset`); false when the session refused. */
  reset(): boolean;
  /** Escape / "Revert to the current tree": the buffer becomes the session's tree, clean. */
  revert(): void;
  /** Call on every session notification: reacts only when this leaf's value changed (the dirty-buffer rule). */
  sessionChanged(): void;
  dispose(): void;
}

/** An issue path inside the leaf: the `<leaf>.` prefix removed, '' for the leaf itself; other paths unchanged. */
export function stripLeaf(path: string, leaf: TreeLeaf): string {
  if (path === leaf) return '';
  if (path.startsWith(`${leaf}.`)) return path.slice(leaf.length + 1);
  if (path.startsWith(`${leaf}[`)) return path.slice(leaf.length);
  return path;
}

/** `<node path>: CODE — message`; an issue at the value itself is shown at the leaf path. */
export function issueText(i: EditorIssue, leaf: TreeLeaf): string {
  return `${i.path === '' ? leaf : i.path}: ${i.code} — ${i.message}`;
}

/** The lines the editor lists: a syntax error or the size refusal alone, else the issues and "N more". */
export function issueLines(s: EditorState): string[] {
  if (s.status === 'tooLarge') return [TOO_LARGE_TEXT];
  if (s.syntax !== null) return [`line ${s.syntax.line}, column ${s.syntax.column}: ${s.syntax.message}`];
  const lines = s.issues.map((i) => issueText(i, s.leaf));
  if (s.more > 0) lines.push(`${s.more} more`);
  return lines;
}

/** Caps a validator's list at EDITOR_ISSUE_LINES; a TOO_MANY_ISSUES entry ("<n> more") adds its n to `more`. */
function capIssues(all: readonly EditorIssue[]): { issues: EditorIssue[]; more: number } {
  const issues: EditorIssue[] = [];
  let more = 0;
  for (const i of all) {
    if (i.code === 'TOO_MANY_ISSUES') {
      const m = /^(\d+) more$/.exec(i.message);
      more += m === null ? 1 : Number(m[1]);
    } else if (issues.length < EDITOR_ISSUE_LINES) issues.push(i);
    else more++;
  }
  return { issues, more };
}

/**
 * Maps `offset` from a text with `from` ranges to the same place in a text with `to` ranges: the innermost node holding
 * it, else its longest ancestor path that still names a node in `to` (the new text's root when none), the offset kept
 * at the same distance from that node's start (clamped to the node). Without `from` (a buffer that did not parse) the
 * offset is clamped to `length`.
 */
export function mapOffset(from: TreeRanges | null, offset: number, to: TreeRanges, length: number): number {
  const clamp = (v: number): number => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > length ? length : v);
  if (from === null) return clamp(offset);
  const path = nodeAt(from, offset);
  if (path === null) return clamp(offset);
  const toNodes = new Set(to.nodes);
  let p: string | null = path;
  while (p !== null && !toNodes.has(p)) {
    const cut = Math.max(p.lastIndexOf('.'), p.lastIndexOf('['));
    p = cut > 0 ? p.slice(0, cut) : null;
  }
  const target = p === null ? to.nodes[0] : p;
  if (target === undefined) return clamp(offset);
  const r = to.byPath.get(target)!;
  const delta = p === path ? offset - from.byPath.get(path)!.start : 0;
  return Math.min(r.start + Math.max(0, delta), r.end);
}

type Mutable = { -readonly [K in keyof EditorState]: EditorState[K] };

/** The editor model of `leaf` over `session`, starting clean on the session's tree. */
export function createEditorModel(leaf: TreeLeaf, session: EditorSession, clock: EditorClock): EditorModel {
  const format = formatOfLeaf(leaf);
  const listeners = new Set<(s: EditorState) => void>();
  let shown: JsonValue = leafValue(session.state.params, leaf);
  let printed = printTree(shown, format);
  /** The tier-1 clone of a `valid` buffer: what Apply sends. */
  let candidate: JsonValue | null = null;
  let timer: number | null = null;
  /** Set while Apply or Reset runs, so their own session notification is not "from elsewhere". */
  let busy = false;
  const s: Mutable = {
    leaf, text: printed.text, clean: true, status: 'clean', issues: [], more: 0, syntax: null, ranges: printed.ranges,
    stale: false, caret: 0, scrollAnchor: 0, revision: 0,
  };
  let snapshot: EditorState = Object.freeze({ ...s });
  const emit = (): void => {
    snapshot = Object.freeze({ ...s });
    for (const l of listeners) l(snapshot);
  };
  const cancel = (): void => {
    if (timer !== null) { clock.clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
  };
  const showIssues = (all: readonly EditorIssue[], status: EditorStatus): void => {
    const { issues, more } = capIssues(all);
    s.issues = issues;
    s.more = more;
    s.syntax = null;
    s.status = status;
  };
  /** The buffer equals the print of the session's tree. */
  const markClean = (): void => {
    cancel();
    candidate = null;
    s.clean = true;
    s.stale = false;
    s.status = 'clean';
    s.issues = [];
    s.more = 0;
    s.syntax = null;
    s.ranges = printed.ranges;
  };
  /** Replaces the buffer by the print of the session's current tree, caret and scroll kept on their node paths. */
  const reprint = (): void => {
    const old = s.ranges;
    shown = leafValue(session.state.params, leaf);
    printed = printTree(shown, format);
    s.caret = mapOffset(old, s.caret, printed.ranges, printed.text.length);
    s.scrollAnchor = mapOffset(old, s.scrollAnchor, printed.ranges, printed.text.length);
    s.text = printed.text;
    s.revision++;
    markClean();
  };
  const validate = (): void => {
    cancel();
    candidate = null;
    s.ranges = null;
    if (s.text.length > EDITOR_TEXT_MAX) {
      s.status = 'tooLarge';
      s.issues = [];
      s.more = 0;
      s.syntax = null;
      return;
    }
    const parsed = parseTree(s.text, format);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      s.status = 'syntax';
      s.issues = [];
      s.more = 0;
      s.syntax = parsed.error;
      return;
    }
    s.ranges = parsed.ranges;
    const tier1: Issue[] = [];
    const clone = checkJson(parsed.value, '', tier1, format);
    if (clone === undefined) { showIssues(tier1, 'invalid'); return; }
    const tier2 = validateParamTrees(withLeaf(session.state.params, leaf, clone))
      .filter((i) => i.path === leaf || i.path.startsWith(`${leaf}.`) || i.path.startsWith(`${leaf}[`))
      .map((i) => ({ path: stripLeaf(i.path, leaf), code: i.code, message: i.message }));
    if (tier2.length > 0) { showIssues(tier2, 'invalid'); return; }
    candidate = clone;
    showIssues([], 'valid');
  };
  const refused = (r: SessionResult): boolean => {
    if (r.ok) return false;
    showIssues(r.issues.map((i) => ({ path: stripLeaf(i.path, leaf), code: i.code, message: i.message })), 'invalid');
    return true;
  };

  return {
    get state() { return snapshot; },
    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
    },
    edit(text, caret) {
      s.text = text;
      s.caret = caret;
      if (text === printed.text) {
        markClean();
      } else {
        s.clean = false;
        s.status = 'pending';
        s.ranges = null;
        candidate = null;
        cancel();
        timer = clock.setTimeout(() => { timer = null; validate(); emit(); }, EDITOR_DEBOUNCE_MS);
      }
      emit();
    },
    setCaret(caret, scrollAnchor) {
      s.caret = caret;
      if (scrollAnchor !== undefined) s.scrollAnchor = scrollAnchor;
      emit();
    },
    apply() {
      if (s.clean) return false;
      if (s.status === 'pending') validate();
      if (candidate === null) { emit(); return false; }
      busy = true;
      let r: SessionResult;
      try { r = session.set(leaf, candidate); } finally { busy = false; }
      if (refused(r)) { emit(); return false; }
      reprint();
      emit();
      return true;
    },
    reset() {
      busy = true;
      let r: SessionResult;
      try { r = session.reset(leaf); } finally { busy = false; }
      if (refused(r)) { emit(); return false; }
      reprint();
      emit();
      return true;
    },
    revert() {
      reprint();
      emit();
    },
    sessionChanged() {
      if (busy) return;
      const v = leafValue(session.state.params, leaf);
      if (v === shown) return;
      if (s.clean) { reprint(); emit(); return; }
      shown = v;
      printed = printTree(shown, format);
      if (s.text === printed.text) markClean();
      else s.stale = true;
      emit();
    },
    dispose() {
      cancel();
      listeners.clear();
    },
  };
}
```

Create `src/ui/inspector/jsonText.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The Density tab's JSON printer and parser (SP3d spec §3.5, D18). `printTree` writes a tree for reading, not
 * canonically: two-space indentation; in each node `op` (or `kind`) first, then its scalar fields in their table order,
 * then its children in evaluation order (unknown keys last, sorted); the density value's `root` before `defs`, `defs`
 * keys sorted; a container with no node below it (a node without child nodes, a knot or biome array, a ref) on one
 * line; a −0 as `-0` (`String(-0)` is "0"), so a typed −0 reaches tier 1 as NEGATIVE_ZERO and print ∘ parse is the
 * identity on every JSON tree. `parseTree` is an iterative JSON parser (any nesting, no recursion) that returns the
 * value, the text range of every value path (to container depth 48, tier 1's bound) and syntax errors with their line
 * and column (`JSON.parse` gives no offsets); a duplicate key is a syntax error, and object keys are defined with
 * `Object.defineProperty` on a null-prototype object then normalised to a plain object, so a `"__proto__"` key reaches
 * tier 1 (BAD_KEY) instead of being dropped. The printer records the same ranges, so highlighting works on printed and
 * typed text alike. Paths are tier 1's (`treeKeyPath`): density `root…` / `defs.<name>…` under '', rules `root…`.
 * Pure; no DOM.
 */
import { TREE_LIMITS } from '../../core/constants';
import { treeKeyPath, type JsonFormat } from '../../core/params/json';
import { SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS } from '../../gen/density/source';
import { FIELDS } from '../../gen/surface/rules';

/** A half-open range [start, end) of UTF-16 offsets in a text. */
export interface TextRange {
  readonly start: number;
  readonly end: number;
}

export interface TreeRanges {
  /** Every value path (nodes, fields, array items, the value itself) to container depth 48 → its text, in text order. */
  readonly byPath: ReadonlyMap<string, TextRange>;
  /** The paths of the nodes (objects carrying the format's `op` / `kind` as a string), in text order. */
  readonly nodes: readonly string[];
}

export interface PrintedTree {
  readonly text: string;
  readonly ranges: TreeRanges;
}

export interface SyntaxIssue {
  readonly offset: number;
  /** 1-based. */
  readonly line: number;
  /** 1-based, in UTF-16 units. */
  readonly column: number;
  readonly message: string;
}

export type ParsedTree =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: unknown; readonly ranges: TreeRanges }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: SyntaxIssue };

/** The node path of the value itself: '' for density, `root` for rules (tier 1's, §1.2). */
export const topPathOf = (format: JsonFormat): string => (format === 'surfaceRules' ? 'root' : '');

const tagOf = (format: JsonFormat): string => (format === 'density' ? 'op' : 'kind');

/**
 * Density scalar fields in the order SP3b §1.1's table lists them (`const.v`, `col.field`, a noise `id`, a param `path`,
 * a tap or ref `name`, `lo`/`hi`, `knots`, a tap's `mute` after its name); one list serves every op, since no op has two of
 * them in a different order.
 */
const DENSITY_SCALARS: readonly string[] = ['v', 'field', 'id', 'path', 'name', 'lo', 'hi', 'knots', 'mute'];
/** The rule fields that hold rules or conditions; the other FIELDS are scalars. */
const RULE_CHILDREN: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['if', 'then', 'rules']);
/** A ref `{param, neg}` and any other non-node object: these keys first. */
const OTHER_FIRST: readonly string[] = ['param', 'neg'];
const DENSITY_TOP: readonly string[] = ['root', 'defs'];

function isRecord(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
}

function isNode(v: unknown, tag: string): boolean {
  return isRecord(v) && Object.hasOwn(v, tag) && typeof v[tag] === 'string';
}

/** `first` (those present, in that order), then the other keys sorted. */
function ordered(keys: readonly string[], first: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const own = new Set(keys);
  const out = first.filter((k) => own.has(k));
  const taken = new Set(out);
  return [...out, ...keys.filter((k) => !taken.has(k)).sort()];
}

/** The printing order of an object's keys (§3.5). */
function keyOrder(obj: Record<string, unknown>, path: string, format: JsonFormat): string[] {
  const keys = Object.keys(obj);
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  if (isNode(obj, tag)) {
    const kind = obj[tag] as string;
    if (format === 'density') {
      const children = Object.hasOwn(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, kind) ? (SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[kind]! : [];
      return ordered(keys, [tag, ...DENSITY_SCALARS, ...children]);
    }
    const fields = Object.hasOwn(FIELDS, kind) ? (FIELDS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[kind]! : [];
    return ordered(keys, [tag, ...fields.filter((f) => !RULE_CHILDREN.has(f)), ...fields.filter((f) => RULE_CHILDREN.has(f))]);
  }
  if (format === 'density' && path === '') return ordered(keys, DENSITY_TOP);
  if (format === 'density' && path === 'defs') return [...keys].sort();
  return ordered(keys, OTHER_FIRST);
}

/** `parent[i]`. */
const itemPath = (parent: string, i: number): string => `${parent}[${i}]`;

/** Prints `value` (a tree of either format) for the editor, with the range of every value path (§3.5). */
export function printTree(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat): PrintedTree {
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  // Containers with a node at or below them (memo, so shared subtrees are walked once).
  const holdsNode = new WeakMap<object, boolean>();
  const holds = (v: unknown, level: number): boolean => {
    if (typeof v !== 'object' || v === null) return false;
    const known = holdsNode.get(v);
    if (known !== undefined) return known;
    if (level + 1 > TREE_LIMITS.depth) throw new RangeError(`printTree: container depth above ${TREE_LIMITS.depth}`);
    let r = isNode(v, tag);
    const children = Array.isArray(v) ? v : Object.values(v);
    for (const c of children) if (holds(c, level + 1)) r = true;
    holdsNode.set(v, r);
    return r;
  };
  const below = (v: object, level: number): boolean => (Array.isArray(v) ? v : Object.values(v)).some((c) => holds(c, level + 1));

  let out = '';
  const byPath = new Map<string, TextRange>();
  const nodes: string[] = [];
  const write = (v: unknown, path: string, level: number, indent: string): void => {
    const start = out.length;
    // Reserve the entry so that byPath lists paths in text order.
    byPath.set(path, { start, end: start });
    switch (typeof v) {
      case 'number':
        if (!Number.isFinite(v)) throw new RangeError(`printTree: ${path || 'the value'} is ${String(v)}, not a JSON number`);
        out += Object.is(v, -0) ? '-0' : String(v);
        break;
      case 'string':
        out += JSON.stringify(v);
        break;
      case 'boolean':
        out += v ? 'true' : 'false';
        break;
      case 'object': {
        if (v === null) throw new RangeError(`printTree: ${path || 'the value'} is null`);
        if (level + 1 > TREE_LIMITS.depth) throw new RangeError(`printTree: container depth above ${TREE_LIMITS.depth}`);
        const arr = Array.isArray(v);
        if (!arr && isNode(v, tag)) nodes.push(path);
        const keys = arr ? null : keyOrder(v as Record<string, unknown>, path, format);
        const n = arr ? (v as unknown[]).length : keys!.length;
        const [open, close] = arr ? ['[', ']'] : ['{', '}'];
        if (n === 0) { out += open + close; break; }
        const multi = below(v, level);
        const inner = `${indent}  `;
        out += multi ? `${open}\n` : arr ? open : `${open} `;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          if (multi) out += inner;
          let childPath: string;
          let child: unknown;
          if (arr) { childPath = itemPath(path, i); child = (v as unknown[])[i]; }
          else {
            const k = keys![i]!;
            childPath = treeKeyPath(path, k);
            child = (v as Record<string, unknown>)[k];
            out += `${JSON.stringify(k)}: `;
          }
          write(child, childPath, level + 1, inner);
          if (i < n - 1) out += multi ? ',\n' : ', ';
        }
        out += multi ? `\n${indent}${close}` : arr ? close : ` ${close}`;
        break;
      }
      default:
        throw new RangeError(`printTree: ${path || 'the value'} is a ${typeof v}, not a JSON value`);
    }
    byPath.set(path, { start, end: out.length });
  };
  write(value, topPathOf(format), 0, '');
  return { text: out, ranges: { byPath, nodes } };
}

/** The 1-based line and column of `offset` in `text` (lines end at '\n'). */
export function lineColumn(text: string, offset: number): { line: number; column: number } {
  let line = 1;
  let lineStart = 0;
  for (let i = text.indexOf('\n'); i !== -1 && i < offset; i = text.indexOf('\n', i + 1)) { line++; lineStart = i + 1; }
  return { line, column: offset - lineStart + 1 };
}

const NUMBER_RE = /-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?/y;
const ESCAPES: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map([['"', '"'], ['\\', '\\'], ['/', '/'], ['b', '\b'], ['f', '\f'], ['n', '\n'], ['r', '\r'], ['t', '\t']]);
const HEX4 = /^[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}$/;

class ParseFailure {
  readonly offset: number;
  readonly message: string;
  constructor(offset: number, message: string) {
    this.offset = offset;
    this.message = message;
  }
}

interface Frame {
  readonly array: boolean;
  readonly value: unknown[] | Record<string, unknown>;
  readonly path: string;
  readonly level: number;
  readonly start: number;
  key: string;
}

/** What the next character is, for an error message (`end of text` past the end). */
function got(text: string, i: number): string {
  const c = text[i]!;
  return c < ' ' ? `got ${JSON.stringify(c)}` : `got '${c}'`;
}

/**
 * Parses `text` as one JSON value (§3.5): the value (objects plain, keys defined as own data properties), the range of
 * every value path to container depth 48 and the node paths, or the first syntax error with its offset, line and column.
 */
export function parseTree(text: string, format: JsonFormat): ParsedTree {
  try {
    return parse(text, format);
  } catch (e) {
    if (!(e instanceof ParseFailure)) throw e;
    return { ok: false, error: { offset: e.offset, ...lineColumn(text, e.offset), message: e.message } };
  }
}

function parse(text: string, format: JsonFormat): ParsedTree {
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  const n = text.length;
  const byPath = new Map<string, TextRange>();
  const nodes: { path: string; start: number }[] = [];
  const stack: Frame[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  let result: unknown;
  const fail = (at: number, message: string): never => { throw new ParseFailure(at, message); };
  const ws = (): void => {
    while (i < n) {
      const c = text.charCodeAt(i);
      if (c === 0x20 || c === 0x09 || c === 0x0a || c === 0x0d) i++;
      else break;
    }
  };
  const string = (): string => {
    const open = i;
    i++;
    let s = '';
    let from = i;
    for (;;) {
      if (i >= n) fail(open, 'unterminated string');
      const c = text.charCodeAt(i);
      if (c === 0x22) { s += text.slice(from, i); i++; return s; }
      if (c < 0x20) fail(i, 'control character in a string');
      if (c !== 0x5c) { i++; continue; }
      s += text.slice(from, i);
      const e = text[i + 1];
      if (e === 'u') {
        const hex = text.slice(i + 2, i + 6);
        if (!HEX4.test(hex)) fail(i, `bad escape \\u${hex}`);
        s += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(hex, 16));
        i += 6;
      } else {
        const r = e === undefined ? undefined : ESCAPES.get(e);
        if (r === undefined) fail(i, e === undefined ? 'unterminated string' : `bad escape \\${e}`);
        s += r;
        i += 2;
      }
      from = i;
    }
  };
  /** The path and level of the value about to be parsed. */
  const nextSlot = (): { path: string; level: number } => {
    const top = stack.at(-1);
    if (top === undefined) return { path: topPathOf(format), level: 0 };
    const level = top.level + 1;
    if (level > TREE_LIMITS.depth) return { path: '', level };
    return { path: top.array ? itemPath(top.path, top.value.length as number) : treeKeyPath(top.path, top.key), level };
  };
  /** Stores a finished value into its parent (or as the result) and records its range. */
  const place = (v: unknown, path: string, level: number, start: number): void => {
    if (level <= TREE_LIMITS.depth) byPath.set(path, { start, end: i });
    const top = stack.at(-1);
    if (top === undefined) result = v;
    else if (top.array) (top.value as unknown[]).push(v);
    else Object.defineProperty(top.value, top.key, { value: v, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true });
  };
  /** At a '"' inside an object: reads the key, refuses a duplicate, then the ':'. */
  const key = (f: Frame): void => {
    if (text[i] !== '"') fail(i, i < n ? `expected a string key, ${got(text, i)}` : 'unexpected end of text');
    const at = i;
    const k = string();
    if (Object.hasOwn(f.value, k)) fail(at, `duplicate key ${JSON.stringify(k)}`);
    f.key = k;
    ws();
    if (text[i] !== ':') fail(i, i < n ? `expected ':', ${got(text, i)}` : 'unexpected end of text');
    i++;
  };
  const close = (): void => {
    const f = stack.pop()!;
    i++;
    if (!f.array) {
      Object.setPrototypeOf(f.value, Object.prototype);
      if (f.level <= TREE_LIMITS.depth && isNode(f.value, tag)) nodes.push({ path: f.path, start: f.start });
    }
    place(f.value, f.path, f.level, f.start);
  };

  let expectValue = true;
  for (;;) {
    ws();
    if (expectValue) {
      if (i >= n) fail(i, 'unexpected end of text');
      const { path, level } = nextSlot();
      const start = i;
      const c = text[i]!;
      if (c === '{' || c === '[') {
        const array = c === '[';
        // A null-prototype object: no key can reach a setter; normalised when it closes.
        const f: Frame = { array, value: array ? [] : (Object.create(null) as Record<string, unknown>), path, level, start, key: '' };
        stack.push(f);
        i++;
        ws();
        if (text[i] === (array ? ']' : '}')) { close(); expectValue = false; continue; }
        if (!array) key(f);
        continue;
      }
      if (c === '"') { const s = string(); place(s, path, level, start); expectValue = false; continue; }
      if (c === '-' || (c >= '0' && c <= '9')) {
        NUMBER_RE.lastIndex = i;
        const m = NUMBER_RE.exec(text);
        if (m === null) fail(i, 'bad number');
        i += m![0].length;
        place(Number(m![0]), path, level, start);
        expectValue = false;
        continue;
      }
      const literal = text.startsWith('true', i) ? 'true' : text.startsWith('false', i) ? 'false' : text.startsWith('null', i) ? 'null' : null;
      if (literal === null) fail(i, `expected a value, ${got(text, i)}`);
      i += literal!.length;
      place(literal === 'true' ? true : literal === 'false' ? false : null, path, level, start);
      expectValue = false;
      continue;
    }
    const f = stack.at(-1);
    if (f === undefined) {
      if (i < n) fail(i, `unexpected text after the value, ${got(text, i)}`);
      break;
    }
    if (i >= n) fail(i, 'unexpected end of text');
    const c = text[i];
    if (c === ',') {
      i++;
      ws();
      if (!f.array) key(f);
      expectValue = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === (f.array ? ']' : '}')) { close(); continue; }
    fail(i, `expected ',' or '${f.array ? ']' : '}'}', ${got(text, i)}`);
  }
  nodes.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  // byPath in text order: containers were recorded when they closed, after their children.
  const sorted = new Map([...byPath].sort((a, b) => a[1].start - b[1].start || b[1].end - a[1].end));
  return { ok: true, value: result, ranges: { byPath: sorted, nodes: nodes.map((x) => x.path) } };
}

/** The innermost node whose range holds `offset` (start ≤ offset < end), or null outside every node. */
export function nodeAt(ranges: TreeRanges, offset: number): string | null {
  let best: string | null = null;
  let width = Infinity;
  for (const p of ranges.nodes) {
    const r = ranges.byPath.get(p)!;
    if (r.start <= offset && offset < r.end && r.end - r.start < width) { best = p; width = r.end - r.start; }
  }
  return best;
}

/** The range of `path`, else of its longest prefix (`.key` or `[i]` steps) that has one, else of the value itself. */
export function pathRange(ranges: TreeRanges, path: string): TextRange | undefined {
  let p = path;
  for (;;) {
    const r = ranges.byPath.get(p);
    if (r !== undefined) return r;
    const cut = Math.max(p.lastIndexOf('.'), p.lastIndexOf('['));
    if (cut <= 0) break;
    p = p.slice(0, cut);
  }
  return ranges.byPath.get('') ?? ranges.byPath.get('root');
}
```

- Ruling: one editor model per leaf (the DOM shows the selected root's model), so switching roots never loses or mixes a buffer; the page calls `sessionChanged()` on every session notification and the model reacts only when its leaf's object changed (identity: tier 1 and the session keep registered trees by reference) — cost if wrong: one `setLeaf` later.
- Ruling: "clean" = the buffer equals the print of the session's **current** tree: when the leaf changes elsewhere, a clean buffer is re-printed (`revision` bumps) and a dirty one is kept with `stale: true` while `printed` moves to the new tree, so typing the current tree back makes it clean (stale cleared) and Escape (`revert`) shows the current tree; Apply and Reset run with a `busy` guard so their own notification is not "from elsewhere", then re-print themselves — cost if wrong: one comparison.
- Ruling: Apply on a clean buffer is a no-op (`false`); Apply while the debounce is pending validates synchronously first; Apply sends the tier-1 clone (registered, so the session keeps it by identity and tier 2 is a memo hit); a session refusal lists the session's issues (leaf prefix stripped), keeps the buffer dirty and returns `false` — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: the editor validates the candidate as `validateParamTrees(params with the leaf replaced by the clone)` and keeps only the issues under its own leaf (the other tree is the session's, valid); tier 2 runs only when tier 1 passes; a syntax error, the size refusal and the issues are exclusive states (`issueLines` shows `line L, column C: <message>`, `too large to validate`, or the issues and `N more`) — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: issue display — `<node path>: CODE — message`, an issue at the value itself (node path '') shown at the leaf path (`density.defs: COLUMN_COST — …`, `surface.rules: …`), since '' would print as an empty label; the cap keeps the first 50 non-TOO_MANY_ISSUES issues and adds every hidden one plus each TOO_MANY_ISSUES entry's own count (parsed from its `<n> more` message, 1 if it does not parse) to one `N more` line, so 60 tier-1 issues show 50 lines + "10 more" — cost if wrong: test strings.
- Ruling: 512 KiB = 524,288 UTF-16 units of buffer text (Task 2's characters-for-bytes ruling); a buffer of exactly that length is parsed — cost if wrong: one comparison.
- Ruling: caret and scroll restore — `mapOffset` maps an offset to the innermost node of the old ranges, then to the same path in the new print (or its longest ancestor that still names a node; else the new root), keeping its distance from the node start (clamped to the node); a buffer without ranges (it did not parse) keeps the offset clamped to the new length. The DOM reports `scrollAnchor` as the offset of the first visible line and converts the mapped offset back to a line (Task 25) — cost if wrong: caret placement only.
- Ruling: printer layout — two-space indentation; a container is on one line exactly when no node lies below it (so leaf nodes, refs, knot and biome arrays, `{}`/`[]`), inline objects as `{ "k": v, … }` and arrays as `[a, b]`; key order: a node's tag, then its scalars (density: one global order `v, field, id, path, name, lo, hi, knots, mute` — SP3b §1.1's table, which no op contradicts — kept UI-local, not exported from gen; rules: `FIELDS[kind]` minus `if`/`then`/`rules`), then its children (density `SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS[op]`, rules `if`, `then`, `rules` in FIELDS order), then unknown keys sorted; density top `root`, `defs`, then others; `defs` keys sorted (code-unit order, as canonicalJSON); other objects (refs) `param`, `neg`, then sorted. No trailing newline — cost if wrong: display only (print ∘ parse identity is key-order-free).
- Ruling: ranges are recorded for **every value path** (fields and array items too, not only nodes) so an issue at a field (`root.lo`, `root.knots[2][0]`, `root.rules[1].then.if.min`) finds its exact text; `nodes` lists the node paths for caret → node. Paths are tier 1's: a key that fails TREE_KEY_RE is written `parent."<key>"` (JSON.stringify cut to 40) through the new `treeKeyPath`, which `checkJson` now also uses (behaviour-identical refactor of its two `childPath` calls), so `defs."__proto__"`'s BAD_KEY finds its range. The parser records ranges to level 48 only (deeper values are refused by tier 1 anyway), so a 100,000-deep array keeps 49 ranges, not 100,000 quadratic path strings — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: `parseTree` builds each object on `Object.create(null)` with `Object.defineProperty` and then `Object.setPrototypeOf(o, Object.prototype)` (spec §3.5 literally); a key is checked for duplicates with `Object.hasOwn` before it is defined; syntax messages: `unexpected end of text`, `expected a value, got 'c'`, `expected ',' or '}' / ']', got 'c'`, `expected a string key, got 'c'`, `expected ':', got 'c'`, `unterminated string` (at the opening quote), `control character in a string`, `bad escape \q`, `bad number`, `duplicate key "k"` (at the key's quote), `unexpected text after the value, got 'c'` — strict JSON (no comments, no trailing commas, `01` refused); numbers by `Number()` of the JSON number token, so `1e999` is Infinity for tier 1's NOT_FINITE and `-0` is −0 — cost if wrong: message strings.
- Ruling: `FIELDS` is exported deep-frozen (`Object.freeze` on the object and each list; `validateRules` reads the same object, unchanged behaviour) and still holds names only, so the gen numeric-data rule does not apply — cost if wrong: none.

```ts
/**
 * The Density tab's tree model (SP3d spec §3.2, §6 `inspectorModel.test.ts`): rows and summaries of both default trees,
 * the three-level initial expansion and "expand to selection", the 8 px × 12-level indentation cap, the key strings the
 * DOM re-renders on, the selection following the longest prefix that still names a node after undo and renumbering,
 * and the caret → node mapping (only on a clean or parsing buffer, only for paths of the session's tree).
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import type { Seed64 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import { countTreeNodes, type JsonValue } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import { WorldSession } from '../../src/engine/session';
import { validateParamTrees } from '../../src/gen/trees';
import { createEditorModel, type EditorClock } from '../../src/ui/inspector/editorModel';
import { printTree } from '../../src/ui/inspector/jsonText';
import {
  caretTarget, DEFAULT_SELECTION, expandToSelection, findNode, followNode, highlightRange, indentOf, INDENT_LEVELS,
  INDENT_PX, inspectorTree, isExpanded, NO_EXPANSION, nodePaths, toggleExpansion, type Expansion, type InspectorTree,
  type Selection, type TreeRow,
} from '../../src/ui/inspector/model';

const random = (): Seed64 => [5, 11];
const session = (): WorldSession => new WorldSession(random, { validateParams: validateParamTrees });

/** A clock whose timers run only when the test advances it. */
function fakeClock(): EditorClock & { advance(ms: number): void } {
  let now = 0;
  let next = 1;
  const timers = new Map<number, { at: number; fn: () => void }>();
  return {
    setTimeout(fn, ms) { const id = next++; timers.set(id, { at: now + ms, fn }); return id; },
    clearTimeout(id) { timers.delete(id); },
    advance(ms) {
      const end = now + ms;
      for (;;) {
        const due = [...timers].filter(([, t]) => t.at <= end).sort((a, b) => a[1].at - b[1].at)[0];
        if (due === undefined) break;
        timers.delete(due[0]);
        now = due[1].at;
        due[1].fn();
      }
      now = end;
    },
  };
}

const withDensity = (tree: unknown, base: Params = DEFAULTS): Params =>
  ({ ...base, density: { ...base.density, defs: tree as JsonValue } });
const withRules = (tree: unknown, base: Params = DEFAULTS): Params =>
  ({ ...base, surface: { ...base.surface, rules: tree as JsonValue } });

/** Every node expanded. */
function expandAll(params: Params): Expansion {
  let e: Expansion = NO_EXPANSION;
  for (const p of nodePaths(params.density.defs, 'density')) e = new Map([...e, [`density.defs|${p}`, true]]);
  for (const p of nodePaths(params.surface.rules, 'surfaceRules')) e = new Map([...e, [`surface.rules|${p}`, true]]);
  return e;
}

const rowsOf = (t: InspectorTree, leaf: 'density.defs' | 'surface.rules'): readonly TreeRow[] =>
  t.groups.find((g) => g.leaf === leaf)!.rows;
const brief = (r: TreeRow): string =>
  `${r.depth} ${r.path} | ${r.tail} | ${r.summary}${r.expandable ? (r.expanded ? ' [-]' : ' [+]') : ''}`;

/** The default density's path down to the `clampSigma` param (17 levels, §3.2). */
const PARAM_PATH = 'root.a.a.x.x.a.a.a.a.b.b.x.b.x.x.b.x';

describe('rows and summaries', () => {
  test('both default trees at the initial three-level expansion', () => {
    const t = inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, NO_EXPANSION, null);
    expect(t.groups.map((g) => [g.leaf, g.label])).toEqual([['density.defs', 'Density'], ['surface.rules', 'Surface rules']]);
    expect(rowsOf(t, 'density.defs').map(brief)).toEqual([
      '0 root | root | max [-]',
      '1 root.a | a | add [-]',
      '2 root.a.a | a | tap terrain [+]',
      '2 root.a.b | b | mul [+]',
      '1 root.b | b | tap islands [-]',
      '2 root.b.x | x | const -1000000',
    ]);
    expect(rowsOf(t, 'surface.rules').map(brief)).toEqual([
      '0 root | root | sequence 3 [-]',
      '1 root.rules[0] | rules[0] | if verticalGradient -64 … -59 → bedrock [-]',
      '2 root.rules[0].if | if | verticalGradient -64 … -59',
      '2 root.rules[0].then | then | block bedrock',
      '1 root.rules[1] | rules[1] | if skyOpen [-]',
      '2 root.rules[1].if | if | skyOpen',
      '2 root.rules[1].then | then | sequence 5 [+]',
      '1 root.rules[2] | rules[2] | if verticalGradient 0 … 8 → deepslate [-]',
      '2 root.rules[2].if | if | verticalGradient 0 … 8',
      '2 root.rules[2].then | then | block deepslate',
    ]);
    const root = rowsOf(t, 'density.defs')[0]!;
    expect([root.kind, root.title, root.leaf]).toEqual(['max', 'density.defs.root', 'density.defs']);
    expect(rowsOf(t, 'surface.rules')[1]!.title).toBe('surface.rules.root.rules[0]');
  });

  test('every node is a row when fully expanded, in pre-order, with the summaries of §3.2', () => {
    const t = inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, expandAll(DEFAULTS), null);
    const d = rowsOf(t, 'density.defs');
    const r = rowsOf(t, 'surface.rules');
    expect(d.length).toBe(countTreeNodes(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, 'density'));
    expect(r.length).toBe(countTreeNodes(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES, 'surfaceRules'));
    expect(d.map((x) => x.path)).toEqual(nodePaths(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, 'density'));
    const sum = new Map(d.map((x) => [x.path, x.summary]));
    expect(sum.get(PARAM_PATH)).toBe('param density.noises.jag.clampSigma = 3');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x.x.a.a.a.a.b.b.x.b.x.x.b')).toBe('recip');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x.x.a.a.a.a.b.b.x.b.x.x.a')).toBe('noise2 jag');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x.x.a.a.a.a.a')).toBe('col offset');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x.x.a.a.b.b')).toBe('slide 4 knots');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x.x.a.a.b.b.x')).toBe('noise overhang');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x.x.a.a.a.b')).toBe('neg');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x.x.a.a.a.b.x')).toBe('y');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.a.x')).toBe('interpolated');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.b.b.a')).toBe('param density.detailAmpLo = 0.6');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.b.b.b.b')).toBe('clamp 0 … 1');
    expect(sum.get('root.a.b.b.b.b.x.b')).toBe('const 0.5');
    const rules = new Map(r.map((x) => [x.path, x.summary]));
    const sky = 'root.rules[1].then.rules';
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[0]`)).toBe('if not');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[0].if.if`)).toBe('water 0');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[0].then`)).toBe('if stoneDepth floor 0+sd');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[0].then.then.rules[0]`)).toBe('if biome(warm_ocean, beach, …) → sand');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[0].then.then.rules[2].then.if`)).toBe('noiseThreshold patch surface.patchThreshold … 8');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[0].then.then.rules[5].then.if`)).toBe('water -2 runTop');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[0].then.then.rules[8]`)).toBe('block gravel');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[1].if`)).toBe('steep surface.cliffSteep');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[1].then.if`)).toBe('yAbove surface.cliffMinY runTop');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[2].then.if`)).toBe('temperatureBelow surface.snowline');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[3].then.rules[1]`)).toBe('if biome(badlands)');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[3].then.rules[1].then.rules[1]`)).toBe('bandlands');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[3].then.rules[6].then.rules[1].then.if`)).toBe('noiseThreshold patch -8 … −surface.patchThreshold');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[3].then.rules[7]`)).toBe('block dirt');
    expect(rules.get(`${sky}[4]`)).toBe('if stoneDepth floor 4+sd');
    // Conditions are rows of their rule: `.if` (and a `not`'s `.if.if`) before `.then`.
    const at = r.findIndex((x) => x.path === `${sky}[0]`);
    expect(r.slice(at, at + 4).map((x) => [x.path, x.depth])).toEqual([
      [`${sky}[0]`, 3], [`${sky}[0].if`, 4], [`${sky}[0].if.if`, 5], [`${sky}[0].then`, 4],
    ]);
  });

  test('defs after the root in key order; refs, mutes, dimmed subtrees and literal or ref fields', () => {
    const tree = {
      root: { op: 'add', a: { op: 'ref', name: 'base' }, b: { op: 'tap', name: 'terrain', mute: 0, x: { op: 'mul', a: { op: 'y' }, b: { op: 'ref', name: 'alpha' } } } },
      defs: {
        base: { op: 'clamp', x: { op: 'noise', id: 'detail' }, lo: { param: 'density.detailAmpLo', neg: true }, hi: 2.5 },
        alpha: { op: 'tap', name: 'k', mute: { param: 'density.detailAmpHi' }, x: { op: 'const', v: -0.25 } },
        constructor: { op: 'rangeChoice', x: { op: 'y' }, lo: 0, hi: 10, inside: { op: 'const', v: 1 }, outside: { op: 'const', v: 2 } },

    expect(rows.map((r) => `${r.depth} ${r.path} | ${r.tail} | ${r.summary}${r.muted ? ' M' : ''}${r.dimmed ? ' D' : ''}`)).toEqual([
      '0 root | root | add',
      '1 root.a | a | ref base',
      '1 root.b | b | tap terrain muted 0 M',
      '2 root.b.x | x | mul D',
      '3 root.b.x.a | a | y D',
      '3 root.b.x.b | b | ref alpha D',
      '0 defs.alpha | defs.alpha | tap k muted density.detailAmpHi M',
      '1 defs.alpha.x | x | const -0.25 D',
      '0 defs.base | defs.base | clamp −density.detailAmpLo … 2.5',
      '1 defs.base.x | x | noise detail',
      '0 defs.constructor | defs.constructor | rangeChoice 0 … 10',
      '1 defs.constructor.x | x | y',
      '1 defs.constructor.inside | inside | const 1',
      '1 defs.constructor.outside | outside | const 2',

    // A tap is the row that carries the mute toggle.
    expect(rows.filter((r) => r.tap).map((r) => r.path)).toEqual(['root.b', 'defs.alpha']);

  test('param rows read the session value, so a slider move changes their summary and the key', () => {
    const w = session();
    const sel: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.a.b.b.a' };
    const exp = expandToSelection(w.state.params, NO_EXPANSION, sel);
    const before = inspectorTree(w.state.params, exp, sel);
    expect(rowsOf(before, 'density.defs').find((r) => r.path === sel.path)!.summary).toBe('param density.detailAmpLo = 0.6');
    expect(w.set('density.detailAmpLo', 1.25).ok).toBe(true);
    const after = inspectorTree(w.state.params, exp, sel);
    expect(rowsOf(after, 'density.defs').find((r) => r.path === sel.path)!.summary).toBe('param density.detailAmpLo = 1.25');
    expect(after.key).not.toBe(before.key);
  });
});

describe('expansion, expand to selection and the indentation cap', () => {
  test('the initial expansion opens levels 0 and 1 (three levels shown); a toggle overrides it', () => {
    expect([0, 1, 2, 3].map((d) => isExpanded(NO_EXPANSION, 'density.defs', 'root', d))).toEqual([true, true, false, false]);
    let e = toggleExpansion(NO_EXPANSION, 'density.defs', 'root', 0);
    expect(rowsOf(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, e, null), 'density.defs').map((r) => r.path)).toEqual(['root']);
    expect(rowsOf(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, e, null), 'surface.rules')).toHaveLength(10);
    e = toggleExpansion(e, 'density.defs', 'root.a.a', 2);
    expect(rowsOf(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, e, null), 'density.defs').map((r) => r.path)).toEqual(['root']);
    e = toggleExpansion(e, 'density.defs', 'root', 0);
    expect(rowsOf(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, e, null), 'density.defs').map(brief).slice(0, 4)).toEqual([
      '0 root | root | max [-]',
      '1 root.a | a | add [-]',
      '2 root.a.a | a | tap terrain [-]',
      '3 root.a.a.x | x | interpolated [+]',
    ]);
    expect(NO_EXPANSION.size).toBe(0);
  });

  test('"Expand to selection" opens every ancestor of the selected node and nothing else', () => {
    const sel: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: PARAM_PATH };
    const e = expandToSelection(DEFAULTS, NO_EXPANSION, sel);
    const rows = rowsOf(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, e, sel), 'density.defs');
    const param = rows.find((r) => r.path === PARAM_PATH)!;
    expect(param.selected).toBe(true);
    expect(param.depth).toBe(16);
    expect(rows.filter((r) => r.selected)).toHaveLength(1);
    // The siblings along the way are shown, collapsed: 17 ancestors-or-self + their visible siblings.
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.path === 'root.a.a.x.x.b')!.expanded).toBe(false);
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.path === 'root.a.a.x.x.a.a.a.a.b.b.x.b.x.x.b')!.expanded).toBe(true);
    const rules: Selection = { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[1].then.rules[0].if.if' };
    const er = expandToSelection(DEFAULTS, NO_EXPANSION, rules);
    const rr = rowsOf(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, er, rules), 'surface.rules');
    expect(rr.find((r) => r.selected)!.path).toBe(rules.path);
    expect([...er.keys()].sort()).toEqual([
      'surface.rules|root.rules[1].then', 'surface.rules|root.rules[1].then.rules[0]', 'surface.rules|root.rules[1].then.rules[0].if',
    ]);
    // A selection that names no node changes nothing.
    expect(expandToSelection(DEFAULTS, er, { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[7]' })).toBe(er);
  });

  test('8 px per level, capped at 12 levels', () => {
    expect([INDENT_PX, INDENT_LEVELS]).toEqual([8, 12]);
    expect([0, 1, 11, 12, 13, 16, 40].map(indentOf)).toEqual([0, 8, 88, 96, 96, 96, 96]);
    const sel: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: PARAM_PATH };
    const rows = rowsOf(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, expandToSelection(DEFAULTS, NO_EXPANSION, sel), sel), 'density.defs');
    expect(rows.filter((r) => PARAM_PATH.startsWith(r.path)).map((r) => r.indent)).toEqual(
      [0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 96, 96, 96, 96],
    );
  });

  test('the key string changes exactly when a shown row or the selection changes', () => {
    const a = inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, NO_EXPANSION, null);
    const copy = withDensity(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE)));
    expect(inspectorTree(copy, NO_EXPANSION, null).key).toBe(a.key);
    // A change below the collapsed rows is not shown: same key.
    const deep = withDensity({ ...(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE as { root: object }), root: { op: 'max',
      a: { op: 'add', a: { op: 'tap', name: 'terrain', x: { op: 'y' } }, b: { op: 'mul', a: { op: 'y' }, b: { op: 'y' } } },
      b: { op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: { op: 'const', v: -1000000 } } } });
    expect(inspectorTree(deep, NO_EXPANSION, null).key).toBe(a.key);
    expect(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, NO_EXPANSION, DEFAULT_SELECTION).key).not.toBe(a.key);
    expect(inspectorTree(DEFAULTS, toggleExpansion(NO_EXPANSION, 'density.defs', 'root.a.a', 2), null).key).not.toBe(a.key);
    const islands = withDensity({ ...(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE as object), root: { ...(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE as { root: object }).root,
      b: { op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: { op: 'const', v: -10 } } } });
    expect(inspectorTree(islands, NO_EXPANSION, null).key).not.toBe(a.key);
    expect(rowsOf(inspectorTree(islands, NO_EXPANSION, null), 'density.defs').every((r) => r.key.length > 0)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('selection follows the longest prefix that still names a node', () => {
  test('after undo, redo and reset of the session', () => {
    const w = session();
    const edited = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE)) as { root: { b: unknown } };
    edited.root.b = { op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: { op: 'add', a: { op: 'const', v: 1 }, b: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'const', v: 2 } } } };
    expect(w.set('density.defs', edited).ok).toBe(true);
    const sel: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.b.x.b.x' };
    expect(followNode(w.state.params, sel)).toEqual(sel);
    expect(w.undo()).toBe(true);
    expect(followNode(w.state.params, sel)).toEqual({ leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.b.x' });
    expect(w.redo()).toBe(true);
    expect(followNode(w.state.params, sel)).toBe(sel);
    expect(w.reset('density.defs').ok).toBe(true);
    expect(followNode(w.state.params, sel)).toEqual({ leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.b.x' });
  });

  test('after a deletion that renumbers a sequence, and when a def disappears', () => {
    const rules = (n: number) => ({ kind: 'sequence', rules: [
      ...(n === 3 ? [{ kind: 'block', state: 'stone' }] : []),
      { kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'skyOpen' }, then: { kind: 'block', state: 'dirt' } },
      { kind: 'block', state: 'grass_block' },
    ] });
    const three = withRules(rules(3));
    const two = withRules(rules(2));
    const atThen: Selection = { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[1].then' };
    expect(followNode(three, atThen)).toBe(atThen);
    // rules[0] deleted: rules[1] is now the grass block, which has no `then`.
    expect(followNode(two, atThen)).toEqual({ leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[1]' });
    expect(followNode(two, { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[2]' })).toEqual({ leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root' });
    const withDef = withDensity({ root: { op: 'ref', name: 'd' }, defs: { d: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'y' } } } });
    const sel: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'defs.d.x' };
    expect(followNode(withDef, sel)).toBe(sel);
    expect(followNode(DEFAULTS, sel)).toEqual(DEFAULT_SELECTION);
    expect(DEFAULT_SELECTION).toEqual({ leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root' });
    // Paths that name no node of the format fall back to the tree's root.
    expect(followNode(DEFAULTS, { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.a.b.b.b.b.lo' })).toEqual({ leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.a.b.b.b.b' });
    expect(followNode(DEFAULTS, { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'defs' })).toEqual(DEFAULT_SELECTION);
    expect(followNode(DEFAULTS, { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'rules[0]' })).toEqual({ leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root' });
    expect(followNode(DEFAULTS, { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.constructor' })).toEqual(DEFAULT_SELECTION);
  });

  test('findNode reads own properties only', () => {
    expect(findNode(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, 'density', 'root.b')).toEqual({ op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: { op: 'const', v: -1000000 } });
    expect(findNode(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES, 'surfaceRules', 'root.rules[2].if')).toEqual({ kind: 'verticalGradient', trueAtAndBelow: 0, falseAtAndAbove: 8 });
    expect(findNode(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES, 'surfaceRules', 'root')).toBe(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES);
    for (const p of ['root.toString', 'defs.constructor', 'root.__proto__', 'root.a.knots', 'root.rules[3]', '']) {
      expect(findNode(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, 'density', p)).toBeUndefined();
    }
    expect(findNode(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES, 'surfaceRules', 'root.rules.length')).toBeUndefined();
    expect(findNode(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES, 'surfaceRules', 'root.rules[-1]')).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe('caret → node and selection → highlight', () => {
  const density = (text: string, at: string): number => text.indexOf(at);

  test('a clean buffer: the innermost node at the caret, selected when the session has it', () => {
    const w = session();
    const m = createEditorModel('density.defs', w, fakeClock());
    const { text, ranges } = printTree(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, 'density');
    const overhang = 'root.a.a.x.x.a.a.b.b.x';
    m.setCaret(ranges.byPath.get(overhang)!.start + 3);
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: overhang, select: { leaf: 'density.defs', path: overhang } });
    // On a field of a node: that node.
    m.setCaret(density(text, '"knots"'));
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params).select).toEqual({ leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.a.a.x.x.a.a.b.b' });
    // Outside every node (the value's own braces, the "defs" key): nothing.
    m.setCaret(0);
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: null, select: null });
    m.setCaret(density(text, '"defs"'));
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: null, select: null });
  });

  test('a typed buffer: nothing while it is pending or does not parse; buffer-only paths highlight without selecting', () => {
    const w = session();
    const clock = fakeClock();
    const m = createEditorModel('density.defs', w, clock);
    const base = m.state.text;
    const typed = base.replace('"defs": {}', '"defs": {\n    "extra": { "op": "neg", "x": { "op": "y" } }\n  }');
    expect(typed).not.toBe(base);
    const extra = typed.indexOf('"extra"') + 12;
    m.edit(typed, extra);
    expect(m.state.status).toBe('pending');
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: null, select: null });
    clock.advance(150);
    expect(m.state.ranges).not.toBeNull();
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: 'defs.extra', select: null });
    m.setCaret(typed.indexOf('"op": "y"', extra) + 2);
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: 'defs.extra.x', select: null });
    m.setCaret(typed.indexOf('"islands"'));
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: 'root.b', select: { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.b' } });
    // A syntax error: nothing, also after the debounce.
    m.edit(`${typed},`, 5);
    clock.advance(150);
    expect(m.state.status).toBe('syntax');
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: null, select: null });
  });

  test('the rules editor selects rule and condition paths', () => {
    const w = session();
    const m = createEditorModel('surface.rules', w, fakeClock());
    const at = m.state.text.indexOf('"kind": "skyOpen"');
    m.setCaret(at);
    expect(caretTarget(m.state, w.state.params)).toEqual({ highlight: 'root.rules[1].if', select: { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[1].if' } });
  });

  test('selecting a row highlights its range in the editor of its root', () => {
    const w = session();
    const m = createEditorModel('density.defs', w, fakeClock());
    const { ranges } = printTree(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, 'density');
    expect(highlightRange(m.state, { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.b' })).toEqual(ranges.byPath.get('root.b'));
    expect(highlightRange(m.state, { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root' })).toBeNull();
    expect(highlightRange(m.state, { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.zz' })).toBeNull();
    m.edit('{', 1);
    expect(highlightRange(m.state, { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.b' })).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

Create `src/ui/inspector/model.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The Density tab's tree model (SP3d spec §3.2, D18). Two roots, **Density** (`root`, then each def `defs.<name>` in key
 * order) and **Surface rules** (`root`), whose rows are built from the session's current values: a row is a node (an
 * object carrying the format's `op` / `kind`) with its path tail, its op or kind, a short summary (`const 0.5`,
 * `param density.detailAmpLo = 0.6`, `slide 4 knots`, `tap terrain`, `if biome(desert, beach, …) → sand`,
 * `if stoneDepth floor 0+sd`, `sequence 3`, …) and its full path as the title; a rule's conditions are rows of their
 * rule (`.if`, a `not`'s `.if.if`) before its `.then`. A tap row carries the mute toggle; a muted tap shows its value and
 * its subtree is dimmed. Expansion is three levels at first (levels 0 and 1 open) with explicit overrides, "Expand to
 * selection" opens the selected node's ancestors, and the indentation is 8 px per level capped at 12 levels. The DOM
 * re-renders only when a key string changes. The selection is (root, node path); after an undo, a reset or a renumbering
 * edit it follows the longest prefix of its path that still names a node (`followNode`). The JSON editor's caret selects
 * the innermost node holding it only while the buffer is clean or parses and only when the path exists in the session's
 * tree (a buffer-only path moves the editor's highlight, not the selection). Every lookup keyed by tree content reads
 * own properties only (`constructor`, `toString`, … are valid names). Pure; no DOM.
 */
import type { JsonFormat } from '../../core/params/json';
import type { Params } from '../../core/params/schema';
import { getPath } from '../../core/params/kit';
import { ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS, SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS } from '../../gen/density/source';
import { FIELDS } from '../../gen/surface/rules';
import { formatOfLeaf, leafValue, TREE_LEAVES, type EditorState, type TreeLeaf } from './editorModel';
import { nodeAt, topPathOf, type TextRange } from './jsonText';

/** A tree row's indentation per level and the level it stops growing at (§3.2: 17 levels deep would not fit 220 px). */
export const INDENT_PX = 8;
export const INDENT_LEVELS = 12;
/** Levels shown at first: nodes above this depth start expanded (the roots' rows are level 0). */
export const INITIAL_LEVELS = 3;

/** A selected node: its tree leaf and its node path inside the leaf (`root.a.x`, `defs.terrain`, `root.rules[1].if`). */
export interface Selection {
  readonly leaf: TreeLeaf;
  readonly path: string;
}

/** The tab's first selection: the density root. */
export const DEFAULT_SELECTION: Selection = Object.freeze({ leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root' });

/** Explicit expansion overrides by `expansionKey`; a node without one is expanded when its depth < INITIAL_LEVELS − 1. */
export type Expansion = ReadonlyMap<string, boolean>;
export const NO_EXPANSION: Expansion = new Map();

export interface TreeRow {
  readonly leaf: TreeLeaf;
  /** The node path inside the leaf. */
  readonly path: string;
  /** Levels below the row's tree root (`root` and each def are 0). */
  readonly depth: number;
  /** Left padding in px: INDENT_PX per level, capped at INDENT_LEVELS. */
  readonly indent: number;
  /** The path's last step (`x`, `rules[2]`, `if`), or `root` / `defs.<name>` for a tree root. */
  readonly tail: string;
  /** The node's op (density) or kind (rules). */
  readonly kind: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  /** The full path, as issues write it (`density.defs.root.a.x`). */
  readonly title: string;
  /** The node has child nodes. */
  readonly expandable: boolean;
  readonly expanded: boolean;
  readonly selected: boolean;
  /** A density tap: the row carries the mute toggle. */
  readonly tap: boolean;
  /** A tap with a mute. */
  readonly muted: boolean;
  /** Strictly inside a muted tap's subtree. */
  readonly dimmed: boolean;
  /** Everything the row shows, as a string. */
  readonly key: string;
}

export interface TreeGroup {
  readonly leaf: TreeLeaf;
  readonly label: string;
  /** The visible rows (the descendants of a collapsed row are left out), in pre-order. */
  readonly rows: readonly TreeRow[];
}

export interface InspectorTree {
  readonly groups: readonly TreeGroup[];
  /** Every row's key; the DOM re-renders when it changes. */
  readonly key: string;
}

const GROUP_LABELS: Readonly<Record<TreeLeaf, string>> = Object.freeze({ 'density.defs': 'Density', 'surface.rules': 'Surface rules' });
/** The rule fields that hold rules or conditions, in FIELDS order. */
const RULE_CHILDREN: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['if', 'then', 'rules']);
const NOISE_PREFIX = 'surface.noises.';
/** Biome names a summary lists before `…`. */
const SUMMARY_BIOMES = 2;

/** A node of either format: an object carrying `op` (density) or `kind` (rules) as a string. */
export type TreeNode = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

function isRecord(v: unknown): v is TreeNode {
  return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
}

const tagOf = (format: JsonFormat): string => (format === 'density' ? 'op' : 'kind');

function isNode(v: unknown, tag: string): v is TreeNode {
  return isRecord(v) && Object.hasOwn(v, tag) && typeof v[tag] === 'string';
}

/** An own property, or undefined. */
function own(r: TreeNode, k: string): unknown {
  return Object.hasOwn(r, k) ? r[k] : undefined;
}

export const expansionKey = (leaf: TreeLeaf, path: string): string => `${leaf}|${path}`;

export function indentOf(depth: number): number {
  return INDENT_PX * Math.min(depth, INDENT_LEVELS);
}

export function isExpanded(expansion: Expansion, leaf: TreeLeaf, path: string, depth: number): boolean {
  return expansion.get(expansionKey(leaf, path)) ?? depth < INITIAL_LEVELS - 1;
}

/** `expansion` with the node's expansion flipped. */
export function toggleExpansion(expansion: Expansion, leaf: TreeLeaf, path: string, depth: number): Expansion {
  const out = new Map(expansion);
  out.set(expansionKey(leaf, path), !isExpanded(expansion, leaf, path, depth));
  return out;
}

/** The child nodes of a node, as (path step, node) in evaluation order. */
function childNodes(node: TreeNode, path: string, format: JsonFormat): { path: string; node: TreeNode }[] {
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  const kind = node[tag] as string;
  const out: { path: string; node: TreeNode }[] = [];
  if (format === 'density') {
    const slots = Object.hasOwn(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, kind) ? (SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[kind]! : [];
    for (const k of slots) {
      const c = own(node, k);
      if (isNode(c, tag)) out.push({ path: `${path}.${k}`, node: c });
    }
    return out;
  }
  const fields = Object.hasOwn(FIELDS, kind) ? (FIELDS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[kind]! : [];
  for (const f of fields) {
    if (!RULE_CHILDREN.has(f)) continue;
    const c = own(node, f);
    if (Array.isArray(c)) c.forEach((item, i) => { if (isNode(item, tag)) out.push({ path: `${path}.${f}[${i}]`, node: item }); });
    else if (isNode(c, tag)) out.push({ path: `${path}.${f}`, node: c });
  }
  return out;
}

/** The tree roots of a leaf value: density `root` then each def in key order; rules the value itself at `root`. */
function treeRoots(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat): { path: string; node: TreeNode }[] {
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  if (format === 'surfaceRules') return isNode(value, tag) ? [{ path: 'root', node: value }] : [];
  if (!isRecord(value)) return [];
  const out: { path: string; node: TreeNode }[] = [];
  const root = own(value, 'root');
  if (isNode(root, tag)) out.push({ path: 'root', node: root });
  const defs = own(value, 'defs');
  if (isRecord(defs)) {
    for (const name of Object.keys(defs).sort()) {
      const d = defs[name];
      if (isNode(d, tag)) out.push({ path: `defs.${name}`, node: d });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Every node path of a leaf value in pre-order (the rows of a fully expanded tree). */
export function nodePaths(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const walk = (node: TreeNode, path: string): void => {
    out.push(path);
    for (const c of childNodes(node, path, format)) walk(c.node, c.path);
  };
  for (const r of treeRoots(value, format)) walk(r.node, r.path);
  return out;
}

/** The steps of a node path after the value's top path: `.key` and `[i]`; null when it does not parse. */
function pathSteps(path: string, format: JsonFormat): (string | number)[] | null {
  const top = topPathOf(format);
  let rest: string;
  if (top === '') rest = `.${path}`;
  else if (path === top) return [];
  else if (path.startsWith(`${top}.`) || path.startsWith(`${top}[`)) rest = path.slice(top.length);
  else return null;
  const steps: (string | number)[] = [];
  const re = /\.([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)|\[(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\]/y;
  let at = 0;
  while (at < rest.length) {
    re.lastIndex = at;
    const m = re.exec(rest);
    if (m === null) return null;
    steps.push(m[1] !== undefined ? m[1] : Number(m[2]));
    at = re.lastIndex;
  }
  return steps;
}

/** One own-property step (an array index below its length, an object's own key), or undefined. */
function step(v: unknown, s: string | number): unknown {
  if (typeof s === 'number') return Array.isArray(v) && s < v.length ? (v as unknown[])[s] : undefined;
  return isRecord(v) ? own(v, s) : undefined;
}

/** The node at `path` in a leaf value, or undefined when the path names no node (own properties only). */
export function findNode(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat, path: string): TreeNode | undefined {
  const steps = pathSteps(path, format);
  if (steps === null || (format === 'density' && steps.length === 0)) return undefined;
  let v: unknown = value;
  for (const s of steps) {
    v = step(v, s);
    if (v === undefined) return undefined;
  }
  return isNode(v, tagOf(format)) ? v : undefined;
}

/** The node paths from the value down to `path` (the node itself included), or null when `path` names no node. */
function nodeChain(value: unknown, format: JsonFormat, path: string): string[] | null {
  const steps = pathSteps(path, format);
  if (steps === null) return null;
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  const out: string[] = [];
  let v: unknown = value;
  let p = topPathOf(format);
  if (isNode(v, tag)) out.push(p);
  for (const s of steps) {
    v = step(v, s);
    if (v === undefined) return null;
    p = typeof s === 'number' ? `${p}[${s}]` : p === '' ? s : `${p}.${s}`;
    if (isNode(v, tag)) out.push(p);
  }
  return out.at(-1) === path ? out : null;
}

/**
 * The selection after the leaf's value changed (undo, redo, reset, load, an edit that renumbers siblings): the longest
 * prefix of its path that still names a node, else the tree's `root`. Returns `sel` itself when it still names a node.
 */
export function followNode(params: Params, sel: Selection): Selection {
  const format = formatOfLeaf(sel.leaf);
  const value = leafValue(params, sel.leaf);
  const steps = pathSteps(sel.path, format);
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  let best = 'root';
  if (steps !== null) {
    let v: unknown = value;
    let p = topPathOf(format);
    for (const s of steps) {
      v = step(v, s);
      if (v === undefined) break;
      p = typeof s === 'number' ? `${p}[${s}]` : p === '' ? s : `${p}.${s}`;
      if (isNode(v, tag)) best = p;
    }
  }
  if (best === sel.path) return sel;
  return { leaf: sel.leaf, path: best };
}

/** `expansion` with every ancestor of the selected node expanded (unchanged, the same object, when nothing changes). */
export function expandToSelection(params: Params, expansion: Expansion, sel: Selection): Expansion {
  const chain = nodeChain(leafValue(params, sel.leaf), formatOfLeaf(sel.leaf), sel.path);
  if (chain === null) return expansion;
  let out: Map<string, boolean> | null = null;
  // Depths: a tree root (`root`, `defs.<name>`) is 0; for density the value itself is not in the chain.
  chain.slice(0, -1).forEach((p, depth) => {
    if (isExpanded(expansion, sel.leaf, p, depth)) return;
    out ??= new Map(expansion);
    out.set(expansionKey(sel.leaf, p), true);
  });
  return out ?? expansion;
}

/** A number as it is written (−0 as `-0`). */
function num(v: number): string {
  return Object.is(v, -0) ? '-0' : String(v);
}

/** A numeric field: a literal, or a ref `{param, neg?}` written `path` / `−path`. */
function field(v: unknown): string {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return num(v);
  if (isRecord(v) && typeof own(v, 'param') === 'string') return `${own(v, 'neg') === true ? '−' : ''}${v['param'] as string}`;
  return '?';
}

/** A ref target's current value (`param density.detailAmpLo = 0.6`), read only for paths of ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS. */
function targetValue(params: Params, path: string): string {
  if (!ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.has(path)) return '';
  const v = getPath(params, path);
  return typeof v === 'number' ? ` = ${num(v)}` : '';
}

function densitySummary(node: TreeNode, params: Params): string {
  const op = node['op'] as string;
  switch (op) {
    case 'const': return `const ${field(own(node, 'v'))}`;
    case 'col': return `col ${String(own(node, 'field'))}`;
    case 'noise': case 'noise2': return `${op} ${String(own(node, 'id'))}`;
    case 'param': {
      const path = String(own(node, 'path'));
      return `param ${path}${targetValue(params, path)}`;
    }
    case 'clamp': case 'rangeChoice': return `${op} ${field(own(node, 'lo'))} … ${field(own(node, 'hi'))}`;
    case 'slide': {
      const knots = own(node, 'knots');
      const n = Array.isArray(knots) ? knots.length : 0;
      return `slide ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'knot' : 'knots'}`;
    }
    case 'tap': return `tap ${String(own(node, 'name'))}${Object.hasOwn(node, 'mute') ? ` muted ${field(node['mute'])}` : ''}`;
    case 'ref': return `ref ${String(own(node, 'name'))}`;
    default: return op;
  }
}

function conditionSummary(c: TreeNode): string {
  const kind = c['kind'] as string;
  const runTop = own(c, 'runTop') === true ? ' runTop' : '';
  switch (kind) {
    case 'biome': {
      const list = own(c, 'biomes');
      const names = Array.isArray(list) ? list.map(String) : [];
      const shown = names.slice(0, SUMMARY_BIOMES);
      if (names.length > SUMMARY_BIOMES) shown.push('…');
      return `biome(${shown.join(', ')})`;
    }
    case 'stoneDepth':
      return `stoneDepth ${String(own(c, 'side'))} ${field(own(c, 'offset'))}${own(c, 'addSurfaceDepth') === true ? '+sd' : ''}`;
    case 'water': return `water ${field(own(c, 'offset'))}${runTop}`;
    case 'yAbove': return `yAbove ${field(own(c, 'minY'))}${runTop}`;
    case 'verticalGradient': return `verticalGradient ${field(own(c, 'trueAtAndBelow'))} … ${field(own(c, 'falseAtAndAbove'))}`;
    case 'steep': return `steep ${field(own(c, 'min'))}`;
    case 'noiseThreshold': {
      const noise = String(own(c, 'noise'));
      const short = noise.startsWith(NOISE_PREFIX) ? noise.slice(NOISE_PREFIX.length) : noise;
      return `noiseThreshold ${short} ${field(own(c, 'min'))} … ${field(own(c, 'max'))}`;
    }
    case 'temperatureBelow': return `temperatureBelow ${field(own(c, 't'))}`;
    default: return kind;
  }
}

/** A rule's summary; `cond` tells a condition (a node under `.if`) from a rule. */
function rulesSummary(node: TreeNode, cond: boolean): string {
  if (cond) return conditionSummary(node);
  const kind = node['kind'] as string;
  switch (kind) {
    case 'sequence': {
      const rules = own(node, 'rules');
      return `sequence ${Array.isArray(rules) ? rules.length : 0}`;
    }
    case 'condition': {
      const c = own(node, 'if');
      const then = own(node, 'then');
      const head = `if ${isNode(c, 'kind') ? conditionSummary(c) : '?'}`;
      if (isNode(then, 'kind') && then['kind'] === 'block') return `${head} → ${String(own(then, 'state'))}`;
      if (isNode(then, 'kind') && then['kind'] === 'bandlands') return `${head} → bandlands`;
      return head;
    }
    case 'block': return `block ${String(own(node, 'state'))}`;
    default: return kind;
  }
}

/** The short text of a node (§3.2); `cond` marks a rules condition. */
export function nodeSummary(node: TreeNode, format: JsonFormat, params: Params, cond = false): string {
  return format === 'density' ? densitySummary(node, params) : rulesSummary(node, cond);
}

/** The path's last step, or the tree root's own name. */
function tailOf(path: string): string {
  if (path === 'root' || (path.startsWith('defs.') && path.indexOf('.', 5) === -1)) return path;
  return path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
}

function groupRows(params: Params, leaf: TreeLeaf, expansion: Expansion, selection: Selection | null): TreeRow[] {
  const format = formatOfLeaf(leaf);
  const tag = tagOf(format);
  const rows: TreeRow[] = [];
  const selected = selection !== null && selection.leaf === leaf ? selection.path : null;
  const walk = (node: TreeNode, path: string, depth: number, dimmed: boolean, cond: boolean): void => {
    const children = childNodes(node, path, format);
    const expandable = children.length > 0;
    const expanded = expandable && isExpanded(expansion, leaf, path, depth);
    const kind = node[tag] as string;
    const tap = format === 'density' && kind === 'tap';
    const muted = tap && Object.hasOwn(node, 'mute');
    const summary = nodeSummary(node, format, params, cond);
    const isSel = path === selected;
    const key = `${path}|${depth}|${expandable ? (expanded ? '-' : '+') : '.'}|${isSel ? 's' : ''}${muted ? 'm' : ''}${dimmed ? 'd' : ''}|${summary}`;
    rows.push({
      leaf, path, depth, indent: indentOf(depth), tail: tailOf(path), kind, summary, title: `${leaf}.${path}`,
      expandable, expanded, selected: isSel, tap, muted, dimmed, key,
    });
    if (!expanded) return;
    for (const c of children) walk(c.node, c.path, depth + 1, dimmed || muted, format === 'surfaceRules' && c.path.endsWith('.if'));
  };
  for (const r of treeRoots(leafValue(params, leaf), format)) walk(r.node, r.path, 0, false, false);
  return rows;
}

/** The tree's rows for both roots, from the session's current params (§3.2). */
export function inspectorTree(params: Params, expansion: Expansion, selection: Selection | null): InspectorTree {
  const groups = TREE_LEAVES.map((leaf) => ({ leaf, label: GROUP_LABELS[leaf], rows: groupRows(params, leaf, expansion, selection) }));
  const key = groups.map((g) => `${g.leaf}\n${g.rows.map((r) => r.key).join('\n')}`).join('\n\n');
  return { groups, key };
}

/** What a caret position in the editor does: the node it highlights and, for a path the session's tree has, the selection. */
export interface CaretTarget {
  readonly highlight: string | null;
  readonly select: Selection | null;
}

const NO_TARGET: CaretTarget = Object.freeze({ highlight: null, select: null });

/**
 * The innermost node holding the editor's caret, only while its buffer is clean or parses (`ranges` non-null: the
 * editor sets them after its 150 ms debounce); selected only when the session's tree has a node at that path.
 */
export function caretTarget(editor: Pick<EditorState, 'leaf' | 'ranges' | 'caret'>, params: Params): CaretTarget {
  if (editor.ranges === null) return NO_TARGET;
  const path = nodeAt(editor.ranges, editor.caret);
  if (path === null) return NO_TARGET;
  const inSession = findNode(leafValue(params, editor.leaf), formatOfLeaf(editor.leaf), path) !== undefined;
  return { highlight: path, select: inSession ? { leaf: editor.leaf, path } : null };
}

/** The text range of the selected node in the editor showing its root, or null (another root, no ranges, no such node). */
export function highlightRange(editor: Pick<EditorState, 'leaf' | 'ranges'>, sel: Selection): TextRange | null {
  if (editor.leaf !== sel.leaf || editor.ranges === null || !editor.ranges.nodes.includes(sel.path)) return null;
  return editor.ranges.byPath.get(sel.path) ?? null;
}
```
