```ts
/**
 * The Density tab's node form (SP3d spec §3.3, §1.5, D7; §6 `inspectorForm.test.ts`): every operation on hand-built
 * trees — replace op / kind with children kept by position in `SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS` order and the per-kind defaults, the
 * disabled options, wrap, delete (unwrap, `const 0`, a sequence child with the renumbering the selection follows, a
 * referenced def refused with `UNKNOWN_REF`), add def and add rule, rename def with its refs, knots sorted on commit —,
 * the mute toggle's neutral value per parent, ref ↔ literal on every numeric field (density scalar fields included) and
 * `neg`, int fields listing only int targets, the fields shown per node, the commit through a real session, and the
 * two lints.
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import type { Seed64 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import type { JsonValue } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import { WorldSession } from '../../src/engine/session';
import { ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS, SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, SOURCE_OPS } from '../../src/gen/density/source';
import { CONDITION_KINDS, RULE_KINDS } from '../../src/gen/surface/rules';
import { validateParamTrees } from '../../src/gen/trees';
import type { EditorSession, TreeLeaf } from '../../src/ui/inspector/editorModel';
import {
  addDef, addRule, BLOCK_STATE_OPTIONS, commitFormEdit, deleteNode, densityCostLint, formActions, formFields, LINT_NO_FAST_PATH,
  muteValue, opOptions, refOptions, renameDef, replaceOp, setField, setKnots, setNumber, toggleMute, treeLints, wrapNode,
  type FormEdit,
} from '../../src/ui/inspector/form';
import type { Selection } from '../../src/ui/inspector/model';

const random = (): Seed64 => [5, 11];
const session = (): WorldSession => new WorldSession(random, { validateParams: validateParamTrees });

const withDensity = (tree: unknown, base: Params = DEFAULTS): Params =>
  ({ ...base, density: { ...base.density, defs: tree as JsonValue } });
const withRules = (tree: unknown, base: Params = DEFAULTS): Params =>
  ({ ...base, surface: { ...base.surface, rules: tree as JsonValue } });
const D = (path: string): Selection => ({ leaf: 'density.defs', path });
const R = (path: string): Selection => ({ leaf: 'surface.rules', path });

/** The candidate value of a successful edit (as plain JSON). */
function valueOf(e: FormEdit): unknown {
  if (!e.ok) throw new Error(`refused: ${JSON.stringify(e.issues)}`);
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(e.value));
}
function selectOf(e: FormEdit): Selection {
  if (!e.ok) throw new Error('refused');
  return e.select;
}

const Y = { op: 'y' };
const C = (v: number) => ({ op: 'const', v });
const P = (path: string) => ({ op: 'param', path });
const tree = (root: unknown, defs: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({ root, defs });
const block = (state: string) => ({ kind: 'block', state });
const seq = (...rules: unknown[]) => ({ kind: 'sequence', rules });
const iff = (c: unknown, then: unknown) => ({ kind: 'condition', if: c, then });

describe('replace op (density): children by position in SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS order, per-kind defaults', () => {
  const p = withDensity(tree({ op: 'add', a: Y, b: C(2) }, { b: C(1), a: C(3) }));
  test('every source op takes the old children in evaluation order; missing slots const 0, recip const 1', () => {
    for (const op of SOURCE_OPS.filter((o) => o !== 'recip')) {
      const out = (valueOf(replaceOp(p, D('root'), op)) as { root: Record<string, unknown> }).root;
      const slots = SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS[op];
      const expected = slots.map((_, i) => (i === 0 ? Y : i === 1 ? C(2) : C(0)));
      expect([op, slots.map((k) => out[k])]).toEqual([op, expected]);
    }
    const neg = withDensity(tree({ op: 'neg', x: Y }));
    expect((valueOf(replaceOp(neg, D('root'), 'add')) as { root: unknown }).root).toEqual({ op: 'add', a: Y, b: C(0) });
    expect((valueOf(replaceOp(withDensity(tree(C(3))), D('root'), 'recip')) as { root: unknown }).root).toEqual({ op: 'recip', x: C(1) });
    expect((valueOf(replaceOp(withDensity(tree({ op: 'neg', x: P('density.detailAmpHi') })), D('root'), 'recip')) as { root: unknown }).root)
      .toEqual({ op: 'recip', x: P('density.detailAmpHi') });
  });
  test('the scalars take the op defaults; clamp ↔ rangeChoice keep lo and hi', () => {
    const root = (op: string, q = p) => (valueOf(replaceOp(q, D('root'), op)) as { root: Record<string, unknown> }).root;
    expect(root('const')).toEqual(C(0));
    expect(root('clamp')).toEqual({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1 });
    expect(root('rangeChoice')).toEqual({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, inside: C(2), outside: C(0), lo: 0, hi: 1 });
    expect(root('slide')).toEqual({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[-64, 0], [320, 1]] });
    expect(root('noise')).toEqual({ op: 'noise', id: 'overhang' });
    expect(root('noise2')).toEqual({ op: 'noise2', id: 'jag' });
    expect(root('col')).toEqual({ op: 'col', field: 'offset' });
    expect(root('tap')).toEqual({ op: 'tap', name: 'tap1', x: Y });
    expect(root('ref')).toEqual({ op: 'ref', name: 'a' });
    expect(root('param')).toEqual(P([...ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.keys()][0]!));
    expect(root('param')).toEqual(P('density.noises.jag.clampSigma'));
    const clamp = withDensity(tree({ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: { param: 'density.detailAmpLo', neg: true }, hi: 3 }));
    expect(root('rangeChoice', clamp)).toEqual({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, inside: C(0), outside: C(0), lo: { param: 'density.detailAmpLo', neg: true }, hi: 3 });
    const tapped = withDensity(tree({ op: 'tap', name: 'tap1', x: { op: 'neg', x: Y } }, { d: { op: 'tap', name: 'tap2', x: Y } }));
    expect((valueOf(replaceOp(tapped, D('root.x'), 'tap')) as { root: { x: unknown } }).root.x).toEqual({ op: 'tap', name: 'tap3', x: Y });
  });
  test('the current op is a no-op; the selection stays on the node', () => {
    const e = replaceOp(p, D('root'), 'add');
    expect(valueOf(e)).toEqual(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p.density.defs)));
    expect(selectOf(replaceOp(p, D('root.a'), 'neg'))).toEqual(D('root.a'));
  });
});

describe('disabled options', () => {
  test('ref while defs is empty; recip over a child that is not a const or param', () => {
    const opts = (q: Params, path: string) => Object.fromEntries(opOptions(q, D(path)).map((o) => [o.op, o.disabled]));
    const def = opts(DEFAULTS, 'root');
    expect(Object.keys(def)).toEqual([...SOURCE_OPS]);
    expect([def['ref'], def['recip']]).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(Object.entries(def).filter(([, d]) => d).map(([o]) => o)).toEqual(['ref', 'recip']);
    expect(opts(DEFAULTS, 'root.b.x')['recip']).toBe(false);
    expect(opts(withDensity(tree({ op: 'neg', x: P('density.detailAmpLo') })), 'root')['recip']).toBe(false);
    expect(opts(withDensity(tree(Y, { d: C(1) })), 'root')['ref']).toBe(false);
    expect(opOptions(DEFAULTS, D('root.a')).find((o) => o.current)?.op).toBe('add');
    expect(() => replaceOp(DEFAULTS, D('root'), 'ref')).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => replaceOp(DEFAULTS, D('root'), 'recip')).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
  test('rules: every rule kind for a rule, every condition kind for a condition', () => {
    expect(opOptions(DEFAULTS, R('root')).map((o) => o.op)).toEqual([...RULE_KINDS]);
    expect(opOptions(DEFAULTS, R('root.rules[2].if')).map((o) => o.op)).toEqual([...CONDITION_KINDS]);
    expect(opOptions(DEFAULTS, R('root.rules[2].if')).find((o) => o.current)?.op).toBe('verticalGradient');
    expect(opOptions(DEFAULTS, R('root')).some((o) => o.disabled)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('replace kind (rules)', () => {
  const p = withRules(seq(iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, block('stone')), block('dirt')));
  const at = (q: Params, path: string, kind: string) => valueOf(replaceOp(q, R(path), kind));
  test('sequence ↔ condition keeps the child; leaves take their defaults', () => {
    expect(at(p, 'root', 'condition')).toEqual(iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, block('stone'))));
    expect(at(withRules(seq()), 'root', 'condition')).toEqual(iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, seq()));
    expect(at(p, 'root.rules[0]', 'sequence')).toEqual(seq(seq(block('stone')), block('dirt')));
    expect(at(p, 'root.rules[1]', 'condition')).toEqual(seq(iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, block('stone')), iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, seq())));
    expect(at(p, 'root.rules[1]', 'sequence')).toEqual(seq(iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, block('stone')), seq()));
    expect(at(p, 'root.rules[1]', 'bandlands')).toEqual(seq(iff({ kind: 'skyOpen' }, block('stone')), { kind: 'bandlands' }));
    expect(at(withRules(seq({ kind: 'bandlands' })), 'root.rules[0]', 'block')).toEqual(seq(block('stone')));
  });
  test('condition defaults, and `not` wraps the old condition', () => {
    const cond = (kind: string) => (at(p, 'root.rules[0].if', kind) as { rules: { if: unknown }[] }).rules[0]!.if;
    expect(CONDITION_KINDS.map((k) => cond(k))).toEqual([
      { kind: 'biome', biomes: ['plains'] },
      { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset: 0, addSurfaceDepth: false },
      { kind: 'water', offset: 0, runTop: false },
      { kind: 'yAbove', minY: 63, runTop: false },
      { kind: 'verticalGradient', trueAtAndBelow: 0, falseAtAndAbove: 8 },
      { kind: 'steep', min: 1 },
      { kind: 'noiseThreshold', noise: 'surface.noises.patch', min: 0, max: 8 },
      { kind: 'temperatureBelow', t: 0 },
      { kind: 'skyOpen' },
      { kind: 'lake' },
      { kind: 'not', if: { kind: 'skyOpen' } },
    ]);
  });
});

describe('wrap, delete, add', () => {
  test('wrap: density in a tap with a fresh name (taps of defs counted); a rule in a one-child sequence', () => {
    expect((valueOf(wrapNode(DEFAULTS, D('root.b.x'))) as { root: { b: { x: unknown } } }).root.b.x)
      .toEqual({ op: 'tap', name: 'tap1', x: C(-1e6) });
    const q = withDensity(tree({ op: 'tap', name: 'tap1', x: Y }, { d: { op: 'tap', name: 'tap2', x: C(0) } }));
    expect((valueOf(wrapNode(q, D('root.x'))) as { root: { x: unknown } }).root.x).toEqual({ op: 'tap', name: 'tap3', x: Y });
    expect(selectOf(wrapNode(q, D('root.x')))).toEqual(D('root.x'));
    expect(valueOf(wrapNode(withRules(block('stone')), R('root')))).toEqual(seq(block('stone')));
    expect(formActions(DEFAULTS, R('root.rules[2].if')).wrap).toBe(false);
    expect(() => wrapNode(DEFAULTS, R('root.rules[2].if'))).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
  test('delete (density): one-child nodes unwrap, others become const 0, a def is removed', () => {
    for (const op of ['neg', 'abs', 'square', 'interpolated', 'recip']) {
      const x = op === 'recip' ? C(2) : Y;
      expect([op, (valueOf(deleteNode(withDensity(tree({ op, x })), D('root'))) as { root: unknown }).root]).toEqual([op, x]);
    }
    const one = [
      { op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1 }, { op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[0, 0], [1, 1]] }, { op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: 0 },
    ];
    for (const n of one) expect((valueOf(deleteNode(withDensity(tree(n)), D('root'))) as { root: unknown }).root).toEqual(Y);
    expect((valueOf(deleteNode(DEFAULTS, D('root.a'))) as { root: { a: unknown } }).root.a).toEqual(C(0));
    expect((valueOf(deleteNode(withDensity(tree({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1, inside: Y, outside: Y })), D('root'))) as { root: unknown }).root).toEqual(C(0));
    const q = withDensity(tree(Y, { a: C(1), b: C(2) }));
    const e = deleteNode(q, D('defs.a'));
    expect(valueOf(e)).toEqual(tree(Y, { b: C(2) }));
    expect(selectOf(e)).toEqual(D('root'));
  });
  test('delete of a referenced def is refused with UNKNOWN_REF at the refs, and nothing is sent', () => {
    const q = withDensity(tree({ op: 'add', a: { op: 'ref', name: 'a' }, b: Y }, { a: C(1), b: { op: 'ref', name: 'a' } }));
    let sets = 0;
    const s: EditorSession = { state: { params: q }, set() { sets++; throw new Error('sent'); }, reset() { throw new Error('no'); } };
    const r = commitFormEdit(s, deleteNode(q, D('defs.a')));
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.issues.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root.a.name: UNKNOWN_REF', 'defs.b.name: UNKNOWN_REF']);
    expect(sets).toBe(0);
  });
  test('delete (rules): a sequence child is removed and the selection follows; root and then become empty; not unwraps', () => {
    const p = withRules(seq(block('stone'), block('dirt'), iff({ kind: 'not', if: { kind: 'lake' } }, block('sand'))));
    const mid = deleteNode(p, R('root.rules[1]'));
    expect(valueOf(mid)).toEqual(seq(block('stone'), iff({ kind: 'not', if: { kind: 'lake' } }, block('sand'))));
    expect(selectOf(mid)).toEqual(R('root.rules[1]'));
    const last = deleteNode(p, R('root.rules[2]'));
    expect(valueOf(last)).toEqual(seq(block('stone'), block('dirt')));
    expect(selectOf(last)).toEqual(R('root'));
    expect(valueOf(deleteNode(p, R('root')))).toEqual(seq());
    expect((valueOf(deleteNode(p, R('root.rules[2].then'))) as { rules: unknown[] }).rules[2]).toEqual(iff({ kind: 'not', if: { kind: 'lake' } }, seq()));
    expect((valueOf(deleteNode(p, R('root.rules[2].if'))) as { rules: unknown[] }).rules[2]).toEqual(iff({ kind: 'lake' }, block('sand')));
    expect(formActions(p, R('root.rules[2].if.if')).delete).toBe(false);
    expect(() => deleteNode(p, R('root.rules[2].if.if'))).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
  test('add def (def<k> = const 0, selected) and add rule (block stone appended to a sequence, selected)', () => {
    const e = addDef(DEFAULTS);
    expect((valueOf(e) as { defs: unknown }).defs).toEqual({ def1: C(0) });
    expect(selectOf(e)).toEqual(D('defs.def1'));
    expect((valueOf(addDef(withDensity(tree(Y, { def1: C(1), def3: C(3) })))) as { defs: Record<string, unknown> }).defs['def2']).toEqual(C(0));
    const r = addRule(withRules(seq(block('dirt'))), R('root'));
    expect(valueOf(r)).toEqual(seq(block('dirt'), block('stone')));
    expect(selectOf(r)).toEqual(R('root.rules[1]'));
    expect(formActions(DEFAULTS, R('root.rules[0]')).addRule).toBe(false);
    expect(() => addRule(withRules(block('dirt')), R('root'))).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});

describe('rename def', () => {
  const q = withDensity(tree(
    { op: 'add', a: { op: 'ref', name: 'base' }, b: { op: 'tap', name: 't', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'base' }, mute: 0 } },
    { base: Y, other: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'base' } } },
  ));
  test('renames the def and every ref to it (muted subtrees and other defs too), selected', () => {
    const e = renameDef(q, 'base', 'lift');
    expect(valueOf(e)).toEqual(tree(
      { op: 'add', a: { op: 'ref', name: 'lift' }, b: { op: 'tap', name: 't', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'lift' }, mute: 0 } },
      { lift: Y, other: { op: 'neg', x: { op: 'ref', name: 'lift' } } },
    ));
    expect(selectOf(e)).toEqual(D('defs.lift'));
    expect(formActions(q, D('defs.base')).renameDef).toBe(true);
    expect(formActions(q, D('root')).renameDef).toBe(false);
  });
  test('an existing name is refused; a bad name is refused by tier 1 at commit', () => {
    const e = renameDef(q, 'base', 'other');
    expect(e.ok ? [] : e.issues.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['defs.other: DEF_EXISTS']);
    const w = session();
    const r = commitFormEdit(w, renameDef(withDensity(tree(Y, { a: C(1) }), w.state.params), 'a', '__proto__'));
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.issues.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['defs."__proto__": BAD_KEY']);
  });
});

describe('slide knots are sorted by y on every commit', () => {
  const q = withDensity(tree({ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[-64, 0], [0, 0.5], [320, 1]] }));
  test('the table commit and a cell edit re-sort; a ref sorts by its current value', () => {
    const knots = (e: FormEdit) => (valueOf(e) as { root: { knots: unknown } }).root.knots;
    expect(knots(setKnots(q, D('root'), [[320, 1], [-64, 0], [100, 2]]))).toEqual([[-64, 0], [100, 2], [320, 1]]);
    expect(knots(setNumber(q, D('root'), 'knots[0][0]', { kind: 'literal', value: 200 }))).toEqual([[0, 0.5], [200, 0], [320, 1]]);
    expect(knots(setNumber(q, D('root'), 'knots[1][0]', { kind: 'param', path: 'surface.cliffMinY' })))
      .toEqual([[-64, 0], [{ param: 'surface.cliffMinY' }, 0.5], [320, 1]]);
    expect(knots(setKnots(q, D('root'), [[{ param: 'surface.cliffMinY' }, 1], [50, 0]]))).toEqual([[50, 0], [{ param: 'surface.cliffMinY' }, 1]]);
  });
});

describe('the mute toggle (§1.5, D7)', () => {
  const tap = { op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y };
  test('the neutral value of the tap’s parent: add 0, mul 1, max −1e6, min 1e6, else 0', () => {
    const under = (op: string) => muteValue(withDensity(tree({ op, a: tap, b: Y })), D('root.a'));
    expect(['add', 'mul', 'max', 'min'].map(under)).toEqual([0, 1, -1e6, 1e6]);
    expect(muteValue(withDensity(tree({ op: 'neg', x: tap })), D('root.x'))).toBe(0);
    expect(muteValue(withDensity(tree({ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1, inside: tap, outside: Y })), D('root.inside'))).toBe(0);
    expect(muteValue(withDensity(tree({ op: 'max', a: Y, b: Y }, { d: tap })), D('defs.d'))).toBe(0);
    expect(muteValue(withDensity(tree(tap)), D('root'))).toBe(0);
    expect([muteValue(DEFAULTS, D('root.a.a')), muteValue(DEFAULTS, D('root.b'))]).toEqual([0, -1e6]);
  });
  test('toggling writes the value, toggling again removes it; only taps', () => {
    const on = toggleMute(DEFAULTS, D('root.b'));
    const b = (valueOf(on) as { root: { b: unknown } }).root.b;
    expect(b).toEqual({ op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: C(-1e6), mute: -1e6 });
    const muted = withDensity((on as { value: unknown }).value);
    expect((valueOf(toggleMute(muted, D('root.b'))) as { root: { b: unknown } }).root.b).toEqual({ op: 'tap', name: 'islands', x: C(-1e6) });
    expect([formActions(DEFAULTS, D('root.b')).mute, formActions(DEFAULTS, D('root.a')).mute]).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(() => toggleMute(DEFAULTS, D('root.a'))).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});

describe('ref ↔ literal on every numeric field, and neg', () => {
  const lo = DEFAULTS.density.detailAmpLo;
  test('const.v ↔ a param node (no negate); a param node back to const(<current value>)', () => {
    const e = setNumber(DEFAULTS, D('root.b.x'), 'v', { kind: 'param', path: 'density.detailAmpLo' });
    expect((valueOf(e) as { root: { b: { x: unknown } } }).root.b.x).toEqual(P('density.detailAmpLo'));
    const p = withDensity((e as { value: unknown }).value);
    expect((valueOf(setNumber(p, D('root.b.x'), 'v', { kind: 'literal' })) as { root: { b: { x: unknown } } }).root.b.x).toEqual(C(lo));
    expect((valueOf(setNumber(p, D('root.b.x'), 'v', { kind: 'param', path: 'surface.snowline' })) as { root: { b: { x: unknown } } }).root.b.x)
      .toEqual(P('surface.snowline'));
    expect((valueOf(setNumber(DEFAULTS, D('root.b.x'), 'v', { kind: 'literal', value: -10 })) as { root: { b: { x: unknown } } }).root.b.x).toEqual(C(-10));
    expect(() => setNumber(DEFAULTS, D('root.b.x'), 'v', { kind: 'param', path: 'density.detailAmpLo', neg: true })).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(formFields(DEFAULTS, D('root.b.x'))).toEqual([{ type: 'number', key: 'v', value: -1e6, current: -1e6, int: false, negatable: false }]);
  });
  test('density scalar fields: clamp and rangeChoice bounds, knot coordinates, mute', () => {
    const cases: [unknown, string, (n: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown][] = [
      [{ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1 }, 'lo', (n) => n['lo']],
      [{ op: 'clamp', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1 }, 'hi', (n) => n['hi']],
      [{ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1, inside: Y, outside: Y }, 'lo', (n) => n['lo']],
      [{ op: 'rangeChoice', x: Y, lo: 0, hi: 1, inside: Y, outside: Y }, 'hi', (n) => n['hi']],
      [{ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[-64, 0], [320, 1]] }, 'knots[0][1]', (n) => (n['knots'] as unknown[][])[0]![1]],
      [{ op: 'slide', x: Y, knots: [[-64, 0], [320, 1]] }, 'knots[1][1]', (n) => (n['knots'] as unknown[][])[1]![1]],
      [{ op: 'tap', name: 't', x: Y, mute: 0 }, 'mute', (n) => n['mute']],
    ];
    for (const [node, key, read] of cases) {
      const p0 = withDensity(tree(node));
      const root = (e: FormEdit) => (valueOf(e) as { root: Record<string, unknown> }).root;
      const ref = setNumber(p0, D('root'), key, { kind: 'param', path: 'density.detailAmpLo' });
      expect([key, read(root(ref))]).toEqual([key, { param: 'density.detailAmpLo' }]);
      const neg = setNumber(p0, D('root'), key, { kind: 'param', path: 'density.detailAmpLo', neg: true });
      expect([key, read(root(neg))]).toEqual([key, { param: 'density.detailAmpLo', neg: true }]);
      const back = setNumber(withDensity((neg as { value: unknown }).value), D('root'), key, { kind: 'literal' });
      expect([key, read(root(back))]).toEqual([key, 0 - lo]);
      expect([key, read(root(setNumber(p0, D('root'), key, { kind: 'literal', value: 0.25 })))]).toEqual([key, 0.25]);
    }
    expect(() => setNumber(DEFAULTS, D('root.a'), 'lo', { kind: 'literal', value: 1 })).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
  test('the rules’ nine numeric fields, with int fields listing only int targets', () => {
    const conds: [unknown, string, boolean][] = [
      [{ kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset: 0, addSurfaceDepth: false }, 'offset', true],
      [{ kind: 'water', offset: 0, runTop: false }, 'offset', true],
      [{ kind: 'yAbove', minY: 63, runTop: false }, 'minY', true],
      [{ kind: 'verticalGradient', trueAtAndBelow: 0, falseAtAndAbove: 8 }, 'trueAtAndBelow', true],
      [{ kind: 'verticalGradient', trueAtAndBelow: 0, falseAtAndAbove: 8 }, 'falseAtAndAbove', true],
      [{ kind: 'steep', min: 1 }, 'min', false],
      [{ kind: 'noiseThreshold', noise: 'surface.noises.patch', min: 0, max: 8 }, 'min', false],
      [{ kind: 'noiseThreshold', noise: 'surface.noises.patch', min: 0, max: 8 }, 'max', false],
      [{ kind: 'temperatureBelow', t: 0 }, 't', false],
    ];
    const target = (int: boolean) => (int ? 'surface.cliffMinY' : 'surface.snowline');
    for (const [c, key, int] of conds) {
      const p0 = withRules(iff(c, block('stone')));
      const field = formFields(p0, R('root.if')).find((f) => f.key === key);
      expect([key, field?.type, field?.type === 'number' && field.int, field?.type === 'number' && field.negatable]).toEqual([key, 'number', int, true]);
      const ref = setNumber(p0, R('root.if'), key, { kind: 'param', path: target(int), neg: true });
      const at = (e: FormEdit) => (valueOf(e) as { if: Record<string, unknown> }).if[key];
      expect([key, at(ref)]).toEqual([key, { param: target(int), neg: true }]);
      const back = setNumber(withRules((ref as { value: unknown }).value), R('root.if'), key, { kind: 'literal' });
      expect([key, at(back)]).toEqual([key, 0 - (int ? DEFAULTS.surface.cliffMinY : DEFAULTS.surface.snowline)]);
    }
    expect(refOptions(DEFAULTS, true).map((o) => o.path)).toEqual(['surface.lapseBase', 'surface.cliffMinY']);
    expect(refOptions(DEFAULTS, false).map((o) => o.path)).toEqual([...ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.keys()]);
    expect(refOptions(DEFAULTS, false)[3]).toEqual({ path: 'density.detailAmpLo', label: `density.detailAmpLo = ${String(lo)}`, value: lo, int: false });
  });
  test('a non-int target in an int field is refused at commit (PARAM_KIND)', () => {
    const w = session();
    const p0 = withRules(iff({ kind: 'yAbove', minY: 63, runTop: false }, block('stone')), w.state.params);
    const r = commitFormEdit(w, setNumber(p0, R('root.if'), 'minY', { kind: 'param', path: 'surface.snowline' }));
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.issues.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root.if.minY: PARAM_KIND']);
  });
});

describe('the fields of a node', () => {
  test('density: def name, tap name and mute, selects of noises, sample fields and defs', () => {
    expect(formFields(DEFAULTS, D('root.b'))).toEqual([{ type: 'name', key: 'name', value: 'islands' }]);
    const keys = (q: Params, path: string) => formFields(q, D(path)).map((f) => `${f.type}:${f.key}`);
    const q = withDensity(tree({ op: 'add', a: { op: 'noise', id: 'overhang' }, b: { op: 'ref', name: 'd' } }, { d: { op: 'col', field: 'E' } }));
    expect(keys(q, 'defs.d')).toEqual(['name:defName', 'select:field']);
    expect(formFields(q, D('root.a'))).toEqual([{ type: 'select', key: 'id', value: 'overhang', options: ['overhang', 'detail'] }]);
    expect(formFields(q, D('root.b'))).toEqual([{ type: 'select', key: 'name', value: 'd', options: ['d'] }]);
    expect(keys(withDensity((toggleMute(DEFAULTS, D('root.b')) as { value: unknown }).value), 'root.b')).toEqual(['name:name', 'number:mute']);
    expect(keys(DEFAULTS, 'root.a')).toEqual([]);
  });
  test('rules: FIELDS without children; block states collide; set a select, a boolean, a biome list', () => {
    expect(BLOCK_STATE_OPTIONS).toContain('stone');
    expect(BLOCK_STATE_OPTIONS).not.toContain('air');
    const p0 = withRules(iff({ kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset: 0, addSurfaceDepth: false }, block('dirt')));
    expect(formFields(p0, R('root.if')).map((f) => `${f.type}:${f.key}`)).toEqual(['select:side', 'number:offset', 'boolean:addSurfaceDepth']);
    expect(formFields(p0, R('root'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(formFields(p0, R('root.then'))).toEqual([{ type: 'select', key: 'state', value: 'dirt', options: BLOCK_STATE_OPTIONS }]);
    expect((valueOf(setField(p0, R('root.then'), 'state', 'sand')) as { then: unknown }).then).toEqual(block('sand'));
    expect((valueOf(setField(p0, R('root.if'), 'addSurfaceDepth', true)) as { if: Record<string, unknown> }).if['addSurfaceDepth']).toBe(true);
    const b = withRules(iff({ kind: 'biome', biomes: ['plains'] }, block('dirt')));
    expect((valueOf(setField(b, R('root.if'), 'biomes', ['desert', 'beach'])) as { if: unknown }).if).toEqual({ kind: 'biome', biomes: ['desert', 'beach'] });
    expect(() => setField(p0, R('root.if'), 'offset', 'x')).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect((valueOf(setField(DEFAULTS, D('root.b'), 'name', 'isles')) as { root: { b: { name: string } } }).root.b.name).toBe('isles');
  });
});

describe('commit through the session', () => {
  test('one session.set of the leaf: one undo step, the selection followed', () => {
    const w = session();
    const r = commitFormEdit(w, toggleMute(w.state.params, D('root.a.a')));
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: true, select: D('root.a.a') });
    expect((w.state.params.density.defs as { root: { a: { a: { mute?: number } } } }).root.a.a.mute).toBe(0);
    expect(w.modifiedCount('')).toBe(1);
    expect(w.canUndo).toBe(true);
    w.undo();
    expect((w.state.params.density.defs as { root: { a: { a: { mute?: number } } } }).root.a.a.mute).toBeUndefined();
  });
  test('a tier-2-invalid candidate is never sent; a session refusal lists its issues', () => {
    const w = session();
    const before = w.state.params.density.defs;
    const r = commitFormEdit(w, setNumber(w.state.params, D('root.b.x'), 'v', { kind: 'literal', value: 2e9 }));
    expect(r.ok ? [] : r.issues.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root.b.x.v: LITERAL_RANGE']);
    expect(w.state.params.density.defs).toBe(before);
    const refusing: EditorSession = {
      state: w.state,
      set: () => ({ ok: false, issues: [{ path: 'density.defs.root', code: 'UNKNOWN_OP', message: 'no' }, { path: 'density.defs', code: 'COLUMN_COST', message: 'no' }] }),
      reset: () => { throw new Error('no'); },
    };
    const leaf: TreeLeaf = 'density.defs';
    const r2 = commitFormEdit(refusing, toggleMute(w.state.params, { leaf, path: 'root.b' }));
    expect(r2.ok ? [] : r2.issues.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.code}`)).toEqual(['root: UNKNOWN_OP', ': COLUMN_COST']);
  });
});

describe('the two lints (§3.3)', () => {
  const noises = (k: number): unknown => {
    let e: unknown = { op: 'noise', id: 'overhang' };
    for (let i = 1; i < k; i++) e = { op: 'add', a: e, b: { op: 'noise', id: 'overhang' } };
    return { op: 'interpolated', x: e };
  };
  test('defaults: none', () => {
    expect(treeLints(DEFAULTS)).toEqual([]);
  });
  test('no fast path when a leaf is neither depth-bounded nor Y-only', () => {
    expect(treeLints(withRules(seq(iff({ kind: 'biome', biomes: ['plains'] }, block('stone')))))).toEqual([LINT_NO_FAST_PATH]);
    expect(treeLints(withRules(seq(block('stone'))))).toEqual([]);
  });
  test('density cost above 4 × the default root’s work cost (569 at the defaults)', () => {
    // interpolated(add of k overhang noises): 1 + 8 × (16k + k − 1).
    expect(treeLints(withDensity(tree(noises(16))))).toEqual([]);
    expect(treeLints(withDensity(tree(noises(20))))).toEqual([densityCostLint(2713 / 569)]);
    expect(densityCostLint(2713 / 569)).toBe('density cost ≈ 4.8 × the default');
  });
});
```

Create `src/ui/inspector/form.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The Density tab's node form model (SP3d spec §3.3, §1.5, D7, D18): every form operation is a pure function of the
 * session's params and the selection that yields a candidate tree for the selected root (`FormEdit`), committed with
 * one `session.set('<leaf>', candidate)` by `commitFormEdit` (one undo step; validated first with both tiers, so an
 * invalid tree is never sent, and a refusal comes back as issue lines). Node paths are never session paths.
 *
 * Operations: the fields of the selected node (`formFields`: one per scalar, with the select options of noises, sample
 * fields, defs, block states, biomes and sides); parameter refs on every numeric field (`setNumber`: on `const.v` a
 * target replaces the node by `{op: 'param', path}` and "literal" turns a `param` node back into `const(<its current
 * value>)`; elsewhere the ref form `{param, neg?}` and "literal" writes the current resolved value; an int field lists
 * only int targets, `refOptions`); replace op / kind with children kept by position in `SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS` order, the
 * per-kind defaults below and the options that cannot validate disabled (`opOptions`, `replaceOp`); wrap (`wrapNode`),
 * delete (`deleteNode`; a referenced def's deletion is refused by tier 2's `UNKNOWN_REF`), add def and add rule,
 * rename def with every ref to it (`renameDef`), the mute toggle with the neutral value of the tap's parent
 * (`muteValue`, `toggleMute`), and slide knots sorted by y on every commit (`setKnots`). `treeLints` gives the two tree
 * warnings ("no fast path", "density cost ≈ N × the default"), never refusals. The per-kind defaults live here (gen may
 * not export numbers). Every lookup keyed by tree content reads own properties only, and keys are written with
 * `Object.defineProperty`, so a typed `__proto__` def name reaches tier 1 as `BAD_KEY`. Pure; no DOM.
 */
import { DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE } from '../../core/params/defaultTrees';
import type { JsonFormat } from '../../core/params/json';
import { getPath } from '../../core/params/kit';
import { SCHEMA, type Params } from '../../core/params/schema';
import { SURFACE_BIOMES } from '../../gen/biomes/registry';
import { SAMPLE_FIELDS } from '../../gen/column/columnStage';
import { ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS, resolveDensity, SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, SOURCE_OPS, type ParamRef } from '../../gen/density/source';
import { workCost } from '../../gen/inspect/cost';
import { surfaceFastPath } from '../../gen/surface/compile';
import { CONDITION_KINDS, FIELDS, RULE_KINDS } from '../../gen/surface/rules';
import { surfaceDepthMax } from '../../gen/surface/scan';
import { resolveRules } from '../../gen/surface/source';
import { COLLIDE, REGISTRY } from '../../world/blocks/index';
import { COLLIDE_NONE } from '../../world/blocks/kinds';
import { checkLeafCandidate, formatOfLeaf, leafValue, type EditorIssue, type EditorSession, type TreeLeaf } from './editorModel';
import { findNode, followNode, pathSteps, type Selection, type TreeNode } from './model';

/** What a form operation yields: the leaf's candidate value and the selection after it, or a refusal. */
export type FormEdit =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly leaf: TreeLeaf; readonly value: unknown; readonly select: Selection }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly issues: readonly EditorIssue[] };

/** A committed edit's outcome: the selection to show (followed, §3.2), or the issues (the selection is kept). */
export type FormCommit =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly select: Selection }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly issues: readonly EditorIssue[] };

/** A numeric field's value in the source: a literal or a parameter ref. */
export type NumberValue = number | ParamRef;

/** One control of the form. `key` is the node field (`knots[i][j]` for a knot cell, `defName` for a def's name). */
export type FormField =
  | {
    readonly type: 'number'; readonly key: string; readonly value: NumberValue; readonly current: number;
    /** Only int targets may stand here (§1.3). */
    readonly int: boolean;
    /** "negate" is offered (every numeric field but `const.v`). */
    readonly negatable: boolean;
  }
  | { readonly type: 'select'; readonly key: string; readonly value: string; readonly options: readonly string[] }
  | { readonly type: 'boolean'; readonly key: string; readonly value: boolean }
  | { readonly type: 'name'; readonly key: string; readonly value: string }
  | { readonly type: 'knots'; readonly key: 'knots'; readonly value: readonly (readonly [NumberValue, NumberValue])[] }
  | { readonly type: 'biomes'; readonly key: 'biomes'; readonly value: readonly string[]; readonly options: readonly string[] };

/** A numeric field's new value: a literal (`value` omitted: the field's current value) or a ref to a target. */
export type NumberChoice =
  | { readonly kind: 'literal'; readonly value?: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'param'; readonly path: string; readonly neg?: boolean };

/** A ref target as the select lists it: `<path> = <current value>`. */
export interface RefOption {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly value: number;
  readonly int: boolean;
}

export interface OpOption {
  readonly op: string;
  readonly disabled: boolean;
  readonly current: boolean;
}

/** The actions the form offers on the selection. */
export interface FormActions {
  readonly wrap: boolean;
  readonly delete: boolean;
  readonly addRule: boolean;
  readonly renameDef: boolean;
  readonly mute: boolean;
}

/** The lints (§3.3): warnings, never refusals. */
export const LINT_NO_FAST_PATH = 'no fast path: every solid voxel is evaluated';
/** The density lint fires above this many times the default root's work cost. */
export const LINT_COST_FACTOR = 4;
export const densityCostLint = (ratio: number): string => `density cost ≈ ${String(Math.round(ratio * 10) / 10)} × the default`;

/** The mute toggle's value under each parent op (§1.5: the `islands` convention); 0 elsewhere. */
const MUTE_NEUTRAL: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = new Map([['add', 0], ['mul', 1], ['max', -1e6], ['min', 1e6]]);
/** Ops with one child slot: deleting one unwraps it (§3.3). */
const UNWRAP_OPS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['neg', 'abs', 'square', 'clamp', 'slide', 'interpolated', 'tap', 'recip']);
/** Scalars a replaced op keeps when the new op has the same field with the same meaning. */
const KEPT_SCALARS: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]> = new Map([['clamp', ['lo', 'hi']], ['rangeChoice', ['lo', 'hi']]]);
/** The rules' numeric fields and whether they are int fields (§1.3). */
const RULE_NUMBERS: ReadonlyMap<string, boolean> = new Map([
  ['offset', true], ['minY', true], ['trueAtAndBelow', true], ['falseAtAndAbove', true], ['min', false], ['max', false], ['t', false],
]);
const RULE_CHILD_FIELDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['if', 'then', 'rules']);
const KNOT_KEY = /^knots\[(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\]\[([01])\]$/;
const DEF_ROOT = /^defs\.([^.[]+)$/;

/** The colliding block states, in registry order (a `block` rule's select, §3.3). */
export const BLOCK_STATE_OPTIONS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze((() => {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let s = 0; s < REGISTRY.stateCount; s++) if (COLLIDE[s] !== COLLIDE_NONE) out.push(REGISTRY.stateKey(s));
  return out;
})());
export const BIOME_OPTIONS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([...SURFACE_BIOMES]);
export const COL_FIELD_OPTIONS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([...SAMPLE_FIELDS]);
export const SIDE_OPTIONS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(['floor', 'ceiling']);

/** The schema's noise leaves under `prefix` of dims `dims`, as their names after the prefix (density) or paths (rules). */
function schemaNoises(prefix: string, dims: 2 | 3, strip: boolean): readonly string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, leaf } of SCHEMA.leaves) {
    if (leaf.kind === 'noise' && path.startsWith(prefix) && (leaf.dims ?? 2) === dims) out.push(strip ? path.slice(prefix.length) : path);
  }
  return Object.freeze(out);
}
/** `noise2` reads the 2D density noises, `noise` the 3D ones (by id); `noiseThreshold` a 2D surface noise (by path). */
export const DENSITY_NOISE_OPTIONS: Readonly<Record<'noise' | 'noise2', readonly string[]>> = Object.freeze({
  noise2: schemaNoises('density.noises.', 2, true), noise: schemaNoises('density.noises.', 3, true),
});
export const SURFACE_NOISE_OPTIONS: readonly string[] = schemaNoises('surface.noises.', 2, false);

type Rec = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
const isRec = (v: unknown): v is Rec => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
const own = (r: unknown, k: string): unknown => (isRec(r) && Object.hasOwn(r, k) ? r[k] : undefined);
const isRef = (v: unknown): v is ParamRef => isRec(v) && typeof own(v, 'param') === 'string';
const tagOf = (format: JsonFormat): string => (format === 'density' ? 'op' : 'kind');

/** A plain object with these own entries, every key defined (never [[Set]]: `__proto__` stays an own key). */
function record(entries: Iterable<readonly [string, unknown]>): Record<string, unknown> {
  const o: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of entries) Object.defineProperty(o, k, { value: v, enumerable: true, writable: true, configurable: true });
  return o;
}
const withKey = (r: Rec, k: string, v: unknown): Record<string, unknown> =>
  record([...Object.entries(r).filter(([key]) => key !== k), [k, v]]);
const withoutKey = (r: Rec, k: string): Record<string, unknown> => record(Object.entries(r).filter(([key]) => key !== k));

/** `value` with the item at `steps` replaced by `fn(old)` (copy on write along the path). */
function updateAt(value: unknown, steps: readonly (string | number)[], fn: (old: unknown) => unknown, i = 0): unknown {
  if (i === steps.length) return fn(value);
  const s = steps[i]!;
  if (typeof s === 'number') {
    if (!Array.isArray(value) || s >= value.length) throw new RangeError(`form: no item ${String(s)}`);
    const out = [...(value as readonly unknown[])];
    out[s] = updateAt(out[s], steps, fn, i + 1);
    return out;
  }
  if (!isRec(value) || !Object.hasOwn(value, s)) throw new RangeError(`form: no field ${s}`);
  return withKey(value, s, updateAt(value[s], steps, fn, i + 1));
}

interface Located {
  readonly leaf: TreeLeaf;
  readonly format: JsonFormat;
  readonly value: unknown;
  readonly node: TreeNode;
  readonly steps: readonly (string | number)[];
}

/** The selected node, or a RangeError (the DOM only offers operations on existing nodes). */
function locate(params: Params, sel: Selection): Located {
  const format = formatOfLeaf(sel.leaf);
  const value = leafValue(params, sel.leaf);
  const node = findNode(value, format, sel.path);
  const steps = pathSteps(sel.path, format);
  if (node === undefined || steps === null) throw new RangeError(`form: "${sel.path}" names no node of ${sel.leaf}`);
  return { leaf: sel.leaf, format, value, node, steps };
}

const edit = (at: Located, value: unknown, path: string): FormEdit => ({ ok: true, leaf: at.leaf, value, select: { leaf: at.leaf, path } });
const replaceNode = (at: Located, fn: (old: TreeNode) => unknown, path: string): FormEdit =>
  edit(at, updateAt(at.value, at.steps, (old) => fn(old as TreeNode)), path);

/** A rules node under `.if` is a condition. */
const isCondition = (at: Located): boolean => at.format === 'surfaceRules' && at.steps.at(-1) === 'if';

/** The number a source numeric value stands for under `params`: a literal, or a ref's target value (0 − v with `neg`). */
export function currentNumber(params: Params, v: unknown): number {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v;
  if (!isRef(v)) return Number.NaN;
  const t = getPath(params, v.param);
  if (typeof t !== 'number') return Number.NaN;
  return v.neg === true ? 0 - t : t;
}

/** The ref targets a numeric field may name, each with its current value; an int field lists only int targets. */
export function refOptions(params: Params, int: boolean): RefOption[] {
  const out: RefOption[] = [];
  for (const [path, t] of ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS) {
    if (int && t.kind !== 'int') continue;
    const value = currentNumber(params, { param: path });
    out.push({ path, label: `${path} = ${String(value)}`, value, int: t.kind === 'int' });
  }
  return out;
}

/** The density's tap names (root and every def), for fresh names. */
function tapNames(value: unknown): Set<string> {
  const names = new Set<string>();
  const stack: unknown[] = [own(value, 'root'), ...Object.values(isRec(own(value, 'defs')) ? (own(value, 'defs') as Rec) : {})];
  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const n = stack.pop();
    if (!isRec(n) || typeof n['op'] !== 'string') continue;
    if (n['op'] === 'tap' && typeof own(n, 'name') === 'string') names.add(n['name'] as string);
    const slots = Object.hasOwn(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, n['op']) ? (SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[n['op']]! : [];
    for (const k of slots) stack.push(own(n, k));
  }
  return names;
}

/** `<prefix><k>` with the smallest k ≥ 1 not in `used`. */
function fresh(prefix: string, used: ReadonlySet<string>): string {
  for (let k = 1; ; k++) if (!used.has(`${prefix}${String(k)}`)) return `${prefix}${String(k)}`;
}

/** A fresh tap name `tap<k>` for a density leaf value (§3.3). */
export const freshTapName = (value: unknown): string => fresh('tap', tapNames(value));

const defNames = (value: unknown): string[] => {
  const defs = own(value, 'defs');
  return isRec(defs) ? Object.keys(defs).sort() : [];
};

/** The defaults of a density op's scalars (§3.3); `value` is the leaf value (for fresh names, defs and targets). */
function densityScalars(op: string, value: unknown): [string, unknown][] {
  switch (op) {
    case 'const': return [['v', 0]];
    case 'clamp': case 'rangeChoice': return [['lo', 0], ['hi', 1]];
    case 'slide': return [['knots', [[-64, 0], [320, 1]]]];
    case 'noise': case 'noise2': return [['id', DENSITY_NOISE_OPTIONS[op][0]]];
    case 'col': return [['field', 'offset']];
    case 'tap': return [['name', freshTapName(value)]];
    case 'ref': return [['name', defNames(value)[0]]];
    case 'param': return [['path', ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS.keys().next().value]];
    default: return [];
  }
}

const CONST_0 = (): Rec => record([['op', 'const'], ['v', 0]]);
const SKY_OPEN = (): Rec => record([['kind', 'skyOpen']]);
const EMPTY_SEQUENCE = (): Rec => record([['kind', 'sequence'], ['rules', []]]);

/** A condition kind's defaults (§3.3); `not` wraps the old condition. */
function defaultCondition(kind: string, old: TreeNode): Rec {
  const k = (entries: [string, unknown][]): Rec => record([['kind', kind], ...entries]);
  switch (kind) {
    case 'biome': return k([['biomes', ['plains']]]);
    case 'stoneDepth': return k([['side', 'floor'], ['offset', 0], ['addSurfaceDepth', false]]);
    case 'water': return k([['offset', 0], ['runTop', false]]);
    case 'yAbove': return k([['minY', 63], ['runTop', false]]);
    case 'verticalGradient': return k([['trueAtAndBelow', 0], ['falseAtAndAbove', 8]]);
    case 'steep': return k([['min', 1]]);
    case 'noiseThreshold': return k([['noise', 'surface.noises.patch'], ['min', 0], ['max', 8]]);
    case 'temperatureBelow': return k([['t', 0]]);
    case 'not': return k([['if', old]]);
    default: return k([]);
  }
}

/** A rule kind replacing `old`, keeping its child: `rules: [then]` / `then: rules[0]` or an empty sequence (§3.3). */
function replacedRule(kind: string, old: TreeNode): Rec {
  const oldKind = old['kind'];
  const children: unknown[] = oldKind === 'sequence' ? [...((own(old, 'rules') as readonly unknown[] | undefined) ?? [])]
    : oldKind === 'condition' ? [own(old, 'then')] : [];
  switch (kind) {
    case 'sequence': return record([['kind', 'sequence'], ['rules', children]]);
    case 'condition': return record([['kind', 'condition'], ['if', SKY_OPEN()], ['then', children[0] ?? EMPTY_SEQUENCE()]]);
    case 'block': return record([['kind', 'block'], ['state', 'stone']]);
    default: return record([['kind', kind]]);
  }
}

/** The old node's children in evaluation order (`SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS`). */
function densityChildren(node: TreeNode): unknown[] {
  const op = node['op'] as string;
  const slots = Object.hasOwn(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, op) ? (SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[op]! : [];
  return slots.filter((k) => Object.hasOwn(node, k)).map((k) => node[k]);
}

/** `op` replacing `old`: children by position, missing slots `const 0` (`recip`'s `const 1`), kept and default scalars. */
function replacedDensity(op: string, old: TreeNode, value: unknown): Rec {
  const children = densityChildren(old);
  const entries: [string, unknown][] = [['op', op]];
  const kept = KEPT_SCALARS.get(op) ?? [];
  for (const [k, v] of densityScalars(op, value)) {
    entries.push([k, (KEPT_SCALARS.get(old['op'] as string) ?? []).includes(k) && kept.includes(k) && Object.hasOwn(old, k) ? old[k] : v]);
  }
  (SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[op]!.forEach((slot, i) => {
    entries.push([slot, i < children.length ? children[i] : op === 'recip' ? record([['op', 'const'], ['v', 1]]) : CONST_0()]);
  });
  return record(entries);
}

const isConstOperand = (v: unknown): boolean => isRec(v) && (v['op'] === 'const' || v['op'] === 'param');

/** The ops / kinds the selected node may become (§3.3), with the options that cannot validate disabled. */
export function opOptions(params: Params, sel: Selection): OpOption[] {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  const current = at.node[tagOf(at.format)];
  if (at.format === 'surfaceRules') {
    const kinds = isCondition(at) ? CONDITION_KINDS : RULE_KINDS;
    return kinds.map((op) => ({ op, disabled: false, current: op === current }));
  }
  const first = densityChildren(at.node)[0];
  return SOURCE_OPS.map((op) => ({
    op,
    disabled: (op === 'ref' && defNames(at.value).length === 0) || (op === 'recip' && first !== undefined && !isConstOperand(first)),
    current: op === current,
  }));
}

/** Replace op / kind (§3.3); the selection stays on the node. RangeError for a disabled or unknown option. */
export function replaceOp(params: Params, sel: Selection, op: string): FormEdit {
  const option = opOptions(params, sel).find((o) => o.op === op);
  if (option === undefined || option.disabled) throw new RangeError(`form: "${op}" is not available on ${sel.path}`);
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (option.current) return edit(at, at.value, sel.path);
  if (at.format === 'density') return replaceNode(at, (old) => replacedDensity(op, old, at.value), sel.path);
  return replaceNode(at, (old) => (isCondition(at) ? defaultCondition(op, old) : replacedRule(op, old)), sel.path);
}

/** What the form offers on the selection. */
export function formActions(params: Params, sel: Selection): FormActions {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (at.format === 'density') {
    return { wrap: true, delete: true, addRule: false, renameDef: DEF_ROOT.test(sel.path), mute: at.node['op'] === 'tap' };
  }
  const cond = isCondition(at);
  return { wrap: !cond, delete: !cond || at.node['kind'] === 'not', addRule: at.node['kind'] === 'sequence', renameDef: false, mute: false };
}

/** Wrap (§3.3): density in a `tap` with a fresh name; a rule in a one-child `sequence`. The selection is the wrapper. */
export function wrapNode(params: Params, sel: Selection): FormEdit {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (!formActions(params, sel).wrap) throw new RangeError(`form: a condition cannot be wrapped (${sel.path})`);
  if (at.format === 'density') {
    const name = freshTapName(at.value);
    return replaceNode(at, (old) => record([['op', 'tap'], ['name', name], ['x', old]]), sel.path);
  }
  return replaceNode(at, (old) => record([['kind', 'sequence'], ['rules', [old]]]), sel.path);
}

/**
 * Delete (§3.3). Density: a def's top removes the def (tier 2 refuses it with `UNKNOWN_REF` while a ref names it);
 * a one-child-slot node is unwrapped; any other node becomes `const 0`. Rules: a sequence child is removed (later
 * siblings renumber, the selection follows); the root or a `then` becomes an empty sequence; a `not` is unwrapped.
 */
export function deleteNode(params: Params, sel: Selection): FormEdit {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (!formActions(params, sel).delete) throw new RangeError(`form: this condition can only be replaced (${sel.path})`);
  if (at.format === 'density') {
    const def = DEF_ROOT.exec(sel.path);
    if (def !== null) {
      const defs = own(at.value, 'defs') as Rec;
      return edit(at, withKey(at.value as Rec, 'defs', withoutKey(defs, def[1]!)), 'root');
    }
    const op = at.node['op'] as string;
    const child = UNWRAP_OPS.has(op) ? densityChildren(at.node)[0] : undefined;
    return replaceNode(at, () => child ?? CONST_0(), sel.path);
  }
  const last = at.steps.at(-1);
  if (typeof last === 'number') {
    const seqSteps = at.steps.slice(0, -1);
    const value = updateAt(at.value, seqSteps, (rules) => (rules as readonly unknown[]).filter((_, i) => i !== last));
    const after = followNode(withLeafValue(params, at.leaf, value), sel);
    return edit(at, value, after.path);
  }
  if (at.node['kind'] === 'not') return replaceNode(at, (old) => own(old, 'if'), sel.path);
  return replaceNode(at, () => EMPTY_SEQUENCE(), sel.path);
}

/** "Add def": `def<k>` = `const 0`, selected. */
export function addDef(params: Params): FormEdit {
  const value = params.density.defs;
  const defs = isRec(own(value, 'defs')) ? (own(value, 'defs') as Rec) : {};
  const name = fresh('def', new Set(Object.keys(defs)));
  const out = withKey(value as Rec, 'defs', withKey(defs, name, CONST_0()));
  return { ok: true, leaf: 'density.defs', value: out, select: { leaf: 'density.defs', path: `defs.${name}` } };
}

/** "Add rule": appends `block stone` to the selected `sequence`, selected. */
export function addRule(params: Params, sel: Selection): FormEdit {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (!formActions(params, sel).addRule) throw new RangeError(`form: rules are added to a sequence (${sel.path})`);
  const rules = own(at.node, 'rules') as readonly unknown[];
  return replaceNode(at, (old) => withKey(old, 'rules', [...rules, record([['kind', 'block'], ['state', 'stone']])]), `${sel.path}.rules[${String(rules.length)}]`);
}

/** Every `ref` to `from` (in `root` and every def, muted subtrees included) renamed to `to`. */
function renameRefs(node: unknown, from: string, to: string): unknown {
  if (!isRec(node) || typeof node['op'] !== 'string') return node;
  if (node['op'] === 'ref') return own(node, 'name') === from ? withKey(node, 'name', to) : node;
  let out: Rec = node;
  const slots = Object.hasOwn(SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS, node['op']) ? (SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[node['op']]! : [];
  for (const k of slots) {
    const c = own(node, k);
    const r = renameRefs(c, from, to);
    if (r !== c) out = withKey(out, k, r);
  }
  return out;
}

/** Rename def (§3.3): one edit renaming the def and every ref to it; refused when `to` already names a def. */
export function renameDef(params: Params, from: string, to: string): FormEdit {
  const value = params.density.defs as Rec;
  const defs = own(value, 'defs');
  if (!isRec(defs) || !Object.hasOwn(defs, from)) throw new RangeError(`form: no def ${JSON.stringify(from)}`);
  const select: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: `defs.${to}` };
  if (to === from) return { ok: true, leaf: 'density.defs', value, select };
  if (Object.hasOwn(defs, to)) {
    return { ok: false, issues: [{ path: `defs.${to}`, code: 'DEF_EXISTS', message: `a def named ${JSON.stringify(to)} already exists` }] };
  }
  const renamed = record(Object.entries(defs).map(([k, v]) => [k === from ? to : k, renameRefs(v, from, to)] as const));
  return { ok: true, leaf: 'density.defs', value: record([...Object.entries(value).filter(([k]) => k !== 'root' && k !== 'defs'), ['root', renameRefs(own(value, 'root'), from, to)], ['defs', renamed]]), select };
}

/** The mute toggle's value for the selected tap (§1.5, D7): the neutral value of its parent op in the source. */
export function muteValue(params: Params, sel: Selection): number {
  locate(params, sel);
  if (sel.path === 'root' || DEF_ROOT.test(sel.path)) return 0;
  const parent = findNode(params.density.defs, 'density', sel.path.slice(0, sel.path.lastIndexOf('.')));
  return MUTE_NEUTRAL.get(parent?.['op'] as string) ?? 0;
}

/** The mute toggle (§1.5): a muted tap loses its `mute`; an unmuted one gets `muteValue`. */
export function toggleMute(params: Params, sel: Selection): FormEdit {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (at.node['op'] !== 'tap') throw new RangeError(`form: only a tap can be muted (${sel.path})`);
  const m = muteValue(params, sel);
  return replaceNode(at, (old) => (Object.hasOwn(old, 'mute') ? withoutKey(old, 'mute') : withKey(old, 'mute', m)), sel.path);
}

/** Knots sorted by y (literal or the ref's current value), stably (§3.3: the table commits sorted). */
function sortKnots(params: Params, knots: readonly (readonly [unknown, unknown])[]): unknown[][] {
  return knots.map((k, i) => ({ k, y: currentNumber(params, k[0]), i }))
    .sort((a, b) => (a.y < b.y ? -1 : a.y > b.y ? 1 : a.i - b.i))
    .map(({ k }) => [k[0], k[1]]);
}

/** The slide table's commit: the knots sorted by y. */
export function setKnots(params: Params, sel: Selection, knots: readonly (readonly [NumberValue, NumberValue])[]): FormEdit {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (at.node['op'] !== 'slide') throw new RangeError(`form: ${sel.path} is not a slide`);
  return replaceNode(at, (old) => withKey(old, 'knots', sortKnots(params, knots)), sel.path);
}

/** Whether `key` is a numeric field of the node, and an int one. */
function numberField(at: Located, key: string): { int: boolean } | null {
  if (at.format === 'surfaceRules') {
    const kind = at.node['kind'] as string;
    const fields = Object.hasOwn(FIELDS, kind) ? (FIELDS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[kind]! : [];
    return fields.includes(key) && RULE_NUMBERS.has(key) ? { int: RULE_NUMBERS.get(key)! } : null;
  }
  const op = at.node['op'];
  if (key === 'v') return op === 'const' || op === 'param' ? { int: false } : null;
  if (key === 'lo' || key === 'hi') return op === 'clamp' || op === 'rangeChoice' ? { int: false } : null;
  if (key === 'mute') return op === 'tap' ? { int: false } : null;
  return op === 'slide' && KNOT_KEY.test(key) ? { int: false } : null;
}

/**
 * Sets a numeric field (§3.3 "Param ref"): a literal, or a ref to a target. On `const.v` (and a `param` node's `v`) a
 * target makes the node `{op: 'param', path}` and "literal" makes it `const(<current value>)`; elsewhere a target writes
 * `{param, neg?}` and "literal" without a value writes the field's current resolved value. A knot cell re-sorts the
 * knots. RangeError for a field the node does not have, or `neg` on `const.v`.
 */
export function setNumber(params: Params, sel: Selection, key: string, choice: NumberChoice): FormEdit {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  if (numberField(at, key) === null) throw new RangeError(`form: ${sel.path} has no numeric field ${key}`);
  if (at.format === 'density' && key === 'v') {
    if (choice.kind === 'param') {
      if (choice.neg === true) throw new RangeError('form: const.v takes no negated ref');
      return replaceNode(at, () => record([['op', 'param'], ['path', choice.path]]), sel.path);
    }
    const v = choice.value ?? (at.node['op'] === 'param' ? currentNumber(params, { param: at.node['path'] as string }) : (at.node['v'] as number));
    return replaceNode(at, () => record([['op', 'const'], ['v', v]]), sel.path);
  }
  const knot = KNOT_KEY.exec(key);
  const old = knot === null ? own(at.node, key) : (own(at.node, 'knots') as readonly (readonly unknown[])[])[Number(knot[1])]?.[Number(knot[2])];
  const next: NumberValue = choice.kind === 'param'
    ? (choice.neg === true ? { param: choice.path, neg: true } : { param: choice.path })
    : (choice.value ?? currentNumber(params, old));
  const written = isRef(next) ? record(Object.entries(next)) : next;
  if (knot === null) return replaceNode(at, (n) => withKey(n, key, written), sel.path);
  const knots = (own(at.node, 'knots') as readonly (readonly [unknown, unknown])[]).map((k, i) =>
    (i === Number(knot[1]) ? (knot[2] === '0' ? [written, k[1]] : [k[0], written]) : [k[0], k[1]]) as [unknown, unknown]);
  return replaceNode(at, (n) => withKey(n, 'knots', sortKnots(params, knots)), sel.path);
}

/** Sets a non-numeric field (a select, a boolean, a tap name, a biome list); RangeError for a numeric or unknown one. */
export function setField(params: Params, sel: Selection, key: string, value: string | boolean | readonly string[]): FormEdit {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  const fields = formFields(params, sel).filter((f) => f.type !== 'number' && f.type !== 'knots' && f.key !== 'defName');
  if (!fields.some((f) => f.key === key)) throw new RangeError(`form: ${sel.path} has no field ${key} to set`);
  return replaceNode(at, (old) => withKey(old, key, Array.isArray(value) ? [...value] : value), sel.path);
}

/** The form's controls for the selected node (§3.3): one per scalar, in table order. */
export function formFields(params: Params, sel: Selection): FormField[] {
  const at = locate(params, sel);
  const n = at.node;
  const num = (key: string, int: boolean, negatable = true): FormField =>
    ({ type: 'number', key, value: own(n, key) as NumberValue, current: currentNumber(params, own(n, key)), int, negatable });
  const sel1 = (key: string, options: readonly string[]): FormField => ({ type: 'select', key, value: String(own(n, key)), options });
  if (at.format === 'density') {
    const out: FormField[] = [];
    const def = DEF_ROOT.exec(sel.path);
    if (def !== null) out.push({ type: 'name', key: 'defName', value: def[1]! });
    switch (n['op']) {
      case 'const': out.push(num('v', false, false)); break;
      case 'param': {
        const path = String(own(n, 'path'));
        out.push({ type: 'number', key: 'v', value: { param: path }, current: currentNumber(params, { param: path }), int: false, negatable: false });
        break;
      }
      case 'col': out.push(sel1('field', COL_FIELD_OPTIONS)); break;
      case 'noise': case 'noise2': out.push(sel1('id', DENSITY_NOISE_OPTIONS[n['op']])); break;
      case 'clamp': case 'rangeChoice': out.push(num('lo', false), num('hi', false)); break;
      case 'slide': out.push({ type: 'knots', key: 'knots', value: own(n, 'knots') as readonly (readonly [NumberValue, NumberValue])[] }); break;
      case 'tap':
        out.push({ type: 'name', key: 'name', value: String(own(n, 'name')) });
        if (Object.hasOwn(n, 'mute')) out.push(num('mute', false));
        break;
      case 'ref': out.push(sel1('name', defNames(at.value))); break;
      default: break;
    }
    return out;
  }
  const kind = n['kind'] as string;
  const fields = Object.hasOwn(FIELDS, kind) ? (FIELDS as Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)[kind]! : [];
  return fields.filter((f) => !RULE_CHILD_FIELDS.has(f)).map((f): FormField => {
    if (RULE_NUMBERS.has(f)) return num(f, RULE_NUMBERS.get(f)!);
    if (typeof own(n, f) === 'boolean') return { type: 'boolean', key: f, value: own(n, f) as boolean };
    switch (f) {
      case 'biomes': return { type: 'biomes', key: 'biomes', value: own(n, f) as readonly string[], options: BIOME_OPTIONS };
      case 'state': return sel1('state', BLOCK_STATE_OPTIONS);
      case 'side': return sel1('side', SIDE_OPTIONS);
      case 'noise': return sel1('noise', SURFACE_NOISE_OPTIONS);
      default: return { type: 'boolean', key: f, value: own(n, f) === true };
    }
  });
}

function withLeafValue(params: Params, leaf: TreeLeaf, value: unknown): Params {
  if (leaf === 'density.defs') return { ...params, density: { ...params.density, defs: value as Params['density']['defs'] } };
  return { ...params, surface: { ...params.surface, rules: value as Params['surface']['rules'] } };
}

/**
 * Commits a form edit (§3.3): both tiers first (`checkLeafCandidate`, so an invalid tree is never sent), then one
 * `session.set('<leaf>', clone)`; a refusal returns the issues (node paths inside the leaf) and the caller keeps its
 * selection; success returns the edit's selection followed on the session's new tree.
 */
export function commitFormEdit(session: EditorSession, e: FormEdit): FormCommit {
  if (!e.ok) return e;
  const checked = checkLeafCandidate(session.state.params, e.leaf, e.value);
  if (checked.value === null) return { ok: false, issues: checked.issues };
  const r = session.set(e.leaf, checked.value);
  if (!r.ok) {
    const prefix = `${e.leaf}.`;
    return { ok: false, issues: r.issues.map((i) => ({ path: i.path === e.leaf ? '' : i.path.startsWith(prefix) ? i.path.slice(prefix.length) : i.path, code: i.code, message: i.message })) };
  }
  return { ok: true, select: followNode(session.state.params, e.select) };
}

/**
 * The two tree lints (§3.3) of the session's params: "no fast path" when the resolved rules have none, and "density
 * cost ≈ N × the default" when the resolved root's work cost exceeds LINT_COST_FACTOR × the default tree's at the
 * same params. A tree that does not resolve gets no lint (the session never holds one).
 */
export function treeLints(params: Params): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  try {
    const rules = resolveRules(params.surface.rules, params);
    if (surfaceFastPath(rules, surfaceDepthMax(params.surface.depthMul, params.surface.noises.depth.clampSigma)) === null) out.push(LINT_NO_FAST_PATH);
  } catch { /* not resolvable: no lint */ }
  try {
    const cost = workCost(resolveDensity(params.density.defs, params), params);
    const base = workCost(resolveDensity(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, params), params);
    if (cost > LINT_COST_FACTOR * base) out.push(densityCostLint(cost / base));
  } catch { /* not resolvable: no lint */ }
  return out;
}
```

- Ruling: replace op — children by position as §3.3 (old children in `SOURCE_CHILD_KEYS[oldOp]` order into the new op's slots; missing → `const 0`, `recip`'s → `const 1`; extra dropped); "missing scalars take the op's defaults" read as: a scalar is kept only when the old and new op both have it **with the same meaning**, i.e. `clamp` ↔ `rangeChoice` `lo`/`hi` (refs kept); everything else takes the defaults (`noise` ↔ `noise2` do not keep `id`, whose dims differ; `tap` ↔ `ref` do not keep `name`); `noise`/`noise2` default to the first schema noise of their dims (`overhang`, `jag`), `param` to the first target (`density.noises.jag.clampSigma`), `ref` to the first def in key order, `tap` to `tap<k>` (smallest unused k ≥ 1 over the root **and every def**, since tap names are unique tree-wide); choosing the current op is a no-op; the selection stays on the path. Rules kinds: `sequence` ↔ `condition` keep the child, a leaf becoming `condition` gets `then: sequence []`, `block` → `stone`; condition kinds take §3.3's defaults (no field carried over, e.g. `water` → `yAbove` gets minY 63), `not` wraps the old condition — cost if wrong: one table.
- Ruling: disabled options are exactly §3.3's two (`ref` while `defs` is empty; `recip` when the node's first child in evaluation order exists and is not a `const`/`param`; a childless node's `recip` gets `const 1` and is enabled); nothing is disabled for rules; any other invalid result (e.g. a nested `interpolated`) is left to the commit's tier-2 refusal — cost if wrong: more options greyed later.
- Ruling: wrap selects the wrapper (same path), add def selects `defs.def<k>`, add rule selects the new `…rules[n]`, rename def selects `defs.<to>`; delete in a rules sequence selects `followNode` of the old path on the candidate (the renumbered next sibling, else the parent sequence); `deleteNode` on the root or a `then` writes `sequence []`, on a `not` its operand, on a density one-child-slot op (`neg`, `abs`, `square`, `clamp`, `slide`, `interpolated`, `tap`, `recip`) its child, else `const 0` — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: numeric fields — density `const.v` (and a `param` node's, shown as field `v` holding `{param}`, not negatable), `clamp`/`rangeChoice` `lo`/`hi`, `tap.mute` (shown only while muted), knot cells `knots[i][j]`; rules the nine fields, int = `offset`, `minY`, `trueAtAndBelow`, `falseAtAndAbove`. "literal" without a value writes the field's **current resolved value** (`getPath` of the target, `0 − v` with `neg`); `refOptions(params, int)` lists `ALLOWED_REF_TARGETS` in schema order with current values, int fields only `surface.lapseBase` and `surface.cliffMinY`; a non-int target forced into an int field is refused at commit by tier 2's `PARAM_KIND`. The target's slider (§3.3 "moving it sets the target leaf") is not in form.ts: Task 25's DOM shows the parameter panel's row for the field's `value.param` and calls `session.set(targetPath, v)` directly — cost if wrong: one helper.
- Ruling: knots are sorted by y on **every** knot commit, the table's (`setKnots`) and a single cell's (`setNumber` on `knots[i][0|1]`), by the y's current value (a ref by its target's current value), stably; equal y are kept in order and left to tier 2's `KNOTS_ORDER`; fewer than 2 knots are left to `KNOTS_SHAPE` — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: the mute toggle's value is the neutral value of the tap's parent op found from the path (the node one `.key` up): `add` 0, `mul` 1, `max` −1e6, `min` 1e6, any other parent (one-child ops, `rangeChoice`, `clamp`, `slide`, `interpolated`, another `tap`) 0, and 0 at `root` and at a def's top; toggling a muted tap removes `mute`; the mute value then edits as a numeric field (ref or literal) — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: lints run on the session's params (the tree as a whole, §3.3): "no fast path: every solid voxel is evaluated" when `surfaceFastPath(resolveRules(rules, params), surfaceDepthMax(depthMul, depth clampSigma)) === null` (null-ness does not depend on SD_MAX); "density cost ≈ N × the default" when `workCost(resolveDensity(defs, params), params)` > 4 × `workCost(resolveDensity(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, params), params)` — the default at the **same** params, so a noise-octave slider moves both — with N rounded to one decimal; a tree that does not resolve gets no lint (the session never holds one). The factor 4 and the strings are form.ts constants (UI-only) — cost if wrong: wording, one constant.
- Ruling: `BLOCK_STATE_OPTIONS` = the registry's colliding states in registry order (24 of today's 25 states: all but `air`), the select a `block` rule shows (§3.3 "a select of the colliding registry states"); `bandlands` stays a kind, not a state — cost if wrong: none.
- MEASUREMENT: density cost lint boundary on `interpolated(add of k overhang noises)` = 1 + 8 × (17k − 1): k = 16 → 2,169 (3.8 × 569, no lint), k = 20 → 2,713 (4.8 ×, "density cost ≈ 4.8 × the default") (`inspectorForm.test.ts`).

```ts
/**
 * The slice viewer's drawing model (SP3d spec §4.3, §4.1 field select, §3.7 first show, §6 `sliceModel.test.ts`): the
 * diverging colormap (auto and fixed scale, s = 0 drawn white with "constant 0", the fixed scale's accepted range), the
 * 0-level contour by marching squares, the 64-bin histogram with nearest-rank p1/p50/p99, sd and % < 0 against
 * hand-computed values (incl. p1 = p99), the field select and `selected`'s resolution, `initialSliceState` and the
 * vertical empty state, and the model's use of the geometry (Task 11's `gen/inspect/fieldSlice.ts` functions and
 * metrics' `segmentPointAt`; the formulas themselves are pinned by `fieldSliceGeometry.test.ts`, not re-derived here).
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { WINDOW_HALF } from '../../src/core/coords';
import { horizontalCoord, sliceRowY, sliceSampleVoxel, squareProblem } from '../../src/gen/inspect/fieldSlice';
import { segmentPointAt, segmentProblem, type Segment } from '../../src/metrics/crossSection';
import { voxelRgb } from '../../src/ui/crossSection/voxels';
import type { Selection } from '../../src/ui/inspector/model';
import {
  autoScale, blocksLegend, blocksRgba, clampCentre, contourSegments, divergingRgb, FIELD_CHOICES, fieldOptions, formatSliceValue,
  histogram, histogramLabels, imageOrder, initialSliceState, levelLine, NO_LINE_TEXT, parseScale, pixelSample, pixelVoxel,
  ruleRgba, ruleShare, ruleShareText, resolveField, SCALE_MAX, SLICE_BLUE, SLICE_DEFAULT_EXTENT, SLICE_DEFAULT_Y, SLICE_GREY,
  SLICE_RED, SLICE_WHITE, RULE_NA, RULE_OFF, RULE_ON, scaleOf, sliceAxisLabels, sliceEmptyText, sliceGeometryOf, sliceRgba,
  sliceStats, type SliceState,
} from '../../src/ui/inspector/sliceModel';
import { WATER_SOURCE } from '../../src/world/blocks/fluid';
import { AIR, REGISTRY, STONE } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';

const W = WINDOW_HALF;
const pixel = (img: Uint8ClampedArray, i: number): number[] => [img[4 * i]!, img[4 * i + 1]!, img[4 * i + 2]!, img[4 * i + 3]!];
const rgb = (img: Uint8ClampedArray, i: number): number[] => pixel(img, i).slice(0, 3);
const DENSITY_SEL: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.a.x' };
const RULE_SEL: Selection = { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[1]' };
const LINE: Segment = { ax: -1664, az: 8, bx: -640, bz: 8 };
const DIAG: Segment = { ax: -27136.5, az: -31992.25, bx: -26113.75, bz: -31000.5 };

describe('colormap', () => {
  test('diverging and centred on 0: blue below, white at 0, red above, linear in v / s clamped to [-1, 1]', () => {
    expect(divergingRgb(0, 1)).toEqual(SLICE_WHITE);
    expect(divergingRgb(-0, 1)).toEqual(SLICE_WHITE);
    expect(divergingRgb(1, 1)).toEqual(SLICE_RED);
    expect(divergingRgb(-1, 1)).toEqual(SLICE_BLUE);
    expect(divergingRgb(250, 2)).toEqual(SLICE_RED);
    expect(divergingRgb(-1e300, 2)).toEqual(SLICE_BLUE);
    // Halfway: the white–end average per channel, rounded.
    const half = (end: readonly number[]) => end.map((c) => Math.round(255 + (c - 255) * 0.5));
    expect(divergingRgb(2, 4)).toEqual(half(SLICE_RED));
    expect(divergingRgb(-2, 4)).toEqual(half(SLICE_BLUE));
    const quarter = (end: readonly number[]) => end.map((c) => Math.round(255 + (c - 255) * 0.25));
    expect(divergingRgb(0.25, 1)).toEqual(quarter(SLICE_RED));
  });

  test('s = 0 draws every sample white; a non-finite value is grey whatever the scale', () => {
    for (const v of [0, 5, -5, 1e100]) expect(divergingRgb(v, 0)).toEqual(SLICE_WHITE);
    for (const v of [NaN, Infinity, -Infinity]) {
      expect(divergingRgb(v, 1)).toEqual(SLICE_GREY);
      expect(divergingRgb(v, 0)).toEqual(SLICE_GREY);
    }
  });

  test('the fixed scale is accepted when finite and in (0, 1e100]', () => {
    expect(SCALE_MAX).toBe(1e100);
    expect(parseScale('2')).toBe(2);
    expect(parseScale(' 0.5 ')).toBe(0.5);
    expect(parseScale('1e100')).toBe(1e100);
    expect(parseScale('5e-324')).toBe(5e-324);
    for (const t of ['', ' ', '0', '-0', '-1', '1e101', 'Infinity', 'NaN', 'abc', '1e999']) expect(parseScale(t)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('the auto scale is max(|p1|, |p99|) of the finite values; a fixed scale replaces it', () => {
    const v = Float64Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => i - 89); // -89 … 10
    const st = sliceStats(v)!;
    expect([st.p1, st.p99]).toEqual([-89, 9]);
    expect(autoScale(st)).toBe(89);
    expect(scaleOf(st, null)).toBe(89);
    expect(scaleOf(st, 4)).toBe(4);
    expect(autoScale(null)).toBe(0);
    expect(scaleOf(null, null)).toBe(0);
  });

  test('a constant 0 field (a tap muted to 0): auto scale 0, every pixel white, the histogram says "constant 0"', () => {
    const n = 32;
    const v = new Float64Array(n * n);
    const st = sliceStats(v)!;
    expect(autoScale(st)).toBe(0);
    const img = sliceRgba(v, n, 'vertical', scaleOf(st, null));
    for (let i = 0; i < n * n; i++) expect(pixel(img, i)).toEqual([...SLICE_WHITE, 255]);
    expect(histogramLabels(st)).toEqual(['constant 0']);
  });

  test('the image is in plane order and draws a non-finite sample grey', () => {
    const n = 2;
    // Sample (c, k) at c·n + k. Vertical: c is the pixel column, k the row; horizontal: c is the row (z), k the column (x).
    const v = Float64Array.from([1, NaN, -1, 0]);
    const vert = sliceRgba(v, n, 'vertical', 1);
    expect([rgb(vert, 0), rgb(vert, 1), rgb(vert, 2), rgb(vert, 3)]).toEqual([SLICE_RED, SLICE_BLUE, SLICE_GREY, SLICE_WHITE]);
    const hor = sliceRgba(v, n, 'horizontal', 1);
    expect([rgb(hor, 0), rgb(hor, 1), rgb(hor, 2), rgb(hor, 3)]).toEqual([SLICE_RED, SLICE_GREY, SLICE_BLUE, SLICE_WHITE]);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) expect(vert[4 * i + 3]).toBe(255);
  });

  test('imageOrder transposes a vertical plane and keeps a horizontal one', () => {
    const v = Uint16Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => i);
    expect(Array.from(imageOrder(v, 3, 'vertical'))).toEqual([0, 3, 6, 1, 4, 7, 2, 5, 8]);
    expect(imageOrder(v, 3, 'vertical')).toBeInstanceOf(Uint16Array);
    expect(imageOrder(v, 3, 'horizontal')).toBe(v);
    expect(() => imageOrder(v, 4, 'vertical')).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});

describe('contour (marching squares on the sample grid, the 0 level: solid when v > 0)', () => {
  // Grids in image order (row-major, row 0 at the top); sample (px, py)'s centre at (px + 0.5, py + 0.5).
  const img = (rows: number[][]): Float64Array => Float64Array.from(rows.flat());

  test('one cell: the crossing is linear between the two samples of an edge', () => {
    expect(contourSegments(img([[-1, 1], [-1, 1]]), 2)).toEqual([[1, 0.5, 1, 1.5]]);
    expect(contourSegments(img([[-1, 3], [-1, 3]]), 2)).toEqual([[0.75, 0.5, 0.75, 1.5]]);
    expect(contourSegments(img([[1, 1], [-1, -3]]), 2)).toEqual([[0.5, 1, 1.5, 0.75]]);
    // One solid corner (top left): left edge to top edge.
    expect(contourSegments(img([[1, -1], [-1, -1]]), 2)).toEqual([[0.5, 1, 1, 0.5]]);
    // 0 is not solid: the crossing sits on the 0 sample.
    expect(contourSegments(img([[0, 2], [0, 2]]), 2)).toEqual([[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.5]]);
  });

  test('no segment on a uniform cell; a non-finite sample is not solid and crosses at the midpoint', () => {
    expect(contourSegments(img([[1, 2], [3, 4]]), 2)).toEqual([]);
    expect(contourSegments(img([[-1, 0], [-3, -4]]), 2)).toEqual([]);
    expect(contourSegments(img([[NaN, 1], [NaN, 1]]), 2)).toEqual([[1, 0.5, 1, 1.5]]);
    expect(contourSegments(img([[Infinity, -1], [-1, -1]]), 2)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('saddles are decided by the mean of the four samples', () => {
    // Top left and bottom right solid; mean 0 (not solid): the two solid corners are cut off.
    expect(contourSegments(img([[1, -1], [-1, 1]]), 2)).toEqual([[0.5, 1, 1, 0.5], [1, 1.5, 1.5, 1]]);
    // Mean 1: the solid corners join and the two air corners are cut off.
    expect(contourSegments(img([[3, -1], [-1, 3]]), 2)).toEqual([[1.25, 0.5, 1.5, 0.75], [0.5, 1.25, 0.75, 1.5]]);
    // The other diagonal.
    expect(contourSegments(img([[-1, 1], [1, -1]]), 2)).toEqual([[1, 0.5, 1.5, 1], [0.5, 1, 1, 1.5]]);
    expect(contourSegments(img([[-1, 3], [3, -1]]), 2)).toEqual([[0.5, 0.75, 0.75, 0.5], [1.25, 1.5, 1.5, 1.25]]);
  });

  test('a vertical plane solid below y 100 gives one horizontal line of n − 1 segments between the rows around y 100', () => {
    const n = 32;
    const v = new Float64Array(n * n);
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) v[c * n + k] = 100 - sliceRowY(k, n);
    const segs = contourSegments(imageOrder(v, n, 'vertical'), n);
    expect(segs.length).toBe(n - 1);
    const r = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => k).findIndex((k) => 100 - sliceRowY(k, n) > 0); // first solid row
    const above = 100 - sliceRowY(r - 1, n);
    const below = 100 - sliceRowY(r, n);
    const y = r - 1 + 0.5 + above / (above - below);
    for (const [i, s] of segs.entries()) expect(s).toEqual([i + 0.5, y, i + 1.5, y]);
  });

  test('a 3 × 3 grid with one solid centre gives a closed diamond of four segments', () => {
    const segs = contourSegments(img([[-1, -1, -1], [-1, 1, -1], [-1, -1, -1]]), 3);
    expect(segs.length).toBe(4);
    const pts = new Set(segs.flatMap(([x0, y0, x1, y1]) => [`${x0},${y0}`, `${x1},${y1}`]));
    expect([...pts].sort()).toEqual(['1,1.5', '1.5,1', '1.5,2', '2,1.5']);
  });
});

describe('histogram', () => {
  test('nearest-rank percentiles, population sd and % < 0 over 1 … 100 (shuffled)', () => {
    const v = Float64Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => ((i * 37) % 100) + 1);
    const st = sliceStats(v)!;
    expect(st).toEqual({ count: 100, nonFinite: 0, p1: 1, p50: 50, p99: 99, mean: 50.5, sd: Math.sqrt(833.25), below0: 0 });
    const h = histogram(v, st);
    expect([h.lo, h.hi, h.counts.length]).toEqual([1, 99, 64]);
    expect(h.counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)).toBe(100);
    // Bin b holds v with ⌊(v − 1) / 98 · 64⌋ = b (bins 1.53 wide; 100 falls in the end bin): bin 0 holds 1, 2; bin 1 3, 4;
    // bin 62 96, 97; bin 63 98, 99 and 100.
    expect([h.counts[0], h.counts[1], h.counts[62], h.counts[63]]).toEqual([2, 2, 2, 3]);

    expect(h.counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)).toBe(5);

    const sw = sliceStats(w)!;
```
