Create `src/ui/inspector/densityTab.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The drawer's Density tab (SP3d spec §3.1-§3.3, §3.5, D18): a grid `220px | 280px | minmax(0, 1fr) | minmax(0, 1.2fr)`
 * of **tree | node form | JSON editor | slice viewer**. Below 1,200 px of drawer width the last two share one column with
 * the sub-tabs "Slice" (shown first) and "JSON"; below 900 px the columns stack (tree, form, then the sub-tabs). The
 * mode follows the tab's own width (`densityLayout`, a ResizeObserver), not the viewport.
 * - Tree (§3.2): the rows of `inspectorTree` for both roots, re-rendered only when its key string changes; a row's
 *   toggle expands it, its button selects it, a tap row carries the mute toggle (a plain edit: the selection stays,
 *   `selectionAfterCommit`); "Expand to selection" opens the selected node's ancestors.
 * - Node form (§3.3): the selected node's op or kind (options that cannot validate disabled), its actions (wrap, delete,
 *   add rule, add def, mute), one control per scalar (`formFields`): a numeric field has the select "literal / <targets>",
 *   the literal's text field (read as the panel's `valueField` reads it: `setTypedNumber`), "negate" outside `const.v`,
 *   and while it is a ref the parameter panel's slider of the target (`createTargetRow`, which sets the target leaf);
 *   slide knots are a two-column table with add and remove. Each
 *   edit is one `commitFormEdit` (one `session.set` of the leaf through the page's `edit` wrapper, one undo step); a
 *   refusal keeps the control red with the issue lines under the form and the selection as it was. The form also shows
 *   the selected node's value at the hovered voxel (fed by the page, `setHoverValue`) and the two tree lints.
 * - JSON editor (§3.5): `jsonEditor.ts` bound to the selected root's `editorModel` (one per leaf, so a root switch never
 *   mixes buffers). A row's selection highlights its node's text and scrolls to it; the caret selects the innermost node
 *   holding it only while the buffer is clean or parses and the path is in the session's tree (`caretTarget`), else it
 *   moves only the editor's highlight.
 * - The slice viewer's cell is `sliceHost`; mounting the viewer and the tab on the page is the page's (`mapPage.ts`).
 * Hidden drawer tabs keep their DOM, so selection, expansion and the buffers survive a switch; the scroll offsets of the
 * tree, the form and the text are saved when the tab is hidden and restored when it is shown (`setShown`). Every
 * selection follows the session (`followNode`) after undo, redo, reset or a renumbering edit. Text only through
 * `textContent`. DOM only: the rules are in model.ts, form.ts, editorModel.ts and jsonText.ts.
 */
import './inspector.css';
import type { SessionState, WorldSession } from '../../engine/session';
import type { Params } from '../../core/params/schema';
import { el } from '../common/dom';
import { createTargetRow } from '../paramPanel/controls';
import { createEditorModel, issueText, TREE_LEAVES, type EditorClock, type EditorIssue, type EditorModel, type EditorState, type TreeLeaf } from './editorModel';
import {
  addDef, addRule, commitFormEdit, currentNumber, deleteNode, formActions, formFields, opOptions, refOptions, renameDef, replaceOp,
  selectionAfterCommit, setField, setKnots, setNumber, setTypedNumber, toggleMute, treeLints, wrapNode, type FormCommit, type FormEdit,
  type FormField, type NumberChoice, type NumberValue,
} from './form';
import { createJsonEditor, type JsonEditorView } from './jsonEditor';
import { pathRange, type TextRange } from './jsonText';
import {
  caretTarget, DEFAULT_SELECTION, DEFAULT_SUB_TAB, DENSITY_SUB_TAB_LABELS, DENSITY_SUB_TABS, densityLayout, expandToSelection, followNode,
  highlightRange, inspectorTree, NO_EXPANSION, shownPanes, toggleExpansion, type DensityLayout, type DensitySubTab, type Expansion,
  type Selection, type TreeRow,
} from './model';

export interface DensityTabDeps {
  readonly session: WorldSession;
  /** Runs a session call caused by the input event `e`, so the preview latency counts from `e.timeStamp`. */
  edit(e: Event, fn: () => void): void;
  /** The JSON editor's debounce clock (default: the window's timers). */
  readonly clock?: EditorClock;
}

export interface DensityTab {
  readonly element: HTMLElement;
  /** The slice viewer's cell (the page mounts `sliceView` here). */
  readonly sliceHost: HTMLElement;
  /** The selected node: its root (tree leaf) and node path. */
  readonly selection: Selection;
  /** Selects a node (the parameter panel's link selects a root), opening its ancestors and scrolling the text to it. */
  select(sel: Selection): void;
  /** Called after every selection change; returns the unsubscribe function. */
  onSelect(fn: (sel: Selection) => void): () => void;
  /** The node form's "value at the hover" line (§3.6), or null to hide it. */
  setHoverValue(text: string | null): void;
  /** The drawer shows or hides the tab: scroll offsets are saved on hide and restored on show; a hidden tab skips renders. */
  setShown(shown: boolean): void;
  dispose(): void;
}

type NumberField = Extract<FormField, { type: 'number' }>;

const sameSelection = (a: Selection, b: Selection): boolean => a.leaf === b.leaf && a.path === b.path;
/** A number as the form writes it (−0 as `-0`, which tier 1 then refuses: §3.5 never normalises it). */
const numberText = (v: number): string => (Object.is(v, -0) ? '-0' : String(v));
/** A key string of form data (−0 kept apart from 0). */
const keyOf = (v: unknown): string => JSON.stringify(v, (_, x: unknown) => (Object.is(x, -0) ? '-0' : x));
const isRefValue = (v: NumberValue): v is Exclude<NumberValue, number> => typeof v !== 'number';

const windowClock: EditorClock = {
  setTimeout: (fn, ms) => window.setTimeout(fn, ms),
  clearTimeout: (id) => window.clearTimeout(id),
};

export function createDensityTab(host: HTMLElement, deps: DensityTabDeps): DensityTab {
  const { session } = deps;
  const params = (): Params => session.state.params;
  let selection: Selection = DEFAULT_SELECTION;
  let expansion: Expansion = NO_EXPANSION;
  /** A node path the typed buffer has and the session's tree does not: highlighted, never selected (§3.2). */
  let bufferHighlight: string | null = null;
  let layout: DensityLayout = 'grid';
  let subTab: DensitySubTab = DEFAULT_SUB_TAB;
  let shown = true;
  let stale = false;
  let saved: { tree: number; form: number } | null = null;
  const listeners = new Set<(sel: Selection) => void>();
  const editors = new Map<TreeLeaf, EditorModel>(TREE_LEAVES.map((leaf) => [leaf, createEditorModel(leaf, session, deps.clock ?? windowClock)]));

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- DOM
  const element = el('div', 'it');
  const treePane = el('nav', 'it-tree');
  treePane.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Tree nodes');
  const formPane = el('div', 'it-form');
  const subBar = el('div', 'it-subtabs');
  subBar.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');
  const jsonPane = el('div', 'it-json');
  const sliceHost = el('div', 'it-slice');
  element.append(treePane, formPane, subBar, jsonPane, sliceHost);
  host.append(element);

  const button = (label: string, tip: string, run: (e: MouseEvent) => void, cls = ''): HTMLButtonElement => {
    const b = el('button', cls, label);
    b.type = 'button';
    b.title = tip;
    b.addEventListener('click', run);
    return b;
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- layout and sub-tabs
  /** The JSON editor (created below, after the first layout). */
  let jsonView: JsonEditorView | null = null;
  const subButtons = new Map<DensitySubTab, HTMLButtonElement>();
  for (const id of DENSITY_SUB_TABS) {
    const b = button(DENSITY_SUB_TAB_LABELS[id], `Show the ${DENSITY_SUB_TAB_LABELS[id]} pane`, () => { subTab = id; applyLayout(); });
    b.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
    subButtons.set(id, b);
    subBar.append(b);
  }
  const applyLayout = (): void => {
    const panes = shownPanes(layout, subTab);
    // The JSON text keeps its scroll across a sub-tab or layout switch, and gets the scroll owed while it was hidden
    // (a row selected under the Slice sub-tab scrolls the text when JSON is shown: jsonEditor's restoreScroll).
    if (!panes.json && !jsonPane.hidden) jsonView?.saveScroll();
    element.dataset['layout'] = layout;
    subBar.hidden = !panes.subTabs;
    jsonPane.hidden = !panes.json;
    sliceHost.hidden = !panes.slice;
    for (const [id, b] of subButtons) b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(id === subTab));
    if (panes.json) jsonView?.restoreScroll();
  };
  const resize = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    const next = densityLayout(element.getBoundingClientRect().width, layout);
    if (next !== layout) { layout = next; applyLayout(); }
  });
  resize.observe(element);
  applyLayout();

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tree
  const treeHead = el('div', 'it-tree-head');
  treeHead.append(button('Expand to selection', "Open the selected node's ancestors", () => {
    expansion = expandToSelection(params(), expansion, selection);
    renderTree();
  }));
  const treeRows = el('div', 'it-rows');
  treePane.append(treeHead, treeRows);
  let treeKey = '';

  const rowElement = (r: TreeRow): HTMLElement => {
    const row = el('div', `it-row${r.dimmed ? ' it-dimmed' : ''}${r.muted ? ' it-muted' : ''}`);
    row.style.paddingLeft = `${r.indent}px`;
    row.title = r.title;
    const toggle = el('button', 'it-toggle', r.expandable ? (r.expanded ? '▾' : '▸') : '');
    toggle.type = 'button';
    toggle.tabIndex = -1;
    toggle.disabled = !r.expandable;
    if (r.expandable) toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', `${r.expanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'} ${r.title}`);
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      expansion = toggleExpansion(expansion, r.leaf, r.path, r.depth);
      renderTree();
    });
    const node = el('button', 'it-node');
    node.type = 'button';
    node.append(el('span', 'it-tail', r.tail), el('span', 'it-summary', r.summary));
    if (r.selected) node.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
    node.addEventListener('click', () => choose({ leaf: r.leaf, path: r.path }, true));
    row.append(toggle, node);
    if (r.tap) {
      const mute = el('input', 'it-mute');
      mute.type = 'checkbox';
      mute.checked = r.muted;
      mute.title = r.muted ? 'Unmute this tap' : "Mute this tap: the neutral value of its parent replaces its subtree";
      mute.setAttribute('aria-label', `mute ${r.title}`);
      const at: Selection = { leaf: r.leaf, path: r.path };
      mute.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => toggleMute(params(), at), r.leaf, () => { mute.checked = r.muted; }, 'row'));
      row.append(mute);
    }
    return row;
  };

  function renderTree(): void {
    const t = inspectorTree(params(), expansion, selection);
    if (t.key === treeKey) return;
    treeKey = t.key;
    treeRows.replaceChildren(...t.groups.flatMap((g) => [el('div', 'it-group', g.label), ...g.rows.map(rowElement)]));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- node form
  const formHead = el('div', 'it-form-head');
  const formActionsBox = el('div', 'it-actions');
  const formFieldsBox = el('div', 'it-fields');
  const hoverLine = el('div', 'it-hover');
  hoverLine.hidden = true;
  const formIssues = el('div', 'it-issues');
  formIssues.hidden = true;
  const lintBox = el('div', 'it-lints');
  lintBox.hidden = true;
  formPane.append(formHead, formActionsBox, formFieldsBox, hoverLine, formIssues, lintBox);
  let formKey = '';
  /** What each control refreshes on a session change that keeps the form's structure (ref labels, target sliders). */
  let syncs: ((s: SessionState) => void)[] = [];
  let lintKey: readonly unknown[] = [];

  const showIssues = (issues: readonly EditorIssue[] | null, leaf: TreeLeaf): void => {
    formIssues.textContent = issues === null ? '' : issues.map((i) => issueText(i, leaf)).join('\n');
    formIssues.hidden = issues === null || issues.length === 0;
  };

  /**
   * One edit committed through the page's `edit` (§3.3); a refusal shows its issues and runs `failed`. A success selects
   * the node the edit returns, except a tree row's mute (`source` 'row'), which keeps the selection (§3.2).
   */
  function commit(e: Event, make: () => FormEdit, leaf: TreeLeaf, failed: () => void = () => {}, source: 'form' | 'row' = 'form'): boolean {
    const out: { r?: FormCommit } = {};
    deps.edit(e, () => { out.r = commitFormEdit(session, make()); });
    const r = out.r;
    if (r === undefined) throw new Error('edit did not run the form commit');
    if (!r.ok) {
      showIssues(r.issues, leaf);
      failed();
      return false;
    }
    showIssues(null, leaf);
    setSelection(selectionAfterCommit(source, selection, r.select), false);
    return true;
  }

  const fieldRow = (label: string, ...controls: HTMLElement[]): HTMLElement => {
    const row = el('div', 'it-field');
    row.append(el('span', 'it-name', label), ...controls);
    return row;
  };

  const invalid = (input: HTMLElement, on: boolean): void => {
    input.classList.toggle('it-invalid', on);
    if (on) input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    else input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
  };

  /** A text field that commits on change (Enter or blur) and restores its text on Escape. */
  const textField = (value: string, label: string, write: (text: string) => FormEdit, leaf: TreeLeaf): HTMLInputElement => {
    const input = el('input', 'it-input');
    input.type = 'text';
    input.spellcheck = false;
    input.autocomplete = 'off';
    input.value = value;
    input.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
    input.addEventListener('change', (e) => { invalid(input, !commit(e, () => write(input.value), leaf)); });
    input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      e.preventDefault();
      input.value = value;
      invalid(input, false);
    });
    return input;
  };

  /** A numeric field (§3.3 "Param ref"): literal or a target, "negate", and the target's slider while it is a ref. */
  const numberControl = (f: NumberField, label: string): HTMLElement => {
    const sel = selection;
    const ref = isRefValue(f.value) ? f.value : null;
    const choice = el('select', 'it-ref');
    choice.setAttribute('aria-label', `${label}: a literal or a parameter`);
    choice.append(new Option('literal', ''));
    const targets = refOptions(params(), f.int);
    for (const o of targets) choice.append(new Option(o.label, o.path));
    choice.value = ref === null ? '' : ref.param;
    const literal = textField(typeof f.value === 'number' ? numberText(f.value) : '', label,
      (text) => setTypedNumber(params(), sel, f.key, text), sel.leaf);
    literal.hidden = ref !== null;
    const neg = el('input');
    neg.type = 'checkbox';
    neg.checked = ref?.neg === true;
    const negLabel = el('label', 'it-check', ' negate');
    negLabel.prepend(neg);
    negLabel.hidden = ref === null || !f.negatable;
    const pick = (path: string, negated: boolean): NumberChoice =>
      (path === '' ? { kind: 'literal' } : negated && f.negatable ? { kind: 'param', path, neg: true } : { kind: 'param', path });
    choice.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => setNumber(params(), sel, f.key, pick(choice.value, neg.checked)), sel.leaf, () => {
      choice.value = ref === null ? '' : ref.param;
    }));
    neg.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => setNumber(params(), sel, f.key, pick(choice.value, neg.checked)), sel.leaf, () => {
      neg.checked = !neg.checked;
    }));
    const row = fieldRow(label, choice, literal, negLabel);
    row.classList.add('it-number');
    const target = ref === null ? null : createTargetRow({ session, edit: deps.edit }, ref.param);
    if (target !== null) {
      target.element.classList.add('it-target');
      row.append(target.element);
    }
    syncs.push((s) => {
      refOptions(s.params, f.int).forEach((o, i) => { const opt = choice.options[i + 1]; if (opt !== undefined) opt.text = o.label; });
      target?.sync(s);
    });
    return row;
  };

  const selectControl = (key: string, value: string, options: readonly string[], write: (v: string) => FormEdit, leaf: TreeLeaf): HTMLSelectElement => {
    const s = el('select', 'it-select');
    s.setAttribute('aria-label', key);
    for (const o of options) s.append(new Option(o, o));
    if (!options.includes(value)) s.append(new Option(value, value));
    s.value = value;
    s.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => write(s.value), leaf, () => { s.value = value; }));
    return s;
  };

  const knotsControl = (f: Extract<FormField, { type: 'knots' }>): HTMLElement => {
    const sel = selection;
    const box = el('div', 'it-knots');
    box.append(el('span', 'it-name', 'knots'));
    const table = el('div', 'it-knot-table');
    const knotsNow = (): readonly (readonly [NumberValue, NumberValue])[] => {
      const k = formFields(params(), sel).find((x) => x.type === 'knots');
      return k?.type === 'knots' ? k.value : [];
    };
    f.value.forEach((knot, i) => {
      const cell = (j: 0 | 1): HTMLElement => numberControl({
        type: 'number', key: `knots[${String(i)}][${String(j)}]`, value: knot[j], current: currentNumber(params(), knot[j]), int: false, negatable: true,
      }, j === 0 ? `y ${String(i)}` : `v ${String(i)}`);
      const remove = button('×', `Remove knot ${String(i)}`, (e) => commit(e, () => setKnots(params(), sel, knotsNow().filter((_, j) => j !== i)), sel.leaf), 'it-remove');
      const row = el('div', 'it-knot');
      row.append(cell(0), cell(1), remove);
      table.append(row);
    });
    const add = button('Add knot', 'Append a knot one block above the last', (e) => commit(e, () => {
      const k = knotsNow();
      const last = k.at(-1);
      const next: [number, number] = last === undefined ? [0, 0] : [currentNumber(params(), last[0]) + 1, currentNumber(params(), last[1])];
      return setKnots(params(), sel, [...k, next]);
    }, sel.leaf));
    box.append(table, add);
    return box;
  };

  const biomesControl = (f: Extract<FormField, { type: 'biomes' }>): HTMLElement => {
    const sel = selection;
    const s = el('select', 'it-biomes');
    s.multiple = true;
    s.size = Math.min(8, f.options.length);
    s.setAttribute('aria-label', 'biomes');
    for (const o of f.options) {
      const opt = new Option(o, o);
      opt.selected = f.value.includes(o);
      s.append(opt);
    }
    s.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => setField(params(), sel, 'biomes', [...s.selectedOptions].map((o) => o.value)), sel.leaf, () => {
      for (const opt of s.options) opt.selected = f.value.includes(opt.value);
    }));
    return fieldRow('biomes', s);
  };

  const controlOf = (f: FormField): HTMLElement => {
    const sel = selection;
    switch (f.type) {
      case 'number': return numberControl(f, f.key);
      case 'select': return fieldRow(f.key, selectControl(f.key, f.value, f.options, (v) => setField(params(), sel, f.key, v), sel.leaf));
      case 'boolean': {
        const c = el('input');
        c.type = 'checkbox';
        c.checked = f.value;
        c.setAttribute('aria-label', f.key);
        c.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => setField(params(), sel, f.key, c.checked), sel.leaf, () => { c.checked = f.value; }));
        return fieldRow(f.key, c);
      }
      case 'name': {
        const write = f.key === 'defName'
          ? (text: string) => renameDef(params(), f.value, text)
          : (text: string) => setField(params(), sel, f.key, text);
        return fieldRow(f.key === 'defName' ? 'def name' : f.key, textField(f.value, f.key, write, sel.leaf));
      }
      case 'knots': return knotsControl(f);
      case 'biomes': return biomesControl(f);
    }
  };

  function buildForm(): void {
    const p = params();
    const sel = selection;
    const fields = formFields(p, sel);
    const ops = opOptions(p, sel);
    const actions = formActions(p, sel);
    const key = keyOf([sel, fields.map((f) => (f.type === 'number' ? { ...f, current: 0 } : f)), ops, actions]);
    if (key === formKey) return;
    formKey = key;
    syncs = [];
    const density = sel.leaf === 'density.defs';
    const path = el('div', 'it-path', `${sel.leaf}.${sel.path}`);
    path.title = `${sel.leaf}.${sel.path}`;
    const op = el('select', 'it-op');
    op.setAttribute('aria-label', density ? 'op' : 'kind');
    for (const o of ops) {
      const opt = new Option(o.op, o.op);
      opt.disabled = o.disabled;
      op.append(opt);
    }
    const current = ops.find((o) => o.current)?.op ?? '';
    op.value = current;
    op.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => replaceOp(params(), sel, op.value), sel.leaf, () => { op.value = current; }));
    formHead.replaceChildren(path, fieldRow(density ? 'op' : 'kind', op));
    const acts: HTMLElement[] = [];
    if (actions.wrap) acts.push(button('Wrap', density ? 'Wrap the node in a tap with a fresh name' : 'Wrap the rule in a one-child sequence', (e) => commit(e, () => wrapNode(params(), sel), sel.leaf)));
    if (actions.delete) acts.push(button('Delete', 'Delete the node (one-child nodes are unwrapped)', (e) => commit(e, () => deleteNode(params(), sel), sel.leaf)));
    if (actions.addRule) acts.push(button('Add rule', 'Append a block stone rule to this sequence', (e) => commit(e, () => addRule(params(), sel), sel.leaf)));
    if (density) acts.push(button('Add def', 'Add a def (const 0) and select it', (e) => commit(e, () => addDef(params()), 'density.defs')));
    if (actions.mute) {
      const muted = fields.some((f) => f.key === 'mute');
      const mute = el('input');
      mute.type = 'checkbox';
      mute.checked = muted;
      const label = el('label', 'it-check', ' muted');
      label.prepend(mute);
      label.title = 'A muted tap evaluates to its mute value (the neutral value of its parent at first)';
      mute.addEventListener('change', (e) => commit(e, () => toggleMute(params(), sel), sel.leaf, () => { mute.checked = muted; }));
      acts.push(label);
    }
    formActionsBox.replaceChildren(...acts);
    formFieldsBox.replaceChildren(...fields.map(controlOf));
  }

  function renderForm(s: SessionState): void {
    buildForm();
    for (const sync of syncs) sync(s);
    const k = [s.params.density, s.params.surface];
    if (k[0] !== lintKey[0] || k[1] !== lintKey[1]) {
      lintKey = k;
      const lints = treeLints(s.params);
      lintBox.replaceChildren(...lints.map((t) => el('div', 'it-lint', t)));
      lintBox.hidden = lints.length === 0;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- JSON editor
  const refreshHighlight = (scroll: boolean, at: TextRange | null = null): void => {
    const m = view.model;
    if (m === null) return;
    const s = m.state;
    const r = at ?? (bufferHighlight !== null && s.ranges !== null ? s.ranges.byPath.get(bufferHighlight) ?? null : highlightRange(s, selection));
    view.highlight(r, scroll);
  };
  /** The caret (or an issue's position) at `caret` in the editor's buffer: highlight its node, select it when the session has it. */
  const caretAt = (s: EditorState, caret: number, range: TextRange | null): void => {
    const t = caretTarget({ leaf: s.leaf, ranges: s.ranges, caret }, params());
    if (t.select !== null) {
      bufferHighlight = null;
      if (!sameSelection(t.select, selection)) {
        expansion = expandToSelection(params(), expansion, t.select);
        setSelection(t.select, false, false);
      }
    } else {
      bufferHighlight = t.highlight;
    }
    refreshHighlight(range !== null, range);
  };
  const view = createJsonEditor({
    edit: deps.edit,
    onState: () => refreshHighlight(false),
    onCaret: (s) => caretAt(s, s.caret, null),
    onIssue: (s, path) => {
      if (s.ranges === null) return;
      const r = pathRange(s.ranges, path);
      if (r !== undefined) caretAt(s, r.start, r);
    },
  });
  jsonPane.append(view.element);
  jsonView = view;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- selection and rendering
  /** Shows `sel` (followed on the session's tree); `scroll` scrolls the text to it; `rebind` binds its root's editor. */
  function setSelection(sel: Selection, scroll: boolean, rebind = true): void {
    const next = followNode(params(), sel);
    const changed = !sameSelection(next, selection);
    selection = next;
    if (rebind) {
      bufferHighlight = null;
      view.bind(editors.get(selection.leaf)!);
    }
    if (shown) {
      renderTree();
      renderForm(session.state);
      if (rebind) refreshHighlight(scroll);
    } else {
      stale = true;
    }
    if (changed) for (const l of listeners) l(selection);
  }

  function choose(sel: Selection, scroll: boolean): void {
    showIssues(null, sel.leaf);
    setSelection(sel, scroll);
  }

  const renderAll = (): void => {
    stale = false;
    renderTree();
    renderForm(session.state);
    refreshHighlight(false);
  };

  const unsubscribe = session.subscribe(() => {
    for (const m of editors.values()) m.sessionChanged();
    const next = followNode(params(), selection);
    if (!sameSelection(next, selection)) {
      setSelection(next, false);
      return;
    }
    if (shown) renderAll();
    else stale = true;
  });

  view.bind(editors.get(selection.leaf)!);
  renderAll();

  return {
    element,
    sliceHost,
    get selection() { return selection; },
    select(sel) {
      expansion = expandToSelection(params(), expansion, followNode(params(), sel));
      choose(sel, true);
    },
    onSelect(fn) {
      listeners.add(fn);
      return () => { listeners.delete(fn); };
    },
    setHoverValue(text) {
      hoverLine.textContent = text === null ? '' : `value at the hover: ${text}`;
      hoverLine.hidden = text === null;
    },
    setShown(on) {
      if (on === shown) return;
      shown = on;
      if (!on) {
        saved = { tree: treePane.scrollTop, form: formPane.scrollTop };
        view.saveScroll();
        return;
      }
      if (stale) renderAll();
      if (saved !== null) {
        treePane.scrollTop = saved.tree;
        formPane.scrollTop = saved.form;
      }
      view.restoreScroll();
    },
    dispose() {
      unsubscribe();
      resize.disconnect();
      view.dispose();
      for (const m of editors.values()) m.dispose();
      listeners.clear();
    },
  };
}

+/** The editor's line height in CSS px (inspector.css: `.je-text` and `.je-mirror` share it); scrolling is by lines. */
+export const EDITOR_LINE_PX = 16;
+
+/** The 0-based line of `offset` in `text` (lines end at '\n'; an offset past the end is on the last line). */
+export function lineIndexAt(text: string, offset: number): number {
+  let line = 0;
+  for (let i = text.indexOf('\n'); i !== -1 && i < offset; i = text.indexOf('\n', i + 1)) line++;
+  return line;
+}
+
+/** The offset where 0-based line `line` starts; `text.length` past the last line. */
+export function lineStart(text: string, line: number): number {
+  let at = 0;
+  for (let l = 0; l < line; l++) {
+    const nl = text.indexOf('\n', at);
+    if (nl === -1) return text.length;
+    at = nl + 1;
+  }
+  return at;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The scrollTop that shows line `line` (§3.5: a range is scrolled into view by its line index × the line height): the
+ * current one while the line is wholly visible, else the line a third of the view from the top (whole lines).
+ */
+export function scrollTopForLine(line: number, lineHeight: number, viewHeight: number, scrollTop: number): number {
+  const top = line * lineHeight;
+  if (top >= scrollTop && top + lineHeight <= scrollTop + viewHeight) return scrollTop;
+  return Math.max(0, top - Math.floor(viewHeight / lineHeight / 3) * lineHeight);
+}
+
+/** The scroll anchor the model keeps: the offset of the first line shown at `scrollTop`. */
+export function anchorOfScroll(text: string, scrollTop: number, lineHeight: number): number {
+  const last = lineIndexAt(text, text.length);
+  return lineStart(text, Math.min(last, Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / lineHeight))));
+}
+
+/** The scrollTop that shows the anchor's line first. */
+export function scrollOfAnchor(text: string, anchor: number, lineHeight: number): number {
+  return lineIndexAt(text, anchor) * lineHeight;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A scroll the JSON editor owes its text: a line to bring into view (a selected node, an issue), an anchor to show
+ * first (a re-print, §3.5), or the offsets the view had when it was hidden (§3.1).
+ */
+export type ScrollRequest =
+  | { readonly kind: 'line'; readonly line: number }
+  | { readonly kind: 'anchor'; readonly anchor: number }
+  | { readonly kind: 'offset'; readonly top: number; readonly left: number };
+
+/** The text view as the DOM reports it: a textarea that is not displayed (its pane or its tab hidden) is 0 tall. */
+export interface ScrollView {
+  readonly height: number;
+  readonly top: number;
+  readonly left: number;
+}
+
+/** The scroll offsets to write for `req` in a displayed view (`left` kept unless the request is an offset). */
+export function scrollTarget(req: ScrollRequest, text: string, view: ScrollView): { top: number; left: number } {
+  switch (req.kind) {
+    case 'line': return { top: scrollTopForLine(req.line, EDITOR_LINE_PX, view.height, view.top), left: view.left };
+    case 'anchor': return { top: scrollOfAnchor(text, req.anchor, EDITOR_LINE_PX), left: view.left };
+    case 'offset': return { top: req.top, left: req.left };
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * The JSON editor's owed scroll (§3.1, §3.2, §3.5). A textarea that is not displayed ignores scroll writes (below
+ * 1,200 px the JSON pane shares its column with the slice behind the Slice/JSON sub-tabs, and the drawer hides whole
+ * tabs), so a request made while the view is 0 tall is kept, the latest winning, and written when the view shows
+ * again; hiding a displayed view keeps its offsets the same way unless a request is already owed. So a row selected
+ * while the JSON pane is hidden is in view when it is shown, and a re-print while the tab is hidden shows the anchor
+ * the model mapped, not the offsets saved before it.
+ */
+export interface ScrollKeeper {
+  /** Asks for `req`: the offsets to write now, or null when the view is hidden (kept for `shown`). */
+  request(req: ScrollRequest, text: string, view: ScrollView): { top: number; left: number } | null;
+  /** The view is about to be hidden: a displayed view's offsets are kept, unless a request is owed. */
+  hidden(view: ScrollView): void;
+  /** The view may show again: the owed offsets to write (then nothing is owed), or null (nothing owed, or still hidden). */
+  shown(text: string, view: ScrollView): { top: number; left: number } | null;
+  readonly owed: ScrollRequest | null;
+}
+
+export function createScrollKeeper(): ScrollKeeper {
+  let owed: ScrollRequest | null = null;
+  const displayed = (view: ScrollView): boolean => view.height > 0;
+  return {
+    get owed() { return owed; },
+    request(req, text, view) {
+      if (!displayed(view)) {
+        owed = req;
+        return null;
+      }
+      owed = null;
+      return scrollTarget(req, text, view);
+    },
+    hidden(view) {
+      if (owed === null && displayed(view)) owed = { kind: 'offset', top: view.top, left: view.left };
+    },
+    shown(text, view) {
+      if (owed === null || !displayed(view)) return null;
+      const target = scrollTarget(owed, text, view);
+      owed = null;
+      return target;
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+/** The mirror's three parts: the text before the highlighted range, the range, the text after (clamped to the text). */
+export function highlightParts(text: string, range: TextRange | null): [string, string, string] {
+  if (range === null) return [text, '', ''];
+  const a = Math.min(Math.max(0, range.start), text.length);
+  const b = Math.min(Math.max(a, range.end), text.length);
+  return [text.slice(0, a), text.slice(a, b), text.slice(b)];
+}
+
+/** The fields of a KeyboardEvent the editor reads. */
+export interface EditorKey {
+  readonly key: string;
+  readonly ctrlKey: boolean;
+  readonly metaKey: boolean;
+  readonly altKey: boolean;
+  readonly shiftKey: boolean;
+}
+
+/** Ctrl/Cmd+Enter applies, Escape (no modifier) reverts the buffer (§3.5); anything else is the textarea's. */
+export function editorKeyAction(e: EditorKey): 'apply' | 'revert' | null {
+  if (e.altKey) return null;
+  if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) return 'apply';
+  if (e.key === 'Escape' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.shiftKey) return 'revert';
+  return null;
+}

```css
/* The drawer's Density tab (SP3d spec §3.1): tree | node form | JSON editor | slice viewer; sub-tabs below 1,200 px,
   stacked below 900 px (data-layout, set from the tab's own width by densityTab.ts). */
.it { display: grid; height: 100%; min-height: 0; font-size: 12px; }
.it [hidden] { display: none !important; }
.it[data-layout="grid"] { grid-template-columns: 220px 280px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "tree form json slice"; }
.it[data-layout="tabs"] { grid-template-columns: 220px 280px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "tree form sub" "tree form pane"; }
.it[data-layout="stack"] { height: auto; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto; grid-template-areas: "tree" "form" "sub" "pane"; }
.it-tree { grid-area: tree; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; border-right: 1px solid #2c3038; }
.it-form { grid-area: form; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 4px 8px; border-right: 1px solid #2c3038; }
.it-subtabs { grid-area: sub; display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #333; }
.it-subtabs button { padding: 3px 10px; font: inherit; color: #9aa; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; }
.it-subtabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: #eee; border-bottom-color: #4a90d9; }
.it-json { grid-area: json; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; border-right: 1px solid #2c3038; }
.it-slice { grid-area: slice; min-width: 128px; min-height: 128px; overflow: auto; }
.it[data-layout="tabs"] .it-json, .it[data-layout="tabs"] .it-slice, .it[data-layout="stack"] .it-json, .it[data-layout="stack"] .it-slice { grid-area: pane; }
.it[data-layout="stack"] .it-tree { max-height: 220px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #2c3038; }
.it[data-layout="stack"] .it-form { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #2c3038; }
.it[data-layout="stack"] .it-json { height: 320px; border-right: 0; }

/* Tree (§3.2). */
.it-tree-head { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; padding: 3px 6px; background: #1f2228; border-bottom: 1px solid #2c3038; }
.it-tree-head button, .it-actions button, .it-knots button { font: inherit; padding: 1px 7px; }
.it-group { padding: 4px 6px 2px; font-weight: 600; color: #9aa; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; }
.it-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }
.it-row:hover { background: #262a31; }
.it-toggle { flex: 0 0 14px; width: 14px; padding: 0; font: inherit; color: #9aa; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.it-toggle:disabled { cursor: default; }
.it-node { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; padding: 1px 4px; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: left; color: #bbb; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.it-node[aria-current="true"] { color: #fff; background: #2b3a52; }
.it-tail { color: #7f8a9c; margin-right: 6px; }
.it-mute { flex: 0 0 auto; margin: 0 6px 0 2px; }
.it-muted .it-summary { color: #f0b34a; }
.it-dimmed { opacity: 0.45; }

/* Node form (§3.3). */
.it-path { font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; color: #c0c8d8; overflow-wrap: anywhere; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.it-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin: 4px 0; }
.it-fields { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.it-field { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 6px; }
.it-name { flex: 0 0 5.5em; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: #9aa; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; }
.it-input, .it-select, .it-op, .it-ref, .it-biomes { min-width: 0; padding: 1px 4px; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; color: #ddd; background: #15171b; border: 1px solid #3a3f48; border-radius: 2px; }
.it-input { flex: 1 1 5em; width: 5em; }
.it-ref { flex: 1 1 8em; max-width: 100%; }
.it-select, .it-op { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.it-biomes { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.it-invalid { border-color: #ff7b72; outline-color: #ff7b72; }
.it-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }
.it-target { flex: 1 1 100%; padding-left: calc(5.5em + 6px); }
.it-knots { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.it-knot-table { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.it-knot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 4px; align-items: start; }
.it-knot .it-name { flex-basis: 2.5em; }
.it-hover { margin-top: 6px; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; color: #b8c2d0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.it-issues { margin-top: 4px; color: #ff7b72; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.it-lints { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; margin-top: 6px; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid #6b5424; border-radius: 3px; color: #f0b34a; }
.it-lints::before { content: 'Warnings'; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* JSON editor (§3.5): a textarea over a mirror <pre> with the same font, line height and padding. */
.je { display: grid; grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto auto; height: 100%; min-height: 0; }
.je-box { position: relative; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #15171b; }
.je-mirror, .je-text { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 4px 6px; font: 12px/16px ui-monospace, monospace; tab-size: 2; white-space: pre; border: 0; }
.je-mirror { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; color: transparent; pointer-events: none; }
.je-mark { color: transparent; background: #2b3a52; border-radius: 2px; }
.je-text { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; resize: none; overflow: auto; color: #ddd; background: transparent; caret-color: #fff; outline: none; }
.je-text.je-dirty { color: #f2e6c9; }
.je-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 6px; border-top: 1px solid #2c3038; }
.je-bar button { font: inherit; padding: 1px 8px; }
.je-status { color: #8a95a8; }
.je-status[data-status="valid"] { color: #9fd08f; }
.je-status[data-status="invalid"], .je-status[data-status="syntax"], .je-status[data-status="tooLarge"] { color: #ff7b72; }
.je-stale { padding: 2px 6px; color: #f0b34a; }
.je-stale button { font: inherit; padding: 0; color: #6fa8e8; text-decoration: underline; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.je-issues { max-height: 8em; overflow: auto; padding: 0 6px 4px; }
.je-issue { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: left; color: #ff7b72; background: none; border: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: pre-wrap; }
button.je-issue { cursor: pointer; }
button.je-issue:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
```

Create `src/ui/inspector/jsonEditor.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The Density tab's JSON editor (SP3d spec §3.5, D18): a `wrap="off"` textarea over a mirror `<pre>` with the same font,
 * size, line height and padding. The mirror paints the highlighted node range behind the text (a textarea cannot paint a
 * range while unfocused, and focusing it would take the focus from the tree row) and follows the textarea's scroll; a
 * range is scrolled into view by its line index × the line height. Under the text: Apply (and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter), Reset,
 * the status, the "Revert to the current tree" notice of a dirty buffer whose tree changed elsewhere, and the issue lines
 * (a click selects the issue's node and scrolls the text to it). Escape reverts the buffer; the shortcut layer leaves
 * Escape and Ctrl+Z to text entry, so the drawer stays open and Ctrl+Z is the browser's text undo. The buffer, the
 * dirty rule, the debounce and Apply / Reset / Escape are `editorModel.ts`'s, the line arithmetic too; this file only
 * binds a model (one per tree leaf; the tab binds the selected root's) to the DOM. Text only through `textContent`.
 */
import { el } from '../common/dom';
import {
  anchorOfScroll, createScrollKeeper, EDITOR_LINE_PX, editorKeyAction, highlightParts, issueLines, lineIndexAt,
  type EditorModel, type EditorState, type EditorStatus, type ScrollRequest, type ScrollView,
} from './editorModel';
import type { TextRange } from './jsonText';

export interface JsonEditorDeps {
  /** Runs a session call caused by the input event `e` (the page's latency wrapper). */
  edit(e: Event, fn: () => void): void;
  /** After every update of the bound model's state. */
  onState(state: EditorState): void;
  /** The caret moved (typing, a click, a key) and the buffer's ranges are known (clean or parsing, §3.2). */
  onCaret(state: EditorState): void;
  /** An issue line was clicked: the issue's node path inside the leaf. */
  onIssue(state: EditorState, path: string): void;
}

export interface JsonEditorView {
  readonly element: HTMLElement;
  /** Binds the editor to a leaf's model (the selected root's), showing its buffer, caret and scroll. */
  bind(model: EditorModel): void;
  readonly model: EditorModel | null;
  /** The range the mirror paints (null: none); with `scroll`, the text scrolls to show its first line. */
  highlight(range: TextRange | null, scroll: boolean): void;
  /**
   * The text is about to be hidden (the drawer tab, the JSON sub-tab or a layout change): its scroll offsets are kept,
   * unless a scroll is owed (§3.1).
   */
  saveScroll(): void;
  /**
   * The text may be shown again: the scroll owed is written — a node selected, an issue clicked or a re-print made
   * while it was hidden (written then, a hidden textarea ignores it), else the offsets kept when it was hidden.
   */
  restoreScroll(): void;
  dispose(): void;
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Readonly<Record<EditorStatus, string>> = Object.freeze({
  clean: 'the current tree',
  pending: 'checking…',
  valid: 'valid: Apply to use it',
  invalid: 'not valid',
  syntax: 'not JSON',
  tooLarge: 'too large',
});

export function createJsonEditor(deps: JsonEditorDeps): JsonEditorView {
  let model: EditorModel | null = null;
  let unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;
  let revision = -1;
  let range: TextRange | null = null;
  let mirrorKey = '';
  let issuesKey = '';
  /** A caret event happened; reported once the buffer's ranges are known. */
  let caretMoved = false;
  /** The scroll owed to the text while it is not displayed (`editorModel.ts`'s keeper). */
  const keeper = createScrollKeeper();

  const element = el('div', 'je');
  const box = el('div', 'je-box');
  const mirror = el('pre', 'je-mirror');
  mirror.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  const before = el('span');
  const mark = el('mark', 'je-mark');
  const after = el('span');
  mirror.append(before, mark, after);
  const text = el('textarea', 'je-text');
  text.wrap = 'off';
  text.spellcheck = false;
  text.autocomplete = 'off';
  text.setAttribute('autocapitalize', 'off');
  text.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Tree as JSON');
  box.append(mirror, text);

  const bar = el('div', 'je-bar');
  const button = (label: string, tip: string, run: (e: MouseEvent) => void): HTMLButtonElement => {
    const b = el('button', '', label);
    b.type = 'button';
    b.title = tip;
    b.addEventListener('click', run);
    return b;
  };
  const apply = button('Apply', 'Use the typed tree (Ctrl+Enter); an invalid tree is never sent', (e) => {
    if (model !== null) deps.edit(e, () => { model!.apply(); });
  });
  const reset = button('Reset', "Reset the tree to the profile's", (e) => {
    if (model !== null) deps.edit(e, () => { model!.reset(); });
  });
  const status = el('span', 'je-status');
  bar.append(apply, reset, status);
  const stale = el('div', 'je-stale');
  stale.append(el('span', '', 'The tree changed elsewhere. '), button('Revert to the current tree', 'Replace the typed text by the current tree', () => model?.revert()));
  const issues = el('div', 'je-issues');
  element.append(box, bar, stale, issues);

  const paintMirror = (s: EditorState): void => {
    const key = `${String(s.revision)}|${s.text.length}|${range === null ? '' : `${String(range.start)}-${String(range.end)}`}|${s.text}`;
    if (key === mirrorKey) return;
    mirrorKey = key;
    const [a, m, b] = highlightParts(s.text, range);
    before.textContent = a;
    mark.textContent = m;
    // The trailing newline keeps the mirror's last line as tall as the textarea's.
    after.textContent = `${b}\n`;
  };

  const viewOf = (): ScrollView => ({ height: text.clientHeight, top: text.scrollTop, left: text.scrollLeft });
  const write = (to: { top: number; left: number } | null): void => {
    if (to === null) return;
    text.scrollTop = to.top;
    text.scrollLeft = to.left;
    mirror.scrollTop = text.scrollTop;
    mirror.scrollLeft = text.scrollLeft;
  };
  /** Scrolls now, or owes it until the text is shown (a hidden textarea ignores scroll writes). */
  const scrollTo = (req: ScrollRequest): void => { write(keeper.request(req, text.value, viewOf())); };
  const scrollToLine = (line: number): void => { scrollTo({ kind: 'line', line }); };

  const renderIssues = (s: EditorState): void => {
    const lines = issueLines(s);
    const key = `${s.status}|${lines.join('\n')}`;
    if (key === issuesKey) return;
    issuesKey = key;
    issues.replaceChildren(...lines.map((line, i) => {
      const issue = s.syntax === null && s.status !== 'tooLarge' ? s.issues[i] : undefined;
      if (issue === undefined && s.syntax === null) return el('div', 'je-issue', line);
      const b = el('button', 'je-issue', line);
      b.type = 'button';
      b.title = issue === undefined ? 'Show the error in the text' : 'Select the node and show it in the text';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const st = model?.state;
        if (st === undefined) return;
        if (issue !== undefined) { deps.onIssue(st, issue.path); return; }
        if (st.syntax !== null) {
          text.focus();
          text.setSelectionRange(st.syntax.offset, st.syntax.offset);
          scrollToLine(lineIndexAt(st.text, st.syntax.offset));
        }
      });
      return b;
    }));
  };

  const render = (s: EditorState): void => {
    if (s.revision !== revision) {
      revision = s.revision;
      // A re-print (or a newly bound model): the text, then the caret and the scroll the model mapped by node path.
      if (text.value !== s.text) text.value = s.text;
      const focused = document.activeElement === text;
      if (focused) text.setSelectionRange(s.caret, s.caret);
      scrollTo({ kind: 'anchor', anchor: s.scrollAnchor });
    }
    paintMirror(s);
    status.textContent = STATUS_TEXT[s.status];
    status.dataset['status'] = s.status;
    apply.disabled = s.clean;
    stale.hidden = !s.stale;
    text.classList.toggle('je-dirty', !s.clean);
    renderIssues(s);
    deps.onState(s);
    if (caretMoved && s.ranges !== null) {
      caretMoved = false;
      deps.onCaret(s);
    }
  };

  const reportCaret = (): void => {
    if (model === null) return;
    caretMoved = true;
    model.setCaret(text.selectionStart, anchorOfScroll(text.value, text.scrollTop, EDITOR_LINE_PX));
  };

  text.addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (model === null) return;
    caretMoved = true;
    model.edit(text.value, text.selectionStart);
  });
  text.addEventListener('click', reportCaret);
  text.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (e.key.startsWith('Arrow') || e.key === 'Home' || e.key === 'End' || e.key === 'PageUp' || e.key === 'PageDown') reportCaret();
  });
  text.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    mirror.scrollTop = text.scrollTop;
    mirror.scrollLeft = text.scrollLeft;
    model?.setCaret(text.selectionStart, anchorOfScroll(text.value, text.scrollTop, EDITOR_LINE_PX));
  });
  text.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const action = editorKeyAction(e);
    if (action === null || model === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (action === 'apply') deps.edit(e, () => { model!.apply(); });
    else model.revert();
  });

  return {
    element,
    get model() { return model; },
    bind(m) {
      if (m === model) return;
      unsubscribe?.();
      model = m;
      revision = -1;
      mirrorKey = '';
      issuesKey = '';
      caretMoved = false;
      unsubscribe = m.subscribe(render);
      render(m.state);
    },
    highlight(r, scroll) {
      range = r;
      if (model !== null) paintMirror(model.state);
      if (scroll && r !== null && model !== null) scrollToLine(lineIndexAt(model.state.text, r.start));
    },
    saveScroll() {
      keeper.hidden(viewOf());
    },
    restoreScroll() {
      write(keeper.shown(text.value, viewOf()));
    },
    dispose() {
      unsubscribe?.();
      unsubscribe = null;
      model = null;
    },
  };
}
```

+export function densityLayout(width: number, last: DensityLayout = 'grid'): DensityLayout {

+export const DEFAULT_SUB_TAB: DensitySubTab = 'slice';
+
+/** Which of the JSON editor and the slice viewer a layout shows, and whether the sub-tab bar is shown. */
+export function shownPanes(layout: DensityLayout, sub: DensitySubTab): { slice: boolean; json: boolean; subTabs: boolean } {
+  if (layout === 'grid') return { slice: true, json: true, subTabs: false };
+  return { slice: sub === 'slice', json: sub === 'json', subTabs: true };
+}

diff --git a/src/ui/paramPanel/model.ts b/src/ui/paramPanel/model.ts
index 1681f33..c722989 100644
--- a/src/ui/paramPanel/model.ts
+++ b/src/ui/paramPanel/model.ts
@@ -276,3 +276,33 @@ export function amplitudeItemChange(def: NoiseDef, i: number, value: unknown): {
   if (list === null || !Number.isInteger(i) || i < 0 || i >= list.length) return {};
   return { amplitudes: list.map((a, j) => (j === i ? value : a)) };
 }
+
+/**
+ * The slider of a parameter ref's target (SP3d spec §3.3: while a tree field is a ref, the Density tab's form shows
+ * the target's slider, and moving it sets the target, as this panel does): a number or int leaf is its own control and
+ * is written on itself; a numeric field of a noise leaf (`<noise>.clampSigma`, the only one refs name) is the noise
+ * sub-block's slider and is written as a partial noise on the noise leaf. RangeError for any other path.
+ */
+export interface RefTargetControl {
+  readonly spec: ControlSpec;
+  /** The leaf the slider writes (`session.set(leaf, refTargetWrite(t, v))`). */
+  readonly leaf: string;
+  /** The noise field written, or null for a number or int leaf. */
+  readonly field: NoiseNumberField | null;
+}
+
+export function refTargetControl(path: string): RefTargetControl {
+  const metas = new Map(SCHEMA.leaves.map((l) => [l.path, l.meta] as const));
+  const meta = metas.get(path);
+  if (meta !== undefined && (meta.kind === 'number' || meta.kind === 'int')) return { spec: controlOf(meta), leaf: path, field: null };
+  const cut = path.lastIndexOf('.');
+  const noise = cut > 0 ? metas.get(path.slice(0, cut)) : undefined;
+  const field = path.slice(cut + 1) as NoiseNumberField;
+  if (noise === undefined || noise.kind !== 'noise' || !NOISE_NUMBER_FIELDS.includes(field)) throw new RangeError(`no slider for ${path}`);
+  return { spec: noiseFieldControl(controlOf(noise), field), leaf: noise.path, field };
+}
+
+/** The value `session.set(t.leaf, …)` takes for the target value `v`. */
+export function refTargetWrite(t: RefTargetControl, v: unknown): unknown {
+  return t.field === null ? v : { [t.field]: v };
+}

GREEN: 125/125, scrolled to 2,049 px and kept across a Slice/JSON switch. A first version of the step passed on the old code because earlier steps had left the text scrolled near root.b.x, so the step now selects the root first (scrollTop 0) and asserts that the node's line lies below the first view. Ruling: the keeper owes the latest request, and a request replaces the pixels saved at a hide, so a re-print's anchor wins over stale offsets. A hide with nothing owed keeps the exact pixels (top and left), so a plain tab switch restores exactly as before. Cost if wrong: one scroll position after a hide and a re-print.
- Item 3 (Task 25, BUG, fixed): `form.ts` `setTypedNumber(params, sel, key, text)` reads the text with `parseFieldText`. Text that spells no number gives `{path: '<node>.<key>', code: 'NOT_NUMBER', message: 'expected a number, got "<trimmed text>"'}`, a typed −0 is written 0, and anything else goes through `setNumber`. `densityTab.ts`'s private `typedNumber` is gone. RED: on the old code the test's import is missing; the brief's experiment showed '0,5' and '' giving NOT_FINITE "got NaN" and '-0' giving NEGATIVE_ZERO. Ruling: '0x10' → 16 in both places (the panel's `Number` reading), not refused. A typed −0 becomes 0 (the panel's q15 does the same), while the JSON editor still reports a typed −0 (§1.7, §3.5), because the form is a number field and the editor is JSON text. Cost if wrong: one message.
- Spec defect: §3.3 "as `valueField` does" left the reading of typed text unsaid → the parse, NOT_NUMBER and −0 sentence (`main`).
- Item 4 (Task 25, BUG, fixed; Task 29 smoke step): `form.ts` `selectionAfterCommit(source, current, committed)`. `densityTab.ts`'s `commit` takes a `source` ('row' for the tree row's mute checkbox, 'form' otherwise), and a row commit keeps the current selection (followed by `followNode`). RED: on the old code the import is missing. In the browser the new mute step checks that the current row stays `density.defs.root` and that the selected root's slice equals the density field's (p1 −1.448 · p50 −0.006346 · p99 1.462 · sd 0.6453 · < 0: 50.4 %). Ruling: the `--shots` flow now selects the terrain row before muting it from its row, so `density-muted-terrain.png` shows the form on the tap as before. The re-shot equals the committed asset apart from the palette and the "last edit" ms, so the asset is not re-committed. Cost if wrong: none.
- Spec defect: §3.2 said nothing about where a row's mute leaves the selection → "Toggling it from the row is a plain edit: the selection stays …" (`main`).

Create `test/unit/sliceView.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The slice viewer's DOM rules, extracted as pure helpers of `sliceModel.ts` (SP3d spec §4.3, §3.6, §3.7, §4.5; the DOM is
 * `sliceView.ts` and the page wiring `mapPage.ts`): the pointer offset → sample `⌊(px / side) · n⌋` in a square box whose
 * side is the smaller of its cell's width and height (at least 128 px), the slice hover readout (the sample's voxel and
 * the shown field's value, from the slice buffer), the map hover's voxel at the y control, the horizontal centre and
 * extent changes (clamped into the window) and the y control, the map's square overlay, the field select's label of
 * `selected`, the status line, the form's hover line, and the params of the draft the pool's resolved configure holds.
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { WINDOW_HALF } from '../../src/core/coords';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import type { FieldSliceResult } from '../../src/engine/workerPool';
import { sliceSampleVoxel, type SliceGeometry } from '../../src/gen/inspect/fieldSlice';
import type { Segment } from '../../src/metrics/crossSection';
import type { Selection } from '../../src/ui/inspector/model';
import {
  createDraftLog, fieldOptionLabel, formatSliceValue, hoverLineText, initialSliceState, mapHoverVoxel, parseSliceY, pixelVoxel,
  RULE_NA, SLICE_BOX_MIN_PX, sliceBoxSide, sliceGeometryOf, sliceHoverText, slicePixel, sliceSquare, sliceStatusText, withCentre,
  withExtent, type SliceShown, type SliceState,
} from '../../src/ui/inspector/sliceModel';
import { WATER_SOURCE } from '../../src/world/blocks/fluid';
import { AIR, REGISTRY, STONE } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';

const W = WINDOW_HALF;
const LINE: Segment = { ax: -1664, az: 8, bx: -640, bz: 8 };
const HORIZONTAL: SliceState = { plane: 'horizontal', field: 'density', y: 63, extent: 256, cx: 100, cz: -40 };
const VERTICAL: SliceState = { ...HORIZONTAL, plane: 'vertical' };
const DENSITY_SEL: Selection = { leaf: 'density.defs', path: 'root.b.x' };
const RULE_SEL: Selection = { leaf: 'surface.rules', path: 'root.rules[1]' };

const geometryOf = (s: SliceState, line: Segment | null, n: number): SliceGeometry => {
  const g = sliceGeometryOf(s, line, n);
  if (!g.ok) throw new Error(g.problem);
  return g.geometry;
};
const shownOf = (geometry: SliceGeometry, result: FieldSliceResult, sessionEpoch = 3, key = 'k'): SliceShown => ({ sessionEpoch, key, geometry, result });
const ramp = (n: number): Float64Array<ArrayBuffer> => Float64Array.from({ length: n * n }, (_, i) => i / 8 - 7);

describe('pointer → sample (§4.3: ⌊(px / side) · n⌋ inside the box, null outside)', () => {
  test('a 256 px box showing 128 samples', () => {
    expect([0, 1.999, 2, 3.5, 128, 255.99].map((px) => slicePixel(px, 256, 128))).toEqual([0, 0, 1, 1, 64, 127]);
    for (const px of [-0.001, 256, 300, Number.NaN, Infinity]) expect(slicePixel(px, 256, 128), String(px)).toBeNull();
    expect(slicePixel(10, 0, 128)).toBeNull();
    expect(slicePixel(10, Number.NaN, 128)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('a 200 px box showing a 32² draft: every offset gives ⌊(px / side) · n⌋ and every sample is reached', () => {
    const seen = new Set<number>();
    for (let px = 0; px < 200; px += 0.25) {
      const s = slicePixel(px, 200, 32);
      expect(s).toBe(Math.floor((px / 200) * 32));
      seen.add(s!);
    }
    expect(seen.size).toBe(32);
    expect(slicePixel(199.9999, 200, 32)).toBe(31);
  });

  test('composed with pixelVoxel, the pointer names the voxel that was evaluated', () => {
    const g = geometryOf(HORIZONTAL, null, 128);
    // The box's centre: sample (64, 64), the block just east and south of the centre (x_i = cx − E/2 + ⌊(2i + 1)E / 2n⌋).
    const px = slicePixel(150, 300, 128)!;
    const py = slicePixel(150, 300, 128)!;
    expect([px, py]).toEqual([64, 64]);
    expect(pixelVoxel(g, px, py)).toEqual([100 - 128 + 129, 63, -40 - 128 + 129]);
    // The top-left corner pixel is the north-west sample.
    expect(pixelVoxel(g, slicePixel(0, 300, 128)!, slicePixel(0.5, 300, 128)!)).toEqual([100 - 128 + 1, 63, -40 - 128 + 1]);
  });
});

describe('the slice box (§4.3: the smaller of its cell\'s width and height, at least 128 px)', () => {
  test('sides', () => {
    expect(SLICE_BOX_MIN_PX).toBe(128);
    expect(sliceBoxSide(300, 200)).toBe(200);
    expect(sliceBoxSide(200.7, 512)).toBe(200);
    expect(sliceBoxSide(100, 400)).toBe(128);
    expect(sliceBoxSide(0, 0)).toBe(128);
    expect(sliceBoxSide(Number.NaN, 300)).toBe(128);
  });
});

describe('the slice hover readout (§3.6: the sample\'s voxel and the shown field\'s value, from the slice buffer)', () => {
  test('horizontal density: sample column = row z, sample = column x', () => {
    const n = 32;
    const g = geometryOf(HORIZONTAL, null, n);
    const values = ramp(n);
    const shown = shownOf(g, { field: 'density', values, fluid: null, n });
    const h = sliceHoverText(shown, 5, 9);
    const [x, y, z] = sliceSampleVoxel(g, 9, 5);
    expect(h.voxel).toEqual({ x, y, z });
    expect(y).toBe(63);
    expect(h.text).toBe(`(${x}, 63, ${z}) · density ${formatSliceValue(values[9 * n + 5]!)}`);
  });

  test('vertical node: sample column = pixel column (A on the left), sample = row (y 319 at the top); non-finite values', () => {
    const n = 32;
    const g = geometryOf(VERTICAL, LINE, n);
    const values = ramp(n);
    values[3 * n + 0] = Number.NaN;
    const shown = shownOf(g, { field: 'node', values, fluid: null, n });
    const h = sliceHoverText(shown, 3, 7);
    const [x, y, z] = sliceSampleVoxel(g, 3, 7);
    expect(h.voxel).toEqual({ x, y, z });
    expect(h.text).toBe(`(${x}, ${y}, ${z}) · node ${formatSliceValue(values[3 * n + 7]!)}`);
    expect(sliceHoverText(shown, 3, 0).text).toMatch(/· node NaN$/);
    expect(sliceHoverText(shown, 0, 0).voxel.y).toBe(313);
  });

  test('blocks name the state, or water; a rule mask reads yes, no or n/a', () => {
    const n = 32;
    const g = geometryOf(VERTICAL, LINE, n);
    const states = new Uint16Array(n * n).fill(STONE);
    const fluid = new Uint8Array(n * n);
    states[1 * n + 2] = AIR;
    fluid[1 * n + 2] = WATER_SOURCE;
    states[1 * n + 3] = AIR;
    const blocks = shownOf(g, { field: 'blocks', values: states, fluid, n });
    expect(sliceHoverText(blocks, 0, 0).text).toMatch(new RegExp(`· blocks ${REGISTRY.stateKey(STONE)}$`));
    expect(sliceHoverText(blocks, 1, 2).text).toMatch(/· blocks water$/);
    expect(sliceHoverText(blocks, 1, 3).text).toMatch(new RegExp(`· blocks ${REGISTRY.stateKey(AIR)}$`));
    const mask = new Uint8Array(n * n);
    mask[0] = 1;
    mask[1] = RULE_NA;
    const rule = shownOf(g, { field: 'rule', values: mask, fluid: null, n });
    expect([0, 1, 2].map((py) => sliceHoverText(rule, 0, py).text.split(' · ')[1])).toEqual(['rule yes', 'rule n/a', 'rule no']);
  });

  test('outside the slice\'s size it throws (the pointer helper never gives such a pixel)', () => {
    const g = geometryOf(HORIZONTAL, null, 32);
    const shown = shownOf(g, { field: 'density', values: ramp(32), fluid: null, n: 32 });
    expect(() => sliceHoverText(shown, 32, 0)).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});

describe('the map hover\'s voxel while Density is shown (§3.6: the hovered block at the y control)', () => {
  test('floored block, the y control, null outside the half-open world window', () => {
    expect(mapHoverVoxel(10.7, -3.2, 63)).toEqual({ x: 10, y: 63, z: -4 });
    expect(mapHoverVoxel(-0.5, 0.5, -64)).toEqual({ x: -1, y: -64, z: 0 });
    expect(mapHoverVoxel(W - 0.5, -W, 319)).toEqual({ x: W - 1, y: 319, z: -W });
    expect(mapHoverVoxel(W, 0, 63)).toBeNull();
    expect(mapHoverVoxel(0, -W - 0.01, 63)).toBeNull();
    expect(mapHoverVoxel(Number.NaN, 0, 63)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('the plane controls (§4.2, §3.7)', () => {
  test('a map click sets the horizontal centre, floored and clamped into the window', () => {
    expect(withCentre(HORIZONTAL, 12.9, -7.1)).toEqual({ ...HORIZONTAL, cx: 12, cz: -8 });
    expect(withCentre(HORIZONTAL, W + 5, -W - 5)).toEqual({ ...HORIZONTAL, cx: W - 128, cz: -W + 128 });
    expect(withCentre(VERTICAL, 3, 4)).toEqual({ ...VERTICAL, cx: 3, cz: 4 });
  });

  test('an extent change keeps the centre where it fits and clamps it otherwise', () => {
    expect(withExtent(HORIZONTAL, 8192)).toEqual({ ...HORIZONTAL, extent: 8192 });
    const edge = { ...HORIZONTAL, cx: W - 1024, cz: -W + 1024, extent: 2048 };
    expect(withExtent(edge, 8192)).toEqual({ ...edge, extent: 8192, cx: W - 4096, cz: -W + 4096 });
    expect(() => withExtent(HORIZONTAL, 300)).toThrow(RangeError);
  });

  test('the y control takes an integer in −64 … 319', () => {
    expect(['63', ' -64 ', '319', '0'].map(parseSliceY)).toEqual([63, -64, 319, 0]);
    for (const t of ['320', '-65', '1.5', '', 'abc', '1e2x', 'Infinity']) expect(parseSliceY(t), t).toBeNull();
  });

  test('the square overlay is the horizontal plane\'s (blocks [cx − E/2, cx + E/2)), none on the vertical plane', () => {
    expect(sliceSquare(HORIZONTAL)).toEqual({ cx: 100, cz: -40, extent: 256 });
    expect(sliceSquare(VERTICAL)).toBeNull();
    expect(sliceSquare(null)).toBeNull();
    const first = initialSliceState({ line: null, viewCentre: [0.5, 0.5], pin: [33.3, -9.9] });
    expect(sliceSquare(first)).toEqual({ cx: 33, cz: -10, extent: 2048 });
  });

  test('the field select names the selected node', () => {
    expect(fieldOptionLabel('selected', DENSITY_SEL)).toBe('selected (root.b.x)');
    expect(fieldOptionLabel('selected', RULE_SEL)).toBe('selected (root.rules[1])');
    expect(fieldOptionLabel('density', DENSITY_SEL)).toBe('density');
    expect(fieldOptionLabel('blocks', RULE_SEL)).toBe('blocks');
  });
});

describe('the status line and the form\'s hover line', () => {
  test('status: the stage in flight, else stale or the shown size', () => {
    const g = geometryOf(HORIZONTAL, null, 32);
    const shown = shownOf(g, { field: 'density', values: ramp(32), fluid: null, n: 32 }, 3, 'k');
    expect(sliceStatusText({ key: null, shown: null, pending: null }, 3)).toBe('');
    expect(sliceStatusText({ key: 'k', shown: null, pending: { sessionEpoch: 3, key: 'k', n: 32 } }, 3)).toBe('slicing 32² …');
    expect(sliceStatusText({ key: 'k', shown, pending: { sessionEpoch: 3, key: 'k', n: 128 } }, 3)).toBe('32² · slicing 128² …');
    expect(sliceStatusText({ key: 'k', shown, pending: null }, 3)).toBe('32²');
    expect(sliceStatusText({ key: 'k', shown, pending: null }, 4)).toBe('stale');
    expect(sliceStatusText({ key: 'other', shown, pending: { sessionEpoch: 3, key: 'other', n: 32 } }, 3)).toBe('stale · slicing 32² …');
  });

  test('hover line: the value (and a rule node\'s rule suffix) at the voxel; nothing without a voxel or a value', () => {
    expect(hoverLineText({ x: 1, y: 63, z: -2 }, '0.5', '')).toBe('0.5 at (1, 63, -2)');
    expect(hoverLineText({ x: 1, y: 63, z: -2 }, 'yes', ' · rule root.rules[1].then')).toBe('yes · rule root.rules[1].then at (1, 63, -2)');
    expect(hoverLineText(null, '0.5', '')).toBeNull();
    expect(hoverLineText({ x: 1, y: 63, z: -2 }, '', '')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('the draft the pool\'s resolved configure holds (§4.5: requests run on it, its params cost the slice)', () => {
  test('params by session epoch; null before a configure or for an unknown draft; older drafts are dropped', () => {
    const log = createDraftLog();
    const p1: Params = { ...DEFAULTS };
    const p2: Params = { ...DEFAULTS };
    log.remember(1, p1);
    log.remember(2, p2);
    expect(log.configured({ poolEpoch: null, sessionEpoch: null })).toBeNull();
    const c1 = log.configured({ poolEpoch: 4, sessionEpoch: 1 });
    expect(c1).toEqual({ poolEpoch: 4, sessionEpoch: 1, params: p1 });
    expect(c1!.params).toBe(p1);
    expect(log.configured({ poolEpoch: 5, sessionEpoch: 2 })!.params).toBe(p2);
    // Configures resolve in session order: the drafts before the one configured are never configured again.
    expect(log.configured({ poolEpoch: 4, sessionEpoch: 1 })).toBeNull();
    expect(log.configured({ poolEpoch: 6, sessionEpoch: 7 })).toBeNull();
    expect(log.size).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

 ### 5.5 Density inspector, taps, mutes, probe, slice view
 
-- **Inspector:** a tree of `density.defs` and taps, with a param form per node and a JSON text editor with schema validation.
-  - Slice preview: XZ@y, XY@z or ZY@x; extent 256-8192; diverging colormap with a 0-contour and a sea-level line.
+- **Inspector:** the `?map` Density tab (SP3d): a tree of `density.defs` and `surface.rules`, a node form with param refs, and JSON editors for both trees with validation (amended by SP3d).
+  - Slice preview: vertical along the cut line (XY@z and ZY@x are its axis-aligned cases) and XZ@y with extent 256-8192; a 32² draft, then 128²; diverging colormap with a 0-contour and a sea-level line.

 - **Slice view (L):** any 3D field (final density, each cave term, carver mask, aquifer level and status, biome3d, stone depth, blocks, cave-type tint, light for loaded columns). It re-renders on param edits.
 - **Probe:** at the crosshair, map hover or slice hover. It shows climate, shape, every tap, carver hit, aquifer cell / level / status, biome 2D and 3D, the **surface-rule branch path taken**, light and stage hashes. A button copies it as JSON. SP3c: `surfaceProbe(sc, x, y, z)` returns the voxel's state and the rule ids from `root` to the leaf that yielded it (`[]` for air, water and unmatched stone), walking the reference evaluator, never the fast path; the branch path reaches the `?map` cross-section's Voxels hover through the `surfaceProbe` worker job, which shows the leaf's id (amended by SP3c).
 - **JSON editors** (textarea plus validation) cover surface rules, placed features and structure sets/pools. A visual editor is out of scope.

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the view's rules (sliceView.ts, mapPage.ts)
+
+/** The slice box's smallest side in CSS px (§3.1, §4.3); the drawer scrolls below it. */
+export const SLICE_BOX_MIN_PX = 128;
+
+/** The side of the square slice box: the smaller of its cell's width and height, at least SLICE_BOX_MIN_PX (§4.3). */
+export function sliceBoxSide(width: number, height: number): number {
+  const s = Math.floor(Math.min(width, height));
+  return Number.isFinite(s) && s > SLICE_BOX_MIN_PX ? s : SLICE_BOX_MIN_PX;

+ */
+export function slicePixel(offset: number, side: number, n: number): number | null {
+  if (!(side > 0) || !(offset >= 0) || !(offset < side)) return null;
+  return Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor((offset / side) * n));
+}

+    case 'blocks': return isWater(r.values[i]!, r.fluid[i]!) ? 'water' : REGISTRY.stateKey(r.values[i]!);
+    case 'rule': return r.values[i] === 1 ? 'yes' : r.values[i] === 0 ? 'no' : r.values[i] === RULE_NA ? 'n/a' : String(r.values[i]);
+  }
+}

+ * The slice hover (§3.6): the voxel of image pixel (px, py) of a shown slice and its readout, `(x, y, z) · <field> <value>`
+ * with the value from the slice buffer. Throws a RangeError for a pixel outside the slice.
+ */
+export function sliceHoverText(shown: SliceShown, px: number, py: number): { readonly voxel: HoverVoxel; readonly text: string } {
+  const g = shown.geometry;
+  const [x, y, z] = pixelVoxel(g, px, py);
+  const { c, k } = pixelSample(g.plane, g.n, px, py);
+  return { voxel: { x, y, z }, text: `(${x}, ${y}, ${z}) · ${shown.result.field} ${sampleText(shown.result, c * g.n + k)}` };
+}
+
+/** The voxel of a map hover while the Density tab is shown (§3.6): the hovered block at the y control; null outside the world window. */
+export function mapHoverVoxel(x: number, z: number, y: number): HoverVoxel | null {
+  const bx = Math.floor(x);
+  const bz = Math.floor(z);
+  if (!(bx >= -W && bx < W && bz >= -W && bz < W)) return null;
+  return { x: bx, y, z: bz };
+}
+
+/** A map click on the horizontal plane (§3.7): the centre at the clicked block, clamped into the window for the extent. */
+export function withCentre(s: SliceState, x: number, z: number): SliceState {
+  const [cx, cz] = clampCentre(x, z, s.extent);
+  return { ...s, cx, cz };
+}
+
+/** Another extent (SLICE_EXTENTS, else a RangeError): the centre is kept where the square fits, else clamped. */
+export function withExtent(s: SliceState, extent: number): SliceState {
+  const [cx, cz] = clampCentre(s.cx, s.cz, extent);
+  return { ...s, extent, cx, cz };
+}
+
+/** The y control's text: an integer in −64 … 319, else null (refused). */
+export function parseSliceY(text: string): number | null {
+  const t = text.trim();
+  if (!/^-?\d+$/.test(t)) return null;
+  const y = Number(t);
+  return y >= MIN_Y && y <= MAX_Y ? y : null;
+}
+
+/** The horizontal plane's square on the map (§3.7), or null (no state yet, or the vertical plane). */
+export function sliceSquare(s: SliceState | null): MapSquare | null {
+  return s === null || s.plane !== 'horizontal' ? null : { cx: s.cx, cz: s.cz, extent: s.extent };
+}
+
+/** The field select's label: `selected` names the selected node's path (§4.1). */
+export function fieldOptionLabel(choice: FieldChoice, sel: Selection): string {
+  return choice === 'selected' ? `selected (${sel.path})` : choice;
+}
+
+/** The status line: the shown slice (its size when fresh, "stale" otherwise), then the stage in flight. */
+export function sliceStatusText(r: Pick<FieldSliceRequests, 'key' | 'shown' | 'pending'>, sessionEpoch: number): string {
+  const view = fieldSliceView(r, sessionEpoch);
+  const parts: string[] = [];
+  if (view === 'fresh') parts.push(`${r.shown!.result.n}²`);
+  else if (view === 'stale') parts.push('stale');
+  if (r.pending !== null) parts.push(`slicing ${r.pending.n}² …`);
+  return parts.join(' · ');
+}
+
+/** The form's "value at the hover" (§3.6): the value (and a rule node's rule suffix) at the voxel, or null (nothing to show). */
+export function hoverLineText(voxel: HoverVoxel | null, value: string, rule: string): string | null {
+  if (voxel === null || value === '') return null;
+  return `${value}${rule} at (${voxel.x}, ${voxel.y}, ${voxel.z})`;
+}
+
+/** The params of the drafts handed to the preview driver, by session epoch: `configured` names the one the pool holds. */
+export interface DraftLog {
+  remember(sessionEpoch: number, params: Params): void;
+  /** The pool's last resolved configure (`DriverStatus`) and its draft's params; null before one or for an unknown draft. */
+  configured(status: { readonly poolEpoch: number | null; readonly sessionEpoch: number | null }): ConfiguredDraft | null;
+  /** Drafts remembered. */
+  readonly size: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Configures resolve in session order, so the drafts before the configured one are never configured again and are
+ * dropped (`DriverStatus` holds no params: SP3d spec §4.5 costs a slice on the draft the workers hold).
+ */
+export function createDraftLog(): DraftLog {
+  const drafts = new Map<number, Params>();
+  return {
+    remember(sessionEpoch, params) { drafts.set(sessionEpoch, params); },
+    configured({ poolEpoch, sessionEpoch }) {
+      if (poolEpoch === null || sessionEpoch === null) return null;
+      const params = drafts.get(sessionEpoch);
+      if (params === undefined) return null;
+      for (const e of drafts.keys()) if (e < sessionEpoch) drafts.delete(e);
+      return { poolEpoch, sessionEpoch, params };
+    },
+    get size() { return drafts.size; },
+  };
+}
